en:
This "High Boy"-style hot rod was displayed at the Henry Ford Museum.

When it comes to custom cars, the U.S. ranks number one in terms of quality, volume and genre. And, by far, the oldest genre—one that is now an iconic part of American culture—is the hot rod. This was a movement that originated in the 1930s, where the Ford Model T, and later the Model A and Model B, were heavily modified by their owners. Extensive exterior modifications were performed on these cars, such as removing fenders and engine hoods, and altering the body to make chop-tops. Later, as newer and more powerful engines were developed elsewhere in the world, they then were mounted into these vehicles.

The most well-known platform for this practice was the Ford Model B. Why? Not just because it was the first car of the era to be powered by a V8, it was also quite rare—the Model B was only produced for a single year, in 1932.

The vehicle with number plate "V-3883" displayed in the Henry Ford Museum is one such car based on the Model B, carrying the nickname of "Deuce." It was built by Richard Smith of Phoenix, Arizona, in 1954, with US $2800 (a considerable sum back then) and a massive amount of time and effort. The V-3883 is a classic "highboy" style hot rod, with removed fenders, but the engine has been swapped for a <180ps> Chrysler 331 Hemi. The side panels have been cut and modified to accommodate the wide engine, and the engine covers are now part of the exterior accents. This is a car that has been crafted to the very last detail; it is a simple, yet beautiful example of the "good old days."F
zh:
在亨利·福特博物馆展出的“高脚橱”风格的改装车。

这台车的根源可追溯至20世纪30年代美国的定制车与高性能改装车文化。在当时，Ford的Model T与Model B常被玩家进行大胆的外观改造，并换上更强力的引擎。Henry Ford博物馆展出的“V-3883”换装了180 PS Chrysler 331 Hemi引擎。此车是简约美学的典范，引擎盖本身就足以成为外观上的亮点。

en:
A new era of mobility that reimagines transportation.

Sony Honda Mobility introduced the AFEELA brand at CES® 2023 and further developed it through CES 2024 as a bold new direction in mobility, aiming to transform transportation into a rich, engaging experience. At CES® 2025, the company pulled the wraps off its first production model: The AFEELA 1. The name signaled the start of a new chapter—one that represented the beginning of something revolutionary.

Much of the technology and design philosophy from the prototype was carried over to the production version. It boasts a clean and refined exterior, with a flowing shape that avoids any unnecessary styling elements. Even the door handles are gone, and all sensors—including LIDAR, radar, and cameras—have been neatly integrated into the bodywork.

Inside, the AFEELA 1 was designed as a creative entertainment space—a true mobility environment. Wide-format displays dominate the cabin, while each passenger seat has been fitted with its own sound system. Advanced noise-cancelling and spatial audio tech ensure an immersive experience for every passenger.

A standout feature is its built-in personal agent, capable of natural conversation. It learns user preferences over time, evolving into a smart companion that can assist with travel planning and engage in meaningful dialogue.

Of course, the AFEELA 1 did not forgotten that it is still a car. Electric motors, brakes, and suspension work together as one system, controlled through advanced robotics-based software to deliver a smooth and composed ride and sharp handling traits in any condition.

The vehicle is also equipped with Sony Honda Mobility’s proprietary ADAS system. The sensors of the ADAS system feed data to a high-performance ECU delivering 800 TOPS of processing power, enabling the car to assist from departure to parking with precision ad confidence.

The AFEELA 1 will be available in two trims: the AFEELA 1 Origin and AFEELA 1 Signature. The AFEELA 1 Signature, shown here, cmes stadard with 21-inch wheels, a rear entertinment system, and acenter camera monitoring setup.
zh:
全新“移动出行”座驾，颠覆传统交通理念。

AFEELA 1在CES® 2025展会上正式亮相。这款量产车型根据装饰级别共有两个配置版本可选：Origin版和Signature版。这款纯电动汽车以“创意娱乐空间”为设计理念打造豪华内饰，颠覆了传统的出行体验。它搭载了众多先进技术，包括集成在车身外部的感知设备，以及支持自然语言对话的智能助理。

en:
A revolutionary "mobility device" set to change how we spend time commuting.

"Move people, through the pursuit of innovation with diverse inspirations." Embrace cutting edge technology and create a new kind of joy in movement to inspire others. These are the reasons Sony Honda Mobility was founded in 2022. This collaboration between two distinct companies represents a fusion of diverse expertise and perspectives and resulted in the AFEELA Prototype 2024 BEV, which was unveiled at CES® 2024.

The orthodox hatchback shape with a smooth aerodynamic look suggests a blend of functionality and style, catering to the practical needs of everyday driving while maintaining a modern aesthetic appeal. The incorporation of devices such as LiDAR, image sensors, and radar indicates a strong focus on safety and advanced driver assistance. These devices also contribute to a more natural and intuitive driving experience.

The automatic opening doors—triggered by the driver's approach—introduce a seamless and convenient entry experience, eliminating the need for traditional door handles. The customizable "Media Bar" positioned towards the grille represents a novel approach to self-expression and vehicle communication.

Inside the AFEELA, the cabin is designed to captivate passengers with a multitude of features. Upon entering, the expansive dashboard display immediately catches your eye, stretching nearly the full width of the car.

This screen not only provides essential vehicle information but also offers various entertainment choices, which can also be mirrored on the seatback displays for rear passengers. Beyond music and movies, passengers can immerse themselves in a real-time 3D view of the car's surroundings captured by the sensor arrays, turning the journey into an interactive and enjoyable experience akin to playing a game. The appeal of the AFEELA continues in its ability to behve like a personal assistant, allowing passengers to interact with the ca through natural speech.

Also, the collaboration between Honda's moblity exertise and Sony's audio proficiency hasyielded an innovativ noise-canceling system. It ensres a remarkably quiet cbin. Aternatively, or those who prfer to indulge in music, the abundance of speakers delivers an unparalleled audio eperience.  It creates an exansive soundstage withinthe ehicle.
zh:
将会改变我们驾乘体验形态的革新性“移动性设备”。

AFEELA Prototype 2024是Sony Honda Mobility在2024年CES®展会上发布的纯电动汽车。该车通过众多传感设备提供自然的驾驶辅助功能，内饰方面则在仪表板和座椅靠背设置了显示屏，提供丰富的娱乐内容。AFEELA让旅途从单纯的等待变成了充实的美好时光。

en:
A futuristic-looking design featuring a large central headlight, this Abarth was first shown at the 1952 Turin Motor Show.

With the advancements in aircraft engineering during World War II, the principles of aerodynamics found their way into automotive design.

One car that typified this new approach was the B.A.T. series designed by Bertone in the 1950s. B.A.T. stands for Berlinetta Aerodinamica Tecnica.

The most renowned examples of this aerodynamic revolution were the B.A.T. 5, 7, and 9, but their predecessor was the Abarth 1500 Biposto—first seen at the 1952 Turin Motor Show.

Later called the B.A.T. 1, this car was based on a FIAT, unlike the later models which were based on Alfa Romeos. Power for its 1.5-liter engine increased to <75ps>.

The most striking aspect of this car was, without a doubt, its styling—penned by the legendary Franco Scaglione, who was then still new at Bertone. The car not only showcased his aerodynamic engineering mastery but also blended breathtaking originality with avant-garde design.

The front of this car is truly unforgettable, with triple headlights that protrude forward, and dynamic air intakes nestled between them. The large rear window adopted a two-part design, separated by a thin center pillar, which flowed gracefully into the rear section. The rear of the car was defined by pronounced vertical tail fins—a bold design element that would later become popular in American cars.

Only a single example of this car was ever built, and after its debut at the Turin Motor Show, it was acquired by the Packard Motor Car Company. Although it remained hidden from the world for many years, Chris Drake from the UK fully restored the car in recent years and presented it at the Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance in the summer of 2010, where it received the Gran Turismo Trophy.
zh:
个性化兼具精密计算的美，标志着汽车设计中融入空气动力学研究的车型。

这是1952年在都灵车展上展出过的空气动力学测试车。这台基于FIAT车型打造的测试车采用了弗朗哥·斯凯荣内魅力独具的造型风格，搭载的1.5升引擎经Abarth调校后可输出75 PS。唯一的样车在近年来参加了圆石滩经典车展，荣获Gran Turismo奖杯。

en:
The Abarth returned yet again with bolder looks and performance, this time in the form of the timeless "500."X

Abarth & C. made a welcome comeback in 2007 with the release of the Abarth Grande Punto, a model based on the FIAT Grande Punto. This legendary Italian tuning house boasts an extraordinary legacy, having created many high-performance cars throughout the years.

The following year at the Geneva Motor Show, Abarth enthusiasts finally got what they had been waiting for—the Abarth 500, based on the new FIAT 500, which was introduced in 2007.

The new FIAT 500 cleverly reimagined the second-generation model with a contemporary design. Its signature rounded styling, paired with a refreshing driving experience, made it immediately popular.

The Abarth was powered by a turbocharged 1.4-liter 4-cylinder DOHC that produced <135ps> and <21kgm> torque. This allowed the car, which weighed only <1110kg>, to reach <100km/h> in a scant 7.9 seconds and hit a top speed of <205km/h>. These performance figures clearly surpassed the standards for this segment.

The suspension setup remained unchanged, featuring MacPherson struts up front and a torsion beam at the rear. However, this model benefited from specially tuned springs and reinforced dampers. Also, it possessed a variety of electronic devices including TTC that acted like a limited-slip differential. The TTC system provided exceptional stability through corners, defying the initial expectations set by the car’s tall, rounded profile.

This car also made a bold styling statement. With its aggressive aerodynamic front and rear bumpers, pronounced side skirts, and a roof spoiler, there was no mistaking it for anything other than a true Abarth.-
zh:
Abarth的第二次回归带来了永恒经典的500，外观大方，性能卓越。

这是意大利传奇调校品牌Abarth于2007年回归后生产的FIAT 500工厂调校版。配备1.4升双顶置凸轮轴涡轮增压引擎，可输出135 PS/21.0 公斤力米，车身重量极轻，仅有1,110 公斤，该车能够在7.9秒内由0加速至100 公里/小时，最高时速达205 公里/小时。这台车配备的大尺寸保险杠、车身侧裙和车顶扰流板展现了Abarth的不屈精神。

en:
This champion race car won 12 out of 20 races in the super-competitive DTM race series.

The DTM (Deutsche Tourenwagen Meisterschaft) series allowed significant vehicle upgrades in 1993, leading to DTM cars with a wide variety of electronic control devices like ABS. The cars featured such high levels of technology that they were often referred to as "F1 in a box."

The Alfa Romeo 155 entered the DTM in 1993 and experienced success right off the bat, trouncing the formidable AMG Mercedes-Benz 190E to win its maiden race. It won 12 of 20 races that year, taking home both the Drivers' and Manufacturers' Championships. This car, known as the 155 2.5 V6 TI, was built based on the 155 sedan that appeared in 1992. The 2.5-liter 60-degree V-6 generated <420ps>, which was sent to all four wheels.

In 1995, the 155 adopted a 6-speed sequential paddle-shift semi-automatic, similar to those used by Formula 1 cars, but it wasn't enough to beat the up-and-coming Mercedes-Benz teams that year. In 1996, Alfa entered with a new 90-degree V-type engine that put out <490ps>. As a result, the 155 took 10 wins in 26 races at 13 events, besting both Mercedes-Benz (7 wins) and Opel (9 wins). However, the 155 lagged behind in points and left without retaking the title. At the end of the season, the DTM series integrated with the ITC, and the DTM was gone, for a while.

Interestingly, an Alfa Romeo 155 2.5 V6 TI was driven by former F1 driver Alessandro Nannini, whose right arm was severed in a helicopter accident in 1990. Nannini's 155 was equipped with separate gear levers that allowed him to shift with one arm.
zh:
在20场高性能DTM赛事中赢得12个冠军的真正冠军车。

155 2.5 V6 TI由Alfa Romeo开发，用于参加自1993年起允许深度改装的德国房车大师赛。该车是在92款四门155轿车基础上改装而成，采用动力输出为420 PS的2.5升60度V6引擎以及全时四驱系统。它在总共参加的20场比赛中创下辉煌记录，赢得了12场冠军。

en:
The launch edition of the 4C, limited to 1000 units, sold out almost immediately after going on sale.

While Alfa Romeo produced a number of mid-engine race cars in its day, the 4C, introduced in 2013, represents the marque’s first mass-production car that features the performance-minded layout.

Alfa Romeo engineers stressed weight reduction when developing this high-performance sports car. They installed a carbon monocoque structure that weighs only <65kg>, and combined it with a lightweight aluminum subframe. Also helping to keep the car’s curb weight low is the <1742cc> aluminum engine block that’s <22kg> lighter than its steel counterpart found in the Giulietta. As a result, the 4C tips the scales at a lean <895kg>.

The 4C’s turbocharged direct-injection inline-4 produces <240ps> and a peak torque of <35.7kgm>. It comes combined with a quick-shifting dual-clutch 6-speed gearbox that helps the 4C run from 0-<100km/h> in 4.5 seconds and reach a top speed of <258km/h>.

One would assume that performance figures from a car with such a modest engine output would be improbable, but the lightweight nature of the 4C makes it possible. It also looks the part of an exotic car, sporting a design theme based on the famous Tipo 33/2 Stradale.

Alfa Romeo included a limited-edition model, whose production run was 1000 units, in the 4C lineup. This car, which commemorated the launch of the 4C, came equipped with special carbon headlight bezels, door mirrors and a rear spoiler, as well as a sports suspension system and sports exhaust. This model sold out immediately. As for the base 4C, well, potential customers had to endure a long waiting list as the car’s production couldn’t meet the high demand.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo._
zh:
1000台车瞬间销售一空。4C的限量版，性能达到超级跑车水平。

4C Gr.3基于Alfa Romeo新一代中置跑车4C制造，是一款经改装后满足Gr.3组别标准的赛事认证车型。该车在稳定性和空气动力学方面得到了精心考量，轴距延长了110毫米，前悬延长约30毫米。4C Gr.3在蜕变成一款能够承受强大动力的赛车的同时，仍保留了原版出色的过弯能力。

Alfa Romeo于2013年发布的首款量产中置引擎跑车。该车从经典的Tipo 33/2 Stradale的造型中汲取了大量灵感。1,742 立方厘米的4缸引擎可输出240 PS/35.7 公斤力米，与极致轻盈的车身相结合，使该车能够在4.5秒内加速至100 公里/小时，最高时速达258 公里/小时。“Launch Edition”是一款特别版车型，全球限量1000台。

en:
Equipped with DOHC V-8, this exquisite coupe was produced by Alfa Romeo in the pre-war period.

Before World War II, Alfa Romeo was a small automotive manufacturer that specialized in creating race machines and upscale road cars. The most notable model from this era was the 8C that appeared in 1931.

The name 8C actually refers to the company's 8-cylinder powerplant. Designed by renown engineer, Vittori Jano, this water-cooled engine featured the latest technology of its day, including dual overhead cams (DOHC) and a hemispherical combustion chamber. The 1937 8C 2900B, the last in the 8C line, had 2.9 liters of displacement and came equipped with twin superchargers, enabling the engine to produce <180ps>. Two different versions of the chassis were available, with varying wheelbases, allowing customers to choose a number of different body styles from their favorite Carrozzerias.

The Alfa Romeo 8C 2900B Touring Berlinetta is a gorgeous coupe created by Carrozzeria Touring, utilizing the company's Superleggera (Superlight) technology. Thanks to its engine, it boasted race car performance, making it one of the most heralded super sports cars of its day. Rumor has it that only five of these cars were ever produced.
zh:
这款精致的双门跑车配备了双顶置凸轮轴8缸引擎，由Alfa Romeo在战前时期生产。

顾名思义，Alfa Romeo 8C 2900B Touring Berlinetta是由Carrozzeria Touring用超轻结构技术打造的精致双门轿跑。“8C”指的是引擎的8个气缸。液冷直列式8缸引擎出自天才设计师维托瑞·加诺之手，性能表现直逼赛车。据说这台车总共仅生产了5台。

en:
This car marked Alfa Romeo's return to the rear-drive coupe and possessed a top speed of <290km/h> plus.

The first FR Alfa Romeo coupe since the SZ was given a very traditional and legendary name. The 8C is the name of the engine which had made Alfa Romeo famous for their technical excellence in the 1920s, that was designed by the famous Vittorio Jano. This was a famous and revolutionary 8-cylinder power unit that was not only used in the red racing machines of the Alfas in that era, but also by many different manufacturers at the time.

The front dashboard's classic look brings to mind its background and has been applied to all models coming after the 8C as the new family trademark of Alfa Romeo. The very Alfa-esque emotional design is a major identifier, and the orders for the limited run of 500 cars worldwide was full almost as soon as it was announced.

The car weighs <1585kg> and the weight distribution is slightly towards the rear at 49 to 51. To achieve this, the body combines a steel frame with carbon. Many aspects of the power unit are shared with Maserati, but Alfa Romeo has tuned its performance and sound. The 4.7-liter <450ps> V8 engine is matched with a trans-axle Q select 6-speed semi automatic. Alfa Romeo states that its exciting sound is compliant with all of the sound regulations set in various countries around the world.

With a top speed of over <290km/h> and a 0-<100km/h> acceleration of 4.2 seconds or less, its styling may be classic, but its performance is nothing short of a modern-day super sports car.
zh:
Alfa Romeo后轮驱动双门轿车回归，最高速度超过290 公里/小时。

初代8C得名于维托瑞·加诺设计的8缸引擎。在其经典造型下，隐藏着Alfa Romeo调校的4.7升V8引擎，动力输出达450 PS，最高时速可达290 公里/小时，0-100 公里/小时加速时间不到4.2秒，让不少同期的超级跑车都相形见绌。这台车全球限量仅500台，发售的一瞬间便被抢购一空。

carNameEn: Alfa Romeo GIULIA TZ2 carrozzata da ZAGATO '65
en:
Both in style and substance, this car represented all that was good about sports cars in the 1960s.

Established just north of Milan, Italy, in a town called Monza in 1919, Carrozzeria Zagato became one of the most heralded coach-builders of its day. It was primarily known for producing lightweight car bodies that borrowed technology from aircraft manufacturing. Alfa Romeo, which had been producing sports cars since before World War II, met with amazing racing success with Zagato-built bodies. This collaboration continued even after the war, and together they went on to create many significant cars that have now become part of automotive history.

One of the notable examples was the TZ introduced in 1962. The TZ, whose name stands for Tubolare Zagato, was a road car that could also double as a race car. It featured an aerodynamic aluminum body on a steel tubular space frame, helping it to weigh in at a lean <660kg>. Supplying the power was a DOHC 1.6-liter engine from the Giulia that produced <112ps> at <6500rpm>.

Unlike the original TZ, the 1965 TZ2 was a pure race car, with a production run of only 10 to 12 units. Rumor has it that many original TZ owners preferred a pure race version of their cars, so they returned them to the factory to be refitted as the TZ2.

What differentiated the TZ2 from the TZ was its fiber glass body that made it <40kg> lighter. It also sported a lower nose and roof that resulted in better aerodynamics. Its engine was also upgraded using the same twin-ignition head from the GTA. The result was 170 HP at <7500rpm> and a top speed of <245km/h>, up from the TZ's <215km/h>.
zh:
来自60年代的优美经典车型。

这辆赛道机器是Alfa Romeo和Carrozzeria Zagato联手打造的产物。它的车身设计借鉴了经典车型TZ，但外壳换用了纤维强化塑料，为了优化空气动力学性能，还降低了车头和车顶的高度。在动力方面，它采用了一部由Giulia GTA打造的双火花塞点火引擎，能够输出165 PS的动力，最高时速更是达到了245 公里/小时。

en:
The top-of-the-line model in the Giulia lineup celebrated 110 years of Alfa Romeo.

In 2020, special editions of the Alfa Romeo Giulia were introduced to celebrate the 110th anniversary of the historic company. The cars were called the Giulia GTA and GTAm, which were based on the high-performance Quadrifoglio model.

For these cars, the power output of the twin-turbocharged 2.9-liter V-6 was increased to <540ps>, while curb weight was reduced by <100kg>. Also, the front and rear track were widened by <50mm> to enhance the car's stability, while the cars' aerodynamics were significantly enhanced in the form of new front and rear fenders, as well as other redeisgned body parts, thanks to help from Alfa Romeo's Formula 1 partner, Sauber.

The GTAm offers a more hardcore setup designed for circuit use. In addition to a larger front splitter and carbon fiber rear wing, a roll-cage was installed and the rear seats were removed.
zh:
这款车是Giulia系列的巅峰之作，也是对Alfa Romeo 110年历史的纪念。

2020年，Alfa Romeo为庆祝品牌成立110周年，特别推出了Giulia的“GTA”和“GTAm”特别版车型。2.9升V6双涡轮增压引擎的功率提升至540 PS，同时通过减重和加宽轮距进一步强化性能表现。GTAm车型专为赛道使用而设计，配备了大型前定风翼、碳纤维尾翼和防滚架等极致的硬核配置。

carNameEn: Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GT Veloce '67
sourceName: Alfa Romeo Giulia Sprint GT Veloce '67
en:
An iconic 1960s high-performance coupe from Alfa Romeo

The first generation Giulia was marketed from the 1960s to the 1970s and proved to be a huge hit for Alfa Romeo. The Giulia was available only as a 4-door sedan when it went on sale in 1962, but a coupe version was added to the line up in 1963. This first coupe was called the Sprint GT.

It was designed by a young Giorgetto Giugiaro, who was with Carrozzeria Bertone at the time. The car's body consisted of smooth lines and soft curves, with a characteristic edge at the front. The beauty of the car has made it popular among classic-car enthusiasts to this day.

The Giulia Sprint GT came powered by a 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4. Producing <106ps> and <14.2kgm> torque, it propelled the lightweight <950kg> body to a top speed of <180km/h>.

The car was extremely popular with driving enthusiasts because of its compact lightweight body, which translated to exceptional handling and acceleration. All of this allowed the Giulia Sprint GT to overcome the test of time, being produced until 1977.
zh:
Alfa Romeo在1960年代推出的标志性高性能双门跑车。

Alfa Romeo首代Giulia系列于1962年问世，最初为四门轿车，1963年增加了Sprint GT双门轿跑版本。车身由乔治亚罗设计，线条流畅，表面弧度柔美。Sprint GT凭借出色的高性能跑车表现深受喜爱，生产周期持续至1977年。

en:
Alfa Romeo's MiTo hatchback brings a dash of Italian flair to the compact car segment.

Since its debut in 2000, the 147 had served as Alfa Romeo’s entry-level model, but in 2008, the 3-door MiTo took over this role in the lower B-segment.

The "Mi" in MiTo stands for Milan, where Alfa Romeo's design studios are located. The "To'" refers to Turin (Torino in Italian), where the car was manufactured. And the word "mito" in Italian translates to "myth" or "legend," adding a layer of meaning to the name.

One size smaller than the 147, the MiTo was crafted at Alfa Romeo’s design center. The car's overall styling, particularly the front and rear, invoke the spirit of the 8C Competizione. Alfa Romeo fans embraced the MiTo’s appearance, which they felt exuded an ideal balance of charming, classic styling and modern, cutting-edge aesthetics.

While the MiTo shared components with the FIAT Grande Punto, it was tuned to deliver the unmistakable flavor of an Alfa Romeo. When it was introduced, many hailed the MiTo as the best in its class, praising its blend of responsive handling and exceptional controllability.

Under its hood resided a turbocharged 1.4-liter DOHC inline-4. The 1.4 Sport model, which came with a 6-speed manual gearbox, produced <155ps> and <23.5kgm> torque. The MiTo sprinted from 0 to <100 km/h> in 8.0 seconds and hit a top speed of <215 km/h>, making it among the sportiest cars in its class.,
zh:
外形可爱，操控性能和可控性都极佳。

这是一款市场定位为B级车的三门掀背车，也是Alfa Romeo的前代入门级车型147的替代者。它的名字来源于两座在Alfa Romeo发展史上非常重要的城市，米兰和都灵。1.4 Sport车型的标准动力单元是一部1.4升双顶置凸轮轴涡轮增压引擎，能够输出155 PS/23.0 公斤力米，并配以一套6速手动变速箱。它拥有215 公里/小时的最高时速，并且能够在8.0秒内完成0-100 公里/小时的加速，在同级别车中拥有鹤立鸡群的实力。

en:
The swoopy rear-engined Alpine was powered by a Renault engine.

When it came to high-performance lightweight vehicles, the A110, created by French car maker Alpine, had few equals. The svelte coupe, which was produced from 1961 to 1977, featured a rear-engine/rear-drive layout (RR) that translated to amazing cornering prowess and incredible traction.

In 1963, the A110 was powered by a 1.1-liter engine, and for the next few years, displacement was incrementally increased. Then in 1968, the 1600S was introduced, equipped with a <1565cc> powerplant that came from the Renault 16. In 1973, this engine was swapped out for a <1605cc> unit from the Renault 17. During this time, the car's handling capabilities saw upgrades as well, going to a double wishbone rear suspension and smaller-diameter tires.

There were many variations to the 1600S, but three models are worth noting: the 1600SC, a French domestic model with twin Weber 45DCOE carburetors; an export version called the 1600SI with fuel injection, and the easy-to-drive 1600SX. The first two models possessed engines that delivered <140ps>/<6000rpm> and mated to a 5-speed manual gearbox. The top speed for both vehicles was rated at <210km/h>, quite impressive for a car with only a <1600cc> engine. The secret was its lightweight nature; it tipped the scales at around <700 kg>. As for the 1600SX, sold from 1976, it was a tamer model than its predecessors, with a de-tuned engine that produced <95ps>/<6000rpm>, enabling it reach a modest top speed of <190km/h>. That said, the 1600SX was easier to drive and was popular with people with no interest in motorsports.

Speaking of motorsports, the A110 was a successful rally car, winning a number of races in the 1970s. During the 1970-1972 seasons, it participated in the International Championship for Manufacturers, winning several races in Europe. As a result, it was considered ne of the greatest rally machines of its day. The A110 remained popular een after its successor, the A310 debuted in 1971. A total of 7160 cars ere prouced until the end of its production in1977.
zh:
Alpine汽车的典范，超轻后驱跑车的巅峰。

Alpine A110这台经典法国跑车在拉力赛领域拥有辉煌的历史传承。凭借后置式引擎布局带来的卓越牵引力与超轻车身，它席卷国际拉力赛事，斩获无数胜利。A110在1963年首次出战时搭载的是1.1升引擎，此后为应对竞争，引擎排量逐年提升。终极型号当属采用1.6升引擎的1600S。

en:
This lightweight sports car from the reborn Alpine brand combined elegance with performance.

Renault revealed the new Alpine A110 at the 2017 Geneva Auto Show, signaling the spiritual return of the iconic brand that celebrated driving excitement and high performance.

The new A110’s aluminum bodywork came ripe with the latest aerodynamic technologies, as it sat wide and low to the ground. Thanks to a lightweight and rigid aluminum chassis, the A110 tipped the scales at a lean <1100kg>. Mounted amidships was a new turbocharged 1.8L inline-4 that produced <252ps> and 320Nm (<32.6kgm>) of torque. It came mated to a Getrag 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. Together, the powertrain helped the A110 accelerate from 0 to <100km/h> in 4.5 seconds and reaches a top speed of <250km/h>. Handling was supplied by a double wishbone suspension setup at all four corners.

The model presented in Geneva was the Premiere Edition, limited to a production run of 1955 units. It featured special 18-inch aluminum wheels with a matte black diamond-turned finish and a lightweight sports exhaust. The cabin included carbon fiber ornamentation, aluminum pedals and sports seats as standard equipment.
zh:
Alpine品牌复活后出品的轻型跑车杰作，兼具优雅的外观和高超的性能。

经典的Alpine A110在全球拉力赛中表现出色。2017年，Renault重振Alpine品牌，推出新一代Alpine A110，延续这一传奇。这款新车型采用的铝制车身让人联想到经典的A110，中置1.8升4缸涡轮增压引擎可输出252 PS/32.0 公斤力米。特别版“Première Édition”全球限量1955台。

en:
Not only a maker of dominant rally cars, the noted French car company also forayed into road machines.

Many race aficionados know that Alpine is a revered marque in the rallying world, as the A110 remains one of the most successful rally cars in history. That said, the French automaker also carved out a niche on the tarmac with a series of successful prototype race cars in the 1960s, among them being the M63 (1963) and the M64, which was followed by the M65 in 1965. The M cars were succeeded by the A210, introduced in 1966, which went on to take the top three spots of the energy efficiency index of the 1967 24 Hours of Le Mans.

While the A210 managed to take a few class victories in various races in 1967, Alpine wanted the overall title at the 1968 24 Hours of Le Mans, so it went to work on a machine that could accomplish this feat. The result was the A220 that came powered by a new 3.0-liter V-8 that produced <300ps> and weighed <80kg> less than the A210. While it was decidedly quicker than the A210, the A220 failed to meet Alpine's lofty goals, but it remains as one of the most loved models of Alpine today because it was the final race car built exclusively by the company before it became part of the Renault Group.
zh:
Alpine的另一面：搭载3升V8引擎的LeMans赛车。

得益于A110的卓越表现，Alpine作为拉力赛品牌广为人知。而到了20世纪60年代，Alpine还研发过原型赛车，这些车型在赛道上同样战绩斐然。其中，1968年首秀的A220最具问鼎勒芒24小时耐力赛总冠军的潜力。尽管正赛中该车故障频发，成绩未达预期，但至今仍被车迷视为Alpine经典车型之一。

en:
A legendary brand's glimpse of the ultimate future sports car.   v

Alpine, the French sports car brand par excellence, has returned! After the A450 Le Mans prototype won in the European Endurance Championship in 2013, and with the revival of the company in February 2016, Alpine continued to ride its successful streak by introducing a new A110 car in 2017.

Since the company was founded in the mid-1950s, it has built a reputation for creating performance cars built with passion. They were lightweight, agile and extremely elegant. Race versions of them took on, and defeated, those from other, much larger, automobile manufacturers.

In March 2015, Alpine introduced Gran Turismo players to a new sports car that was as unique as it was fascinating: the Alpine Vision Gran Turismo. This sleek and distinctive machine—developed exclusively for the world’s most famous driving simulation game—was created by the same dedicated designers and engineers who work on the company's future production models. So it should come as no surprise that the Alpine Vision Gran Turismo explored the key Alpine themes of agility, performance and style to the maximum.

Agility has always been a defining characteristic of Alpine's road cars. They have all been engineered to corner as if they were part of the driver, making operating an Alpine car a fun and exciting experience. Because the cars are lightweight, they respond quickly and efficiently to driver inputs. On top of that, they exuded a classy, unqiue sense of style that made them the center of attention on the race track or public roads.

The Alpine Vision Gran Turismo, in its own distinctive way, possessed every single one of these ingredients.

Loyal fans will no doubt notice a nod to yesteryear's Alpine race cars in the rear styling of the Vision Gran Turismo (VGT). Look closely, and you can see in the details elements of the A20, an energy-efficient race car that won its class at the 1966 24 Hours o Le Mans. There are also hints of the A442B, the overall winner of the 978 Le ans race, and the A450, which won the LP2 category in the 213 ELMS competition. Players unamiliar with past Alpine can apreciate the GT's low-slung lanks and aerodynamic body. There are also plenty of rich creative elements to the ar, including the side air rakes.

融合Alpine汽车过去与未来的瑰宝。

这是法国著名品牌Alpine为《跑车浪漫旅》玩家专门设计的单座跑车。它的设计秉承了Alpine“速度与激情融于造型”的理念，同时也是对经典Alpine车型的致敬。这台革命性的车架起了公路与赛道、虚拟与现实之间的桥梁。

en:
Modified by Amuse, this Z car not only looked great, but also underwent a major weight reduction.

One of the most notable versions of the 350Z (Z33) was the Version NISMO Type 380RS. Created by the motorsports arm of Nissan, the NISMO 380RS possessed many technologies that were developed for the race track.

With only 300 units produced, the 380RS featured a stiffer body structure than the base car, reinforced brakes, tuned suspension, front and rear aerodynamic bumpers and a new rear spoiler. Under the hood was a VQ35HR 3.8-liter V-6 that was detuned for road use. Output was rated at <350ps> at <7200rpm> and <40.5kgm> of torque that peaked at <4800rpm>.

Tuning firm Power House Amuse took this car and worked its own magic on it. Called the Amuse NISMO 380RS Super Leggera, the car had a different compression ratio and upgraded intake and exhaust systems that resulted in <386ps> and <41.8kgm> of torque. Also, as its name implies, curb weight was reduced by <140kg> by extensive use of carbon fiber and titanium.

This car made its public debut at the 2008 Tokyo Auto Salon where it received the Gran Turismo Award.
zh:
一辆由Amuse改装的380RS。Z系列中的杰作，经过了大幅的减重。

Version NISMO Type 380RS是NISMO基于Z33 Fairlady Z打造的改装完成车。Power House Amuse进一步调校出了Amuse NISMO 380RS Super Leggera。正如它名字中的“Super Leggera”标签（意大利语中“超轻”的意思）所说，最显著的改进是高达140 公斤的减重。

en:
Development engineers of Gran Turismo contributed with Amuse to build this ultimate S2000.

Powerhouse Amuse knows a thing or two about tuning the S2000, whether the venue be a winding mountain road or a high-speed race track. Among its more notable creations is the S2000 GT1.

The design of the unique full-body kit was actually created through cooperative development with Polyphony Digital. Not just for looks, the Amuse S2000 GT1 boasts awesome aerodynamic performance, equal to that of full racing machines, especially its long nose that provides downforce at the front of the car. Hideki Tanabe, the president of Powerhouse Amuse and a driving expert himself, widened the car to <1829mm>, while reducing weight as much as possible. He did so by incorporating carbon-fiber parts wherever possible and replacing other components with lighter materials. As a result, the total weight of the car was reduced to approximately <1120kg>.

According to Amuse, the base F20C engine's displacement was increased to 2.3 liters and combined with a GT30Pro-S turbine. The addition of the turbocharger required reinforcement of the engine block and other parts, but it was well worth it, as output of the Amuse S2000 GT1 is a whopping <626ps> and <53kgm> of torque, giving the car an incredible weight-to-power ratio of <1.79kg> per <1ps>. Shifting is done via a 7-speed gearbox with paddle shifters, which makes the Amuse S2000 fit to attack any track on the planet.
zh:
跑车浪漫旅的开发工程师参与了Amuse的终极S2000开发。

Power House Amuse以丰富的S2000调校经验而著称，其终极成就便是S2000 GT1。这套碳纤维车身套件是与Polyphony Digital合作开发的。尽管车身宽度增加至1,829毫米，但整车的重量降低到大约1,120 公斤。引擎也得到了优化，马力重量比实现了每1 PS仅1.79 公斤。

en:
Aston Martin's successor to the DB9 featured a new futuristic design theme."

Introduced at the 2016 Geneva Motor Show, the DB11 represents all that is good about Aston Martin. It succeeds the popular DB9, which proudly represented the brand for 12 years.

The styling of the DB11 follows Aston Martin tradition, characterized by the brand's signature long nose and elegant wind-cutting profile. Aston Martin's Vice President and Chief Creative Officer, Marek Reichman, made sure the new coupe was instantly recognizable as an Aston, while imrproving aerodynamic efficiency. With airflow strategically guided around and under the body, the DB11 exhibits less lift at high speed and generates more downforce than its predecessor.

The DB11 is built on a new bonded-aluminum VH platform with a completely new design evolved from past models. Under the hood is a newly-developed twin-turbo 5.2-liter V-12. It produces <608ps> and <71.4kgm> of torque and comes mated to ZF 8-speed gearbox, allowing the super sports coupe to run to <100km/h> in 3.9 seconds and reach a top speed of <322km/h>.
zh:
阿斯顿·马丁的下一代DB9，外观新颖，未来感十足。

在2016年日内瓦车展上亮相的这台车便是最典型的Aston Martin。在延续品牌标志性轮廓的同时，这台车新颖的现代设计细节与过往车型形成鲜明对比。搭载一台新开发的5.2升V12双涡轮增压引擎，输出可达608 PS/71.0 公斤力米，搭配ZF 8速自动变速箱，DB11能够实现超级跑车级别的速度，0-100 公里/小时加速时间为3.9秒，最高时速可达332 公里/小时。

en:
This historic 1950s race car won the Pebble Beach Gran Turismo Trophy.

Aston Martin's DB3S, based on the DB3 and developed under the guidance of David Brown, was a successful race car through the mid-1950s. In this era when not much separated race cars from sports cars, the DB3 was essentially a custom-built machine for the track, using many parts from the DB2.

The DB3S was a modernized version of the DB3, with a more curvaceous body for better aerodynamics, and an extra rigid and lighter body for better overall performance. The inline-6 engine started out life producing <166ps>, but then output was increased to <185ps>, and then to <228ps> and then ultimately to <243ps>. The car was a definite monster on the track, securing victories on both British soil as well as around the world.

Only 31 examples of the DB3S were produced. The car with vehicle chassis No. 1 received the Gran Turismo Trophy at the famous Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance in 2013.
zh:
来自1950年的赛车，曾荣获圆石滩车展的Gran Turismo奖项。

20世纪50年代赛车场上的常客。以基础版DB3为范本，这辆车拥有更短的轴距，更轻的车身重量和优化后的空气动力学效应。直列6缸引擎最初可输出228 PS，但经过调校后达到243 PS。这台车在2013年圆石滩车展荣获“Gran Turismo奖杯”。

en:
This classic sports car from the 1960s, as well as its most famous driver, James Bond, put Aston Martin on the international sports-car map.

One of the most recognizable classic cars today is the Aston Martin DB5, and that's because it has been the automobile of choice of a certain fictitious super spy named James Bond. First appearing in the Bond film Goldfinger, the DB5, introduced in 1963, was built by Italian coachbuilder Carrozzeria Touring using Touring's patented "Superleggera" super light construction methods.

The DB5 was powered by a tuned version of the DB4's inline-6, but with displacement increased to 4.0 liters, it produced a hearty <285.9ps>, while the high-performance Vantage model pumped out <318.4ps>. These numbers exceeded the output of some V-12-equipped sports cars of the day, making Aston Martin owner Sir David Brown ("DB") one of the most significant automobile manufacturers of his time.
zh:
这辆60年代跑车设计的杰作因成为邦德专用座驾而名声大噪。

Aston Martin DB5于1963年问世。这台跑车由意大利Carrozzeria Touring设计，采用Superleggera超轻结构技术降低车身重量。标准车型引擎能输出285英制马力（285.9 PS），而Vantage版的动力更是高达314英制马力（318.4 PS）。它被誉为60年代初超级跑车的代表作之一。该车还因多次成为詹姆斯·邦德系列电影中的“邦德座驾”而声名鹊起。

en:
This GT1 race car based on the Aston Martin DB9, commemorated the marque's return to international motorsports.

The Aston Martin DBR9 GT1, built to compete in GT1 races, was based on the DB9 and named after the DBR1, the first DB series race car that finished 1-2 in the 1959 24 Hours of Le Mans.

With its chassis and body structure thoroughly reinforced, the DBR9 GT1 featured carbon fiber body panels (except the roof) and a completely stripped interior. Other weight-saving measures resulted in a car that tipped the scales at a lean <1100kg>, which is more than <600kg> less than the DB9 road car.

The car's aerodynamics were enhanced by way of a new front spoiler, side skirts, rear diffuser and wing. The 5.9-liter V-12 was tuned to raise its power from the <456ps>/<58.1kgm> of the DB9 to <608ps>/<71.4kgm>. The engine came mated to an Xtrac 6-speed sequential transmission.

The DBR9 GT1 won its debut race at the 2005 Sebring 12-hour event, and proved a menace on the track all the way until the GT1 category was discontinued at the end of 2011. In 2006, it won the team and drivers' titles in the ACO Le Mans Series, and took the FIA-GT manufacturers' title. In 2007 and 2008, it won the GT1 class of the 24 Hours of Le Mans two years in a row.
zh:
Aston Martin回归国际赛车运动，带来一辆基于DB9改装的GT1赛车。

Aston Martin DBR9 GT1由Aston Martin Racing专为GT1组别打造，以DB9为基础，于2005年投入生产。车身采用碳纤维结构实现轻量化，与之搭配的是一台5.9升V12引擎以及6速序列式变速箱。初战即在赛百灵12小时耐力赛夺冠，并在2007至2008年蝉联勒芒24小时耐力赛GT1组冠军。

carNameEn: Aston Martin DP-100 Vision Gran Turismo
sourceName: Aston Martin DP-100 Vision Gran Turismo
en:
A glimpse of the ultimate British sports car of the future.

Joining the Vision Gran Turismo’s exciting stable of conceptual virtual super cars is the Aston Martin Design Prototype 100, or DP-100 for short. This exciting machine—developed by the brand’s styling team led by its director, Marek Reichman, at the company’s headquarters in Gaydon, Warwickershire—is not merely a design study, but one that’s been engineered to perform at the highest levels.

Reichman’s team utilized many of the same techniques applied to the company’s real-life sports cars, including using hand sketches and 3D modeling. Thus, the DP-100 features an exceptionally high level of detail, most notably in the suspension system and in its electronics. Residing behind the car’s cockpit is a twin-turbocharged V-12 that produces upwards of 800 BHP (<811ps>) that allows the DP-100 to accelerate like a pure-bred race car.

Like Aston Martin’s centenary celebration concept car, the CC100 Speedster, some of the design elements of the DP-100, including the light blade rear lamps, might find their way into future Aston Martin production models. Could the DP-100 be in the future of the world’s most famous spy? We’d like to think so.
zh:
真正的高性能跑车，让人一窥Aston Martin未来的方向。

这款Vision Gran Turismo由Aston Martin的马雷克·瑞克曼带领的设计团队亲手完成。该车在沃里克郡盖登的Aston Martin总部以与量产车相同的流程进行开发。它的动力单元是一台800BHP（811 PS）V12双涡轮增压引擎。DP-100还被用作Aston Martin未来技术和设计的先行探索车型。

en:
This handsome supercar was limited to 77 units, and could very well be the most desirable British car ever.

Taking center stage at the 2008 Paris Motor Show was a special camouflaged sports car from noted supercar manufacturer, Aston Martin. This car would ultimately become the now legendary One-77, named thus because its production run was limited to a mere 177 units. The car made its official introduction at the 2009 Geneva Motor Show.

At first glance, the One-77 was obviously an Aston Martin, as it possessed the styling cues of other modern high-profile Aston models, namely the DB9 and DBS. That said, the One-77 did sport a unique, more exotic shape that gave it better aerodynamics than its stablemates.

Developed from the ground-up, the One-77’s chassis was a joint effort by Aston Martin and Multimatic. It combined a carbon monocoque tub with handmade aluminum panels, while the suspension featured an inboard double-wishbone geometry that was similar to those of many race cars.

Cosworth helped with the engine. Starting with the company’s 6.0-liter V12, displacement was increased to <7312cc>, which resulted in a whopping <760ps>/<76.5kgm>…the highest output of any normally aspirated engine to date. What’s more, all this displacement and extra power came in a more compact package. Because the actual size of the engine decreased by 25 percent when compared to the 6.0-liter, Aston Martin engineers were able to mount it <100mm> lower than usual and nearly <260mm> behind the front axle. This provided a low center of gravity and excellent front/rear weight distribution, which made the One-77 one of the best handling production cars in the world.
zh:
Aston Martin仅有77辆的限量版车型。

这是Aston Martin在2009年推出的全新旗舰车型。虽然外观上与DB9和DBS非常近似，但其实它是一款从头开始设计的特殊车型。其动力单元采用了一部与Cosworth联合开发的7.3升V12引擎，动力输出达到了760 PS/76.0 公斤力米，是有史以来量产车中性能最强大的自然进气引擎。这款车起初在英国官方公布的售价为120万英镑。但在2011年初开始交车后，全部77台车在一年时间内便被抢购一空。

en:
A well-balanced, high-performance car that immediately became a familiar presence on race podiums.(

One of the most visually stunning race cars on the planet is the Aston Martin V12 Vantage GT3, which has been competing on the international motorsports stage since 2012, after replacing the vaunted DBR9/DBRS9.

The GT3 race car is based on the flagship in the Aston Martin lineup, the V12 Vantage, which first made its appearance in 2009. The production model came equipped with a 5.9-liter V-12 that produced <517ps> and <58.1kgm> of torque, which was stuffed into a light and sturdy body that allowed it to run from 0-<100km/h> in 4.2 seconds and reach a top speed of <305km/h>.

For the race car, Aston Martin tuned the engine to <600ps> and torque was increased to <71.4kgm>. Also, the stock gearbox was swapped out for an XTrac sequential transmission with paddle shifters. After shedding unwanted weight to a lean <1250kg> while establishing an ideal 50:50 front/rear weight distribution, the V12 Vantage GT3 was ready to rock.

The car’s exterior looks a lot meaner than the road-going car because of FIA GT3 regulations that called for a gigantic front spoiler lip, huge rear wing and larger fenders.

The race teams around the world that purchased the V12 Vantage GT3 were impressed from its first year on the circuit. In 2012, the Aston Martin race car piled up 18 wins and 30 podium finishes. In 2013, it scored 17 wins and 34 podium finishes, which just went to prove that the car ran as good as it looked.
zh:
平衡性良好的高性能车型，立即就成为了领奖台上的常客。

这款纯正的赛车从2012年开始参加GT赛事，延续了它的前代车型DBR9和DBRS9的辉煌纪录。这款车基于V8 Vantage的车身打造，其前挡泥板得到了拓宽，还加装了一部大尺寸尾翼，而车重也被削减到仅1,250 公斤的水平。其V12引擎经过精心调校，能够输出600 PS/71.0 公斤力米，并搭配了一套带换挡拨片的XTrac序列式变速箱。在之后的时间里，这款车在全世界范围内的各条赛道上都献上了精彩的表现。

en:
Aston Martin's Porsche 911 fighter: The new Vantage.

After a long five-year absence from the marketplace, the third-generation Vantage finally made its appearance in 2005. Before, the Vantage was a high-end sports car that touted supercar performance, but the new version was positioned at the bottom of Aston’s lineup with a competitive price tag.

Referred by some as “the baby Aston,” the new front-engine/rear-wheel-drive Vantage set its sights on the Porsche 911, hoping to lure buyers away from the popular German 2+2. Therefore, high performance was made a priority. The Vantage sported the graceful design DNA of the DB7, and it was built atop a bonded aluminum space frame called the VH platform (also found on the DB9). Thanks to this new lightweight chassis, the new Vantage tipped the scales at a lean <1570kg>, which was <400kg> lighter than the previous model.

The Vantage came powered by a 4.3-liter V-8 that shared the same block as the powerplant in Jaguar XK. The engine initially produced <385ps>, but gradual improvements kicked the power up to <406ps> in 2007. In 2008, the V8’s displacement was increased to 4.7 liters, which resulted in even more power at <426ps>. In 2011 power output peaked at <436ps> for the Vantage S model.

The top-of-the-line Vantage S not only received the high-output engine, but it had a sportier suspension via stiffer dampers, springs and bushings. Also, a quicker steering gear ratio gave the Vantage S race car-like handling, giving its rival, the Porsche 911, all it could handle on the racetrack.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.,
zh:
无论是公路还是赛道，都能提供优异性能的表现。

这辆昵称“Baby Aston”的车型旨在尽其所能提供最优秀的性能。在2005年首次亮相时，这款前置后驱跑车安装了一部4.3升V8引擎，然后在2008年，为了提升性能，引擎排量被提高到了4.7升。Vantage S是2011年推出的一款特殊高性能版本。除了高动力输出引擎之外，它还采用了更硬的悬挂和更激进的转向比，进而能够提供更敏锐的运动驾驶体验。

en:
A uniquely shaped hypercar with F1-derived aerodynamics.

Few car companies possess a rich and profound history like that of Aston Martin. Founded 110 years ago, the British car company, known for its beautiful and powerful road and race cars, recently produced the Valkyrie, developed in collaboration with Formula 1 constructor Red Bull Racing.

The design started from an idea for an innovative road car devised by Red Bull Racing's designer and aerodynamics expert, Adrian Newey, who took his proposal to Aston Martin where chief designer Marek Reichman took notice. In 2016, the project began in earnest as the "AM-RB 001," the letters standing for Aston Martin and Red Bull. The car was unveiled at the 2017 Geneva Motor Show as the AM-RB, along with its official name, the Valkyrie.

Production versions of the Valkyrie were first seen in 2021, taking form as a uniquely shaped hypercar that incorporated F1-derived aerodynamics combined with Aston Martin's design language. The front of the car featured a spoiler that directed air through Venturi tunnels in the underbody, generating massive downforce at high speed. Inside the teardrop shaped cockpit, the driver and passenger sat with their feet elevated ala an F1 car.

Extensive use of lightweight materials was implemented, including the carbon-fiber body. Even the Aston Martin nose emblem was made lighter, crafted from aluminum measuring only 70 microns wide. As a result, the car tipped the scales at roughly <1000kg>, achieving an astonishing power-to-weight ratio of <1.0kg/ps>.

Mounted aft of the cabin is a hybrid power unit that combined a naturally-aspirated 6.5-liter V-12 Cosworth engine with a KERS (Kinetic Energy Recovery System). The total output of the system was rated at <1155ps>, putting the car on par with top category racing machines.

Only 150 units of the coupe version of the Valkyrie were offeredat US $3 million, and they sold out almost immediately. Then came the "AM pro," a Le Mans style competition model, and an open-top "Spider" verson. Whaever model you chose, one thing for sur was that the Aston artin Valkyrie remains one of ahandful of hypercars to oast te performancelevels of an LM1 machine.
zh:
造型独特的、采用F1空气动力学理念的终极跑车。

Valkyrie超级跑车由红牛车队和Aston Martin联合开发。前翼悬挂在高车鼻前部下方，整个车身底板设计成风道结构，可产生巨大下压力。这款车搭载6.5升自然进气V12引擎，配备KERS（动能回收系统）混合动力配置。总系统输出达到1,155 PS，在性能上接近顶级赛车水准。

en:
This lightweight cornering machine has been hailed as the finest Aston Martin ever.

The name "Vantage" had long been synonymous with Aston Martin's high-performance variants, but in 2005, it emerged as its own distinct model. Relatively compact for an Aston Martin and equipped with a V-8 engine, the car would become a hit as the best handling front-engine/rear-wheel-drive car in the lineup.

The next-generation Vantage, unveiled in 2017, carried forward the fundamental principles that defined its predecessor. While sharing its platform with the DB11 V8, the Vantage featured a shorter wheelbase and shed <120kg>, transforming it into a precise cornering machine celebrated as the finest handling car in Aston Martin's storied history.

The powerplant came in the form of a Mercedes-AMG 4.0-liter V-8, producing <510ps>. Its 0-62 mph time of 3.7 seconds and top speed of 195 mph placed it in the elite supercar category.
zh:
这款轻量化的弯道之王被誉为史上最出色的Aston Martin。

Vantage作为高性能后驱跑车取得了巨大成功。2017年推出的车型在结构上与DB11 V8几乎相同，但轴距更短且减重约120 公斤，因此获得好评，被誉为Aston Martin历史上过弯操控最佳的车型。引擎采用源自Mercedes-AMG的4升V8双涡轮增压引擎，最高时速可达195英里（314 公里/小时）。

Therefore, high performance was made a priority. The Vantage sported the graceful design DNA of the DB7, and it was built atop a bonded aluminum space frame called the VH platform (also found on the DB9). Thanks to this new lightweight chassis, the new Vantage tipped the scales at a lean <1570kg>, which was <400kg> lighter than the previous model.

The Vantage came powered by a 4.3-liter V-8 that shared the same block as the powerplant in Jaguar XK. The engine initially produced <385ps>, but gradual improvements kicked the power up to <406ps> in 2007. In 2008, the V8’s displacement was increased to 4.7 liters, which resulted in even more power at <426ps>. In 2011 power output peaked at <436ps> for the Vantage S model.
