zh:
无论是公路还是赛道，都能提供优异性能的表现。

这个跑车浪漫旅原创车型是Aston Martin的中档跑车“Vantage”按照Gr.4规则进行改装的版本。它配备了一台动力澎湃的V8引擎，能够提供强悍的直线速度性能和非常杰出的过弯能力，再加上高效的重量配比设计，让它成为了一款平衡性极佳的优秀赛车。

en:
With a mere 24 units produced, this hypercar shined on the track and became an instant collector's item.

Talk about your super exclusive exotic cars. After creating the One-77 in 2009 that was limited to a production run of 77 units, Aston Martin introduced the Vulcan at the 2015 Geneva Motor Show, which unlike the One-77 was intended only for the race track, but like its predecessor extremely limited in production. Only 24 cars were made available.

The Vulcan was built around a full carbon-fiber monocoque and body, with a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive layout. Under its hood was Aston Martin’s signature naturally-aspirated V-12, whose displacement was raised to 7.0-liters and tuned to pump out <811ps>. It was mated to an XTrac 6-speed sequential transaxle. Power was routed through a magnesium torque tube and carbon fiber drive shaft. And like a true race car, it featured a push-rod-type suspension with variable shock absorbers. It also sported carbon ceramic brake discs and driver-adjustable ABS system. The traction-control system could also be adjusted by the driver to fit his or her tastes.

Every part of the car has been optimized for lightness and strength, as it tipped the scales at a lean <1350kg>. This gave the Vulcan an amazing weight-to-power ratio of <1.66kg/ps>. A
zh:
这款纯粹的终极跑车总共只生产了24辆，只为主宰赛道而生。

这是一款赛道专用的特别版限量车型，总共只生产了24辆，汇聚了One-77项目中积累来的经验。它采用了一台前中置布局的7升V12引擎，动力输出高达811 PS，并通过一套驱动桥式传动系统得到传输。驾驶者还能够按照自己的喜好对减震器、ABS和TCS进行调整。每一名有幸购入它的车主都能够获得Aston Martin的全面技术支持，甚至还能接受专门的赛道驾驶课程。

en:
Audi's history-making LMP1 car dominated the World Endurance Championship in the 2010s.

The Audi R18 is a LMP1 class race machine developed by Audi to compete in the FIA World Endurance Championships (WEC).

The first appearance of the race machine dubbed the “R18” was in 2011. This later evolved into the “R18 Ultra” in 2012, and “R18 e-tron quattro” from 2013-2015, continually evolving over its years in competition. The Audi R18 is the successor to this series, but while it carries over the R18 name, this was a very different machine from the past iterations, developed from scratch.

First, the aerodynamics were greatly revised. The front center section looks like a very narrow version of the high nose section of an F1 machine. Between this and the left and right fenders there is a wing, also like that of a formula car. The shapes of the front and rear fenders were also changed, with positions and sizes of the wheel housing air outlets changed as well. This car had a very different style from that of the previous R18 e-tron quattro.

Another major difference is the engine. While still a 4L turbocharged diesel, the regenerative energy storage device was changed from an electric flywheel to a lithium-ion battery, and the amount of regenerative energy discharge was increased from 4MJ to 6MJ. The output of the front MGU was also greatly increased from 200 kW (<272ps>) to 350 kW (<476ps>)

In the 2016 World Endurance Championship Series, 2 cars were entered from Audi Sport Team Joest. The R18 raised constant good results by winning 2 races, placing 2nd in 5 races, and 3rd in 2 races. Ultimately they achieved a respectable 2nd place in the Constructors point rankings for the year. However Audi decided to withdraw from the World Endurance Championship Series at the end of this season.
zh:
具有划时代意义的奥迪LMP1车型，曾在21世纪初的世界耐力锦标赛中称霸赛场。

Audi R18是专为参加2016世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）所开发的车型。它的空气动力学外形得到了全面重塑，改为了F1样式的带前翼长车头，而它的再生动能释放量由4兆焦耳提高到了6兆焦耳。尽管在车厂冠军的争夺中锁定了第二的好成绩，但Audi仍在赛季临近收官时决定从WEC退赛，令人扼腕。

en:
This diesel-powered R18 TDI scored yet another victory for Audi at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 2011.

The Audi R18 TDI is a prototype race car developed by Audi to run in endurance races such as the famed 24 Hours of Le Mans. This model takes its heritage from a series of diesel-powered race cars such as the R10 in 2006 and the R15 in 2009. However, the major difference compared to previous Audi LMP1 machines is that the car features a closed body again for the first time since the 1999 R8C.

While the previous R15 produced <600ps> from its 5.5-liter V10 turbo powerplant, the R18 produces <540ps> from a 3.7-liter turbocharged V6. The closed-body design was utilized to alleviate this loss of power by improving aerodynamics. The necessity for these changes was due to the car's chief design directive: to incorporate a futuristic hybrid system, which required the car to be as light as possible. This was the main reason for choosing a lighter V6 over a more powerful V8, the cylinder count of which was perfectly allowed by race regulations. The body is, of course, a carbon monocoque, and even the gearbox housing is made of carbon fiber, to save weight. Much thought was also given to designing the 120 degree V6 that mounts a single turbo between the cylinder banks; in doing so, Audi was able to lower the center of gravity and increase airflow on both the intake and exhaust sides of the engine.

The car's racing debut was in the second race of the LMS (Le Mans Series) in May 2011. In the pinnacle of the series—the 24-hour race—the car from Team Joest, driven by Benoît Tréluyer, André Lotterer and Marcel Fässler achieved the ultimate goal, an overall win.
zh:
设计充满先锋精神。2011年勒芒24小时耐力赛的总冠军。

这是由Audi开发的一款原型赛车。虽然与采用柴油动力的R10和R15非常类似，但R18的不同之处在于它是Audi自1999年的R8C之后推出的首款封闭式车身。它的引擎与其他最近推出的车型相比动力稍逊，仅有540 PS，但全方位的减重处理和封闭式车身带来的空气动力学优势已足以弥补。2011年，这辆车在勒芒跑出了全胜的优异战绩。

en:
Engineered to the finest detail, this Audi supercar features welds measured in microns.

The Audi R8 sports car, whose foundation was based on the "Le Mans quattro" concept car shown in 2003, was a special supercar not only because it was the company's first exotic, but because it was named after the prototype race car that successfully won several consecutive championships at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The body incorporated Audi's ASF technology (Audi Space Frame), a space-frame structure made of aluminum. This helped the weight of the body and shell of the car to weigh a mere <210kg>. Audi cut no corners when it came to quality; most of the body was built by hand, and an X-ray inspection device was used to check all welds at the micron level. The center section of the rear spoiler rose at speeds above <100km/h>, improving the car's aerodynamics at high speed, while dissipating heat from the exhaust when the car was sitting still.

The 4.2 FSI engine, mounted behind the cockpit, is a direct-injection 4.2-liter V8 that produces <420ps>. The power is transferred to all four wheels via the "quattro" all-wheel-drive system, which has now become a hallmark of Audi. A viscous-coupling unit utilized for the center differential distributes 10 to 35 percent of the drive force to the front wheels.

Audi poured all of its latest technology into this supercar, implementing the Magnetic Ride system, which included dampers that utilized magnetic particles, and the R-Tronic gearbox that shifted using hydraulic pressure.
zh:
Aud超跑的焊点据称已达到微米级别，堪称完美无瑕。

尽管是基于“Le Mans Quattro”概念车开发而来，这辆量产版本跑车在命名时却投向了在勒芒表现亮眼的Audi R8赛车。这款车型使用了Audi的超轻量空间车架技术，装备了一部420 PS的4.2升V8引擎，并通过采用了粘性耦合器的Quattro系统将动力输送到全部四个车轮。2009年，产品线中又增添了5.2 FSI版本，换用了能够输出525 PS动力的5.2升V10引擎。

en:
Audi's second-generation sports car based on the Le Mans-conquering R8.

The R8 was originally a Le Mans Prototype race car. Its name and much of its technology were incorporated into a road-going version of the car, which made its debut in 2006. The R8 road car met with worldwide critical acclaim, prompting the arrival of a second-generation model in 2016.

The new R8 adopted the original car's basic formula, but there were key changes, including a new version of the lightweight Audi Space Frame constructed from lightweight materials. It also had an updated version of the quattro AWD system. While the new car's exterior styling appeared similar to that of its predecessor, most of its details here were completely new.

Inside the engine bay was the same 5.2-liter V-10 as before, but the one in the second-generation R8 produced <15ps> more, bringing total output to <540ps>. Also, the new model lineup featured the "R8 V10 Plus," which increased power to <610ps>, while adding a fixed rear wing and mechanical LSD as standard fare. The newly tuned engine allowed the R8 V10 Plus to run from zero to <100km> in a scant 3.2 seconds and reach a top speed of <330km/h>.
zh:
Audi的第二代公路跑车，与勒芒耐力赛冠军车型R8同名。

这是Audi公路跑车的第二代车型，继承了征战勒芒24小时耐力赛的原型赛车的传奇名号。这款新车型延续了前代的设计精髓，同时升级了Audi空间车架结构和"quattro"四驱系统。这款V10 Plus是高性能版本，将5.2升V10引擎的动力进一步调校至610 PS。还配置了固定式尾翼和机械限滑差速器。

en:
This updated version of a champion race car won the Nürburgring 24 Hour Race immediately after its debut.

The Audi R8 generated one of the most successful GT3 race cars ever, in the form of the R8 LMS and R8 LMS Ultra. When it came time for a new production R8 to be introduced, in March 2015, Audi took this opportunity to improve the R8 GT3 car, most notably in the safety department.

The second-generation R8 LMS featured crumple zones in front and rear, the “PS1” Audi Protection Seat from LMP machines, and a roof escape, the first ever for GT machine. With all the new safety measures, the new R8 LMS actually exceeded the safety standards of FIA-GT3 regulations for 2016.

The car’s performance was also improved, starting with aerodynamics. The new race car boasted an underbody that was almost completely flat, and came with an enlarged diffuser. Even the air circulation within the cockpit was engineered to minimize wear on the driver.

Despite the fact that the race car shared 50 percent of the parts with its production car sibling, the R8 LMS was a much meaner animal. The R8 LMS was built using the same spaceframe as the production model, but it weighed <25kg> less, thanks to new lighter materials used in the chassis. The powerful V-10, which came off the same line as the production car’s engine, was significantly retuned, and the suspension system was completely replaced. Also, the car’s 6-speed gearbox and traction control were newly developed.

The new R8 LMS made its debut at the Nürburgring 24 Hour Race, and to the surprise of almost no one, it took the overall win in the race.)
zh:
亮相之后立刻赢得纽博格林赛道24小时耐力赛的强劲GT3。

Audi R8量产车型在2015年迎来了全面改款，公司也随之推出了升级版的R8 LMS FIA-GT3规格赛车。除了在安全性和空气动力学性能方面进了重大提升之外，其传动系统和牵引力控制也更换为了最新开发的系统。在公布后不久，R8 LMS就在纽博格林24小时耐力赛上首次亮相，并拿下了全面碾压式的胜利。

en:
This evolved version of Audi's R8 LMS competed in various GT3 events across the globe.

As the name implies, the Audi R8 LMS Evo is an evolved version of the R8 LMS, a GT3-regulation race car based on the production R8 code named the Type 42. Introduced in 2009, it shined on the race track for six years, until an all-new R8 production car, the Type 45, made its debut.

What separated the R8 LMS from its production-car sibling was its superior cooling and improved aerodynamics. The front grille and rear bumper were enlarged, while air channels were added next to the headlights to provide extra cooling for the engine. The front canard wings were enlarged to provide extra downforce.

The 5.2-liter V-10 of the previous car was carried over, producing <585ps> and <56kgm>, but with curb weight reduced by <25kg> to <1200kg>, the new R8 LMS Evo was quicker and more agile than its predecessor.

Introduced at the 2018 Paris Motor Show, the R8 LMS Evo competed in and won the Gulf 12-hour race at the end of that same year.
zh:
Audi R8 LMS的进化车型，在全球各地接受各种GT3赛事的考验。

R8 LMS的进化版本。相比R8 LMS，散热和空气动力学性能得到改善，整套传动系统也经过升级，以提升赛事可靠性。引擎动力保持不变，但车身减重25 公斤，为添加压舱配重时的重量平衡调校提供了更大灵活性。2018年秋季首次亮相，年底便在海湾12小时耐力赛中夺冠，迅速证明了自身实力。

en:
A DTM machine with two victories in the Class 1 era.

The year 2019 marked a pivotal time of reform for the German Touring Car Championship (DTM). The series adopted the new Class 1 regulations, including the downsizing of engines, allowing for the possibility of shared race events with Japan's Super GT Championship.

Audi's entry in this new arena was this RS 5 DTM, powered by a brand-new engine. While the exterior retained the familiar look from the previous season, beneath the body, the naturally-aspirated 4.0-liter V-8 was replaced with a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 engine. This change resulted in a dramatic reduction in weight and improved weight distribution, while also delivering more than 600 hp, far exceeding the output of its predecessor. It was a completely new machine on the inside.

Audi entered six of these RS 5 DTM cars in 2019 through its factory DTM teams. With additional support from customer teams, the Audi RS 5 DTM was a dominant force on the grid. Among this impressive lineup, one car stood out above the rest: Car No. 33, piloted by ace driver René Rast. From the opening rounds, the car proved unstoppable, clinching victory after victory. In the final race at Hockenheim (Race 2), it achieved a pole-to-win finish, besting fellow Audi driver Nico Müller. Audi Sport Team Rosberg, with Rast at the helm, also claimed the team title, making car No. 33 a historic double-title winner.

The final round at Hockenheim was a special mixed-class event featuring Japan's Super GT500 cars, and an interleague exhibition race followed in Japan. However, the emergence of the COVID-19 pandemic led to Audi's withdrawal from the DTM. With one of its key manufacturers stepping away, the Class 1 regulations were retired after just two seasons.

Despite its short lifespan, the Audi RS 5 DTM stands as a shining representation of the ambition and innvation embodied by Class 1 regulations and has become a vital part of motrsports history. m
zh:
在Class 1时代蝉联冠军的德国房车大师赛赛车。

这是一款2019年德国房车大师赛（DTM）赛车。根据一级赛车（Class 1）引入的引擎小型化规则，引擎从4升V8改为2升直列四缸涡轮增压引擎。但后者实际上能产生比前代更强的动力，在车重和重量分布方面也更具优势。2019赛季，王牌车手雷内·拉斯特夺得车手总冠军，同时也为车队赢得团体冠军。

carNameEn: Audi Sport quattro S1 Pikes Peak '87
en:
The 1987 winner of the Pikes Peak that also set a new record that year.

When Audi introduced AWD technology to the World Rally Championships (WRC) in 1981, it changed the face of rally racing forever. Having all four wheels provide grip and traction over off-road courses gave its cars a distinct advantage over the competition. That was validated in 1982 when the company won both the Manufacturers Title and the Drivers Championship. The following year, an Audi driver won the Drivers Championship and in 1984, the company claimed both titles yet again.

The race car at the center of this amazing run was the Sports quattro. In the fall of 1983, Audi sold 200 of the 2133cc turbocharged inline-5-powered Sports quattros for Group B homologation. In the 1985 Tour de Corse, an improved version of the car, called the Sports quattro S1, also known as the Sports quattro E2 in some countries, made its debut. The car's engine was basically a carryover from the previous car, incorporating some improvements such as a misfiring (anti-lag) system, but output was increased to a staggering <600ps>. The big change came to the transmission, a 6-speed semi-automatic with a clutch sensor in the shifter. Later that year, it was also given a revised body with front spoilers and large front fenders that improved the car's aerodynamics and made it look meaner. Along with rear fenders incorporating air inlets, plus a rear wing, the car by this time had matured into the ultimate rallying quattro.

During this time, Audi also modified a WRC-spec Sports quattro S1 to hill-climb specifications and entered it in the Pikes Peak International Hill Climb. The result: Overall wins and track records in 1985 and 1987, with Michèle Mouton and Walter Röhrl behind the wheel, respectively.
zh:
1987年派克峰国际爬坡赛的冠军，并在同一年创下了当时的赛事纪录。

当Audi在1981年世界拉力锦标赛上派出运用他们的全时四驱技术的赛车出战时，如同一股风暴一般席卷了整个拉力世界。而这辆车是专为爬坡赛所改装的Sports Quattro S1拉力赛车特别版本，其设计实现了极具侵略性的地面效应。1987年，沃尔特·罗尔驾驶这辆车参加派克峰国际爬坡赛，拿下了破纪录的胜利。

en:
With its ground-breaking exterior design, this agile coupe took the sports car world by storm.

Audi was hesitant at first in producing a compact 2+2, but when the TT concept was greeted enthusiastically at the 1995 Frankfurt Motor Show, the company went to work in making the car a reality, and the TT 1998 bowed to a waiting public.

The base engine was a <180ps> 1.8-liter DOHC inline-4, the same engine that powered the A3 and A4. But the choice for enthusiasts was a retuned version with dual intercoolers that pumped out <225ps>. Because of the compact size of the TT, it was one of the most nimble cars in the marketplace. Built on the A3's platform, with the wheelbase shortened <9cm>, the TT displayed excellent cornering balance with a slight penchant for understeer. The choice for enthusiast was the all-wheel-drive version because of a more neutral turning character, helped in part by the car's double wishbone rear suspension.

The TT's popularity was increased even more by an attractive convertible version in 2000 and the addition of a 3.2-liter DOHC V-6 in 2003. With <250ps> on tap and mated to the company's revolutionary DSG twin-clutch semi-automatic gearbox, the TT became the luxury 2+2 of choice for discerning enthusiasts.
zh:
绝无仅有的未来风格设计让这款运动双门跑车吸引到了老中青车迷的目光。

Audi TT是1998年发布的运动型轿跑车。基础版搭载与Audi A3和A4相同的180 PS 1.8升直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴涡轮增压引擎，高级版本则采用同款引擎的高调校版本。2003年，3.2 quattro加入车系，搭载输出250 PS的3.2升V6引擎。匹配新一代双踏板手动“DSG”（直接换挡变速箱）变速箱。

en:
These TTs were produced specifically for the "Audi Sport TT Cup" one-make race.

The TT Cup is a purpose-built race car developed by quattro GmbH, based on the Audi TT. It was engineered specifically for the Audi Sport TT Cup, an exclusive one-make racing series launched in 2015.

While the road-going TT Coupé featured aluminum in its outer panels and upper frame, the Cup car took weight reduction even further with the use of carbon fiber in parts of its body shell. Stripped of comfort amenities, it tipped the scales at <1125kg>, more than <100kg> lighter than the lightest production version.

Both front and rear fenders were widened to accommodate 260/660R18 tires.
Aerodynamics were further refined with specially designed low-profile front and rear bumpers, while a large adjustable rear wing added significant downforce.

Under the hood resided the familiar 2.0-liter TFSI inline-4, the same engine used in the production model in Germany. While the base output remained at <31ps>, the TT Cup car featured a push-to-pass system. With the press of a button, drivers received a temporary boost of <30ps>, encouraging bold overtakes and keeping the racing fiercely competitive. It was paired with the same 6-speed S tronic dual-clutch gearbox found in the road-going TT.

The front axle was fitted with an electronically controlled Haldex hydraulic limited-slip differential, allowing the driver to fine-tune the locking ratio directly from the cockpit.

Although positioned as an entry-level racing series, the Audi Sport TT Cup often served as a support race for the prestigious DTM. Its popularity soared in 2016, when the series attracted a total of 125 participating drivers.
zh:
这些TT跑车是专为“Audi Sport TT杯”单一车种赛而生产的。

这是一款基于Audi TT，专为参加“Audi Sport TT杯”单一车种赛而生产的赛车。其车身材料部分换用了碳纤维，所有的舒适性内饰也都被拆除，从而将车重降低到了1,125 公斤。其动力系统与常规版本的TTS相同，采用了一部310 PS的2升4缸引擎，但加入了一个“按键超车”功能，可以让其在短时间内将动力输出再提升30 PS。

en:
A high-performance model, aggressively evolved from the TT.

The Audi TTS, the high-performance version of the TT, first made its debut at the North American International Auto Show in January 2008.

The powertrain combined a turbocharged 2.0-liter direct injection engine with either a 6-speed manual or 6-speed S-Tronic dual-clutch transmission. Power was rated at <272ps> and <35.7kgm> of torque. Although it possessed the same displacement as the standard turbocharged 2.0-liter model, the TTS featured a bespoke engine block, pistons and connecting rods, while the turbocharger was enhanced to increase performance. It produced <72ps> more power and <7.2kgm> more torque than the base turbocharged 2.0-liter unit found in models such as the 2.0 TFSI quattro. As a result, its 0-<100km/h> acceleration time was impressive: 5.2 seconds for the S-Tronic and 5.4 seconds for the 6-speed manual.

Aside from the standard coupe body, a convertible "Roadster" model was released in certain regions. The car came equipped with the Audi Magnetic Ride variable dampers system as standard. When selecting the sports mode from the switch on the console, the ride height dropped by <10mm>, improving handling. It also provided a more aggressive ride befitting the TTS name.

In terms of design, the exterior kept the flavor of the TT series, with special bumpers at both ends giving the car a sportier appearance. It also featured the same variable rear wing as the standard models. Inside, the seats were upholstered with a combination of Alcantara and leather, which along with the unique instrument panel, gave the car a modest yet definite look of a special grade model.
zh:
代表更高性能的车型，相比师出同门的TT，性能突飞猛进。

TTS是2008年首次亮相的TT系列中的高性能版本。动力系统采用2升直喷涡轮增压引擎，匹配6速手动或6速S-Tronic变速箱。引擎缸体、活塞和连杆均为TTS专用设计，涡轮增压器也经过升级以承受更大动力输出。传动系统采用Audi专有的全时四驱系统，S-Tronic版本0-100 公里/小时加速时间为5.2秒，手动版本为5.4秒。

en:
With more power, the sporty version of the third-gen TT took a good thing and made it even better.(

When the third-generation Audi TT bowed at the 2014 Geneva Motor Show, the design direction stayed consistent with the first two generation models, meaning it still possessed a sporty, round look. Still, a new front fascia, highlighted by a one-piece grille and R8-like headlights, ensured that this was not the same TT as before.

Despite riding on a <37mm> longer wheelbase than its predecessor, the new TT’s overall length was shortened by <8mm>, making it slightly smaller. Its compact size accentuated the car’s amazing agility, provided in part by a new, lighter Audi Space Frame, which helped decrease the curb weight of the third-gen car by <50kg>.

The TTS sports model came with a turbocharged 2.0-liter TFSI inline-4 tuned to produce <314ps> and <38.7kgm> of torque (specs of the German-market model). The powerplant came mated to a 6-speed manual gearbox that sent power to all four wheels via Audi’s renown quattro system. With the lighter body and increased engine output, the new TT was faster than before, racing from zero to <100km/h> in a scant 4.7 seconds and reaching a restricted top speed of <250km/h>. The Audi Magnetic Ride variable damper system came as standard equipment, while a dual clutch semi-automatic S Tronic transmission with launch control was available as an option.
zh:
简洁又不乏动力。第三代TT的跑车级别车型。

第三代TT于2014年公布。尽管其整体设计概念与前两代并无不同，但这款新车的外观采用了更大尺寸的单体框架格栅和R8风格的头灯，呈现出更凶猛的面貌。TTS是整个产品线中最高档的跑车型号，配备了一部4缸涡轮增压2.0 TFSI引擎，而德国本土型号还进行了精细调校，将动力输出提升到了314 PS/38.0 公斤力米。再加上连接到Quattro系统的6速手动变速箱，提供令人不可置信的驾驶体验。

en:
Taking cues from its IMSA race cars, this Vision Gran Turismo machine represents the future of Audi.~

The Audi Vision Gran Turismo, developed by Audi Design exclusively for the "Vision Gran Turismo" competition and launched on the 15th anniversary of the series, came in both hybrid and fully-electric versions. Launched on the 15th anniversary of Gran Turismo, these exciting race machines offer a look into the future of motorsports.

The hybrid Audi Vision Gran Turismo is equipped with e-tron quattro, making it all-wheel-drive. It borrows the same technology as the 2012 Le Mans-winning race car, which featured motor-driven front wheels and a conventional rear-wheel setup. The front wheels of the Audi Vision Gran Turismo is powered by a 400 kW (<544ps>) motor (MGU-K) that recovers energy when braking. The rear tires are powered by a turbocharged 3.4-liter V-6 that produces 550 kW (<748ps>), making total output an impressive 950 kW (<1292ps>), which is more than many of today's LMP1 hybrid racers. It comes mated to a sequential 7-speed gearbox actuated by paddles on the steering wheel. The weight-to-power ratio for the Audi Vision Gran Turismo is less than one kilogram per horsepower.

The new race car is reminiscent of the Audi 90 IMSA GTO, which thrilled fans in the North American IMSA GTO racing series in 1989 with drivers such as Hans-Joachim Stuck, Walter Röhrl, Hurley Haywood and Scott Goodyear. The car was far ahead of its time, thanks to its combination of lightweight construction, a powerful turbocharged inline-5 engine, and quattro all-wheel-drive.

You can tell the all-electric version from the hybrid by the wheels: the former comes with 18-inchers all around, while the hybrid race car has 20-inch wheels in front with 21-inch examples at the rear.=
zh:
这辆Vision Gran Turismo继承了IMSA赛事车辆的精髓，代表着奥迪的未来。

Audi Design打造的一台Vision Gran Turismo。设计师设想了两个版本：混合动力版和纯电动版。混合动力版本中，后轮由3.4升V6涡轮增压引擎驱动，而前轮则连接到动能电机上，两者结合可产生惊人的950千瓦（1,292 PS）。这台车的外观来自于经典的Audi 90 IMSA GTO赛车。

en:
This Vision Gran Turismo is a thrilling embodiment of Audi's electric mobility initiative.

Audi has jumped into the EV fray with a purely electric-powered race car for the future. Called the Audi e-tron Vision Gran Turismo, this awesome machine was initially developed to be a virtual model in the "Vision Gran Turismo" lineup; however, Audi felt it was just too good to keep it exclusively digitized, so it built a running prototype that was used as a race taxi in the Formula E racing series. This makes the e-tron Vision Gran Turismo the first virtual concept car in the Vision Gran Turismo series that became a real-life fully functioning car.

The new race car is reminiscent of the Audi 90 IMSA GTO, which thrilled fans in the North American IMSA GTO racing series in 1989 with drivers such as Hans-Joachim Stuck, Walter Röhrl, Hurley Haywood and Scott Goodyear. The car was far ahead of its time, thanks to its combination of lightweight construction, a powerful turbocharged inline-5 engine, and quattro all-wheel-drive.

The Audi e-tron Vision Gran Turismo, which fans will be able to experience virtually starting April 2018, is powered by three 200 kW (<272ps>) electric motors: two motors for the rear axle and one at the front. Total output is a whopping 600 kW (<815ps>), and when combined with its lean curb weight of <1450kg>, the result is a weight-to-power ratio of <1.78kg> per horsepower. The Audi is also corners with the best of them, thanks in part to a 50/50 front/rear weight distribution and all-wheel-drive with variable power distribution. And just like the company's Formula E race cars, the Audi e-tron Vision Gran Turismo has only one forward gear.
zh:
这辆Vision Gran Turismo完美呈现了奥迪在电动汽车领域的创新性。

Audi Design设计的电动Vision Gran Turismo。纵观全车，到处都能找到Audi赛道传奇90 IMSA GTO的元素。该车的四轮驱动系统由3台电机驱动，1台在前，2台在后，系统总功率输出为600千瓦（815 PS）。Audi Sport打造的一台功能齐全的e-tron，它将在世界各地的赛道上大显身手。

en:
The original hot hatch, with excellent power and agile handling, paved the way for a new genre.

Introduced in 1971, the A112 Abarth is widely regarded as the original hot hatch. Built on the ultra-compact Autobianchi A112 platform, the A112 Abarth was a nimble 3-door hatchback, measuring just <3230mm> in length and <1480mm> in width.

The car was tuned by Abarth, which had just been acquired by the FIAT Group. The prototype featured a heavily modified version of the base <903cc> OHV inline-4 engine, with displacement increased to <982cc>, resulting in <108ps>. This allowed the car to reach a top speed of <208km/h>.

The production model retained the <982cc> engine, but it was detuned to <58ps> to enhance everyday usability. Despite the decrease, it still produced 20 percent more power than the base engine.

Abarth continued to make numerous improvements to the A112's performance. In 1975, engine displacement was increased to <1050cc>, boosting output to <71ps>. In 1979, the transmission was upgraded from a 4-speed to a 5-speed unit,

Although production ceased in 1985, the car remains a favorite among enthusiasts for its uniquely spirited and energetic character.
zh:
这款以高动力操控性而著称的车型是所有小钢炮的先驱。

1971年问世的A112 Abarth通常被视为最初的高性能掀背车之一。该车基于Autobianchi A112打造，并经Abarth之手调校。此后历经多次升级，1975年引擎排量增大，动力提升至71 PS，1979年更换为5速变速箱。虽然该车在1985年停产，但其凭借充满激情的驾驶特性赢得了车迷们的长久喜爱。

en:
Simple yet effective, this single-seat sports car is reminiscent of formula cars from a bygone era. ~

The BAC Mono, a sports car produced by British manufacturer Briggs Automotive Company since 2009, was the realization of the Briggs brothers' vision of "a road vehicle that offers the most authentic and pure driving experience possible while implementing the very latest in racing technology."

The car's most notable element was its formula car-style single seat design. However, unlike modern formula cars that are typically built on a carbon monocoque, the BAC Mono employed a more classical tubular frame design with a carbon-fiber body shell. Both the front and rear suspensions consisted of a double wishbone pushrod design.

The engine, situated behind the driver, came in the form of a Cosworth-tuned Ford Duratec 2.5-liter inline-4 that produced <309ps> and <31.4kgm>. It came mated to a race-specification 6-speed sequential transmission.

The BAC Mono was a remarkably lightweight car, tipping the scales at a very lean <580kg>, making its performance on par with F3 Formula racers of its day. Its performance numbers were awe-inspiring: a zero-to-60-mph time of 2.8 seconds and a top speed of <274km/h>.
zh:
这款单座跑车在简洁中蕴藏着吸引力，让人想起上一个时代的方程式赛车。

这款车型由英国Briggs Automotive Company打造，目标是创造“提供最纯正驾驶体验的公路车辆”。单座底盘采用管状框架配碳纤维车身，搭载经Cosworth调校的2.5升Ford Duratec引擎。车重仅580 公斤，达到了极致轻量化。0-60英里/小时加速仅需2.8秒，最高时速274 公里/小时，性能足以媲美F3赛车。

en:
This lightweight model of the 3.0 CS was stripped of all creature comforts to maximize performance.

BMW followed up its popular 2800 CS, introduced in 1968, with the 3.0 CS luxury sports coupe three years later.

The 2800 CS wore the body of the 1965 2000 C, but possessed a longer front overhang to make room for a 2.8-liter inline-6, replacing the 2000C's four-cylinder engine. With the 3.0 CS, BMW enlarged the engine, known as the "Big Six," to 3.0 liters, resulting in <180ps> and <26.0kgm> of torque. To offset the power increase, BMW fitted 4-wheel disc brakes to the 3.0 CS.

Such a car would make for an excellent race car, BMW concluded, so when the 3.0 CS took to the track, a special lightweight homologation version was offered, one that weighed <200kg> less than the base model. This car was called the 3.0 CSL with the "L" standing for "leicht," which means lightweight in German.
zh:
3.0 CS运动型轿跑车的轻量化版本，去除了所有多余的配置，以最大限度地提高赛道性能。

BMW在1968年推出搭载了强劲2.8升直列6缸引擎的2800 CS双门运动轿跑。而后在1971年发布排量更大的升级版3.0 CS。为满足赛事认证需求，BMW开发出轻量车型3.0 CSL。名称中的“L”代表“轻量”。

en:
This lightweight model of the BMW 3.0 CS was developed to compete in touring car racing.

The BMW 3.0 CS, a luxury sports coupe developed from the 2800 CS, which was released in 1968, picked up where the 2800 CS left off.

Powering the original 2800CS was a 2.8-liter inline-6 that was called "the Big Six." For the 3.0 CS, engine displacement was increased to 3.0 liters, increasing power to <180ps>/<26.0kgm>. To improve stopping power, BMW equipped the 3.0 CS with 4-wheel disc brakes.

The car's performance was so exceptional that BMW decided to take the Big Six racing, so it built a homologation model with significantly reduced weight. This version, called the 3.0 CSL (the "L" stood for "leicht," which in English means "light"), weighed 200 kg less than the base CS, making it an absolute road rocket.
zh:
这款3.0 CS的轻量级车型是为了参加房车赛而开发的。

3.0 CSL于1971年作为BMW 3.0 CS（一台搭载强大的3升直列6缸引擎的双门运动轿跑）的赛事认证车型推出。这台车的引擎排量在1972年从2,985 立方厘米增至3,003 立方厘米，并在1973年的升级车型上再次扩容至3,155 立方厘米，随后在欧洲房车赛场上取得了惊人成功。

en:
A new category sports prototype that carries the lineage of the celebrated V12 LMR.

The BMW M Hybrid V8 was a cutting-edge prototype car developed to the Le Mans Daytona h (LMDh) specifications. Its Dallara-built carbon-fiber monocoque came powered by a DTM-derived P66/3, a twin-turbo 4.0-liter V-8 engine paired with a hybrid system. Producing a combined system output of <680ps>, this power unit blended the thunder of internal combustion with the instantaneous response of electric assistance, delivering performance worthy of the M badge.

The wide kidney grilles of the front fascia created an unmistakable presence, identifying it as a BMW at a single glance. Outlined with laser lighting, these grilles reflected the brand’s heritage and forward-thinking technology while also maximizing aerodynamics and cooling in a form of functional beauty.

During the 2025 season, the BMW M Hybrid V8 competed in both the IMSA SportsCar Championship and FIA World Endurance Championship wearing a distinctive digital mosaic livery. In the eighth round of the IMSA season at Road America, the car dominated the field with a one-two finish, further establishing BMW’s reputation in the GTP class. Meanwhile, in the WEC, it demonstrated strong pace at circuits such as Imola while competing at the very highest level of endurance racing.

Although it carried forward the spirit of celebrated prototypes like the V12 LMR, hybrid technology allowed this machine to become a flagship pointing toward a new era of performance. Tradition, innovation and the drive to win—this car brought them all together.
zh:
参与全新组别的原型跑车，继承传奇车型V12 LMR血脉。

这款前沿的勒芒-戴通纳混合动力（LMDh）原型车，采用了Dallara制造的碳纤维单体车身，并搭载混合动力系统，整合源自DTM的“P66/3”4升V8双涡轮增压引擎。该车在2025赛季参加了IMSA跑车锦标赛和国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛，并在IMSA第八轮美国之路站的比赛中，以精彩的表现包揽了冠亚军。在世界耐力锦标赛中，这款车在伊莫拉等分站赛上同样表现出色，驰骋于耐力赛事的巅峰舞台。

en:
A hardboiled FR that hides the power of a demon in its compact body.

The BMW 2 Series coupe is a popular high-performance rear-wheel-drive compact car. The BMW M2 Competition is the extreme version that fills the same engine compartment with a 3.0-liter twin-turbocharged inline-6 "S55" engine from the M3 and M4.

What you'll notice first is the car's captivating bodywork. With its bulging over fenders, the exterior is the embodiment of speed. Although it measures only <4475mm> in length, it's actually about the same size as the E36 M3. Whether in the city or on winding backroads, the car displays an incredible sense of control, as if it was an extension of the driver's body.

The S55 engine delivers a maximum power output of <410ps> with <56.1kgm> peak torque. Even up against BMW's long history of high-performance inline-6 engines, this model has an exceptional high-revving nature, and as the boost builds its explosive power emerges.

No compromises have been made to the running gear either. To reduce unsprung weight, the aluminum suspension components have been specially tuned for spirited driving. Meanwhile, the torque vectoring "Active M Differential" ensures the car turns exactly where you want it to.

Now that the M3 and M4 have moved to a higher segment, this car may be the ideal expression of BMW's "Ulitmate Driving Machine."
zh:
一辆在紧凑车身下隐藏着恶魔般动力的彪悍前置后驱车。

这台性能猛兽将来自M3/M4的S55 3升直列六缸双涡轮引擎移植到2系双门轿跑的紧凑车身中。外扩的轮拱暗示着澎湃的内在动力，只需短暂加速，涡轮增压器即可完全释放这股狂暴力量。悬挂系统采用铝合金部件，有效降低簧下质量。扭矩矢量分配主动M差速器让这台车能够游刃有余地应对各种弯道挑战。

en:
A virtual race car for the street, this homologation model once claimed victory in the DTM. a

The first BMW M3 appeared in 1985, and it represented a high-performance version of the popular 3 Series (E30) that could also be used for touring car racing.

At first, the M3 only came in 2-door form, with wider treads and sporty fender flares. Also, front and rear spoilers were added, aggressive side skirts were installed and the angle of the C-pillar and rear window were revised to create a car that looked much meaner than the stock 3 Series. These body modifications also resulted in a better Cd of 0.38 (from 0.33). Under the hood was a special 2.3-liter DOHC inline-4 that produced <195ps> and <23.4kgm> of torque.

The race-spec model was introduced in 1987. From the onset, it dominated the DTM, winning five of the first 10 races. That same year, the M3 Evolution was released with even better aerodynamics and a <210ps> engine. In 1988, output was increased to <220ps> for the M3 Evolution II. In 1989 the final model of the E30 M3, called the M3 Sports Evolution, appeared, equipped with a larger engine (2.5 liters) that produced <238ps>/<24.5kgm>.
zh:
曾在DTM中屡获殊荣的赛事认证车型。微微鼓起的挡泥板正是其性能的见证。

这款符合赛事认证要求的车型基于当时的3系开发，专为征战房车锦标赛而生。以双门轿车为基础，加宽轮距并进行空气动力学优化，包括精心调整尾翼的开启角度。最初搭载2.3升直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎，经过逐年改进升级，最终推出了2.5升“Sport Evolution”终极版本。

en:
From race car to luxury grand tourer, the second-generation M3.

The second-generation M3 was introduced in 1992, two years after the debut of its base model, the third-generation 3-Series, codenamed E36.

The original E30 M3 was a racing homologation model, extensively modified from the standard 3-Series. In contrast, the E36 M3 shifted towards the direction of a grand tourer, featuring a more mature appearance with understated aerodynamic components.

Despite this shift, performance remained its central focus. The 3.0-liter inline-6 engine produced <286ps> with <32.7kgm> of torque. With this powerful engine, the car accelerated from 0 to <100km/h> in just six seconds and reach a top speed of <250km/h>, limited by a speed governor.

A minor model update in 1995 introduced a 3.2-liter engine, boosting output to <321ps> and <35.7kgm> of torque. This update also included the replacement of the 5-speed manual transmission with a 6-speed unit and several chassis enhancements to improve handling. In 1997, a 6-speed semi-automatic transmission was introduced.

The E36 M3 significantly elevated the line's reputation as a road car, while the feel and sound of its inline-6 powerplant were celebrated as delightful and enduring features. |
zh:
3.2L的第二代M3：从赛车到豪华旅行车。

第二代M3基于3系E36车型打造。相比初代车型的纯粹竞技风格，这一代车型更偏向于豪华旅行跑车的定位。新增直列六缸引擎选项的同时，提供双门、四门以及敞篷等多种车身形式可选。首发搭载3升引擎，1995款升级为3.2升，同时传动部分引入6速手动变速箱和双踏板SMG变速系统两种选择。

en:
Featuring BMW's high-revving engine technology, this sports car represented the epitome of the E46 3 Series.

In 2000, BMW redefined its super sports coupe, the M3, by placing a 3.2-liter DOHC inline-6 under its hood. Based on the E46 3 Series that underwent a full model change in 1998, the new M3 pumped out a fierce <343ps> at <7900rpm> and a hearty <37.2kgm> of torque at <4900rpm>. This meant that this amazing machine achieved more than <#100ps> per liter when the engine spun to its <7900rpm> redline. What really brought the motor to life was the M3’s new gearbox. Initially, it came equipped with a Getrag 6-speed manual, but later BMW added the SMG II, the company’s prize two-pedal (twin-clutch) semi-automatic transmission.

In developing the new M3’s chassis, BMW followed its credo of “the suspension must always be faster than the engine.” BMW engineers took the base E46 chassis and solidified each section, giving the car rock-solid stability throughout. The suspension was retuned to compensate for the M3’s added power.

In 2003, a lightweight version of this coupe was introduced, boasting even more performance than the base car, thanks mainly to a leaner body. The M3CSL tipped the scales at <1400kg>, about <100kg> less than the base model with the inline-6 pumping out <360ps> at <7900rpm> and <37.8kgm> of torque at <4900rpm>._
zh:
这款跑车采用了BMW的高转速引擎技术，堪称E46 3系的巅峰之作。

第三代M3基于3系E46车型打造。3.2升S54直列六缸引擎的单升功率超过100 PS，在7,900 转每分转速下输出最大343 PS功率。2003年推出了高性能CSL版本。除采用碳纤维车顶实现轻量化外，引擎也经过深度调校，最大功率提升至360 PS。这款车日后在房车锦标赛及各项赛事中取得了辉煌战绩。

en:
Based on the E92 3 Series coupe, this 4th-gen M3 featured a <420ps> V8.

The M3 has represented the top-of-the-line model in BMW's popular 3-Series lineup since the very beginning. The car's performance is tuned by the company's M division, which specializes in taking stock BMW cars and making them virtually race ready. With the M3, tweaks have traditionally been performed on the engine, suspension and aerodynamic parts. The history of the M brand dates back to 1985, and the car represented here is the fourth-generation M3, based on the latest 3-Series Coupe, the E92.

The E92 M3 measured <4620mm> long, <1805mm> wide and <1425mm> high, and rode on a wheelbase of <2760mm>. Several years ago, the M3's engine evolved from a 4-cylinder unit to a 6-cylinder in order to keep up with the growing engine power of other performance cars, especially those that competed in touring car races. For this model, BMW took things even further by mounting a <420ps> 4-liter V8 under the hood.

The car's dimensions were larger than the previous model, but this M3 was lighter, thanks to a high-strength carbon-fiber roof, which helped in lowering the car's center of gravity, and aluminum for the suspension parts to reduce weight. As a result, the M3 tipped the scales at a lean <1630kg>.

Despite being created for the company's motorsports activities, the M3 came laden with the latest technology, including a 7-speed M DCT with Drivelogic (double clutch transmission), Variable M differential lock and M Dynamic Mode. /
zh:
配备420 PS马力V8引擎的第四代M3，基于E92 3系双门跑车开发。

M3的定位是与赛车运动有着紧密联系的高性能车型，3系的每代产品都有它的身影。这辆E92车型搭载了7档双离合变速箱和能够输出420 PS的4升V8引擎。为了减轻较大尺寸车身的重量，开发团队作出了巨大的努力，使其公路车版本仅重1,630 公斤。它可以在4.8秒内完成0-100 公里/小时加速。

en:
BMW's M3 GT2 raced in premier endurance contests including the ALMS and ILMC series as well as the 24 Hours of Nürburgring.

While the first-generation BMW M3 (E30) was a special model created specifically to pass homologation requirements for Group A touring cars, from the second-generation and on, they were sold solely as high-performance models of the 3 Series. For the fourth-generation model (E92), two racing M3s that conformed to GT4 and GT2 FIA regulations were introduced. The GT2 car (which allowed more modifications), called the "M3 GT2," was the fastest M3 ever developed to date.

The street version of the E92 M3 was slightly larger than the previous model (E46) and <80kg> heavier at <1630kg>. To counteract the extra weight, BMW swapped the old M3 engine, a 3.2-liter inline-6, to a 4.0-liter V-8, which increased power output from <343ps> to a whopping <420ps>.

Using this car as the foundation, the M3 GT2 added carbon-fiber body parts, including the front and rear fenders, hood, trunk lid, and both bumpers, allowing the race-ready car to tip the scales at a lean <1245kg>. The GT2 is also <110mm> wider, and with a revised front bumper that incorporates air dams for better ventilation and intake, not to mention the addition of a large rear wing, the car possesses greatly improved aerodynamics. As for the engine, with a <30.1mm> restrictor installed, it produces more than <500ps> and <50kgm> of torque.

BMW entered this car in the ALMS and ILMC series in the 2010 race season. The car dominated the GT Class of the ALMS, and achieved overall victories at the Nürburgring 24 hour race as well as the ILMC Zhuhai 1000km.
zh:
基于M3开发的竞赛车型，在纽博格林24小时耐力赛、亚洲勒芒系列赛和勒芒洲际大奖赛中屡有斩获。

这款GT车型基于高性能M3打造，专门针对比赛进行了改装。其大部分车身板件都更换为碳纤维材料，将车重降低到1,245 公斤，而其挡泥板也进行了加宽，让车身宽度来到了110毫米。即便安装了动力限制器，它的4升V8引擎依然可以输出500 PS的动力。

en:
This highly modified homologation version of the E30 3 Series served as a small hint of what was to come from BMW.(

The first BMW M3 appeared in 1985, and it represented a high-performance version of the popular 3 Series (E30) that could also be used for touring car racing.

At first, the M3 only came in 2-door form, with wider treads and sporty fender flares. Also, front and rear spoilers were added, aggressive side skirts were installed and the angle of the C-pillar and rear window were revised to create a car that looked much meaner than the stock 3 Series. These body modifications also resulted in a better Cd of 0.38 (from 0.33). Under the hood was a special 2.3-liter DOHC inline-4 that produced <195ps> and <23.4kgm> of torque.

The race-spec model was introduced in 1987. From the onset, it dominated the DTM, winning five of the first 10 races. That same year, the M3 Evolution was released with even better aerodynamics and a <210ps> engine. In 1988, output was increased to <220ps> for the M3 Evolution II. In 1989 the final model of the E30 M3, called the M3 Sports Evolution, appeared, equipped with a larger engine (2.5 liters) that produced <238ps>/<24.5kgm>.
zh:
E30，一代传奇的开始。这款E30 3系认证车型经过了大幅改造。

这辆专为房车赛设计的双门轿跑是由BMW M部门基于3系的E30车型打造。它周身安装了鼓起式挡泥板、前后扰流翼和侧裙，营造出锐意进取的震撼外观。这辆Sport Evolution堪称M3的终极型号。它采用了更大排量的2.5升引擎，能够输出238 PS/24.0 公斤力米，成为一股赛道上不容小觑的力量。

en:
The BMW M4 becomes the 2-door version of the daunting M3.

In the summer of 2013, BMW established the new “4 Series” line to separate the 2-door offerings of the 3 Series from the 4-doors. This meant that the extremely performance-minded M3 coupe now went by the name, M4.

While the name had changed, the spirit of the M3 was left totally intact. The M4’s exterior featured a menacing face with large air inlets in the front bumpers and a flowing roofline that hinted at the car’s awesome performance. When seen from its profile, the M4 is visually characterized by traditional BMW proportions—a sleek hood, long wheelbase and short front overhang. The characteristic M gill incorporated the Air Breather, which together with the Air Curtain within the front apron, served to ventilate the wheel arches and facilitate better airflow values.

Underneath the aluminum hood of the M4 was the M TwinPower Turbo engine. This turbocharged inline-6 produced <431ps>, which allowed the lean <1497kg>-car to go from zero to <100km/h> in just 4.1 seconds. Also, the combination of the active M differential, the adaptive M suspension, and the M specific DSC ensured that the M4 retained the handling prowess expected of all cars that wore the M badge.
zh:
从起步加速到100 公里/小时仅需4.1秒。传奇M系列的高性能车型。

3系的双门轿跑与敞篷型号从车系中独立出来，成为了4系，而这辆车就是其中的旗舰型号。只看它匀称的双门轿跑车身比例，就已吸引到众多目光，然而这辆车真正的魅力却在于它的性能。它安装了一台直列六缸双涡轮引擎，动力输出达到431 PS/56.1 公斤力米。再搭配主动式M差速器、自适应M悬挂和M系专用动态稳定控制系统，共同打造出了终极的驾乘体验。

en:
This Gran Turismo original Gr.4 race car maximizes the performance of the M4.!

In the summer of 2013, BMW shuffled its lineup by placing the 3 Series coupe and convertible under the new 4 Series umbrella. This meant that the BMW M3 coupe was now known as the M4. Despite the name change, the car was still the same high-performance enthusiast machine as before.

Underneath the aluminum hood with the slight bulge resided a twin-turbocharged inline-6 that allowed the car to run from zero to <100km/h> in just 4.1 seconds. This was possible, thanks in part to the M4’s remarkably low curb weight of <1497kg>, which set new standards in its class. The M4’s lightweight nature also contributed to its agility, as did the car’s active M differential, adaptive M suspension, and the M specific DSC.

The M4 could be distinguished from the standard 4 Series models by its large air inlets in the front and the racing inspired low rear end. The characteristic M gill incorporates the Air Breather, which together with the Air Curtain within the front apron serves to ventilate the wheel arches and facilitate better airflow. The rest of the M4’s design can be classified as “customary BMW,” such as a sleek hood, long wheelbase and a short front overhang.

Despite the new designation, this performance car will always be a favorite among enthusiasts because it remains a true driver’s car.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
zh:
这辆跑车浪漫旅原创Gr.4跑车将M4的性能发挥到了极致。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型基于BMW的新一代高性能M4轿跑打造，并针对Gr.4规格进行了改装。尽管采用了房车风格的外观，它依然保留了BMW众所称道的过弯能力和稳定性，其表现久经考验。它拥有极其可靠的驾驶性能，意味着即便是新手司机也能毫不费力地在赛道上行驶。

en:
A special safety-car version of the BMW M4.}

In the summer of 2013, BMW shuffled its lineup by placing the 3 Series coupe and convertible under the new 4 Series umbrella. This meant that the BMW M3 coupe was now known as the M4. Despite the name change, the car was still the same high-performance machine as before.

Underneath the aluminum hood with the slight bulge resided a twin-turbocharged inline-6 that allowed the car to run from zero to <100km/h> in just 4.1 seconds. This was possible, in part, because of the M4’s remarkably low curb weight of <1497kg>, which set new standards in its class. The M4’s lightweight nature also contributed to its agility, as did the car’s active M differential, adaptive M suspension, and the M specific DSC.

The M4 could be distinguished from other 4 Series models by its large air inlets in the front and the race-inspired low rear end. The characteristic M gill incorporated the Air Breather, which together with the Air Curtain within the front apron served to ventilate the wheel arches and facilitate better airflow. The rest of the M4’s design was defined by “customary BMW traits,” such as a sleek hood, long wheelbase and a short front overhang.

Whether it's called the M3 or M4, it doesn't matter. What's important is that this performance car will always be a favorite among enthusiasts because it's a true driver’s car.

This machine is a special model designed by Gran Turismo to recreate the image of safety cars used in races like the Moto GP.
zh:
用作安全车的特殊M4车型。

这辆跑车浪漫旅的原创车型的安全车基于BMW的最新一代高性能M4轿跑打造。它采用了“M Performance Edition”的外观，并为其加入了若干特别设计的部件，包括前唇扰流板、引擎盖销、格栅饰条、后扰流翼和扩散器。

en:
The car driven by Kazunori Yamauchi in the 2016 24 Hours of Nürburgring.

BMW introduced the race spec M6, dubbed the M6 GT3, at the 2015 Frankfurt Motor Show. The company announced that the car would participate in the FIA-GT3 class in 2016, replacing the Z4 GT3 that contested in the same category since 2010.

Despite being in the same class, the M6 GT3 is significantly larger than the Z4 GT3, measuring about <5m> in length and more than <2m> wide. Its wheelbase is not only longer than the Z4 GT3, but it's also <5cm> longer than the production model. This allows the M6 GT3 to be more stable at high speed and through corners than its predecessor.

The car's wide fenders, aerodynamic front and rear bumper, and high rear wing not only make the car look menacingly beautiful, they provide gobs of downforce, which is essential to a race car.

The M6 GT3 is very lean, thanks in part to a body that's made of mostly carbon fiber. The body structure has been reinforced, and the suspension has been totally tweaked from that of the production M6. Under the hood is a 4.4-liter V-8 with the Twin Power Turbo, with various reinforcements and modifications that results in <585ps>.

One of the race teams to compete with the M6 GT3 was Walkenhorst Motorsports of Germany. This team usually found themselves at the top of the running order in the highly competitive VLN endurance series. In the 24 Hours of Nürburgring, “Gran Turismo” series producer, Kazunori Yamauchi, joined the team and helped pilot the M6 GT3 to 22nd place overall.=
zh:
山内一典在2016年纽博格林赛道24小时耐力赛中驾驶的赛车。

BMW宣布，他们将从2016年起派出这辆M6 GT3参加FIA-GT3组别的比赛。这辆车的车身尺寸长5米，宽2米，相比起前代的紧凑型赛车Z4 GT3大了一圈。《跑车浪漫旅》系列制作人山内一典曾驾驶这辆Walkenhorst Motorsport M6 GT3参加了纽博格林24小时耐力赛，并取得了总排名第22名的成绩。

en:
A powerful GT3 race machine with a 4.4-liter twin-turbocharged V8.

BMW introduced the race spec M6, dubbed the M6 GT3, at the 2015 Frankfurt Motor Show. The company announced that the car would participate in the FIA-GT3 class in 2016, replacing the Z4 GT3 that contested in the same category since 2010.

Despite being in the same class, the M6 GT3 is significantly larger than the Z4 GT3, measuring about <5m> in length and more than <2m> wide. This allows the M6 GT3 to be more stable at high speed and through corners than its predecessor.

The car's wide fenders, aerodynamic front and rear bumper, and high rear wing not only make the car look menacingly beautiful, they provide gobs of downforce, which is essential to a race car.

The body structure has been reinforced, and the suspension has been totally tweaked from that of the production M6. Under the hood is a 4.4-liter V-8 with the Twin Power Turbo, with various reinforcements and modifications that results in <585ps>.

The M6 GT3 M Power, bathed in the red, blue and black colors of the BMW livery, has proved to be yet another shining example in a long line of successful BMW race machines.
zh:
配备4.4升双涡轮增压的新一代BMW GT3。

自从2010年起，Z4 GT3一直是BMW GT3赛车的中流砥柱，而这款车正是其后继车型。与紧凑的Z4不同，这款车拥有更具威慑力的外观，车身长度约为5 米，宽2 米。它的内核是一台4.4升V8双涡轮增压引擎，在原厂设置下能够输出585 PS的动力。其车身大多采用了碳纤维材料打造，其框架和悬挂也得到了彻底改造，让它与消费级M6车型天差地别。

carNameEn: BMW McLaren F1 GTR Race Car '97
en:
This F1 GTR race car took many racing titles around the world, including the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

Established in 1965, Formula 1 team McLaren has become one of the most recognized names in the glamorous sport, with an image almost equal to that of Ferrari. Whereas Ferrari branched out into manufacturing production cars, McLaren's activities were all race-oriented. That changed with the introduction of the McLaren F1, a car designed by Gordon Murray and powered by a BMW engine.

The concept of the F1 was a "Formula 1 race car for the road," and because it possessed such high levels of performance, its duties weren't restricted to only the public road. The car saw lots of action as a racer, partly because McLaren was promoting the racing version of the F1, the F1 GTR, as aggressively as it was the road car.

For the F1 GTR, McLaren added a front spoiler lip and rear wing to enhance downforce. BMW provided the car's V12, mounted amidships, with power rated at more than the stock version's <627 ps>.

To say that the F1 GTR's maiden race was a success would be a dire understatement. In the 1995 24 Hours of Le Mans, the F1 GTR won its class, as well as placing 3rd, 4th and 5th. It kept on winning all over the world and is still considered today as one of the greatest GT race cars in history.
zh:
这辆F1 GTR在勒芒和全球各地的多项GT赛事中都拿下了桂冠。

由戈登·穆雷主导开发，这是基于“公路版F1”高性能跑车打造的竞赛版本。自1995年首度登场以来逐年改进升级，1997年迎来了这款空气动力学性能卓越的长尾版本。作为一款赛车，此车拥有相对悠长的竞赛生涯，在私人车队手中继续征战赛场直至2003年。

en:
The ultimate road racer that draws its heritage from the glorious touring cars of the '70s.

Following in the tradition of successful BMW touring cars of the 1970s, the BMW design team has created an uncompromising road racer for the modern era.

Crisp proportions and a dynamic silhouette give the BMW Vision Gran Turismo the appearance that it's in constant motion, even when standing still. Front and rear spoilers provide optimum downforce, while the various carbon fiber pieces found throughout the car's body have been designed to reduce drag and keep curb weight at a minimum. The car tips the scales at a lean <1180kg>, with the weight distributed 50:50, front and rear.

Under the hood is a powerful twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter inline-6 that delivers a maximum power of 404 kW/<549ps> between <6200rpm> and <7300rpm>. Peak torque comes at 680 Nm/<69kgm> at a low <1900rpm>. A sequential 6-speed transmission, operated by gearshift paddles on the steering wheel, distributes engine power to the driven rear axle.

The car's M paint scheme pays homage to the company's past successes in touring-car racing, while the bold styling language points to what may lie ahead.
zh:
终极公路赛车，汲取了70年代著名房车的传承。

由BMW设计团队打造的现代公路赛车。其外观设计让车辆即使在静止时也能给人带来难以置信的速度感。强劲的3升直列六缸引擎可输出404千瓦/680牛米（549 PS/69.0 公斤力米）。整车仅重1,180 公斤，并实现了完美的50:50前后重量分配。这台Vision Gran Turismo是BMW赛车传统与最新技术的惊人融合。

en:
An elegant convertible with an inline-6 engine lurking under its elongated hood.+

At the 2002 Paris Motor Show, BMW unveiled the convertible Z4 sports car, which replaced the Z3. At first, the engine lineup included a 2.5-liter and 3.0-liter inline-6, a step up in class in comparison to the Z3 which started out with only a 4-cylinder powerplant.

The design unmistakably showcased the distinctive styling philosophy of Chris Bangle, BMW's chief designer at the time. The flowing lines and the signature "Z"-shaped press line in front of the doors were design elements that instantly distinguished the car.

With an entirely new chassis and body developed from the platform level, the Z4 achieved near-perfect front/rear weight distribution of 50.3/49.7. What was also notable was that although it was <25kg> lighter, the Z4 boasted three times the twisting rigidity of its predecessor.

The suspension setup—featuring struts at the front and a multilink configuration at the rear—was carried over from the E46 3 Series. This decision was driven by the fact that extensive testing had already been completed, ensuring a smoother and more efficient development process for the Z4. No compromises were made in incorporating cutting-edge technologies, including BMW's first electric power steering system, DTC (Dynamic Traction Control), an enhancement to the traction control system, and DDC (Dynamic Drive Control), which adjusted steering feel and throttle response to suit either sporty or normal driving modes. The Z4 offered a variety of transmission options: manual, automatic, and a semi-automatic gearbox called SMG.

Like the Z3, the Z4 was manufactured at BMW's Spartanburg plant in South Carolina, USA. The motorsport version of the Z4 has been participating in prestigious events, such as the 24 Hours of Nürburgring.
zh:
一款优雅的敞篷车。前部的长引擎盖下安装了一部直列六缸引擎。

Z4是一款敞篷跑车，于2002年首次亮相，用以取代Z3。车身以其简洁的翼子板线条和车门前方标志性的Z形冲压线而著称。与Z3相比，它的扭转刚度翻了三番，而车重却轻了25 公斤。它还搭载了众多新技术，是首款配备电动助力转向系统的BMW车型。

en:
Starting the 2011 24 Hours of Spa from the 49th position on the grid, this BMW Z4 GT3 crossed the finish line in a remarkable 2nd place.:

The FIA-GT racing versions of the E85/E86 BMW Z4 were immensely popular with race teams, especially privateers.

The second-generation E89-based GT3 machines started racing in 2010. Because the production Z4 was only sold as a convertible starting in 2009, the GT3 race car was converted into a coupe by omitting the opening and closing mechanism of the power hard top. A large front spoiler and rear wing, along with flared front and rear fenders provided gobs of downforce without any added weight. The hood, roof, wing, and the front and rear fenders were made of carbon fiber, making the car <300kg> lighter at <1200kg>.

Under the hood, the Z4’s stock inline-6 was swapped in favor of the E92 M3’s fire-breathing 4.0-liter V8 that came mated to a 6-speed sequential gearbox. The ECU of this engine was reprogrammed to produce <480ps>. New competition-grade ABS brakes provided the stopping power, and the front axle was redesigned for added performance and durability.

The 2011 model pushed the envelope even further as the fenders were widened and the entire body was upgraded to improve the car’s aerodynamics. Also, engine displacement was increased to 4.4 liters, bumping power up to <515ps>. The 6-speed sequential gearbox was updated to incorporate paddle shifters.

The transformed Z4 GT3 won two races in the FIA-GT3 championships in 2011, and in the two 24-hour races at the Nürburgring and Spa, it placed second overall. The car showed, and continues to show, superb performance in races with high levels of competition.
zh:
纽博格林赛道和斯帕弗朗科尔尚赛道24小时耐力赛亚军。赛车典范，从最艰巨的战斗中脱颖而出。

这辆BMW的GT3赛车基于E89型号Z4打造，从2010年起开始参加比赛。通过将伸缩式顶篷更换为固定板件等改良，车重成功削减了300 公斤。而动力上也换用了一台4升V8引擎。到了2011年，新版本添加了更宽的挡泥板，还换用了更大排量的4.4升引擎，能够输出515 PS。再搭配升级版拨片换挡变速箱，这辆Z4在一系列竞争最为激烈的赛事中均取得了优秀的成绩。

en:
BMW's contemporary Z8 roadster has the distinction of being one of James Bond's rare non-British vehicles.

Announced in 1999, the Z8 was a luxury open-top sports car that took its roots from the legendary BMW 507 of the 1950s (of which only 252 cars were ever made). The car drew additional attention when its gorgeous sheet metal was revealed for the first time, as the Bond car in the 19th "007" movie, "The World is Not Enough."

While the Z8 is a production car, it was positioned as a very special model in the BMW lineup, and they spared no expense in its creation. The basic structure of the car starts by combining an extruded aluminum space frame with aluminum paneling, an expensive undertaking that requires precision craftsmanship. The long-nose, short deck layout, electric soft top, and retro-modern style employing a variety of classical details, is the work of legendary designer Henrik Fisker who would later work on the Aston Martin DB9, before going on to create his own hybrid car company.

Its design motif is consistent through to its interior, recreating the metallic interior panels of the 507 with composite panels and center gauges. Meanwhile, fine leather is utilized unsparingly to create an interior fit for the very best of luxury cars. Mechanically, it borrows its engine from the high-performance E39 M5 sedan, a 4941 cc V8 producing <400ps>/<51.0kgm>, and also shares the 6-speed manual transmission, front MacPherson strut and rear integral-arm aluminum suspension. Because the car is <150kg> lighter than the E39 M5 at <1630kg>, 0-<100km/h> is a brisk 4.7 seconds, which made it the fastest BMW of its day.
zh:
质量和性能均属顶尖的敞篷跑车，拥有“邦德座驾”的殊荣。

这款豪华敞篷跑车从上世纪五十年代的经典车型“507”中获得了大量灵感。其铝合金空间车架中容纳了E39型号M5同款的5升V8引擎和6档变速箱，能够输出400 PS的马力，并在4.7秒内完成0-100 公里/小时加速。它还在一部007电影中作为邦德的爱车登场。

en:
BMW’s first mass-produced production vehicle has a sports-car heart.

BMW established the "i" line specifically to market its alternative-energy vehicles, including EVs and plug-in hybrids. The first example to be offered by the German company with the "i" designation was the i3 in 2013.

In a word, the i3's styling is futuristic, complete with a unique shape and clamshell doors. The car is just under <4m> in length, <1.8m> width, <1.6m> height, and weighs a mere <1195kg>, which is a testament to the engineers who made it a priority to keep the car's curb weight down. They accomplished this by extensively using carbon-fiber in the cabin and incorporating as much aluminum as possible in the chassis. The lithium-ion batteries are placed at the center of the vehicle to optimize handling balance.

The motor produces <170ps> and <25.5kgm> of torque, sending power to the rear wheels. The i3 runs from zero to <60km/h> in just 3.7 and to <100km/h> in 7.2 seconds. Top speed is rated at more than <150km/h>. Because electric motors can deliver peak torque instantaneously, the i3 feels like a supercar when you launch it from a standstill.

At full charge, the i3 possesses a <160km> range, and on the ECO PRO mode with minimal air conditioning and other power saving tricks, it can go up to <200km>. For those who may suffer from range anxiety, a 647cc 2-cylinder gasoline engine can extend the i3's driving range to a maximum of <300km>./
zh:
BMW的第一款市售电动车，拥有跑车级别的加速性能。

2013年，BMW公布了一款电动车。方正的四门车身采用了小尺寸无柱后门设计，底盘使用铝合金材质，而驾驶舱则使用碳纤维，使得全车仅重1,195 公斤。它的电机能够输出170 PS/25.0 公斤力米的性能，从静止状态加速到60 公里/小时仅需3.7秒，加速到100 公里/小时也仅需7.2秒。再加上超过150 公里/小时的最高时速，这款车在其他采用内燃引擎的竞争车型面前也丝毫不落下风。

en:
A digital concept car infused with the DNA of BVLGARI.

The BVLGARI Aluminium Vision Gran Turismo is a concept car that takes its inspiration from the iconic 1988 BVLGARI Aluminium watch, possessing the same sporty, smart and essential spirit as the time piece.

The shapes, materials, colors, and the overall design language of the car are directly inspired by the form language and spirit of the "Aluminium" watch.

The barchetta body style is defined by a combination of pure and geometrical shapes, which are symbolic of Italian-car tradition of creativity and character, integrating elements of various 1960s and 1970s Italian carrozzeria concept cars. The result is an archetype of sportiness that expresses movement, lightness, and performance in a timeless design that's both unique and undeniably Italian in spirit. The car's expression of style and coolness transcends short-lived trends, and affirms itself as a pure expression of BVLGARI-design DNA.
zh:
融入BVLGARI血统的数字概念车。

BVLGARI Aluminium Vision Gran Turismo的设计灵感源自1998年颠覆腕表界的“BVLGARI Aluminium”，承袭了相同的理念：运动、智能、简约而精准。这种永恒而独特的设计体现了创新的概念精神与风格，完美诠释了BVLGARI的设计基因，超越了一时的风潮和时尚。

en:
The successor to the ultra-high-performance Veyron.

The Chiron is a super sports car unveiled by Bugatti in 2016. This limited production model was introduced as a follow-up to the Veyron, with only 500 units available worldwide.

The exterior featured large C-shaped lines that encircled the cabin and also served as air intakes. The body possessed an accentuated centerline inspired by the Type 57 Atlantic Coupe that increased straight-line stability.

The carbon-fiber chassis provided the same level of rigidity as an LMP1 race car and housed the Veyron's quad-turbo 8.0-liter W-16 engine, which was extensively tuned to produce <1500ps> and <163.1kgm> of torque.

The car ran from 0-<100km/h> in 2.5 seconds, and a pre-production prototype was able to reach a maximum speed of <490.48km/h>.

In 2018, the Chiron Sport was introduced with an improved chassis weighing <18kg> less than the original. In 2019, the limited edition "Chiron Sport 110 ans Bugatti" was released to celebrate the 110th anniversary of Bugatti. Only 20 of them were made.
zh:
超高性能跑车Veyron的后继者。

Chiron是Bugatti于2016年推出的超级跑车。全球限量500台，这款车实际上是Veyron的继任者。碳纤维底盘具备与LMP1赛车同等的刚性，源自Veyron的8升W16四涡轮增压引擎经过调校可输出1,500 PS最大动力和163.1 公斤力米峰值扭矩。该车0-100 公里/小时加速仅需2.5秒，原型车曾创下490.5 公里/小时的实测最高时速纪录。

en:
With a little help from a special key, this remarkable automobile reached speeds of over <375km/h>.

It is one of the most fabled marques in the history of the automobile. Ettore Bugatti’s cars were so technologically advanced in the 1930s that they remained quite competitive in numerous racing categories... for about two decades. Imagine a contemporary Formula 1 team or sports car trying to make that claim. But the new Bugatti Veyron created by German car maker Volkswagen was without question the single greatest supercar of the modern era.

Its quad-turbo, 8.0-liter, W-16 engine produced a mind-numbing <1001 ps> at <6000 rpm>. Its transmission was an ultra-smooth, quick-shifting 7-speed DSG developed exclusively to the Veyron. Its performance numbers were downright scary, with a 0-<100 km/h> time of 2.5 seconds and a 0-<300 km/h> dash in 16.7 seconds. Its braking was also impressive, coming to a stop from <100 km/h> in a distance of <31.4 m> and only 2.3 seconds.

Then there’s the price: 1 million Euros (about $1.4 million).

The Veyron was capable of such high speed, said to be over 250 mph, that the vehicle’s ride height and rear wing angles changed in three positions: standard, top speed, and handling mode. To enter the top speed mode enabling speeds of over <375 km/h>, a special separate key needed to be inserted when the car was at a standstill.

Everything about the Veyron, its price, performance, limited quantity and top speed, was completely over-the-top. That’s why it rested atop the pinnacle of the super exotic car universe when it went on sale./
zh:
利用特殊的钥匙，令这辆令人难以置信的野兽达到375 公里/小时。

这是一台终极超跑。这辆车于2005年东京车展上首次亮相，采用了即便在超级跑车中也极其罕见的规格数值：1,001 PS的动力输出，407 公里/小时的极速性能，还有高达一百万欧元的单价。它安装了一台包含4部涡轮增压器的8升W16引擎，并连接到一部7档双离合变速箱。驾驶者还能使用一把特殊钥匙来解锁极速模式，让这辆车的最高时速来到375 公里/小时。

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.[
zh:
利用特殊的钥匙，令这辆令人难以置信的野兽达到375 公里/小时。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是将Bugatti Veyron超级跑车针对Gr.4组别规则进行改装的版本。尽管为了符合Gr.4规则而对基础车型的动力输出进行了削弱，但它在直线加速中依然拥有不输任何对手的实力。得益于四轮驱动布局提供的稳定性，它在弯道中也占据一定优势。

en:
This Vision Gran Turismo machine pays homage to the Type 57 Tank, one of the glorious cars that define Bugatti's history.

Bugatti Vision Gran Turismo is a project as realistic as possible for Bugatti fans to introduce a thoroughbred Bugatti to the virtual world. The result is a symbiosis of technology, tradition and aesthetics, where every design feature has an actual purpose.

The Bugatti designers drew their inspiration from the brand's racing tradition. Bugatti enjoyed great success in racing in the 1920s and 1930s. Historical inspiration for the modern virtual race car came, in particular, from the Bugatti Type 57 Tank and its victories in the 24 Hours of Le Mans races in 1937 and 1939.

The design of the Vision Gran Turismo shows at first glance that Bugatti DNA meets cutting-edge racing technology. Marked by large convex surfaces in contrast with concave transitions and strong lines, the proportions of the vehicle are uncompromisingly athletic and designed for maximum performance. The designers have unmistakably integrated key features of the Bugatti design DNA into the virtual race car's design with every vehicle component having a real performance function. The horseshoe on the front grille acts as a support for the front splitter. The center fin, which derives from the legendary Type 57 SC Atlantic, makes an important contribution to the car's dynamic stability and accommodates the kinematic system for the rear wing, which controls the air brake and the drag reduction system (DRS). The architecture of the interior continues the clean lines of the exterior. Every aspect of the interior is geared to racing.

The virtual race car was developed in close collaboration with the Bugatti engineers and is based on modern racing technology and aerodynamic analyses. To attain the performance goals, the Bugatti Vision Gran Turismo is driven by a W16 engine, which delivers the engine power of 1230 kW (<1650 BHP>) and 1580 Nm (61.1 kgfm) to all four wheels. The engineers have calculated that the Bugtti Vision Gran Turismo can drive at over 400 km/h (250 mph) on four setions o the virtual Le Mans track reaching an verall max speed of 47.59 km/h (278 mph).

The ugatti Vision Gran Turiso is te ultimate rae car, and at te same time a true Bugatti.
zh:
这辆致敬Type 57 Tank的Vision Gran Turismo象征着Bugatti的光辉历史。

这台车是对Bugatti历史赛车车型的致敬。设计师和工程师携手合作，利用最新技术和空气动力学理论打造了这台车。配备足足4个涡轮增压器的W16引擎可输出难以置信的1230千瓦/1580牛米（1,673 PS/161.1 公斤力米），让它得以在勒芒24小时耐力赛的主场萨森赛车场的四个计时点中，速度可超过400 公里/小时（250英里/小时）。强劲且充裕的动力使其能够达到447.6 公里/小时（278英里/小时）的最高时速。
