*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.1 regulatons by Gran Turismo.
zh:
Bugatti梦幻赛车，力争立于赛车之巅。

这是Bugatti Vision Gran Turismo概念车的一个版本，由《跑车浪漫旅》与Bugatti合作开发，并按Gr.1组别规则进行了改装。基础车型的宽轮距和四轮驱动系统带来的出色稳定性，让这台赛车相对易于驾驶。

en:
The ultimate version of the extremely lightweight Caterham.

In 1973, Caterham Cars secured the rights to manufacture the open-cockpit sports and race car called the Seven from Lotus Cars. In 1996, Caterham Cars decided to take the car's performance to another level with the Seven Superlight.

This new version of the British classic came with a semi-monocoque chassis built from a tubular frame with aluminum paneling. semi-monocoque chassis built from a tubular frame with aluminum paneling.
While it possessed the basic visual cues of the original Seven, the Superlight weighed significantly less than the stock version, from <35kg> to <50kg> less depending on the engine you chose.

The "R500" version of this car was introduced in 1999. Its name was derived from the car's 500-horsepower-per-ton power-to-weight ratio.  The first vehicles were equipped with a Rover K-series engine, but in 2008, Caterham decided to throw a <266ps> 2.0-liter Ford Duratec under the hood, giving the R500 supercar-like acceleration: Its zero to <100km/h> came in at 2.88 seconds and top speed was rated at 150 mph.
zh:
轻量化Caterham的终极版本。

这台车由Caterham于1996年打造，该公司自1973年从Lotus手中接过“Seven”的生产权后，便一直持续生产该车型至今。正如其名“Superlight”所示，这款车在每一处都进行了减重处理，比标准版Seven轻了约35 公斤到50 公斤（具体幅度因配置而异）。2008年及之后的后期型号搭载了2升Ford引擎，输出可达266 PS，0-100 公里/小时加速时间仅需2.88秒，足以让一众超级跑车不敢小觑。

en:
Dubbed by some as "the vacuum cleaner," this car became an American racing icon.+

The 2J may well be the most innovative, wildest racing machine ever created. The car, characterized by its big boxy rear end, entered the 1970 SCCA Can-Am racing series in North America, as the first machine in the series to feature active ground effects... in the form of a giant vacuum.

The Can-Am series was quite unusual as, at the time, there was no rule to limit the amount of horsepower for its race cars. Chaparral boss, Texas oil magnate Jim Hall, pulled a wild card from his sleeve when he created a race car that utilized two engines: one was a <700 ps> powerplant to power the car and the other, an air-cooled snowmobile engine that powered a pair of large fans to suck the air flowing underneath the car, thus making it “stick” to the road surface. The area between the sides of the bodywork and the ground were sealed by floating pieces of high-strength Lexan. Nicknamed “The Vacuum Cleaner,” the Chaparral 2J astounded race fans and the other Can-Am drivers alike.

Aside from its odd looks, the 2J often took pole position by several seconds over heady competition that included the previously-dominant McLaren M8D...that is, when it was running. The 2J experienced many mechanical problems in its maiden season, making every race it entered a thrilling event.

Before the start of the 1971 season, the SCCA banned the use of engines used for purposes other than powering the car itself, and the Chaparral 2J was banished from motorsports forever.
zh:
这款车被戏称为“吸尘器”，曾让整个运动赛车界大吃一惊，成为竞速史上的一个标志。

Chaparral 2J是一款独特的赛车，曾参加1970年SCCA Can-Am（加拿大-美国挑战杯）系列赛。此车因其在车身后部安装两个风扇的独特构造而被戏称为“吸尘器”。这两个风扇由辅助引擎驱动，能够强力吸出车底空气。实际上，这是世界上首款主动式地面效应赛车。然而1971年SCCA规则的修改禁止使用任何辅助引擎，迫使这款赛车退出历史舞台。

en:
This is a restomod of the classic Trans-Am hero Camaro Z28.

Introduced in 1966, the Camaro was created as a pony car to take on Ford’s Mustang, with the high-performance Z28 model developed for homologation for the SCCA’s Trans-Am Series.

The Z28 was released as a hardcore motorsports base model, equipped with a high-revving 302 cubic-inch V-8 engine (approx. 4.9 liters), with no options available for automatic transmissions or air conditioning. One such car under Penske Racing claimed a championship victory in the Trans-Am Series. Such results helped create a new trend of small-displacement, high-revving American V-8s.

Created by Gran Turismo, this “Camaro 1969 Race-Mod” is a modern reinterpretation of the original Camaro Z28. The spirit of classic Trans-Am was carried on in the car’s low stance, with a number of elements added from the restomod movement that enjoyed widespread popularity at events like SEMA. All the chrome trim was stripped from the exterior and replaced with carbon black components. A wide-mouth bumper, large ducktail spoiler, and a center-exit exhaust were also added.

The spartan interior featured a sequential shifter, roll cage, and Alcantara bucket seats. Behind these classical stylings, however, lay the true identity of the beast: a supercharged V-8 engine producing <667ps>. The ultimate modern Trans-American race car rebuilt tradition through new technologies.
zh:
经典泛美系列赛传奇赛车Camaro Z28的复原改装。

Chevrolet Camaro 1968 Race-Mod是《跑车浪漫旅》对Camaro Z28的现代演绎。此车最初是为了满足SCCA泛美房车系列赛的认证要求而开发的。车身外侧多处点缀了碳纤维饰件，并配备了宽体前杠、大型鸭尾式扰流板以及中置排气系统。座舱内配置序列式变速器和防滚架，以及Alcantara麂皮桶椅。

en:
The sports grade model of the 6th generation Camaro with the 6.2-liter LT1 engine.

The 6th generation model of the Chevy Camaro, America’s legendary sports car, was revealed in the spring of 2015.

The styling followed in the retro-modern design that was highly popular in the market in the last generation. However, the inside of the car received a full makeover. The platform was changed from the "Zeta" platform of the previous model to the "Alpha" platform shared with cars like the Cadillac CTS, but with roughly 70% of its parts developed specifically for the Camaro.

The body utilizes aluminum in various parts, improving the rigidity of the body by 28% and reducing the weight by over <90kg>. The suspension mounted on this body was also newly designed, with a multi-link MacPherson strut in the front and a 5 link suspension in the rear.

The biggest news regarding the engine was that a turbocharged 2-liter inline-4 producing <279ps> of power and <40.8kgm> of torque was added to the lineup. Improvements were also made to the existing 3.6-liter V6, raising both power and torque slightly to <340ps> and <39.3kgm> respectively. In addition, an LT1 6.2-liter V8, the same engine as in the Corvette, is also available in the lineup, producing <461ps> of power and <62.9kgm> of torque.

The sports grade model powered by this LT1 is the "SS." It is equipped with 20 inch wheels and Brembo brakes, and in the case of manual transmission models, it comes equipped with active rev matching as well as an optional magnet ride control suspension.=
zh:
第6代Camaro的跑车车型，搭载6.2升LT1引擎。

第六代Camaro于2015年首次亮相。外观上沿袭了上一代的现代复古概念，内部结构则是全新设计。基于新的“Alpha”平台，遍布全车的铝制部件将车身刚性提高28%的同时，还削减了90 公斤的重量。SS跑车级车型标配6.2升V8引擎、20英寸车轮和Brembo刹车。

en:
The Z28 is one of the most popular muscle cars ever, thanks to its good looks and high performance.

The Ford Mustang was a hit compact sports car that took the world by storm. The success of the Mustang was due to its excellent performance, low price, and a effective marketing campaign, so naturally, Ford's main rival, General Motors, was quick to produce a rival. That came in the form of the Chevrolet Camaro that appeared in 1966.

While the Camaro was launched to a plenty of high praise, it could not quite eclipse the sales numbers of the Mustang. So, Chevy decided to up the ante and introduce an even higher-performance version of the car, which it called the Z28. The 302-cu.-in. displacement (5.0 liters) was set to meet the regulations for the Trans-Am racing series. While it did well on the race track, it performed well at dealerships. Chevrolet saw sales of the Camaro increase, thanks to a new halo model that did wonders to the car's image.

The 1969 model is the most popular out of all the Camaros, and the Z28 is the most coveted model, for it truly represents the golden era of American pony cars.
zh:
它凭借外观和速度，成为第1代Camaro系列中最受欢迎的车型。

初代Ford Mustang作为一款紧凑型双门运动跑车一经问世便引发空前热潮。为超越Ford的佳绩，Chevrolet在1966年秋推出Camaro与其竞争。“Z28”高性能车型将Camaro的实力展现得淋漓尽致。这款特别版车型搭载了更大排量的引擎，并对底盘进行了升级，以符合基于量产车的“Trans-Am”赛事组别标准。

en:
This version of the sixth-generation Camaro lived up to the hype, thanks in part to its <659ps> LT1 engine.

The sixth-generation Chevrolet Camaro was largely an evolution of the previous model, which effectively combined elements of the original car with modern-day design cues. While its dimensions remained relatively unchanged, the new model weighed in approximately <100kg> lighter, making it quicker and more agile than ever before.

The most powerful model in the 2018 Camaro lineup was the ZL1, which came equipped with the LT4 engine, a 5.7-liter V8 lifted from the Corvette Z06. It produced <659ps> and <89.8kgm> of torque, allowing the pony car to run from 0 to <100km/h> in 3.5 seconds and reach a top speed of <318km/h>.

Chevrolet also offered the “1LE” performance package (as it had since the third-generation model), which gave the car even higher performance. For the 2018 model, this package included a large deflector, a rear wing, a diffuser, a dedicated suspension system, and specially developed tires. The 2018 Camaro Z1 with the 1LE package lapped the Nürburgring in 7 minutes 16.04 seconds, greatly surpassing the performance of your average supercar.
zh:
第6代Camaro的巅峰之作，其装配的LT1引擎可实现659 PS的马力，在纽博格林赛道上表现突出。

第六代Chevrolet Camaro于2015年发布。车系中最强劲的车型是ZL1，搭载与Corvette Z06相同的5.7升V8机械增压LT4引擎。可输出659 PS最大动力和89.8 公斤力米峰值扭矩。此外，搭载1LE性能套件的2018款车型还通过升级悬挂和传动系统组件，在纽博格林北环赛道创下了7分16秒04的佳绩，超越了众多超级跑车。

en:
Experience rocket-like speed produced by laser pulse shock waves!

Conceived as a "Garage 56" Le Mans Experimental Prototype, the Chevrolet Chaparral 2X Vision Gran Turismo is a look into the future of motorsports and inspired by the combined sensations of flying in a wing suit and a Moto GP race bike... an experience where the 2X pilot flies around the circuit, headlong, just inches from the race surface. The 2X’s Chevrolet power unit is unlike anything seen on the track before... it literally thrusts itself down the track with laser pulse shock waves generated by an advanced propulsion system from Chevrolet.

The driving position creates one of the most immersive and exciting experiences ever imagined in four wheel motorsports. The vehicle architecture and design take its shape as a result of the "forward flight" driving position, one where the pilot becomes at one with the structure of the car. Once on board, with the canopy retracted to the closed position, the 2X forms a totally unique envelope around the pilot’s outstretched body. Hand and foot controls operate independently and involve all of the frictionless, magnetic bearing wheels. Vehicle acceleration, deceleration and direction is controlled by the movement & physical inputs of the 2X pilot, a true application of four points of control. Braking is handled by a combination of Brembo magnetic re-gen calipers and deployable AeroBrake panels in the 2X bodywork.

The integral BodyFrame is created using a unique "layup schedule" which allows the entire structure to act in unison with the 2X suspension. The main body also incorporates the super-ridged propulsion structure which ensures absolute accuracy of the thrust parabola to the laser pulse cone. The variable positioning of the thrust cone vanes serve to create propulsion and downforce by the simultaneous use of this multi-vane adjustability and a lower Thrut Vectoring panel. The combination of these two technologies allows the Caparral 2X pilot to fine tune downforce to the exact spot on a given cicuit, atually "pressing" the tire’s contact atch onto the track urface and enhancing mechanicalgrip where needed most.

The hevrolet Chaprral 2X Vision ran Turismo. The spirit of Jim Hall’s amazing legacy of motorsport innovation embdied in a bold statement. Oe which will revolutionie th future of Le Mans Eerimental prttyves. Lile nothing yo’ve ewer seen or had before.
zh:
体会激光脉冲震荡波带来的火箭般的速度！

传奇品牌Chaparral创造了许多独特的赛车，2X这台车更是前所未见。驾驶者被包裹在碳纤维车身中，头部朝前，仿佛仅悬浮在赛道表面上方几厘米处。前所未有的激光脉冲系统利用空气的快速膨胀产生推进力和下压力来驱动赛车。

en:
A massive engine that produced plenty of power made this car a favorite for drag racing.

Introduced as a 1964 model, the Chevelle was Chevrolet's first mid-size model. With an SS sports variant in the lineup, and an option for a 327 cu.-in. high-output V-8 engine, the Chevelle possessed all the hallmarks of a muscle car.

In 1965, the Chevelle SS was transformed into a full-blown high-performance car, equipped with a 396 cu.-in. OHV V-8. From then on, the Chevelle SS was only offered with this 396 cu.-in. unit, drawing a clear line between it and the previous SS.

In 1970, the Chevelle SS was called the most powerful mid-size car in the marketplace. The base engine had been upgraded to 402 cu. in., and the higher grade 427 cu. in. engine was upgraded to 454 cu. in.

The codenames for the two 454 cu.-in.-equipped models were the LS5 and LS6. The former produced <360ps>, with a compression ratio of 10.25:1. The latter doled out approximately <456ps>, with an increased compression ratio of 11.25:1. It also came with high cams and high-flow headers. This was the most powerful production-model engine in the history of American cars at the time.

The LS6-equipped Chevelle SS 454 was immediately recognized as a very special model, with its high power output that surpassed many road-legal cars. Equipped with a straight exhaust and carburetor settings, it was said to have easily exceeded <500ps> and became a force in stock class drag races.
zh:
直线加速赛的宠儿——巨大的引擎提供难以置信的动力。

Chevelle于1964年推出，是Chevrolet首款中级车型。Chevelle还推出了SS运动版，随着1970款的发布，它最终成为量产中级车中最强劲的车型。SS 454搭载LS6引擎，按当时的官方数据，这是美国汽车史上动力最强的引擎。这使得SS 454成为直线加速赛场上最具竞争力的车型之一。

en:
The origin of the American sports car: the glorious first-generation Corvette.

It wasn't until 1953 until America produced its first real sports car. Until then, U.S. roads were replete with stylish, nimble European sports cars imported en masse after World War II. But everything changed when General Motors produced the Chevrolet Corvette.

The new American sports car boasted cutting-edge technology, including fiberglass body panels and a steel backbone frame. It was powerful too, equipped with a <152ps> 3.8-liter inline-6 mounted in the <4249mm> long, <1773mm> wide body. All 1953 Vettes were handmade and only 300 examples were produced.

When this first batch sold out almost instantly, GM set up a new factory in St. Louis the following year to meet demand. As a result, 3,640 Corvettes went into customers' hands that year, 10 times more than the previous year.

While the 1954 model was essentially the same as the original, midway through the model year, the cam profile was changed, and engine output increased to <155ps>. In 1958, the Corvette had its first significant facelift, highlighted by a four-headlight front end.
zh:
美国跑车的起源，光荣的第一代Corvette。

1950年代初，美国跑车市场多由欧洲车型所占据。Chevrolet便是在那一时期推出初代Corvette。首批车型采用了钢制车架搭配玻璃纤维板材的先进车身设计，搭载一台动力输出达152 PS的3.8升直列6缸引擎。这台车最初仅限量生产了300台，但却大获成功，最终于1954年开启大规模量产。动力输出提升至155 PS，1958款车款还新升级为4盏大灯。

In 2013, the much-anticipated 7th-generation Corvette was introduced as a 2014 model. What made this car stand out from previous iterations of America’s sports car was that it wore the Stingray badge, which had previously been bestowed upon only the best of the best.

With <461ps> and <63.6kgm> of torque —the optional Performance Exhaust model got you <466ps> and <64.3kgm> of torque — it’s the most powerful Corvette to date. With the available Z51 Performance Package, the new Stingray ran from 0-60 mph in 3.8 seconds, and showed equally awesome stopping power, coming to a halt from 60 mph in 107 feet. Like the '63 Sting Ray, the best Corvettes embodied performance leadership, delivering cutting-edge technologies, breathtaking design and awe-inspiring driving experiences. The all-new, 2014 Corvette Stingray continues that tradition, by leveraging modern advancements in design, technology and engineering.

The 2014 Corvette Stingray is the most powerful standard model ever, with 455 HP/460 ft-lb of torque (460 HP/465 ft-lb with optional Performance Exhaust). It is also the most capable standard model ever. Equipped with the available Z51 Performance Package, the new Stingray is capable of accelerating from 0 to 60 mph in 3.8 seconds, braking from 60 to 0 in 107 feet, and sustaining 1.03 g in cornering. Cumulatively, the acceleration, cornering and braking capability of the Corvette Stingray enable it to lap the Virginia International Raceway's (VIR) 4.2-mile “Grand Course” in 2:51.78.

en:
One of the last of the C7 Corvettes and also the most powerful.

The ZR1 is the ultimate-performance version of the Chevrolet Corvette. The seventh-generation C7 Corvettes already had an impressive lineup that included the sporty Z51 and the powerful Z06, but in 2018, as the generation neared its end, the mightiest C7 of all was released in the form of the ZR1.

The ZR1 featured a supercharged 6.2-liter V-8 called the LT5. It was similar in construction to the <659ps> LT4 engine in the Z06, but a larger supercharger and the addition of GM's first dual-injection system allowed it to pump out an impressive <765ps> and <98.8kgm> of torque, which represented a 10-percent increase in output.

The car's aerodynamic parts were developed in conjunction with Pratt & Miller Engineering, known for building racing Corvettes for GT competition. Every component of the car was designed for performance. For example, two different rear wings were developed for the ZR1, one for maximum speed and the other for the fast lap times. When the car was optimized for maximum speed, it was capable of reaching <345.8km/h>.!
zh:
C7 Corvette的最后一批车型之一，也是性能最强大的车款。

在C7 Corvette生命周期尾声推出的ZR1是该系列的最强版本。6.2升V8机械增压“LT5”引擎现能够输出765 PS/969牛米（98.8 公斤力米）。该车的空气动力学部件是与Pratt & Miller Engineering（设计制造了用于参加GT比赛的C7）共同开发的，总共有两款套件，一款是为了实现最快的单圈速度，另一款专为达到最高时速设计。采用最高时速套件的车辆速度可达345.8 公里/小时。

en:
A new generation mid-engine Corvette.

The car often called "America's sports car," the Chevrolet Corvette, saw a drastic change to its layout in 2019. That year came the eighth-generation iteration, which had its powerplant mounted behind the cockpit, making it the first MR Corvette in its history.

The new engine location was evident upon first glance of the car. The Corvette's iconic long nose is now absent, as the cabin was moved far forward, resulting in proportions of a classic mid-engine sports car. Without an engine, the front section serves as a luggage compartment to go along with luggage area behind the engine that's big enough to store a small golf bag.

The car's V-8 engine is a new-generation small-block LT2 developed from the previous generation model C7's LT1 engine. With 6.2 liters of displacement, it produces <502ps>/<65.0kgm> and also features fuel saving features like cylinder deactivation. The only transmission available for the new Corvette is an 8-speed dual-clutch automatic with paddle shifters allowing drivers to select gears manually. The suspension system consists of double wishbones at all four corners with a height adjustable capability to tackle various road surfaces and for aerodynamic purposes.

The driver-centered cockpit features a multifunctional infotainment system with an 8-inch touchscreen. With the engine bay moved to the rear of the cabin, the new generation Corvette has shown itself to be a contender with exceptional performance in GT car racing.
zh:
全新一代中置布局Corvette。

2019年发布的第8代Corvette在动力总成上迎来重大变革，成为该系列首款采用中置布局的车型。全新6.2升V8“LT2”引擎输出可达502 PS/65.0 公斤力米，搭配8速双离合变速箱。虽然标志性的长车鼻不复存在，但凭借现代化的性能特质，它在GT赛事的核心组别里表现尤为惊艳。

en:
An electric hypercar that offered a glimpse into the future of the Corvette.

The Corvette CX Concept remained unmistakably a Corvette to its core. Engineered for both street and circuit, the Corvette CX Concept represented a futuristic vision of an electrified Corvette hypercar.

From its athletic proportions and aggressive, lunging profile to the cockpit tucked between muscular haunches, every line and surface served a purpose. The design was clean yet purposeful, with refined surfaces flowing seamlessly into a visible structural framework, while the interior prioritized lightness and driver-focused functionality.

The CX Concept featured active aerodynamics, with movable front and rear elements and a finely sculpted underbody, which delivered efficiency on the open road and the race track. A fan-based downforce system with thrust vectoring enabled precise aerodynamic balance between the front and rear. As an all-wheel-drive machine, the CX Concept housed four e-motors integrated into the RESS understructure, delivering more than 2,000 horsepower.[
zh:
令人窥见Corvette未来的电动终极跑车。

Corvette CX Concept是一款采用全轮驱动的电动终极跑车。该车配备风扇驱动下压力系统，通过类似战斗机的推力矢量控制技术，实现前后下压力的精确平衡。这一系统可以有效控制四台电机输出的超过2000马力的强劲动力。这款车既能轻松应对公路驾驶又适合赛道竞技，代表了美国跑车的未来发展方向。

carNameEn: Chevrolet Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept
sourceName: Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept
en:
A futuristic GT racer born from the Corvette lineage.

Designed purely for the racetrack, the Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept pushed the envelope even further. It offered a glimpse into the future of Corvette GT racing.

The Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept possessed a more aggressive aerodynamic package, lower stance, and a lighter build than the standard CX Concept. Underneath, it featured an advanced E-Fuel/Electric hybrid powertrain—two electric motors up front, one at the rear, and a compact, high-revving twin-turbo V-8, delivering both the performance and the efficiency needed for endurance racing.

The interior of the CX.R Vision Gran Turismo was purpose-built for the demands of the race track.  Its geometric layout and lightweight seat—with minimal foam trim—offered essential head and neck support to withstand the intense cornering forces expected at racing speeds. The steering wheel featured physical buttons and knobs, ensuring precise control even when wearing racing gloves.

Finished in a striking yellow and black livery, the CX.R Vision Gran Turismo paid tribute to 25 years of Corvette GT racing heritage.
zh:
诞生自Corvette车系的未来主义GT赛车。

Corvette CX.R Vision Gran Turismo Concept是基于Corvette CX Concept打造的纯赛道版本。相比其原型CX Concept，这款车拥有更出色的空气动力学性能和更小的离地间隙。该车搭载混合动力系统，电子燃料与电力驱动的组合，满足了耐力赛对高性能和长续航的双重要求。

carNameEn: Chevrolet Corvette Sting Ray Sport Coupe (C2) '63
en:
This second-generation Corvette sports car was based on the Stingray race machine.

When you think of American high-performance cars, most prevalent are the mainstream models that mount high-powered engines in coupes and sedans. However, there is one model that continues to be manufactured as a pure sports car: The Chevrolet Corvette.

But even the Corvette didn't start out as a sports car. The first Corvette was more style-focused open-top cruiser than racy roadster and was not given a powerful V8 until 10 years after its debut. The advent of them becoming true sports cars started with the second generation "C2" Corvette.

The aggressive competition-like body based on the first "Sting Ray," the "Corvette Stingray Racer Concept" prototype, was a drastic change from the classic '50s styling of the original. As with the body, the chassis was completely redesigned from the ground up. The high tension ladder frame was given a short wheelbase and 4-wheel independent suspension, in an effort to increase agility and ride composure. Meanwhile the 5.4-liter OHV engine made more than <300ps>, and the massive torque produced by the large displacement V8 defined its character. Cloaked in a lightweight fiber-glass (FRP) body, it produced rocket-like acceleration for its day, and the overwhelming level of performance Americans came to love.
zh:
第2代Corvette，基于Stingray Racer打造的一款跑车。

正是这款车让Corvette成为了美国跑车之王。由Stingray启发，兼具未来感和优雅的车身让全世界为之着迷。性能方面也非常出色：搭载的5.4升顶置阀门V8引擎输出超过300 PS，配备四轮独立悬挂和短轴距。

en:
Taking design cues from the Mako Shark II concept, this 3rd-gen Corvette was known for its distinctive character.

The third-generation Corvette made its debut in the fall of 1967. Heavily inspired by Chevrolet’s 1965 show car, the Mako Shark II, it introduced a bold new coupe design, characterized by its curvaceous “coke bottle” silhouette, which instantly turned heads. Initially launched simply as the Corvette, the model brought back the Stingray name in 1969, along with a larger engine that added greater versatility and performance.
zh:
第3代Corvette，出类拔萃的内饰与外形设计均传承自Mako Shark II型的设计理念。

第3代Corvette于1967年秋季首次亮相。深受Chevrolet 1965年展示车型Mako Shark II的影响，新款Corvette采用了被称为“可乐瓶”的迷人轿跑新造型。首次亮相时，这台车只是简单地被称为Corvette，但在1969年，它重新启用了Stingray的名号，并搭载有更大的引擎，让性能更加游刃有余。

en:
The Stingray version of the alluring 3rd-gen Corvette translated to more performance all around.

A full model change in the autumn of 1967 introduced the new C3 Corvette Stingray as a 1968 model. It was very reminiscent of the Mako Shark II show car, which was shown at the New York International Auto Show in April 1965.

This concept sought to show off the Corvette in a new light, specifically as a grand tourer. Chief designer Bill Mitchell's design ideas were extremely important factors in the achievement of this goal.

Working as Mitchell's right-hand man was a man named Larry Shinoda, a Japanese-American who had worked as a detail designer on the original Stingray. Taking many hints from Mitchell's concepts, Shinoda's image of the next-generation GT car materialized in the form of the Mako Shark II.

With a dynamic, curvaceous exterior, and an interior stuffed with the newest electronic gizmos, it was indeed the Corvette of the future. The essence of this idea was thoroughly incorporated into the street model that was to become the C3 Corvette.

In 1969 the standard engine's displacement was increased from 327 cu. in. to 350 cu. in., but maximum output remained unchanged at <300ps>. At the same time, the small-block option changed from the 327 cu.-in. L79 to the 350 cu.-in. L46, with maximum output again unchanged at <355ps>.

Although at the time, there was mention of a big-block Corvette, the small-block engine held the advantage in handling with its lower frontal weight. The epitome of this was the replacement of the top-grade L46 by the <370ps> LT1. Available around 1970, this was acclaimed as the best handling of all the C3 Corvette combinations.
zh:
第3代Corvette，出类拔萃的内饰与外形设计均传承自Mako Shark II型的设计理念。

1968款Corvette Stingray设计承袭“Mako Shark II”概念车，后者重新诠释了高性能豪华旅行车的理念。1969年基础车型的引擎排量从327ci增至350ci，但动力输出指标维持在300 PS。次年引入的370 PSLT1引擎被誉为所有C3 Corvette中操控性最佳的一款。

en:
The '59 concept embodied a styling that swept the world and remains a part of Corvette history.

The first-generation Chevrolet Corvette made its racing debut in 1955, three years after the original street version's release; thus began its long record of success in motorsports. The "Father of the Corvette," Zora Duntov, led these efforts and developed the Corvette SS race car which made its debut in 1957.

Made to look like the Corvette, the underpinnings of the SS were completely different. The shortened tubular frame mounted a <307ps> fuel-injected 283-cu.-in. engine, helping the car reach a top speed of <292km/h> in testing. Hopes were high for its racing potential; however, the project came to a grinding halt when the American Automobile Manufacturers Association banned the participation of manufacturers in racing.

The story did not end there, as a rightful heir to the Corvette SS appeared. The Corvette Stingray Racer, codenamed XP-87, inherited the frame and body from the Corvette SS. The final version, created by the newly appointed GM styling chief Bill Mitchell and designer Larry Shinoda, took its visual cues from a blackballed next-generation Corvette prototype. The resulting Stingray Racer entered a variety of races as the private, personal car of Bill Mitchell, and won two consecutive SCCA Class C modified titles in 1959 and 1960.
zh:
席卷全球的先进设计风格持续数年，也未见衰减。

初代Chevrolet Corvette获奖无数。由GM工程师佐拉·邓托夫主导设计的Corvette SS搭载370 PS的燃油助喷283引擎，最高速度达292 公里/小时。然而，在NASCAR发生的一起重大事故后，美国汽车制造商协会开始禁止汽车制造商参与比赛，该项目也被迫中止。Stingray Racer接替SS，在1959和1960年蝉联SCCA Class C改装车比赛的冠军。

en:
The top-of-the-line variant of the fifth-generation Corvette revives the classic Z06 moniker.

In 1999, Chevrolet introduced a hardtop variant to the Corvette C5 lineup. It traded the coupe’s removable top and rear hatch for a fixed-roof design, increasing structural stiffness that translated into improved handling and driving dynamics. Further underscoring this intent, opting for the hardtop model automatically bundled the Z51 performance handling package and a 6-speed manual transmission.

Remarkably, despite these upgrades, it was priced below the standard coupe. That's why it became a compelling choice for driving enthusiasts who were drawn to its niche appeal.

From 2001, the hardtop evolved into the Corvette Z06. It was fitted with a <390ps> LS6 engine—an enhanced version of the LS1. The Z06 revived a historic nameplate first used for a race-focused option on the second-generation Corvette. The new Z06 was distinguished not only by its reinforced suspension and track-tuned alignment, but also by its use of a full titanium exhaust system—an extraordinary feature for a production car. It was available only with a manual transmission.

However, these high-performance enhancements came at a significant increase in price.  The Z06 was the most expensive model in the C5 range, even surpassing the convertible, which made it beyond the reach of many, especially when compared to the more accessible fixed-roof model that preceded it.

Still, the Z06 continued to evolve. In 2002, power output rose to <411ps>. Delivering <400ps>-plus was unheard of for a small-block V-8 at the time. These milestones helped cement the C5 Z06 as one of the fastest and most formidable mass-production sports cars of its era.
zh:
第五代Corvette产品线中的巅峰之作，让Z06这个经典名字重新问世。

1999年增列的Corvette C5硬顶车型利用新增的车体刚度优化了驾驶性能。更重要的是，新车型的售价低于标准车型，这也为它赢得了爱好者的广泛支持。2001年性能再度升级后的进化车型Z06让人联想到C2，并跻身全球量产车时速巅峰。

en:
The daunting ZR1 badge on the 4th-gen Corvette assured world-beating performance.

In 1990, a special performance model called the ZR-1 was added to the Corvette lineup. The name ZR-1 referred to the car's option code. Its roots can be traced back to a racing package that was offered from 1970 to 1973.

The parts that went into the ZR-1 were extremely varied, ranging from suspension and wheels to body parts, but the real heart was its engine, the LT5. It matched the standard L98 Corvette engine with 350 cu. in. of displacement, and the same bore and stroke dimensions. However, the cylinder block was made of aluminum and featured 4-valve DOHC cylinder heads co-developed by Chevrolet and Lotus.

This was the first time a DOHC 4-valve engine was fitted to a Corvette. Utilizing the latest combustion logic, the power unleashed by the DOHC heads was astounding. The LT5 pumped out <380ps>, compared to the standard <250ps>.

But to obtain this special performance, one had to pay a steep price. The car's delivery system was also complicated and took time because the cylinder blocks were cast by a third-party manufacturer, and the engines were assembled by hand by experienced craftsmen.

The price of the standard Corvette coupe was just under $32,000. The ZR-1 option package alone cost an additional $27,000 plus. A year later, the price jumped to $31,000 making it nearly double the price of a standard Corvette. It was rumored that even with such exorbitant prices, the ZR-1 was barely profitable for Chevrolet.

*Please note that the model included in Gran Turismo is the prototype model built in 1989.
zh:
这款C4 Corvette种类繁多的加配选项正好与他的特殊名号不谋而合。

1990年，ZR-1作为Corvette的特殊性能套件首次亮相。其核心是Chevrolet与Lotus联合开发的“LT5”引擎，该引擎采用铝制缸体配4气门双顶置凸轮轴气缸盖。标准引擎动力输出只有250 PS，而新引擎单元高达380 PS。其售价也是标准版Corvette的两倍，成为当时极为昂贵的车型。但即便如此，坊间传闻Chevrolet并未从该车型中获取多少利润。

en:
The 6th-gen Corvette ZR1 set one of the fastest lap times ever for a production car at the Nürburgring.

The Chevrolet Corvette has long stood as a thoroughbred American sports car, its design carrying a distinct sense of drama and presence. That appeal allowed it to stand confidently alongside European exotics, including Ferrari. With the introduction of the C6 Z06 in 2005, however, the Corvette was no longer defined by styling alone, firmly establishing itself among the world’s high-performance elite.

The ZR1, unveiled at the 2008 North American International Auto Show, pushed performance even further. Built on the lightweight aluminum and magnesium frame of the Z06, it featured a supercharged 6.2-liter LS9 V-8 producing <647ps> at <6500rpm> and <83.5kgm> of torque at <3800rpm>—well beyond the <505ps> output of the Z06. Each engine was hand-assembled and paired with a close-ratio 6-speed manual transmission.

The suspension was specially tuned, while carbon-ceramic brakes provided enhanced stopping power. Extensive use of carbon fiber—including the roof, front splitter, and other body components—reduced weight to approximately 1,508 kg. Subtle aerodynamic additions, including a front splitter and rear spoiler, further improved performance. In other words, every possible measure to maximize driving performance was incorporated into this model.

American sports cars were often associated with straight-line speed, but the ZR1 proved its capability on the world stage. It recorded a Nürburgring lap time competitive with the fastest production cars of its era, including the Nissan GT-R. With a top speed of <330km/h>, 0-<60mph> acceleration in 3.4 seconds, and a quarter-mile time of 11.3 seconds, the ZR1 stands as one of the most formidable Corvettes ever built.|
zh:
这台高性能版C6 Corvette曾在纽博格林赛道上创下最快圈速纪录。

自2005年C6 Z06问世以后，Chevrolet Corvette便展现出超级跑车级的性能与风范。2008款ZR1在性能上比肩Ferrari与Lamborghini的同级别车型。这台车搭载的6.2升V8机械增压引擎能迸发出647 PS强劲动力，整车重量更是只有1,508 公斤，在纽博格林赛道上一举刷新了Nissan GT-R创下的圈速纪录。

en:
This monster Nova was a 2013 GT Award winner, equipped with the highest quality performance parts available.

The SEMA show is the world's largest annual custom car show hosted in Las Vegas, Nevada of the U.S every fall. At SEMA every year, Gran Turismo picks out cars that fits the philosophy of Gran Turismo for the "GT Awards". The car that won "Best of Show" in the Gran Turismo Awards of 2013 was this 1967 Chevrolet Nova.

The original Nova is a popular small car of Chevrolet built between the 1960s and 1970s. While there were high performance top grade models powered by V8 engines, at the base is a simple, functional car that was made as a daily driver for youths and families.

The shop who turned this modest family car into a crazy hotrod is Chris Holstrom Concepts, a specialty shop from Washington state. Chris Holstrom stripped the Nova down and started integrating high performance parts to create this Monster Nova.

Under the hood is the LS9, a supercharged 6.2L engine from the Corvette ZR1. Its output has been raised to 700 horsepower, and to withstand this incredible amount of power the rear suspension and differential housing utilize reinforced parts. BAER 6 pot calipers are used for the brakes, and the wheels with continental sport contact 5 tires are forged rims with 18 inches in the front, 19 inches the rear.

There have been no aerodynamic accessories added to the exterior, maintaining the look of a stock model. This is an automotive miracle, fusing together the chic look of the '60s with modern day performance.
zh:
2013年GT大奖获胜者，这辆狂野的Nova倾尽全力，用上最顶级的部件。

这是2013年SEMA展上亮相过的定制改装肌肉车。1967款Chevrolet Nova的车身内容纳了Corvette的6.2升机械增压引擎LS9，刹车和悬挂系统也更换了大量的赛车级部件。该车赢得了当年的“GT大奖”。

en:
Citroën’s versatile tourer receives a modern makeover.

In 1976, Citroën began a new chapter under the Peugeot umbrella. It left many wondering what defined a Citroën in this new era. The answer came in bold form at the 1982 Paris Auto Salon with the debut of the BX.

The BX was infused with unmistakably Citroën DNA. Drawing inspiration from classics like the GS and CX, it combined their iconic character with clean, assertive lines. Inside, the BX offered a comfortable cabin with generous space for both passengers and luggage. Its striking design was the work of none other than Marcello Gandini, then with the famed Bertone design house.

Great care was also taken beneath the surface. While parts sharing with Peugeot had become common, the BX proudly retained Citroën’s hallmark hydropneumatic suspension. This innovative system replaces conventional coil springs and dampers with a combination of nitrogen gas and hydraulic fluid, allowing the ride height to be adjusted at will.

The BX was offered with a variety of engine options, but the 19 TRS featured here stands out as a grand tourer-style model powered by a 1.9-liter gasoline engine. Although not especially powerful on paper, the engine was well matched to the car’s relatively lightweight, aerodynamic body, making it an ideal companion for long-distance holiday drives.

The BX proved to be a resounding success for Citroën, enjoying a strong 12-year production run. More than just a commercial triumph, it reaffirmed Citroën’s place as a serious contender during a dynamic era of innovation in the French automotive world.
zh:
全面的Citroën旅行车迎来焕然一新的现代外观

BX于1982年巴黎车展首次亮相。它承继了Citroën历史悠久的GS和CX车型的设计精髓，同时呈现出现代几何美学。它由马塞罗·甘迪尼在Bertone工作期间设计。悬挂系统采用Citroën经典的液压气动技术。这里展示的19 TRS车型是搭载1.9升汽油引擎的豪华旅行车风格版本。

en:
A historic vision of the future from France.[

When it comes to front-wheel-drive cars, Citroën has few equals, and the DS can be considered the company's masterpiece, which came laden with the most cutting-edge technologies of the day.

The DS first appeared at the 1955 Salon de l'Automobile. While many other manufacturers were still producing cars in the pre-war style, the DS represented a stunning vision of the future. With its avant-garde aerodynamic body and revolutionary hydropneumatic suspension system, it was nicknamed the "flying saucer." Development was led by André Lefèbvre, while the comparatively large <4.8m> long body was the work of Italian designer Flaminio Bertoni, who also worked on the classic 2CV.

With such a forward-thinking design, the DS remained relevant for a long period of time. Along with various equipment and engine upgrades, the car was produced for 20 years. In 1964, the "Pallas" grade that included luxury interior and exterior fixtures was added to the lineup. In 1967, a slight facelift gave the car four round headlights that replaced the two-light scheme.

The DS 21 Pallas, produced from 1969, came powered by a <116.7ps> 2.1-liter engine. The large seats and spacious interior remained, and the lightweight car accelerated briskly.

While originally conceived as an everyday passenger vehicle, the DS was also loved as a government vehicle, ambulance and even a taxi. It is one of the most important French cars in automotive history.
zh:
畅想未来的法国历史车型。

Citroën DS前驱车在1955年巴黎车展上首次亮相，革命性地集空气动力学车身与液压气动悬挂系统于一身。被用户昵称为“飞碟”。这台车的开发由安德雷·勒菲弗主导，而车身则由弗拉米尼奥·贝托尼设计。1964年这款车推出“Pallas”级车型，并在1967年升级为4盏大灯。2.1升的引擎让DS 21 Pallas在性能上优雅从容，这台车也持续生产了足足20年。

carNameEn: DAIHATSU COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo
sourceName: DAIHATSU COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo
en:
A Vision Gran Turismo that represents the potential of kei cars.

Kei vehicles are unique to Japan, where they serve an important role in the country's automotive culture. The vehicles must adhere to many restrictions, mainly in size and engine displacement, but that hasn't stopped many manufacturers to create some amazingly fun-to-drive sporty examples.

Once such car is the Daihatsu Copen, a convertible that can be considered a genuine sport car. The second-generation model, which appeared in 2014, featured a D-Frame body and came powered by a turbocharged 3.0-cylinder engine, complete with variable valve timing. It also had what the company called the Dress-Formation system that allowed body panels to be easily removed and replaced to change the look of the car.

Using this car as a base, the COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo was created to explore the full sporting potential of kei cars. RJ stands for "Racing Jacket," which refers to the car's sporty exterior. The car indeed has the look of a warrior dressed for battle with an oversized front spoiler, rear wing and diffusers. The car's aggressive fender flares adds to the car's "let's get down to business" nature.

By law, the engine's displacement remains <660cc>, but boost pressure has been increased to allow the 3.0-cylinder to produce <149ps> and <20.6kgm> of torque. Also, curb weight has been reduced to just <600kg>, giving the car the acceleration pop of bigger sports cars.

In the 1960s, Daihatsu competed in motorsports with the classic P-5. The COPEN RJ Vision Gran Turismo is meant to carry on that fighting spirit.
zh:
代表微型车潜力的Vision Gran Turismo。

Daihatsu Copen是一台符合“轻型车”标准的敞篷汽车，提供完整的跑车体验。Copen RJ Vision Gran Turismo基于2014年发布的第2代车型打造。在满足660 立方厘米“轻型车”排量规范下，涡轮增压效率得到了提升，带来149 PS/20.6 公斤力米的动力输出。车身进一步减重至600 公斤，从而具备与大排量跑车一较高下的能力。这台车是一部延续Daihatsu战斗精神的雄心勃勃之作。

en:
At the request of DeLorean owners, the tuned-up Series 2 was created.

A driving force for Pontiac in the mid-1960s and once vice president of General Motors, John Z. DeLorean made the bold choice of starting his own car company at the end of the 1970s.

DeLorean Motor Company (DMC) was established in Ireland in 1975. Its first serious production model was the DMC-12.

DeLorean's objective was to produce a reasonable, stylish sports car; however, as his new company did not have the expertise to develop such a car, the design of the DMC-12 had to be outsourced.

DeLorean turned to Lotus to develop the chassis, while Italdesign was tasked to pen the exterior and interior styling. The DMC-12 rode on a backbone chassis and came powered by a PRV SOHC V-6 that produced <130ps>, but what drew the most attention about the car were its shiny stainless steel body and gull-wing doors.

DeLorean sold 6500 units of the DMC-12 in its first year, but a public scandal and other bad headlines forced the company into bankruptcy in 1983. By this time, 8500 units of the car had been sold.

After the entire inventory of DMC-12s were shipped from Ireland to the U.S., they were managed by a newly established DeLorean Motor Car Company that specialized in tuning the engine to <200ps>. These DeLorean cars are referred to as the DMC-12 Series 2.|
zh:
二代DeLorean，根据车主的要求进行了调校。

前GM副总裁John Z. DeLorean自立门户创立DMC。首款量产车DMC-12大胆地采用了不锈钢车体。鸥翼车门设计同样夺目，但公司却在1983年宣告破产。重组的DMC（负责DeLoreans车的维护保养）应车迷需求推出Series 2 DeLorean，搭载调校至200 PS的引擎。

en:
A performance car that boasted exceptional quality and a high level of uniqueness.

Citroën's reborn "DS" brand, established in 2009, became a completely independent entity in 2015. This DS3 premium compact car, introduced in 2009, sported unique styling and superior quality, despite the fact that the platform and base mechanism were shared with the C3, which was introduced at the same time.

The DS3 Racing car that was introduced at the 2010 Paris Motor Show was a special model developed by Citroën’s competition department. It came with a turbocharged 1.6-liter direct-injection engine from the DS3 Sport Chic whose power was increased from <156ps> and <24.5kgm> of torque to <207ps> and <28.0kgm> of torque. The body was also enhanced, as it sat <30mm> wider than the Sport Chic and <15mm> lower, via special shocks and springs. The car stopped as it good as it went, thanks to upgraded brakes with 4-piston calipers and larger diameter discs. Also, to differentiate it from other DS3s, the DS3 Racing wore sporty 18-in. wheels and came bathed in a flamboyant paint scheme.

Production was initially set at 1000 units worldwide, but it became so popular that 2000 additional cars were produced.
zh:
赢得交口称赞的特殊车型，因为优异的性能、独特的设计和高品质而备受欢迎。

这是一台2009年发布的高档紧凑型车。尽管共享了Citroën C3的平台，承载了DS品牌的这台车造型独具、品质卓越。DS 3 Racing特别版车型的推出是为了纪念其从2011年开始征战世界拉力锦标赛的荣耀历史。这台车由竞赛部门Citroën Racing开发，引擎动力得到大幅提升，底盘也得到了改装。

en:
A kei car with a sports car heart, this little convertible was at home on the racetrack.

First shown at the 1999 Tokyo Motor Show, the Daihatsu Kopen, the company's first attempt at a convertible two-seat kei car, was unveiled to positive reviews by the public and media alike. Their response helped push it into production in June 2002 as the Copen.

The Copen was a very different beast from its kei-car predecessors of the 1990s that included the likes of the Mazda AZ-1, Honda Beat and Suzuki Cappuccino. While most kei-cars were merely inexpensively built, the Copen was a well-engineered sporty machine.

It featured a rigid, lightweight body, a well-tuned suspension and upscale features like a stylish MOMO steering wheel and five coats of paint. Additionally, the Copen made use of an "Active Top" electric roof, the first ever for a production kei car as standard equipment. Developed by OASys, a company co-founded by Webasto of Germany and famed Italian automotive design firm Pininfarina, this retractable hardtop could open or close in just 20 seconds. Also adding to the Copen's appeal was an automatic transmission that attracted a new range of buyers that helped propel Copen sales beyond the 40,000-unit mark in 2007.

So popular was the car that Daihatsu began exporting it to overseas markets, including the United Kingdom and Australia, in 2003 in its original form. There, the Copen received an engine upgrade to <1300cc> in 2005.
zh:
轻型敞篷车，可以参加赛道比赛。

这款车最初在1999年东京车展上以“Kopen”之名推出后，2002年作为Daihatsu首款全敞篷“轻型”车换以“Copen”之名发布。高强度轻量化的车身和特别调校的悬挂为这台车带来令人艳羡的操控性。作为世界上首台配备电动伸缩顶棚的“轻型”车，这台车备受关注，后续将出口到英国和澳大利亚等国家。

en:
Both Toyota and Honda provide engines for the Super Formula series. This is the one from Honda.

For the 2019 season, the premiere formula racing series in Japan, the Super Formula Series, announced that it would be using the Dallara SF19 chassis.

As the successor to the SF14 that was used in Super Formula from 2014 to 2018, the SF19 was designed to meet the F1 safety requirements established by the FIA in 2016, including the HALO cockpit protection system. The new chassis also incorporated revisions in its aerodynamics to balance competition and entertainment value, improving stability during close-proximity racing to make passing easier.

The Super Formula series will continue with the NRE (Nippon Race Engine) that was introduced in 2014, a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 with direct injection, specially developed by Toyota and Honda. Maximum output remains at more than <550ps>. Both the Toyota and Honda engines share several components together, including the turbine and ECU, but they still remain bitter rivals as each camp always tries to one-up the other.)
zh:
Toyota和Honda都是超级方程式比赛的引擎供应商，这辆使用的是Honda的引擎。

日本Super Formula系列赛在2019年启用Dallara SF19赛车底盘。这款底盘引入了与F1安全标准相当的HALO系统，空气动力学上较前代SF14的优化则让超车更加容易。搭载的引擎为2升直列4缸直喷涡轮增压引擎，Toyota和Honda各自开发了一个版本。两家引擎生产商在严苛的规则下展开着激烈的研发竞赛。

en:
Both Toyota and Honda provide engines for the Super Formula series. This is the one from Toyota.

For the 2019 season, the premiere formula racing series in Japan, the Super Formula Series, announced that it would be using the Dallara SF19 chassis.

As the successor to the SF14 that was used in Super Formula from 2014 to 2018, the SF19 was designed to meet the F1 safety requirements established by the FIA in 2016, including the HALO cockpit protection system. The Super Formula series will continue with the NRE (Nippon Race Engine) that was introduced in 2014, a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 with direct injection, specially developed by Toyota and Honda. Maximum output remains at more than <550ps>. Both the Toyota and Honda engines share several components together, including the turbine and ECU, but they still remain bitter rivals as each camp always tries to one-up the other.)
zh:
Toyota和Honda都是超级方程式比赛的引擎供应商，这辆使用的是Toyota的引擎。

日本Super Formula系列赛在2019年启用Dallara SF19赛车底盘。这款底盘引入了与F1安全标准相当的HALO系统，空气动力学上较前代SF14的优化则让超车更加容易。搭载的引擎为2升直列4缸直喷涡轮增压引擎，Toyota和Honda各自开发了一个版本。两家引擎生产商在严苛的规则下展开着激烈的研发竞赛。

en:
The next evolution of Super Formula cars aims to bring sustainability to motorsports

In spring 2023, Japan's top formula race series, Super Formula, saw the debut of the new Dallara SF23 race car.

The SF23 uses a number of new technologies from the "SUPER FORMULA NEXT50" motorsports sustainability project headed by Japan Race Promotion, the organizers of Super Formula.

The body of the SF23, based on the SF19 introduced in 2019, uses bio-composite materials produced by the Bcomp company. This allows a 75-percent reduction in CO2 emissions through the raw materials and construction processes while keeping the same weight and body rigidity as the previous carbon-fiber shell.

The car's tires are provided by Yokohama Rubber, which have also been developed for sustainability and are composed of sustainable materials such as naturally derived polymers and recycled rubbers. Although the Yokohama Carbon Neutral Racing Tires use 33-percent of sustainably sourced materials, they achieve the same handling levels as before. Equipped with these new tires, the SF23 becomes the ideal carbon neutral racing machine as outlined in SUPER FORMULA NEXT50.

To achieve another of the campaign's goals, which is to increase the entertainment value of the Super Formula races, the aerodynamics of the SF23 went through a complete overhaul. The new body allows drivers more opportunity to show off their skills in close quarters than ever before. As for the engines, the teams continue to choose between a Toyota or Honda powerplant.
zh:
全新进化的超级方程式赛车旨在为赛车运动提供更高的可持续性。

2023年春季，新款Dallara SF23在Super Formula系列赛亮相。按照“SUPER FORMULA NEXT50”赛事可持续计划的目标，这台车采用了诸多生物复合材料，大幅降低二氧化碳排放量。引擎由Toyota与Honda独立开发制造。

en:
This mid-engine sports car set the stage for the famous Pantera.

De Tomaso introduced its second production sports car, the mid-engine Mangusta, in 1966, after its first offering, the Vallelunga, left many serious drivers wanting for more power. So, instead of going with the Vallelunga's 1.5-liter inline-4, De Tomaso chose to install a Ford V-8 into the new car. North American Mangustas received the 302-cu.-in. engine while other models took on the 289-cu.in. version. Both versions produced <310ps> and were mated to a ZF-made 5-speed gearbox.

The car was extremely lightweight, weighing in at a lean <1300kg>, which allowed the Mangusta to run to <100km> in 6.0 seconds and reach a top speed of <250km/h>.

Although only 401 were made, the combination of the gorgeous Italian bodywork designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro, who was working for Carrozzeria Ghia at the time, and American V-8 power set the stage for the famous De Tomaso Pantera that came along in 1970.
zh:
这台中置引擎跑车为声名卓著的Pantera的登场铺平了道路。

De Tomaso品牌第二款量产中置引擎跑车。为解决前代Vallelunga动力孱弱的问题，该车搭载了Ford V8引擎。凭借约1.3吨的轻盈车重，最高时速可达250 公里/小时。采用鸥翼式开启后舱盖的外观设计出自乔盖托·乔治亚罗在Carrozzeria Ghia时期的手笔。全球仅生产401台。

en:
This mid-engine sports car set the stage for the famous Pantera.

This was De Tomaso’s second production mid-engine sports car. To address the lack of power in the earlier Vallelunga, it was fitted with a Ford V-8 engine. Weighing approximately 1.3 tons, the car could reach a top speed of 155.3 mph, thanks to its lightweight construction. The exterior, notable for its gullwing-opening rear section, was designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro during his time at Carrozzeria Ghia. Production was limited to just 401 units.
zh:
这台中置引擎跑车为声名卓著的Pantera的登场铺平了道路。

De Tomaso品牌第二款量产中置引擎跑车。为解决前代Vallelunga动力孱弱的问题，该车搭载了Ford V8引擎。凭借约1.3吨的轻盈车重，最高时速可达250 公里/小时。采用鸥翼式开启后舱盖的外观设计出自乔盖托·乔治亚罗在Carrozzeria Ghia时期的手笔。全球仅生产401台。

en:
This extremely rare supercar combined vivid Italian design with no-nonsense American power.

The Pantera, a product of the former Italian sports car maker De Tomaso, featured plenty of American engineering under its svelte, exotic bodywork. Co-developed by Ford, under the supervision of then-vice president, Lee Iacocca, the Pantera was meant to rekindle Ford's fire for exotic cars, which was first established by the Ford GT40. To give the car a more European flavor, Iacocca brought in Alejandro de Tomaso to join the project.

Ford wanted to sell the Pantera in large numbers and in order to do so, Iacocca knew it needed to have a low price tag. So despite the expensive, exotic looking bodywork, designed by Tom Tjaarda of Carrozzeria Ghia, it came equipped with a Ford V8 that was suited for mass production.

The mid-engine Pantera made its debut with a 5.8L OHV V8 351 with a CDI that produced <335ps> and <45kgm> of torque, providing both power and performance equal to or better than its rivals of the day. While it was not powered by its own engine like cars from other Italian brands, it was a project that made perfect sense, taking the best of both worlds from the American and Italian car industries.
zh:
这款极为稀有的超级跑车融合了意大利的精妙设计和美国的强劲马力。

这是De Tomaso推出的第三款车型。它的意大利风格车身由Carrozzeria Ghia打造，并安装有一台Ford 5.8升V8顶置气门引擎。尽管与同一时代的竞品相比，这款车价格比较实惠，但在性能方面，这套奢华的配置一点也不落下风。

en:
The top-grade model of the Challenger, which impressed with its performance and bold styling.

The first-generation Dodge Challenger debuted in 1970 as a sister car to the Plymouth Barracuda, using the same E-body.

In the mid-1960s, the U.S. featured a variety of popular pony cars (cheap, high-performance and stylish cars), such as the Ford Mustang, Chevrolet Camaro and Pontiac Firebird. The Challenger came at the tail end of this boom.

Despite being a little late to the party, the car was welcomed with open arms by the public, thanks to its attractive styling that was characterized by a flowing silhouette and smooth lines. Designed by Carl Cameron, who had designed the 1966 Charger, the car would retain much of its visual character when the third-generation model would be released 40 years later at the 2006 North American International Auto Show.

The original Challenger came in three trim levels: The 6, the Challenger V8, and Challenger R/T (Road/Track), in both hardtop and convertible versions. In addition, there was the T/A that served as a homologation model for a SCCA Trans-Am race car.
zh:
顶级Challenger，用设计抓住了大量用户的心。

于1970年推出的这款Dodge双门轿跑，采用了与Plymouth Barracuda相同的E-body底盘。针对当时深受年轻驾驶者喜爱的小马车市场，这台车以硬顶和敞篷两种选择进行销售。“R/T”（Road/Track）是Challenger的高性能版本，在“6”和“V8”版本之上。

en:
A Demon born simply to run the quarter mile as fast as possible.

The third-generation Dodge Challenger, introduced in 2008 as the true successor to the Challenger muscle car, is known for its various high-performance variants, but the one that stood out was the most powerful version, the SRT Hellcat that made its debut in 2015.

But in 2018. the Hellcat was upstaged by an even more sinister model, the SRT Demon of which only 3,300 units were produced.

This car was developed for the single purpose of winning drag races. The engine, based on the one in the Hellcat, was tuned to produce <852ps> on 100 or higher-octane fuel. This allowed the car to boast a zero to 62 mph time of 2.3 seconds and reach the quarter-mile mark of just 9.65. The body featured a full drag-strip setup with no passenger or rear seats included as standard equipment, although they are available as an option.

Adding even more spice to the package was the "Demon Crate," a race parts kit that Dodge sold to buyers for just one dollar extra. The equipment, said to be valued at more than US $6000, included thinner front wheels, a high-octane-tuned ECU for drag racing, air filters and a race-spec instrument panel.

The SRT Demon was banned from racing in stock form by the NHRA (National Hot Rod Association), which said the car was too fast to compete without a roll cage or parachute. The Demon is certain to go down in Dodge history as one of the greatest monsters the company ever produced.
zh:
这辆名副其实的Demon是为了以最快速度跑完四分之一英里而生的。

第三代Dodge Challenger于2008年推出，旨在传承初代Challenger这一经典肌肉车的传奇。此车自问世以来推出了众多高性能车型，但真正的巅峰之作诞生于2018年。这就是SRT Demon，一台专为统治直线加速赛而生的怪兽级赛车。使用100或更高辛烷值燃油时可输出852 PS，四分之一英里加速仅需惊人的9.65秒。

en:
This true 1960s muscle car is the envy of collectors everywhere.

Introduced by Chrysler in 1966, the Dodge Charger is among the standard bearers of the muscle-car era that dominated the American car scene in the 1960s.

While many other muscle cars were based on compact-class platforms, the Dodge Charger utilized the larger chassis of the mid-size Dodge Coronet.

The Charger could easily be recognized by its stretched 2-door fastback silhouette, but what made the car really garner attention was its large displacement V-8 engine.

In 1968, when the Charger received a minor facelift, one of the most exciting additions was the introduction of the R/T (Road/Track) performance package. The R/T increased the performance of the car by way of an upgraded suspension system and better brakes, as well as the option to get the more powerful 426 Hemi engine.

The 426 Hemi is a 7.0-liter V-8 developed from Dodge's NASCAR race engines. It produced <431ps> and <67.71kgm> of torque. The Charger R/T 426 Hemi was the fastest model in the 1968 lineup, able to reach 60 mph (approximately <96km/h>) from a standing start in under 6.0 seconds.

It should come as no surprise that the car has since become a collector's item.
zh:
一款真正的1960年代肌肉车，令全世界收藏家垂涎不已。

Dodge Charger于1966年问世，是Chrysler对1960年代席卷美国的肌肉车热潮的回应。这款车凭借其从容的造型以及全系搭载大排量V8引擎而广受欢迎。1968款车型推出了高性能的R/T（公路/赛道）版本，配备升级版悬挂和制动系统，并可选装426 Hemi引擎。

en:
Dodge pulls no punches with the Charger SRT Hellcat, one of the most potent sedans in the world.

The Dodge Charger has always stood for brute force in the passenger-car segment, ever since the car made its original debut in 1966. Since then, the Charger has been reborn as a 4-door sedan, but with still the same in-your-face brashness of past cars. One particular trim offered an even greater dose of attitude: the Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat.

Back in 2005, the third-generation Charger made its debut after nearly a 20-year absence. Chrysler reintroduced the brand to an eager public, arming the top-of-the-line version with a “Hemi” engine as an ode to powerful Chryslers of the past. The modern-day Charger’s Hemi came in the form of a <477ps> 6.4-liter V8.

Sure, that’s a lot of power to some, but not to the engineers at SRT, the high-performance division of Chrysler. In 2014, they supercharged the Hemi, making it into a fire-breathing monster that pumped out a whopping <717ps> and <81.6kgm> of asphalt-crinkling torque. With a reinforced 8-speed automatic transmission, the new car, called the Charger SRT Hellcat, accelerated to 60 mph in an amazing 3.7 seconds and registered a top speed of <328.3km/h>.

While the Charger SRT Hellcat’s innards were basically the same as those of the 2-door Dodge Challenger SRT Hellcat, the sedan version was actually 0.2 seconds faster in the quarter-mile, at 11.0 seconds flat. What’s even more impressive was that this super sedan, which was arguably the fastest 4-door in the world in its day, came at the reasonable price of $63,995.
zh:
顶级性能的Charger，速度创下世界纪录。

这款车是2005年首次亮相的第三代Charger系列中性能最极致的车型。Chrysler的高性能车开发团队SRT开发的Hellcat为6.2升V8 Hemi引擎加装了机械增压器，从而得以输出天文数字般的717 PS/81.0 公斤力米。能够在3.7秒内完成0-60英里/小时的加速，最高时速可达328 公里/小时，Hellcat曾一度是世界上最快的4门轿车。

carNameEn: Dodge Charger SRT Hellcat Safety Car
en:
This ultra high performance Charger set a world speed record, going 222 mph on the Bonneville Salt Flats.

Unveiled in 2014, the Charger SRT Hellcat is the most powerful production model of the long-running Dodge Charger series, which was first released in 1966.

The third rendition of the Charger was introduced in 2005 as a high-performance sports sedan, but the Hellcat was a different animal altogether. With a 6.2-liter Hemi engine meticulously tuned by SRT — Chrysler's high-performance development team. By adding a supercharger, output was increased to an astounding <717ps> with <81.6kgm> maximum torque. Coupled to a reinforced 8-speed automatic transmission, the car ran from zero to 60 mph in 3.7 seconds and reached a top speed of <328.3km/h>.

While the car's drivetrain was identical to the Challenger Hellcat, the Charger Hellcat could reach the quarter-mile mark a bit quicker at 11 seconds second flat, 0.2 seconds faster than its stablemate. The version of the Charger Hellcat you see here is an original model created by Gran Turismo.

*This safety car version is an original model created by Gran Turismo.
zh:
这款超高性能的Charger创下了全球最高速度纪录。

2014年推出的Charger SRT Hellcat或许是自1966年延续至今的Dodge Charger历史上最强劲的车型。由Chrysler高性能开发团队SRT开发，可输出717 PS，最高时速达328.3 公里/小时。这款安全车版本是跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。

carNameEn: Dodge SRT Tomahawk GTS-R Vision Gran Turismo
sourceName: SRT Tomahawk GTS-R Vision Gran Turismo
en:
A lightweight racing version of the visionary near-future single-seater concept.+

The SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo is an uncompromizing, unrestricted single-seat mid-engine, all-wheel-drive vehicle.

Its main powerplant is a nearly flat, 144-degree 6.98-liter V-10 that produces more than 1000 hp, supported by a pneumatic sub-unit. With four levels of assistance, the pneumatic power unit uses regenerative braking to compress air and store it into two pneumatic cylinders, then releases it when it’s required. This unit is also used for the suspension system.

The handling dynamics of the Tomahawk are enhanced by a continuously active aerodynamic system that deploys multiple pneumatically driven elements, including a rear wing and a secondary front splitter. The Tomahawk’s aerodynamic system reacts to inputs provided by a forward scanning laser system that detects surface changes in front of the car. The computer controls anticipate changes in vehicle ride height, pitch and yaw to adjust the splitter accordingly. The exhaust of the V-10 is routed to the rear diffuser. This accelerates underbody flow at the rear of the car and creates a blown diffuser effect that increases downforce with no negative effect on drag.

The GTS-R is the lightest and race-ready version of the Tomahawk concept. The extreme g-forces resulting from its immense power output, its extremely lightweight nature and enhanced handling are more than what the human body can handle unassisted. Therefore, the driver requires a special racing suit that pressurizes the body to maintain blood flow to the brain. This G-suit uses excess pressurized air from the pneumatic power system, allowing it to quickly react to increasing g-forces.

The Tomahawk GTS-R’s aerodynamics are enhanced with a dual-element version of the active rear wing. The upper element is stored beneath the lower element when it’s not in use or uring high-speed straightaway speed. Each of the four fenders is vented t avoid any high pressure build up in the wheel wells.@
zh:
一款放眼未来的近未来单座概念的轻量化赛车版本。

这辆属于未来的汽车结合了毫不妥协的理念，不加拘束的性能，以及令人惊叹的设计。它采用了中置引擎四轮驱动布局和单座的形式，其车身也采用最顶尖的复合材料打造。动力方面，它安装了一部高达1000马力的气动式附件辅助6.98升V10引擎。这辆GTS-R是来自Tomahawk的赛车版本。为了帮助车手应对驾驶这辆车时可能承受的强大重力加速度，甚至还附带了专用比赛服。

carNameEn: Dodge SRT Tomahawk S Vision Gran Turismo

en:

The SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo is a 20-year-forward vision of uncompromising, unrestricted performance. It is the virtual fusion of extreme motoring and stunning design. carNameEn: Dodge SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo (Gr.1)
en:
A mid-engine rear-wheel drive version of the Tomahawk for Gr.1 competition.	n

The SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo is a near-future supercar created by Dodge's in-house tuning department, SRT (Street and Racing Technology). This mean machine features next-generation automobile technologies that includes high-tech materials throughout the chassis and a road-surface-sensing active aerodynamics system. Providing the muscle is a 1000-hp V-10 engine mated to pneumatic power units.

The SRT Tomahawk Vision Gran Turismo (Gr.1) adopts the core concepts and dynamic nature of the Tomahawk and modifies them for Gr.1 classification.

This version is based on the race spec GTS-R, the lightest model in the series. After overhauling the body, the stock car’s active aero parts were scrapped in favor of a fixed rear wing and an aero fin mounted aft of the cockpit.

To reduce weight, the pneumatic power units were removed, while the engine was tuned to produce <703ps>. The power train layout has also been changed from all-wheel drive to rear-wheel drive to comply with regulations.

While it is no longer capable of extreme speeds that transcends the limits of the human body, its superb handling and aerodynamic control remain intact. In endurance races, this model will no doubt put great fear into your opponents.(

en:
A Coronet, equipped with a 7.0-liter V8 Hemi, this was one of the standout cars in the muscle-car era.

The Dodge Super Bee, introduced by Chrysler in 1968, was created to compete in the growing muscle-car marketplace. Priced at the lower end of the segment, the Super Bee was all about performance. It was not equipped with some of the creature comforts that its rivals possessed.

Based on the mid-size Dodge Coronet, the Super Bee was really a rebadged Plymouth Roadrunner, complete with a lightweight 2-door body and exterior design that looked menacing from every angle. In 1969, a convertible version of the car was added to the lineup.

The Super Bee’s performance on the road matched its mean looks, thanks to a powerful engine lineup. The base powerplant was a <340ps> 6.8-liter V8, followed by the upgraded version’s <395ps> 7.2-liter V8. The top-of-the-line model came with a <431ps> 7.0L Hemi. To handle all of this power, Chrysler equipped the car with a reinforced suspension system, a Mopar A833 4-speed manual transmission and high-performance tires.

In 1970, the Super Bee received a facelift that included a two-section grille and a revised chrome bumper. The following year, an all-new Super Bee was introduced; this one was based on the Dodge Charger.
zh:
搭载了一台7升的V8 Hemi引擎的Coronet，这辆“Super”车型创下了肌肉车历史。

Dodge Super Bee是1968年亮相的一台性能十足却又有高性价比的肌肉车。该系列包含3款高性能引擎可选，其中431 PS的7.0升引擎位列性能之首。这款车的内饰相对简朴，舒适配置较少。小改款于1970年发布，在1971年这款车又全面升级为了基于Charger打造的2代车型。

en:
With its monstrous levels of power and grip, this venerable machine could arguably be called America's first supercar.

Dodge introduced the Viper concept in 1989 to an awe-struck public to show that Chrysler was capable of producing something that could dethrone the Chevrolet Corvette as America's sports car. America's supercar war officially began in 1992 when Dodge released the 2-seat convertible to the public.

The Viper was as raw as sports cars came, with a loud, powerful engine and wide, menacing body that reminded many of the Shelby Cobra. For some, the car was too over-the-top. Dodge, hearing these comments, produced a fixed-roof version of the Viper called the GTS in 1996. At the same time, a race version of the GTS was also introduced, called the GTS-R. The GTS-R was created to contest in the world's GT races that included Le Mans and the 24 Hours of Nürburgring.

The GTS didn't just get a fixed roof, but also got more power. The massive V10 under its long hood now produced <456ps>, as opposed to <400ps> in the RT/10 roadster, which made the car quicker off the line.

The aerodynamic shape created by the fixed roof accounted for a better top speed, one that eclipsed the RT/10's top speed of <165mph> at <185mph>. The GTS's handling was also sharper, thanks to the car's added structural rigidity. The FR (front-engine, rear-wheel-drive) sports car set record-breaking slalom and skidpad records, thanks in part to its meaty tires.

The original Viper was a nostalgic and primitive-feeling sports car. However, with the release of the GTS, the Viper joined the ranks of the supercar.
zh:
打破束缚的车型，推动Viper跑车进入超跑领域。

这款双门轿跑的设计宗旨是为了发挥出Viper的全部潜力。它原封不动地沿用了RT/10敞篷跑车的基础架构、悬挂和V10引擎，但动力输出增强到了456 PS。但因为改为了硬顶，这款车能够跑出185英里/小时（约296 公里/小时）的最高时速，较敞篷版的165英里/小时有了较大提升。于同一时间亮相的GTS-R版本参与了全球范围内的多项耐力赛，展示了其优越的性能。

en:
This third-generation Viper is now marketed under Dodge's extreme performance SRT brand.

For years, Americans had only one real sports car, the Chevrolet Corvette. That all changed when the Dodge Viper arrived on the scene in 1991. The two became immediate rivals, and in a classic battle of one-upmanship, both Chevrolet and Dodge kept trying to outdo one another in an all-out performance race. As a result, both cars became such formidable sports machines that their on-road and on-track prowess eclipsed high-priced European supercars of their day.

In 2012, Dodge kept the tradition going with a new model that would transcend the others that came before it. The 3rd-generation Viper was tuned by the folks at SRT, Chrysler's high-performance factory tuning division. They kept the spirit of the American supercar intact, but raised the performance level so high that even Chevrolet engineers were scratching their respective heads. Built on the square steel space frame as before, this Viper featured aluminum cross bracing that improved rigidity by 50 percent. Also, thanks to the extensive use of lightweight materials such as carbon fiber, the car weighed <45 kg> less than the previous model. The heart of the Viper, the massive 8.4-liter V10 powerplant, received new pistons, as well as a new intake, exhaust and engine management system, allowing it to produce <649ps> and <83kgm> torque. The upper grade GTS was equipped with active suspension.

The new specs allowed the Viper to hit a top speed of <330km/h>, higher than most race cars. When you consider that the price of the 2013 model was still under the $100,000 mark, it's easy to see why many people, even today, regard the Viper as the best bang-for-the-buck supercar of all time.
zh:
第三代Viper，获得SRT的极限性能支持。

第三代Viper于2012年公布。这款新车型的主要亮点在于它将由Chrysler的高性能品牌SRT打造。尽管它的V10引擎依然保持8.4升的排量不变，但SRT对其内部进行了多项改良，让这部引擎能够输出649 PS/83.0 公斤力米。和前代车型相同，它采用了一套钢管空间车架，但刚性提升了50%。最高档的车型GTS还换用了主动式悬挂。
