zh:
第3代Viper，继承了SRT品牌的极致优越性能。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是对Dodge的高性能跑车Viper针对Gr.4组别规则进行改装的版本。它的车身外观采用了锐气十足的前定风翼和侧翼，外加一部大尺寸尾翼，能够产生强大的下压力。这也让它在拥有卓越直线性能的同时，过弯性能也不容小觑。

en:
A machine for private racers, carrying on the bloodline of the GTS-R.

The Dodge Viper evolved into its 3rd-generation model at the 2012 New York Motor Show. With the appearance of this iconic American sports car, the development of a GTS-R competition model was also announced, and it became clear that the Viper would return once again to the 24 Hours of Le Mans and the American Le Mans series after a 10 year hiatus. The Viper GT3-R is a GT3 machine created for private teams, based on the GTS-R works machine.

In the development of this machine, SRT, the high performance car development division of Dodge, and Riley Technologies, a major racing constructor in the U.S., worked together to instill the car with their know-how for victory.

The traditional long nosed, short deck body had improved aerodynamics with a flat bottom and the addition of a wing. Weight had also been reduced to <1295kg>. The 8.4-liter V10 with a dry sump was powered up to <680ps> (507kW) unrestricted, and this power was transferred with a X-Trac 6 speed sequential transmission. It was also equipped with 6 piston front/4 piston rear brake calipers with large diameter discs for stopping power.

The Viper GT3-R was priced at $459,000, with orders received from the latter half of 2013. Its level of performance was already proven in various GT Car races in the U.S. and other parts of the world.
zh:
为私人赛车手打造的赛车，延续了GTS-R的血统。

当第三代Viper于2012年首次亮相时，官方还公布会推出一款赛车车型，GTS-R。而GT3-R则是基于GTS-R，专为私人车队开发的一款GT3赛车。这个车型由Chrysler的高性能车开发团队SRT和Riley Technologies联合打造，他们对车重进行了大幅削减，还添加了许多空气动力学性能强化件。这辆车在北美和全球其他地区的GT比赛中证明了自己的竞速潜力。

en:
The much-anticipated fixed-roof version of the supercar featured better aerodynamics and lighter weight.

When the original Dodge Viper was introduced in 1992, the sports car world immediately took notice. Its sleek body, mean-looking design and powerful V-10 engine put it on par with the most exotic cars of its day. The breed improved in 2003 with the arrival of the second-generation model, and in 2006 a new model joined the lineup: a hard-top version called the SRT10 Coupe.

The SRT (Street and Racing Technology) in the car's name refers to Chrysler/Dodge's specialty sports division in charge of spicing up the company's vehicles. For the new Viper, it took its 8.3-liter OHV V10 and tuned it so it would produce <517ps> and an asphalt-shredding peak torque of <73.96kgm>, much more powerful than before.

The crew at SRT also improved the Viper's handling, by lowering the curb weight and testing it on the demanding Nürburgring circuit, not just to take the "America's Sport Car" moniker away from its main rival, the Chevrolet Corvette, but to challenge the likes of Ferrari and Lamborghini, which it succeeded in doing on the world stage.

Though its unique exterior tends to grabs everyone’s attention first, the Dodge Viper remains one of the most powerful and fastest sports car in history.
zh:
让大家望眼欲穿的全封闭车身，更加优秀的空气动力学，更轻的车重，换来真正的极速性能。

这款双门车型随Viper的第二代产品一并推出，并进化为了一辆跑车。Chrysler高性能车型通用的“SRT”徽标也出现在了它的车身上。它的轻量化车身中安装了一台517 PS的8.3升V10引擎，在与其他国际品牌的竞争车型对垒时也绝不落下风。

en:
This Mustang, a 2012 GT Award Winner, possessed the heart of a Ford GT.

The Grand Turismo Awards take place every year during the SEMA Show in Las Vegas. In 2012, the GT crew awarded their 10th anniversary prize to a 1969 Ford Mustang customized by Eckert's Rod & Custom.

Based in Oregon, U.S., Eckert's Rod & Custom has worked on the restoration and customization of classic and muscle cars for more than 25 years. Its creation, called the Mach Forty, is a beautifully-restored first-generation Mustang Fastback, with plenty of added attitude underneath its sheet metal. Most of the flawless bodywork was completely rebuilt, and the floor, from the rear seats to the trunk, has been cut out to make room for an engine, making this Mustang a mid-engine sports car.

Ford's supercharged 5.4L V-8 was tuned to pump out <862ps> and includes a control fitted inside the cabin that allows the driver to adjust engine output from approximately <608ps> to <862ps>. To handle the substantial increase in power, the chassis has been thoroughly reinforced, and the Chevrolet Corvette C6's suspension and traction control system have been installed.

Sure, Eckert's Rod & Custom tampered with the Mustang's traditional front-engine/rear-drive formula, but in doing so, it created a car even the most ardent Mustang fan would love.
zh:
2012年GT大奖获胜者，这辆令人惊叹的Mustang体内藏着一颗Ford GT的心脏。

这台拥有猛兽性能的Mustang由俄勒冈州最受欢迎的改装厂之一打造。从后排座椅到后备箱的一切都被清空，只为了腾出空间放置Ford GT的中置式5.4升V8机械增压引擎，这将马力输出冲到了862 PS。这台车在2012年SEMA展上亮相并赢得了GT大奖。

en:
Christened with the name of the founder, this car celebrated the company's 55th anniversary and had a limited 399-production run.

The Enzo Ferrari is an ultra premium sports car with a limited production of 399 cars, built in commemoration of the 55th anniversary of Ferrari.

The Enzo was designed by Ken (Kiyoyuki) Okuyama, a Japanese designer in Pininfarina at the time. The highly aerodynamic body is reminiscent of F1 machines of the day. It is notable that not only the body panels, but most of the frame is built of carbon composites.

The 6-liter V12 engine was specially designed for the Enzo, and produces a massive <660ps> of power, and <67.04kgm> torque. The suspension is double wishbone in front and rear, and combined with Brembo carbon ceramic disc brakes, it can withstand full speed runs on the circuit. With its powerful engine and lightweight body, its maximum speed is in excess of <350km/h>.

Though it mounts the high power engine midship as in the F40 and the F50, it is also given gullwing doors, air conditioning, and a semi automatic transmission called the F1-matic. Measures have been taken against noise and vibration by mounting the engine to the subframe that is buffered by bushings, and it is designed to be more of a road than the F50, which was closer to a pure race car. E
zh:
作为55周年纪念，总共生产了399辆的限量版。继承了Ferrari创始人之名。

2002年，Ferrari为了庆祝成立55周年发布了这款限量399台的超级跑车。其酷似F1赛车的尖鼻车身是当时任职Pininfarina的设计师奥山清行的杰作。车身板件和大部分车体框架都是采用碳纤维复合材料制成。定制开发的6升V12引擎可输出660 PS/67.0 公斤力米，最高时速可超过350 公里/小时。

en:
The Italian version of the people's car makes a comeback after a 50-year hiatus.+

With its irresistibly charming design and remarkably low price, the second-generation FIAT 500 sold four million units between 1957 and 1977, playing a pivotal role in Italy’s automotive revolution. With its endearing round "eyes," smooth curves, and unmistakable charm, the spirit of the second-generation FIAT 500 was reborn 50 years later in the third generation.

Unveiled at the 2004 Geneva Motor Show, the concept car immediately captivated the world. When it finally hit the market in 2007, its popularity soared. Its appeal was so overwhelming that backorders continued in most markets worldwide, even two years after its launch.

The available engines under the hood came in the form of a 1.2-liter and 1.4-liter gasoline engine and a 1.3-liter diesel. The 1.2-liter engine produced only <69ps> and <10.4kgm> of torque, but revved quite smoothly. Weighing just <1010kg>, even in the luxury-grade Lounge model, the FIAT 500 boasted a finely tuned chassis that delivered a surprisingly sporty driving experience, belying its cute appearance.

Pronounced “cinquecento” in Italian, the FIAT 500 carries this affectionate nickname worldwide.
zh:
阔别50年的第3代Cinquecento，保留了2代的可爱造型。

得益于亲民的价格与迷人的造型，Fiat 500自1957年推出后的20年间累计售出400万台。第2代发布50年后，第3代Fiat 500问世。这台车在2004年日内瓦车展上迎来首秀，并在2007年夏季上市后迅速风靡全球。全球汽车爱好者亲切称其为“Cinquecento”——意大利语“500”之意。

en:
Small, versatile and inexpensive, this minimalist car could also be raced.

Introduced in 1957, the FIAT 500 was a compact car that carried forward the legacy of the pre-war Topolino. But it was more than just a successor, it was a new design that redefined the essence of a functional passenger car.

Certainly, there are many differences between the Topolino and the FIAT 500. Although compact, the FIAT 500 offered seating for four adults—an improvement over the two-seat Topolino. Furthermore, unlike the front-engine/rear-drive layout of the Topolino, the FIAT 500 featured a rear-engine/rear-drive configuration within a full monocoque body.

The FIAT 500's engine was a <479cc> air-cooled 2-cylinder OHV that produced <15ps>, enabling a top speed of <90km/h>. The standard front-half canvas-top was designed primarily for improved ventilation and noise reduction, rather than just open-air driving appeal.

Even though it was compact, it was highly practical. Of note, the affordable FIAT 500, with its immense popularity in Italy, inspired a variety of tuning models over the years. Among them, the model tuned by Carlo Abarth—hailed as the god of engine tuning—was unmatched in the compact class, making the 500 a formidable force in motorsports.

Naturally, the FIAT 500 itself evolved. In 1959, the sport model was introduced, with engine displacement increased to <499cc> and power raised to <18ps>. This sports engine came as standard fare in the 500D, introduced in 1961. And, for safety reasons, the original front-opening doors were replaced with rear-hinged ones in the 1965 FIAT 500F.

As a pioneer of the "minimum car" concept—some call it the original mini—this iconic vehicle remains beloved to this day.
zh:
功能全面，价格合理，还能用于竞速。一款充满乐趣的极简原创车型。

这款车标志着FIAT公司实现了为大众市场制造汽车这一目标。诞生于1957年，这款车以极其紧凑的车身在尾部搭载了15 PS的497 立方厘米引擎。这台车虽然小巧，但非常实用，且凭借低廉的价格广受欢迎，甚至催生了众多Abarth的改装版本。F车型首次采用前铰链式车门。

en:
A hardcore sports version of the FIAT 500.

Introduced in 1963, the FIAT Abarth 595 was a high-performance version of the second-generation FIAT 500 tuned by Abarth.

While the base FIAT 500 featured a <496cc> air-cooled 2-cylinder engine, the Abarth version received comprehensive upgrades. Displacement was increased to <594cc>, complemented by enhanced intake and exhaust flow. These upgrades delivered a significant performance boost, with peak output rising from <18ps> to <27ps> and top speed increased from <95km/h> to <120km/h>. The transformation made the Abarth variant a favorite among young enthusiasts who craved more power.

Then, in 1964, Abarth introduced an even more finely tuned version of the 595. This car was called the 595 Esseesse.

The 595 Esseesse utilized the same basic engine as its predecessor, but compression ratio was increased and a larger diameter carburetor was installed, resulting in <32ps> and a top speed of <130km/h>.

Thanks to the newfound power, the 595 series enjoyed great success in the under-<600cc>-class of racing all over Europe.
zh:
FIAT 500的硬核运动版。

FIAT Abarth 595于1963年问世。该车基于第二代FIAT 500打造，经Abarth调校。595的进一步调校版本——595 Esseesse随后登场。虽然引擎排量相同，但通过提高压缩比将动力输出提升至32 PS。凭借这一性能提升，595系列在欧洲各项赛事中大放异彩，在600 立方厘米以下组别中所向披靡。

en:
This jewel of a compact car is the one designer Giugiaro called his greatest work.

In 1980, as demand for smaller cars rose in the wake of the oil shock, Fiat introduced a bold new compact to replace the aging 126. In a stark departure from its predecessor, the Panda was a front-wheel-drive hatchback with a transverse, front-mounted engine.

Although relatively simple, its design was both modern and practical. The packaging of the Panda was entrusted to design maestro Giorgetto Giugiaro. To reduce costs, the body panels were shaped with flat surfaces and straight lines, while the windows were made of flat glass. The seats followed suit, using a basic hammock layout with fabric stretched over a pipe frame. Yet the overall look of the car was fresh, and the interior proved surprisingly spacious.

At its debut, the Panda was powered by either a <652cc> 2-cylinder air-cooled engine or a <903cc> 4-cylinder water-cooled engine. At the time, Fiat named its engines according to output, with the former designated the 30 and the latter the 45. In 1983, a part-time 4-wheel-drive 4x4 version appeared. It marked a world first for a vehicle with a transverse-engine/front-wheel-drive layout.

The Panda became an immediate success upon release, quickly emerging as one of the driving forces behind Fiat's resurgence. Giugiaro himself declared at the time that this compact masterpiece was the greatest work of his career.
zh:
紧凑型车中的瑰宝，被其设计师乔治亚罗视作个人巅峰之作。

FIAT Panda是一款前轮驱动掀背车，于1980年第二次石油危机后的小型车热潮中推出。其外观设计由设计大师乔盖托·乔治亚罗操刀完成。为控制成本，车身采用直线线条和平整面板设计，呈现出简洁、现代且实用的外观。该车首发时提供两种引擎选项：风冷652 立方厘米双缸引擎或水冷903 立方厘米四缸引擎。这款在《跑车浪漫旅》游戏中登场的车型采用的是前者。

en:
A predecessor to the 250 GTO, this car racked up numerous wins in the world of endurance racing.

Styled by Pininfarina, the 250 GT Berlinetta made its debut at the 1959 Paris Motor Show, equipped with a 3.0-liter 12-cylinder engine that had 250 cc of displacement in each of its cylinders, as the name implied.

There was a definitive difference between this car and previous models. The car's wheelbase, which measured <2600mm> long, had been chopped down to <2400mm> in order to improve cornering agility. It was also to give it an edge in GT category racing. Years later, the car came to be known as the "250 GT Berlinetta passo corto," or 250 GT Berlinetta SWB (the abbreviation for Short Wheelbase in English) to distinguish this version from previous models.

The 250 GT Berlinetta passo corto began production in 1960, a year after its public unveiling, and came with an all-aluminum racing body, as well as a steel body for road-going models. The <2953cc> SOHC V12 produced between <220ps> to <280ps>, depending on its degree of tuning, and was the first mass production vehicle by Ferrari to be equipped with 4-wheel disc brakes.

The immediate racing success that was to follow was largely attributed to the car's shorter wheelbase: Nearly unstoppable, it won the Tour De France Automobile three years in a row from 1960 to 1962 and the GT category at Le Mans in 1960 and 1961. It also won the Nürburgring <1000km> race two years in a row, from 1961 to 1962. Thereafter, the 250 GT passed the baton to the 250 GTO, which was based on the 250 GT Berlinetta passo corto. In the end, only 162 examples of this beautiful grand touring machine were built.
zh:
250 GTO的前辈，赢得无数耐力赛奖项。

250 GT Berlinetta比前代车型更短的轴距让其在赛道上拥有更优异的过弯性能。这些改进成效显著。从1960年起，这台车在环法汽车赛、纽博格林1000公里耐力赛等赛事中斩获无数胜利。到1962年这款车总共只生产了162辆，在那之后由250 GTO传承其衣钵。

en:
This ultra-popular car was built to win the GT Class International Championship title.

When you think of multi-million-dollar classic exotics, the first name that usually comes to mind is Ferrari. And among all the valuable Ferrari cars through history, the 250 GTO stands out as the “collectable Ferrari.” Built in the early 1960s, the 250 GTO, the original Testarossa, made an immediate impact on the world sports car scene.

The “250” in the name indicates its engine displacement of 250cc per cylinder. And the car had 12 cylinders, which meant it was a total displacement of 3.0 liters. The “GTO” stands for Gran Turismo Omologato, a reference to it being a homologation model for GT racing. And as such a name implies, it was introduced in 1962 specifically to win the GT class in international production sports car racing.

The car was based on the agile 250 GT SWB, but with a lighter curb weight. Covering its steel tubular frame was an all-aluminum body, and the nose was long and low in order to boost aerodynamic performance. The rear of the car was characterized by a coda tronca, with bulging rear fenders to allow space for large tires. The ride height of the car is <90mm> lower than the SWB. Power comes from a Testarossa engine with a dry oil sump and six carburetors, delivering an output of <300ps>. It helped enable the car to reach a top speed of <300km/h>.

Only 39 250 GTOs were ever produced, which by itself was not enough for homologation. But Ferrari stated that the car was simply a variation of the SWB, and once this was accepted, the car started racing in '62. The 250 GTO won the international championship three years in a row.

All 39 of these cars still exist today. The 3729GT included in the game is a right-hand drive model delivered to the UK in '62. It was once raced by a Ferrari semi-works team, and achieved podium finishes in many British races. 8
zh:
为赢得GT组别国际锦标赛而打造的超高人气车型。

直到20世纪60年代初，赛车和公路车之间的界限十分模糊。而这款车正是那个时代的经典。车名中的“GTO”表明这是一台GT赛事认证车型。车架为钢管结构，车身为全铝制。3升V12引擎配备6个化油器，马力高达300 PS。为英国市场生产的右舵型号在英国各地的赛事中多次登上领奖台。

en:
This elegant GT3 machine is also known as the "Racing Queen.")

Ferrari had long produced racing machines derived from its road-going super sports cars, achieving remarkable results in endurance and GT race championships. The 296 GT3 was one such car to carry on that tradition, developed from the 296 GTB.

As a pure racing machine, the 296 GT3 dispensed with the plug-in hybrid system of the road car, relying solely on a 600-horsepower twin-turbo V-6 engine. This unit employed a 3.0-liter 120-degree V-6, extensively modified for weight reduction and reliability. Drivetrain, cooling components, and aerodynamic parts were all replaced with dedicated race versions.

Unlike earlier racing Ferraris, traditionally constructed by Michelotto, the 296 GT3 was built by legendary race-car specialists Oreca. From chassis construction to assembly and after-sales service, Oreca provided full end-to-end support. The car was first unveiled at the 2022 24 Hours of Spa in July, before making its racing debut at the 2023 24 Hours of Daytona.

The 296 GT3 was not confined to the current international endurance championships; its design continued to evolve toward the future. An Evo version, with enhanced aerodynamic efficiency and improved endurance, had already been announced for the 2026 season.

By blending the sophistication of its road-going sibling with the raw speed of a track machine, the 296 GT3 became the new standard-bearer of Ferrari’s motorsports strategy.
zh:
一款被誉为“赛道女王”的优雅GT3赛车。

作为基于296 GTB开发的GT3赛车，296 GT3摒弃了公路版车型的插电混动系统，仅搭载可输出600匹马力的V6双涡轮增压引擎，成为了一辆纯种赛车。该车由世界级赛车制造商Oreca打造，其业务涵盖从底盘制造、整车组装到客户服务。该车于2022年7月首次在斯帕24小时耐力赛亮相，随后在不到两年的时间里赢得了100场比赛，展示了其高性能的赛车能力。

en:
Here's a mid-engine sports car with a revolutionary V-6 + PHEV system.

There is a long-standing tradition within the Ferrari line-up in which its super sports models have relied on a mid-mounted V-8s. With a lightweight, high-revving engine placed behind the driver, this layout delivered sharp response and agile maneuverability, and it became emblematic of the brand. The 296 GTB carried forward parts of that legacy while opening the door to new possibilities.

It was the first Ferrari to adopt a twin-turbo V-6 engine. And it was the first time in more than a half century that a V-6 block had been used by the marque—last seen on the 206 and 246 under the Dino name. With a displacement of <2992cc>, the engine employed a 120-degree bank angle with IHI turbochargers positioned within the vee.

One of the key reasons behind the move to a V-6 powertrain was the integration of a plug-in hybrid (PHEV) system. Combined with a 123kW electric motor, the system produced a total of 830 horsepower, allowing for blistering acceleration from zero to <100km/h> in just 2.9 seconds. With a top speed of <330km/h>, the 296 GTB offered performance truly worthy of the Ferrari name.

Its design paid homage to the legendary 250 LM of the 1960s, while also being the most compact model in the contemporary Ferrari line-up. The distinctive tunnel-back rear window enhanced both aerodynamics and elegance. Blending the classic mid-engine sports layout with groundbreaking technology, the 296 GTB stood as the epitome of Ferrari’s new generation.
zh:
采用革命性V6+PHEV系统的中置引擎跑车。

296 GTB是一款插电式混合动力跑车，同时配备了自Dino系列以来首款V6引擎。经典风格的车身设计致敬1960年代的经典车型250 LM，同时也是当前Ferrari产品线中最小的车型。该车采用中置布局搭载3升V6双涡轮增压引擎，结合123千瓦电机，系统综合输出功率达830马力。该车仅需2.9秒即可完成0-100 公里/小时加速，最高速度能达到330 公里/小时，性能当之无愧于Ferrari之名。

en:
This successor to the Ferrari Dino 246 GT features a V-8 mounted amidships."

Making its debut in 1975 was the successor to the very popular Ferrari Dino 246 GT called the 308 GTB. This svelte sports car represented one of the first of a long line of V-8-powered mid-engine Ferraris that would the exotic-car genre for years to come.

The wedge-shaped exterior was penned by Leonardo Fioravanti of Pininfarina, who was responsible for a number of Ferrari designs from the late 1960s to the early 1990s.

Under the sheet metal, the 308 GTB was equipped with a 3.0-liter DOHC V-8, the same powerplant as the Dino 208 GT4, which produced <255ps>. In 1980, new emissions regulations brought output down to <215ps>, but two years later Ferrari increased it back up to <240ps> after it adopted a 4-valve system for the engine. The new car was called the 308 GTB Quattrovalvole. In 1977, a targa top GTS was added to the mix, setting the stage for the 328 that was introduced in 1985.
zh:
这款Dino 246 GT的继任者采用中置布局，容纳一台V8引擎。

1975年亮相的308 GTB接替Dino 246 GT，开启了经久不衰的双座V8车型风潮。管状车架之上覆盖的优雅车身出自Pininfarina的列奥纳多·菲奥拉万蒂之手，他在1960年代末至1990年代初设计了一系列Ferrari车型。

en:
This V12-powered P Series race car was known as "the most beautiful machine ever."f

When thinking of Ferrari's motorsports activities, the first thing that comes to mind are their feats in the F1 Grand Prix. However from the 1950s to the 1960s, they also enjoyed great success in sports car racing. Though they withdrew from sports car racing in 1973, the 330 P4 is one car that left its name in history for being the most beautiful machine out of the "P series" V12 midship engine prototype racers, that left a glorious record from the '60s to the '70s.

330 stands for the displacement per cylinder, in other words signifying a 4-liter displacement engine, and the name stands for the fourth version of the P series equipped with a 4-liter engine.

The 330 P4 debuting in 1967 was developed by improving upon the 330 P3, in order to defeat the Ford GT which was on top at the time. Though with the same displacement as the previous version, it was given a <450ps> engine of an almost brand new design, with 3 valves per cylinder consisting of two intake and 1 exhaust on the heads. The nose of the body was slightly extended to the front, and a separate spoiler was added to the rear, to improve its aerodynamic capabilities.

In actual racing, it started off by winning its debut race in the 24 hours of Daytona, and in the Monza 1,000 km race. Unfortunately it was defeated by Ford in the 24 Hours of Le Mans, but it was successful in defeating Porsche in the sports car world championships, and became series champion.
zh:
采用V12引擎的P系列车型中最美丽的一款。

330 P4诞生的目的是为了击败当时风头正盛的Ford GT。尽管总共仅生产了4台，但依旧分出了针对高速赛道的berlinetta版本和为减重而移除车顶的spider版本。它在戴通纳24小时耐力赛中首秀即夺冠。虽然Ford在勒芒获胜，但Ferrari随后就还以颜色，赢得了世界跑车锦标赛。

en:
The ultimate super sport, this front engine, rear-wheel drive machine rivaled the Miura for the highest top speed of its day.

Following the debut of the 1973 Berlinetta Boxer, Ferrari’s V-12-powered supercars transitioned to mid-engine layouts, which would define the marque’s flagship models for many years to come. The final front-engine rear-wheel-drive Ferrari before this hiatus was the 365 GTB4, more widely recognized by its popular nickname, “Daytona.”

The nickname stemmed from Ferrari’s commanding performance at the 1967 Daytona 24-hour race, where the 330 P4 and 412 P sports prototypes secured a 1-2-3 finish, sweeping the podium.

The first to reportedly refer to the car as the “Daytona” was Luigi Chinetti, owner of the Ferrari dealer and semi-works racing outfit, the North American Racing Team (N.A.R.T.), at the time of the prototype’s initial delivery.

The Daytona was developed with a strong focus on the North American market. Its sleek silhouette penned by Leonardo Fioravanti of Pininfarina. Initially fitted with quad headlights housed beneath Plexiglas covers, the design was updated to retractable units after 1970 to comply with North American safety regulations.

Under the hood, the <4390cc> DOHC V-12 engine was fed by six Weber carburetors, producing <352ps> and <44.0kgm> of torque. Its claimed top speed of <280km/h> matched that of its chief rival, the Lamborghini Miura, making it the fastest road car of its era.

At Daytona, it went on to dominate the Le Mans GT class for three consecutive years, cementing its legacy in motorsports history.
zh:
最最顶级的前置后驱超级跑车，与对手Miura争夺最高速度的极致。

作为Ferrari最后一款搭载前置12缸引擎的车型，365 GTB/4（又名“Daytona”）于1968年巴黎车展首次亮相。列奥纳多·菲奥拉万蒂设计的流线性车身下，隐藏着一台4,390 立方厘米的双顶置凸轮轴V12引擎。其最高时速可达280 公里/小时，与竞争对手Lamborghini Miura并列成为当时最快的车。

en:
A road-going racer that greatly improved upon the performance of the F430.

The Ferrari 430 Scuderia was unveiled in September 2007 at the Frankfurt Motor Show, introduced as a high-performance version of the F430. It also served as the successor to the 360 Challenge Stradale, a road-legal version of the 360 Challenge one-make race car from the 360 Modena era.

It came powered by the same 4.3-liter DOHC V-8 as the standard F430, further tuned to produce an additional <20ps> and <0.5kgm> of torque, resulting in a total output of <510ps> and <47.9kgm> of torque. Streamlined interior fittings contributed to a weight reduction of approximately <100kg>, bringing the total weight down to a lean 2975 lbs. These improvements resulted in an impressive power-to-weight ratio of just <2.45kg/ps>.

The transmission came in the form of the two-pedal manual "F1 Superfast 2," allowing gear changes to be performed as quick as 0.06 seconds. The running gear itself also significantly impacted driving and lap times, with several F1-derived technologies implemented into the car, including the F1-Trac combined traction and stability control system, and the electronically controlled E-Diff differential.

The front bumper and rear diffuser were modified to enhance aerodynamics, resulting in blistering performance with a top speed of <320km/h> and a 0-<100km/h> acceleration time of less than 3.6 seconds. Surprisingly, this car achieved lap times that rivaled those of the Enzo at Ferrari's test course.
zh:
对F430的性能进行大幅改进的合法上路车。

430 Scuderia于2007年9月在法兰克福车展上亮相，是Ferrari在F1上的技术经验的集大成之作，也是其史上最快的V8 Berlinetta。相较于基础款F430，它的引擎经过了深度调校，车重更轻，空气动力学表面得到了优化。最终造就了它令人咋舌的320 公里/小时最高速度和3.6秒的0-100 公里/小时加速。

en:
With an astonishing <570ps> under the hood, this V8 mid-engine machine took its heritage from the F430.

With a new version of Ferrari's mid-engine V-8 car appearing every five years (starting from 1989), the successor to the popular F430 arrived in 2009. Called the Ferrari 458 Italia, the sleek supercar was introduced at the 2009 Frankfurt Motor Show, succeeding the likes of the 348 (1989), F355 (1994), 360 Modena (1999) and F430 (2004).

The 458 Italia was built upon a newly designed aluminum space frame, which made it lighter than its predecessor. Behind the cockpit resided a direct-injection V-8 that pumped out <570ps>/<55.1kgm>, astonishing figures from a normally-aspirated engine. Power was transferred to the rear wheels via a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox whose shift speeds were significantly improved over the F355's. The Manettino system that unified the engine, gearbox, suspension, E-DIFF, F1 Trac, ESP and high-performance ABS controls was also improved, allowing the driver to choose one of five different modes: Low Grip, Sports, Race, CT cut, and CST cut.

The 458 Italia was a menace on the asphalt, running to <100km/h> in just 3.4 seconds, and hitting a top speed of <325km/h>. Considering that the final and very special grade model of the F430 Scuderia accelerated from 0 to <100km/h> in 3.6 seconds, and registered a top speed of <320km/h>, you can see the definite and distinct evolution in this Ferrari species.
zh:
这款V8中置引擎车型拥有高达570 PS的惊人马力，是F430的后继车款。

这款车型于2009年在法兰克福车展上公布，是F430的继任者。底盘采用全新铝制空间框架，并搭载4,499 立方厘米V8引擎，马力达570 PS，扭矩则为55.1 公斤力米。整合了引擎、变速箱和悬挂等系统的“Manettino”系统也得到了大幅改进。运用源自F1赛车的空气动力学技术，该车的0-100 公里/小时加速时间仅为3.4秒，最高时速达325 公里/小时。

en:
This car, which generates more downforce than any Ferrari before it, won the FIA-GT European Championship title.

Many of Ferrari’s most memorable cars were powered by V-8 powerplants. Following in the footsteps of the 360 Modena and F430, the latest examples of these amazing V-8-powered machines is the 458 Italia. Designed and developed completely from scratch, the 458 Italia pays homage to the home country of Ferrari, christened by Ferrari’s then-chairman Luca Cordero di Montezemolo.

As with its predecessor, the main components of the 458 Italia’s chassis, body, engine, and suspension are composed of aluminum; however, the torsional rigidity of the 458 is improved by 15 percent when compared to the F430.

The body incorporates winglets inside the front grille and fender “chimney” outlets, allowing the 458 Italia to achieve amazing aerodynamic performance. The car produces <140kg> of downforce at <200km/h>, and more than <360kg> of downforce at top speed.

At the heart of the mid-engine/rear-drive machine is a fire-breathing 4.5-liter naturally-aspirated V-8 that produces <570ps> and <55.1kgm>. It comes mated to a dual-clutch 7-speed F1-matic gearbox whose shift speeds are on par with that of a F1 machine. The 458 Italia accelerates from 0-<100km/h> in 3.4 seconds and reaches a top speed of <325km/h>.

The on-road prowess of the supercar was so impressive that Ferrari decided to produce a race car version of it called the 458 Italia GT3.

The major changes made to the GT3 are to generate more downforce. The front bumper features a low air dam, while a large rear wing helps keep the rear tires planted to the driving surface. The car looks meaner than its production counterpart, thanks mainly to enlarged front and rear fenders. That said, engine power is a bit lower at <550ps> via a restrictor.

The car bowed in 2011 and won the series title that year in the FIA-GT European Championships.
zh:
史上下压力最强的Ferrari车型，FIA-GT欧洲锦标赛冠军得主。

458 Italia GT3是基于458 Italia开发的满足GT3规格的赛车。前保险杠位置进一步压低来充当气坝，同时还增设了一个大尾翼。尽管与公路车型使用的是相同的动力单元，但由于安装了限流器，动力被限制在550 PS。该车在2011年首次亮相，并在同年夺得FIA-GT3欧洲锦标赛冠军。

en:
With an astonishing <570ps> under the hood, this mid-engine V-8-powered machine drew its inspiration from the F430.

With a new version of Ferrari's mid-engine V-8 car appearing every five years (starting from 1989), the successor to the popular F430 arrived in 2009. Called the Ferrari 458 Italia, the sleek supercar was introduced at the 2009 Frankfurt Motor Show, succeeding the likes of the 348 (1989), F355 (1994), 360 Modena (1999) and F430 (2004).

The 458 Italia was built upon a newly designed aluminum space frame, which made it lighter than its predecessor. Behind the cockpit resided a direct-injection V-8 that pumped out <570ps>/<55.1kgm>, astonishing figures from a normally-aspirated engine. Power was transferred to the rear wheels via a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox whose shift speeds were significantly improved over the F355's. The Manettino system that unified the engine, gearbox, suspension, E-DIFF, F1 Trac, ESP and high-performance ABS controls was also improved, allowing the driver to choose one of five different modes: Low Grip, Sports, Race, CT cut, and CST cut.

The 458 Italia was a menace on the asphalt, running to <100km/h> in just 3.4 seconds, and hitting a top speed of <325km/h>. Considering that the final and very special grade model of the F430 Scuderia accelerated from 0 to <100km/h> in 3.6 seconds, and registered a top speed of <320km/h>, you can see the definite and distinct evolution in this Ferrari species.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
zh:
这款V8中置引擎车型拥有高达570 PS的惊人马力，是F430的后继车款。

这辆原创的跑车浪漫旅赛车，符合Gr.4组别规则。其原型458 Italia是Ferrari产品线的入门级车型。基础款已能产生充足的下压力，因此尽管可见的空力部件相对较少，该车的行驶状态仍极为稳定。搭配灵活的Ferrari V8引擎和7档变速箱，它在赛道上潜力无穷。

en:
The glorious Prancing Horse that returned Ferrari to the top category and delivered victory at Le Mans after a 50-year absence.

The 2023 edition of the 24 Hours of Le Mans was a special one, marking the 100th anniversary of the world’s premier endurance race. With glory waiting for the winner, teams brought their most cutting-edge technology and their best cars to the Circuit de la Sarthe.

It was a high-powered showdown, but even in this storied field, most eyes were on Ferrari. After all, Ferrari was returning to the top category for the first time in 50 years, following the 312 P’s appearance in the 1973 race. The car tasked with carrying that legacy was the prototype 499P. The 499P was a hypercar developed to Le Mans Hypercar regulations for the World Endurance Championship’s top category. The “499” in its name referred to the displacement per cylinder, while the “P” stood for “prototype.” Its hybrid system combined a twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 with a front-mounted MGU, producing up to 500 kilowatts.

Its styling was shaped by more than pure speed. It is futuristic, but also unmistakably Ferrari. That is a large part of the 499P’s charm.

The race itself was closely fought, but in the end, car No. 51 came out on top. The 100th edition of the 24 Hours of Le Mans saw Ferrari make a spectacular return to the Circuit de la Sarthe, claiming its first overall victory in 58 years.
zh:
一匹承载荣耀的奔马，不仅带领品牌重返顶级赛事，更在阔别50年后，再次在勒芒赛场上夺得胜利。

Ferrari 499P是一款为“勒芒终级跑车”（LMH）组别打造的原型赛车。这款先进全轮驱动赛车的混合动力系统由一台3.0升V6双涡轮增压引擎和一台前置电机发电单元（MGU）组成，总输出功率达500 kW。2023年，Ferrari重返勒芒赛场，与一众劲敌展开激烈角逐，最终脱颖而出，拿下了全场冠军。这是Ferrari 58年来在勒芒赛场上的首场胜利。

en:
A priceless unrestored example of a Gran Turismo Award winner.

For some years after its establishment in 1947, now-legendary Ferrari would only develop and produce the chassis and engines of its cars, while outsourcing production of the exterior bodies to other Carrozzerias. The 500 Mondial produced in 1953 is a car from that era, and the model's most famous body style is the Barchetta, designed by Pininfarina, who also produced two special coupe bodies for the model. These were called the 500 Mondial Pininfarina Coupe, built to participate in the 1954 Tour de France Automobile.

The 500 Mondial is an extreme sports car, as were many Ferraris of that era, powered by a detuned F2 race car engine that dominated the 1952 and 1953 Grands Prix. The '500' stands for the engine’s per-cylinder displacement within the lightweight DOHC 2.0-liter inline-4, designed by Aurelio Lampredi. Although detuned, it manages to squeeze out <170ps> from just <1985cc>.

The powerplant is mounted in a small, lightweight steel tube space frame and connected to an advanced de Dion axle. The name Mondial loosely translates to “World,” and it was given to the car in commemoration of the Grand Prix victory by Alberto Ascari. Unfortunately, the Pininfarina Coupe was unable to complete the Tour de France Automobile,

but one of these cars still exists in its pristine original condition, never once undergoing a restoration. It received the Gran Turismo Award at the 2012 Pebble Beach Concours d'Elegance.
zh:
Gran Turismo奖得主。一个无法再现的珍贵案例。

500 Mondial Pinin Farina Coupe采用Ferrari的底盘和引擎以及Pininfarina的车身，是为参加1954年环法汽车赛而打造的一款双门轿车。虽未能在环法汽车赛上如期取得成功，现存的一台保存完好的原车仍在2012年圆石滩经典车展中获得“Gran Turismo Award”大奖。

en:
One of the cars that defined the supercar boom in the 1970s, this car was considered the world's fastest, along with the Lamborghini Countach.+

Ferrari launched its first mid-engine production car, the 365 GT4 BB, at the Turin Motor Show in 1971 as an answer to Lamborghini's now-legendary Muira model. The letters “BB” in the new car's title stood for “Berlinetta Boxer,” a reference to the car's coupe body style and its horizontally-opposed “boxer” engine; the pistons of each cylinder bank were positioned exactly opposite of each other on a flat plane.

The 365GT4/BB started delivery in 1973, but was not well received in the marketplace. So, just three years later, Ferrari produced an evolved version of the car called the 512 BB.

The major change was an engine that was enlarged by 600 cc, giving it 5.0 liters in displacement (the name 512 refers to the engine, a 5.0-liter, 12-cylinder). It pumped out <360ps>, which was actually <20ps> less than the 365 GT4 BB's power plant, while torque was <4kgm> higher at <46.0kgm>.

The 512 BB featured a steel tube space frame; the body was composed of steel, aluminum and reinforced fiberglass. The car's svelte shape was penned by both Pininfarina and Scaglietti. Ferrari claimed both the 365GT4/BB and 512 BB had an official top speed of <302km/h>, a response to the <300km/h> top speed of the Lamborghini Countach.

There was a major supercar boom in Japan at the time, and popularity was split roughly 50/50 between the 512 BB and the Countach; making them fierce rivals in the Japanese marketplace as well as the world stage.
zh:
引领20世纪70年代超跑潮流的标杆之一，与Countach争夺最高时速的桂冠。

这是365GT4/BB的改装版，是Ferrari的12缸公路车，也是品牌首款采用中置引擎布局的车型。此次升级的主要亮点是将12缸引擎排量扩容至5升，不过为符合排放法规所做的改动导致动力输出减少20 PS至360 PS。但扭矩还是增加了4.0 公斤力米至46.0 公斤力米。作为Ferrari最令人难忘的经典车型之一，这款车与Lamborghini Countach一起，成为20世纪70年代意大利超级跑车的象征。

en:
Adopting the classic V-12 FR layout, this Ferrari possesses remarkable performance while retaining practicality.	h

Unveiled in 2017, the Ferrari 812 Superfast continued the marque’s proud lineage of front-engine V12 grand tourers. Its name—a combination of “800 PS, 12 cylinders”—paid tribute to the output of its naturally-aspirated 6.5-liter V12, while “Superfast” came from the legendary 500 Superfast of 1964.

The design was shaped by Ferrari’s in-house Styling Center. It exuded classical proportions with a long nose and short rear deck—hallmarks of a front-mid-engine V12 layout. Yet, its sculpted aerodynamics and refined detailing placed it in the realm of modern Ferrari elegance.

Producing <800ps> and 718Nm (<73.3kgm>) of torque, the V12 delivered its power to the rear wheels via a 7-speed dual-clutch transaxle. The 812 also marked a technological milestone as the first Ferrari to feature electric power steering.

Its dynamics were further enhanced by the Virtual Short Wheelbase 2.0 system—an evolution of the 4-wheel steering setup from the F12berlinetta. The prime benefit of this system was that it resulted in razor-sharp turn-in even on tight, hairpin corners, despite its <2720mm> wheelbase.

With usable cargo space behind the seats and a generously sized rear luggage area, the 812 Superfast offered grand touring capabilities wrapped in pure supercar body.
zh:
这款Ferrari采用了经典的V12前置后驱布局，在实现闪电般速度的同时保持实用性。

812 Superfast于2017年推出，延续了Ferrari前置V12车型的血脉。这是Ferrari首款采用电动助力转向系统的车型，它还配备了F12berlinetta的四轮转向系统的升级版，这意味着尽管轴距较长（2,720毫米），车辆仍可灵活通过急弯。

en:
This collector's car took the nickname of Enzo Ferrari's son, Alfredo "Dino," who passed away at the age of 24.

Ferrari had experienced plenty of success in motorsports with its mid-engine layout machines, but in 1968, the company decided to finally release a road-going car incorporating this tried-and-true racing technology. The result was the Dino 206 GT, a beautiful Berlinetta with a flowing all-aluminum body and a <1987cc> aluminum V-6 under the hood, which marked a change from Ferrari's traditional use of V-12s. Another fact worth noting is the car was not marketed with the Ferrari name, being sold simply as the "Dino," as if it were a model from a different brand.

"Dino" was the nickname of founder Enzo Ferrari's eldest son, the engineer Alfredo Ferrari, who tragically died at the tender age of 24. The 65-degree DOHC V6 found in the car that bears his name was an idea he proposed while in the hospital. It proved successful in race cars from 1957 on, and part of the reason the Dino 206 GT was created was to homologate the F2 engine.

Receiving a makeover in 1969, the Dino GT became the 246 GT. Because of the high cost and difficulty to produce the aluminum body, the new one was made of steel, while the engine and block construction were now made of cast iron. To compensate for the increase in weight, displacement was increased to <2418cc>, with output and torque improved from <185ps>/<17.9kgm> to <195ps>/<23.0kgm>. Thus, the car achieved a top speed of <235km/h>. Another major improvement was a longer wheelbase that improved stability and handling performance.

In 1971, a Targa-top 246 GTS was added to the lineup. Along with the Berlinetta, a total of 3761 cars were produced until 1974.
zh:
以Enzo Ferrari的儿子Alfredo 'Dino' Ferrari命名的特殊公路车型。年轻的他不幸在24岁就去世了。

1968年推出的Dino 206GT再度进化，并以自恩佐·法拉利已故的儿子命名。铝制车身改为钢制，延长的轴距改进了操控稳定性。铸铁缸体引擎扩容至2.4升，输出达到195 PS/23.0 公斤力米。

en:
The flagship model of Ferrari wasn't just fast, it was a technological marvel.

Ferrari unveiled its mighty new flagship, the F12berlinetta, in 2012 at the Geneva Motor Show. The successor to the 599 GTB Fiorano featured a newly-designed base structure whose space frame and body shell combined 12 different types of aluminum alloys. The front mid-mounted engine came in the form of a naturally aspirated <6262cc> V-12 producing <740ps> and <70.5kgm> of peak torque, making it the most powerful Ferrari road car to date.

Impressive numbers, to be sure, but Ferrari spent a majority of its development effort on the car’s architecture. The F12berlinetta was <47mm> shorter, <20mm> narrower and <63mm> lower than its predecessor, with a wheelbase that measured <30mm> less. The engine sat <30mm> lower than the 599, and the dual clutch 7-speed F1-matic gearbox utilized a transaxle layout—both of these features helped to lower the center of gravity by <25mm> and established a nearly ideal front/rear weight ratio of 46:54.

On the road, the F12berlinetta, despite its elegant good looks, was an absolute beast. It ran from zero to <100km/h> in a phenomenal 3.1 seconds, getting to <200km/h> in just 8.5, and topping out at a blurring <340km/h>. With its improved handling balance, it set a new fastest road car lap around the Fiorano test track, besting the 599 GTO by a full second.

With refined aerodynamics, advanced electronic devices and a brake cooling system that trickled down from its Formula 1 race car, this prancing horse deserved to be the flagship for what is arguably the most revered and recognized company in automotive history.
zh:
采用了F1技术的Ferrari旗舰车型。

F12berlinetta是Ferrari于2012年公开的599 GTB Fiorano的后继旗舰车型。该车采用新型铝制空间车架与车壳，配备一台前中置式V12引擎。优化后布局带来性能上的提升：0-100 公里/小时加速时间为3.1秒，最高速度达340 公里/小时。这台车还一举刷新Fiorano试车赛道的圈速纪录。

en:
This special exotic machine was the last one produced under the guidance of company founder Enzo Ferrari.

A very special Ferrari was announced by company founder, Enzo Ferrari, in July 1987. Dubbed the F40, this car was to mark the company's 40th anniversary, billed as Ferrari's first "street legal racing car."

Signore Ferrari spared no costs when building this dream machine. The F40's structure utilized a steel tube-frame in the same manner as other Ferrari road cars of the 1980s, but various internal and external chassis components were composed of carbon-fiber and Kevlar, the newest lightest, high-tech composite material available at the time.

The car's body panels were a structural part of the chassis, and its tube frame foundation was constructed from Kevlar and aluminum honeycomb sections, the preferred manufacturing method for racing cars at the time.

Powering the lightweight car was a twin-turbocharged, 3.0-liter DOHC V8 with a 90 degree bank angle, based on the power plant for the Ferrari's Group B 288 GTO; however, the one in the F40 had a larger displacement and altered boost pressures. As a result, the F40 produced an amazing <485ps> and <58.8kgm> of torque. The <1100kg> car could run to <100km/h> in about 4 seconds and reach a top speed of <324km/h>, making it the fastest production car in the world at the time.@
zh:
Ferrari创始人Enzo Ferrari参与设计的最后一款公路车。

这是为纪念Ferrari成立40周年而推出的特别版车型。全车开发完全参照当时的赛车制造方式，采用了钢管车架和碳纤维凯夫拉及铝质蜂窝结构等复合材料。动力单元基于288 GTO的V8双涡轮增压引擎调校，输出可达485 PS/58.0 公斤力米。它也是恩佐·法拉利参与开发的最后一款公路车，至今仍拥有极高的人气。

en:
The rolling piece of mechanical art was capable of reaching a top speed of <315km/h>.

When one utters the phrase "entry-level cars," it's usually meant to describe an inexpensive automobile whose sole purpose is to get people from Point A to Point B. But when you're talking about Ferrari, all conventional definitions go out the proverbial window.

Replacing Ferrari's "entry-level" 360 Modena in 2004 was the F430. The car's styling was mesmerizing, with flowing lines influenced by the company's legendary Formula 1 racers and Le Mans prototypes of the 1960s.

Mounted amidships was a sweet-sounding V8 powerplant. Unlike the 350 Modena's engine, which evolved from that of the 1973 Ferrari 308 GT4 in 1973, the F430's 4.3-liter naturally aspirated unit was completely new. Output was impressive, as it was rated at <490ps>/<8500rpm>, eclipsing the output of the legendary F40's turbocharged V8. It came mated to a high-tech new twin-clutch transmission that allowed the driver to manually select gears via paddles on the steering wheel.

The F430's chassis was a heavily reworked version of the 360 Modena's that featured a frame composed of extruded and forged aluminum. Part of the structure was altered to meet new, more stringent collision safety standards, and the floor board was made of an exceptionally strong aluminum alloy used in aerospace called extra super duralumin. With available carbon-ceramic brake rotors and a top speed of <315km/h>, the Ferrari F430, whose base price was about $180,000, was perhaps the most desirable "entry-level" car in the world.
zh:
顶级的中置引擎跑车，最高速度可达315 公里/小时。

Ferrari F430是一台2004年亮相的中置引擎V8超级跑车。新开发的4.3升引擎动力输出达490 PS。底盘基于360 Modena开发，由超高强度钢铝制成，在稳定性与下压力方面均有提升。这款顶级超级跑车最高时速可达315 公里/小时，并选配碳化陶瓷刹车。

en:
This Italian masterpiece, equipped with a naturally-aspirated V-12 and Formula 1 technology, celebrated Ferrari's 50th anniversary.

As the successor to the amazing F40 sports car, the F50 represented the latest and greatest from renowned auto maker and race team, Ferrari. The car also commemorated the 50th anniversary of the company. The F50 became an instant classic, as only 349 units were built, following in the the tradition established by other limited-edition models, the 288 GTO and the aforementioned F40.

The basic philosophy behind the F50 was to produce a Formula One car for the road. And the sleek sports car was exactly that, realizing a long-standing dream of Piero Ferrari (the second son of Ferrari founder Enzo) of making a road car with an F1 engine.

Designed by Pininfarina, the F50 featured a carbon-fiber body and an open-air cockpit like that of an F1 race machine (although the F50 did come with a removable hard top for rainy days). Also mimicking F1 cars was the F50's chassis whose front suspension was mounted directly to the carbon monocoque tub, while the rear suspension connected directly to the gearbox. The V-12 engine was based on the power unit from the 641, Ferrari's 1990 F1 race car. For the F50, it was tuned for road use, such as increasing displacement from 3.5 to 4.7 liters for smoother power delivery and mating it to a 6-speed manual gearbox. Top speed for the F50 was rated at <325km/h> and its 0-<100km/h> time came in at 3.87 seconds, which far exceeded the best sports cars of its day.@
zh:
装备了F1惯用的自然进气V12引擎，专为庆祝法拉利50周年而打造。

这是为纪念Ferrari成立50周年推出的特别版车型。打造一台“公路版F1赛车”便是这台车的开发理念，它选择了1990年“641” F1赛车的V12引擎，扩容至4.7升后直接安装在底盘上。在520 PS/48.0 公斤力米的动力驱动下，该车能够在3.87秒内从0加速至100 公里/小时，最高时速可达325 公里/小时。

en:
At the heart of this exotic, an update to the 488GTB, is a powerful V-8 that was also in the 488 Pista.

Ferrari introduced the F8 Tribute in 2019 to succeed the 488GTB. While the silhouettes of the two cars were quite similar, they exuded a different ambience altogether.

The F8 Tribute was essentially an update of the 488GTB; therefore, the engine, which was mounted amidships, was carried over from the 488 Pista. This powerplant was a twin-turbocharged 3.9-liter V-8 that produced <720ps> and <78.5kgm> of torque. For the exterior, the body was slightly restyled to improve aerodynamics and redirect air flow to optimize engine cooling. Inside the cockpit, the dashboard, instrument cluster, and door panels were replaced to give the car a fresh look and feel for the driver.

The performance of the F8 Tribute was nominally better than its predecessor with a 0-<100km/h> time of 2.9 seconds, a 0-<200km/h> time of 7.8 and a top speed of <340km/h>.
zh:
Ferrari的V8巅峰之作，拥有一颗488 Pista的心脏。

Ferrari F8 Tributo在2019年接替488 GTB首次亮相。外观上虽与488颇为相似，但围绕空气动力学的诸多细节设计上的重大变化，重塑了这款车的形象。3.9升V8双涡轮引擎动力输出达720 PS，0-100 公里/小时加速时间为2.9秒，最高速度达340 公里/小时，为V8车型之最。搭载的最新车身控制技术使其驾驭起来格外轻松。

en:
The production run of this Ferrari was limited to only 32 units. v

Only 32 examples of the Ferrari FXX K were produced, meaning that it became an instant collector's item when it was introduced in 2014. Developed for track use only by Corso Clienti, the FXX K was based on the LaFerrari super car with various improvements to .

The "K" on its name stood for "HY-KERS," Ferrari's Hybrid Kinetic Energy Recovery system, similar to the KERS systems used on Ferrari's Formula 1 cars. Under the FXX K's hood was LeFerrari's 6.3-liter V-12 tuned to produce <860ps> combined with a <190ps> HY-KERS electric motor, totaling an output of <1050ps>.

In 2017, Ferrari introduced the FXX K Evo, whose aerodynamics enhancements resulted in 23 percent more downforce than the standard FXX K and 75 percent more than the La Ferrari. It generated up to <640kg> of additional weight at 200 km/h, making it one of the most potent supercars ever created by the company.
zh:
这款Ferrari进化版车型只限量生产了32辆。

FXX K是基于LaFerrari开发的一款赛道专用车型，在2014年限量生产了32台。该车采用LaFerrari的6.3升V12引擎以及可产生190 PS的电机，综合动力输出达1,050 PS。车辆的空气动力学也同步得到了升级，加装EVO套件后下压力提升75%。这台车摆脱了赛事规则的限制，带来终极驾驶体验。

en:
At first glance, this monster car appears to be an offshoot model, but it's 100% custom-built on the inside, and produces over 394 horsepower. %

With the introduction of the Group B category in 1982, a number of auto makers brought new limited-run super sports cars to the market. This was because in order to compete in the Group B class, 200 units of production cars based on the race car were required to be produced. One of these cars was the Ferrari GTO, which bowed at the 1984 Geneva Motor Show. Some people referred to this car as the 288 GTO, although it is not the car's official name.

The "O" in GTO stands for omologazione, the Italian word for homologation. Upon first glance, it is obvious that the GTO gets its styling cues from the classic 308 GTB, but despite their similar looks, the GTO was an entirely different beast altogether. Unlike the 308 GTB, it featured a longitudinally-mounted engine, a <110mm> longer wheelbase, and body panels made from carbon fiber and other lightweight materials.

Leonardo Fioravanti, who was with Pininfarina at the time, penned the exterior styling. Flared front and rear fenders, additional fog lights, passing lights in the nose, a rear duck tail reminiscent of the 250 GTO, and three-lined louvers gave the GTO a wonderful balance of aggressiveness and elegance. Power came from a revamped Lancia LC2 engine, which was turned from a naturally-aspirated 3.0-liter to a twin-turbocharged 2.6-liter, then later into a 2.8-liter, the maximum displacement allowed in Group B. With <400ps> and <50.6kgm> of torque on tap, the <1160kg> sports car was the fastest Ferrari in its day, with a top speed of <305km/h>.

Only 272 examples of the 288 GTO were manufactured, and it never actually ran a race. The GTO eventually led to the development of the 288 GTO Evoluzione test vehicle, which in turn became the foundation for the now-legendary F40.
zh:
乍一看仿佛偏离了原旨，实则100%精心打造。一台怪物级的车，马力达到400 PS。

为了满足B组别赛事规则，这款认证车型一共生产了200台。它的造型与308GTB几乎别无二致，但轴距实际上增加了110毫米，引擎改为纵向安装，意味着内部构造完全不同。2.8升双涡轮增压引擎带来高达400 PS的马力，让其成为当时最快的Ferrari。

en:
Ferrari’s first hybrid car, built with the same materials and processes as an F1 racing machine.(

When Ferrari creates a “limited edition” model, the result is often something historic. In the past, now-legendary models such as the 288, GTO, F40, F50, and the Enzo Ferrari have rocked the exotic-car world, but the latest special-edition car from the revered marque will definitely go down in the annals of automotive history as the most special of them all: the LaFerrari.

In the same manner as its predecessors, the LaFerrari, introduced in 2013, represents grace, glamor and unprecedented performance, but two things in particular make this machine special. One of them is its carbon monocoque structure that’s composed of the same materials as Ferrari’s F1 machines, and built using the same processes. In comparison to the Enzo Ferrari, torsional rigidity of the LaFerrari is better by 27 percent, while beam rigidity has been improved by 22 percent. The car's other special feature is its hybrid drivetrain, a first for Ferrari. The 6.3-liter V-12 is tuned to <800ps> and matched to Ferrari’s HY-KERS system from F1 racing. The total output with the added <163ps> provided by the electric motor is rated at a whopping <963ps>, the most from any Ferrari road car…ever.

Also, the LaFerrari features an aerodynamics system that produces optimum performance by actively moving the front/rear diffusers, spoilers, and underbody in relation to driving conditions.

The performance specs include a 0-<100km/h> acceleration of less than 3 seconds, 0-<200km/h> acceleration of under 7, and a top speed of more than <350km/h>. At the Fiorano test track, the LaFerrari’s 1-minute-19.9-second lap was 5 seconds faster than the Ferrari Enzo and 3.1 seconds faster than the F12.

The production run of the LaFerrari was a mere 499 cars, and naturally, all of them have been spoken for, not surprising when you consider tha there were more than 1000 inquiries to buy the super exotic three days ater it was introduced.
zh:
Ferrari的第一款混动车型，完全使用F1赛车的材料和工艺打造。

Ferrari历史上生产过无数特殊车型，譬如F40、F50以及Enzo Ferrari，这款车也是其中之一。该车的材料与制作工艺与Ferrari F1赛车相同，采用了碳纤维单体车壳设计，并配备了调校后可输出800 PS的6.3升V12 F12berlinetta引擎，此外还辅以一套HY-KERS混合动力系统。这辆车的加速从0-100 公里/小时仅需不到3秒，0-200 公里/小时也只要不到7秒，而极速则可以达到令人咂舌的350 公里/小时。

en:
This historic Ferrari flagship impressed all with its vivid design.

The Ferrari Testarossa (Type F110) was introduced as the company's mid-engine flagship in 1984, replacing the popular 512BB in the lineup. Penned by Pininfarina, the car boasted a wild exterior design that was highlighted by its signature side strakes.

At first glance, the strakes may appear to be just a wild design element, but in reality, they directed air to the car's Formula 1-style radiators. The cooling air was necessary to keep the car's 5.0-liter 180-degree V-12 running smooth. This mid-mounted engine produced <390ps> and <50.0kgm> of torque, allowing the car to run from zero to <100km/h> in just 5.8 seconds and reach a top speed of <290km/h>.

Production of the Testarossa, which translated to "red head" in Italian, halted in 1992, making the way for the 512 TR.
zh:
这款历史悠久的Ferrari旗舰车型以其出格而细致的设计令车迷们惊叹不已。

1984年亮相的Testarossa是Ferrari的旗舰中置引擎车型。引擎为平卧放置的5升V12引擎，最大动力高达390 PS，峰值扭矩50.0 公斤力米。0-100 公里/小时加速时间为5.8秒，最高时速可达290 公里/小时。这款车拥有艺术化的优雅车身设计，采用标志性的5片式侧边条翼和从紧凑座舱异军突起的后挡泥板，赢得了全新一代车迷的青睐。

en:
A single-seat concept that pushes the boundaries of the hypercar genre.

The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo is the first Ferrari single-seater concept car dedicated to the world of virtual motor sport, with a spectacular and futuristic design founded in the Prancing Horse's unequalled racing heritage. The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo draws its inspiration from the fascinating world of Ferrari's hugely successful 1960s and '70s sports-prototypes. Below hyper-modern bodywork and dramatic proportions, the car hides the DNA of masterpieces such as the Ferrari 330 P3 and the 512S. It is a nod to the past, yet a powerful hint of the future of endurance racing.

The Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo's architecture is crafted around an advanced aerodynamic design and is equipped with the same engine architecture that powers the Ferrari 499P. Here, though, the engine has been made more extreme to develop no less than 1,030 CV (<1030ps>) at <9000rpm>, with an additional 240 kW (<326ps>) available through three electric motors, one on the rear axle and one on each of the front wheels.
zh:
一辆突破终极跑车界限的单座概念车。

Ferrari Vision Gran Turismo是Ferrari首款纯虚拟单座概念车，设计灵感来自于60年代和70年代的一众赛车原型车。3升涡轮增压V6混动引擎与3台电机配合，综合动力输出达1,030 PS。这台车的设计传承了经典赛车的基因，并昭示了耐力赛在未来的重磅发展方向。

en:
A WRC homologation special with a unique double-decker wing design.

Ford began their 1990s World Rally Championship (WRC) campaign fighting in the Sierra RS Cosworth 4x4. Then, in 1992, came the Escort RS Cosworth, a homologation special developed for even higher performance.

The original Escort was a masterpiece in itself, having been widely used in rally races in the late 1960s and early 1970s. Years later, Ford Europe took the compact body of the fifth-generation Escort, installed a highly tuned version of the 4WD powertrain from the Sierra, and added a large dual level rear wing to create a fearsome race machine.

At the heart of the beast was a longitudinally mounted turbocharged 2.0-liter twin-cam engine built by Cosworth, as per the car's name. The bore-stroke ratio was tweaked, resulting in <1993cc> of displacement and an output of <227ps>/<30.4kgm> in stock form. For the 4WD system, the central differential utilized a combination of a viscous coupling and planetary gears for maximum reliability.

The Escort RS Cosworth began production in 1992 and gained homologation status the following year when it began competing in the WRC's Group A category.

The "Cossie," as fans called it, finished 1-2 in Round 3 of the Portugal Rally before going on to achieve two consecutive victories in Rounds 5 (Tour de Corse) and 6 (Acropolis). It won again in Rounds 11 and 12 (San Remo and Spain), solidifying Ford's reputation as a strong contender on the rally circuit.
zh:
一款装有独特双层尾翼的世界汽车拉力锦标赛赛事认证车型。

1992年推出的Escort RS Cosworth是Ford为征战世界拉力锦标赛而打造的认证车型。承袭自Sierra的双凸轮轴2升引擎（227 PS）搭配上四驱系统，让这台车在拉力赛场展现出惊人性能。这台车在葡萄牙拉力赛中取得了一二带回的成绩，并在科西嘉岛拉力赛与雅典卫城拉力赛中连续获胜，重振了Ford的拉力赛豪门地位。

en:
With <417ps> on tap, this was one of the most potent pickup trucks ever created, thanks to Ford's Special Vehicle Team.

The F series is a line of full size pickup trucks sold by Ford since 1948. This is a model that has stayed on top of the pickup truck segment for over 40 years, and has also been the best selling car across all car categories for over 30 years in the United States.

The F-150 has always been the core of the series since being introduced in 1975. It is a model that has been the backbone of Ford throughout the years.

The F-150 Raptor is a special off-road model based on the 12th generation F-150, which started sales in the fall of 2008. It was developed by Ford's special vehicle development team "SVT" to be fit for racing in the desert and was added to the lineup in 2010.

The body is <18cm> wider with its enlarged fenders that house considerably thicker aluminum suspension arms supported by Fox Racing dampers, which are known to be the first off-road competition dampers to come equipped on a production car. The suspension travel in the front has been extended to <284.5mm> and <307.3mm> in the rear. The clearance under the car is also large, with an approach angle of 30 degrees and a departure angle of 22.7 degrees.

The engine is a 6.2 litre supercharged V8 producing <417ps> and <60.9kgm> of torque, and is combined with a 6 speed automatic transmission.|
zh:
这款出自Ford的Special Vehicle团队之手的高性能皮卡有着417 PS的超强马力。

F系列是Ford自1948年起销售至今的全尺寸皮卡系列车型。30多年来，该广受欢迎的车款一直是美国最为畅销的皮卡车。由Ford特殊车辆开发团队“SVT”开发的F-150 SVT Raptor是一款基于相同四轮驱动系统打造的特殊越野车型，专为沙漠赛车而生。

en:
The chassis performance of the late third-generation model shines in this rally special.

Ford saw performance potential in its affordable sedan, the Focus, so it created the Focus ST, a souped-up version that made its debut in 1998. The third-generation Focus ST (the ST stands for Sports Technology) debuted at the 2010 Paris Motor Show equipped with a brand new engine.

The previous Focus ST came powered by a Volvo-based turbocharged 2.5-liter inline-5, but the new car featured an “EcoBoost” turbocharged direct-injection 2.0-liter inline-4 that boasted better fuel economy and reduced emissions. Despite being smaller by <500cc>, the new engine delivered <25ps> more power, up to <250ps>. While many models had moved on to 2 pedal transmissions, this stoic model only came with a 6-speed manual.

The car thrilled enthusiasts for years, and in 2014, in addition to a mild facelift, Ford engineers made some drastic changes under the sheet metal. They completely revamped the suspension system, changed the variable ratio of the power steering, updated the stability program, and installed a torque vectoring system. As a result, the new Focus ST’s boasted class-leading handling, impressing even hardened race car drivers with its quick reactions and road-holding ability. And with a price that undercut its rivals in the competitive C segment, the Ford ST is still the talk of performance-car aficionados, even at the tail-end of its model run.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.B regulations by Gran Turismo./
zh:
这款最新的第3代拉力特别款车型将底盘性能发挥得淋漓尽致。

作为跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，Ford Focus全球掀背车已按照Gr.B组别规则进行了改装。该车在后挡泥板前方增加了能将空气输送到后置散热器的进气口。散热器移至后备箱后，车身重量分配得到了相应改善，使其成为Gr.B组别中最容易操控的车型之一。

en:
The RS model of the third-generation Ford Focus was the first to get 4-wheel drive.

While the Focus is mostly known as a friendly everyday commuter, Ford has traditionally mixed in a high-performance version called the RS that catered directly to enthusiasts.

The fourth-generation model, which made its debut in 2018, was no different, but this time, the Focus RS was offered with AWD. With the new RS, drivers could adjust the torque distribution between the front and rear wheels, from 0:100 to 100:0, meaning it could be driven in pure front-drive or rear-drive form. Thanks to the rear axle's twin-clutch system that functions as an LSD, the driver could choose from several driving modes, including "Track" and "Drift."

Under the hood was the company's EcoBoost 2.3-liter inline-4 tuned to produce an impressive <350ps> and <44.8kgm>, thanks to new turbocharger and larger intercooler. This allowed the car to run to <100km/h> in 4.7s and reach a top speed of <266km/h>, making this Ford one of the hottest American hatches of all time.
zh:
这款第三代Focus的RS车型是首款使用四轮驱动的车型，已获得更高的比赛性能。

2018年推出的第4代Ford Focus系列包含高性能“RS”车型。这台第4代RS首次配备四驱系统并支持扭矩分配调节。该车新增“赛道”与“漂移”等驾驶模式，底盘与避震器也得到了同步优化。其搭载的是一台2.3升直列4缸“EcoBoost”引擎（350 PS）。0-100 公里/小时加速时间为4.7秒，最高速度达266 公里/小时，性能极其卓越。

en:
Ford's Sport Technology was on full display in this late-model, compact performance car. \

Ford saw performance potential in its affordable sedan, the Focus, so it created the Focus ST, a souped-up version that made its debut in 1998. The third-generation Focus ST (the ST stands for Sports Technology) debuted at the 2010 Paris Motor Show equipped with a brand new engine.

The previous Focus ST came powered by a Volvo-based turbocharged 2.5-liter inline-5, but the new car featured an “EcoBoost” turbocharged direct-injection 2.0-liter inline-4 that boasted better fuel economy and reduced emissions. Despite being smaller by <500cc>, the new engine delivered <25ps> more power, up to <250ps>. While many models had moved on to 2 pedal transmissions, this stoic model only came with a 6-speed manual.

The car thrilled enthusiasts for years, and in 2014, in addition to a mild facelift, Ford engineers made some drastic changes under the sheet metal. They completely revamped the suspension system, changed the variable ratio of the power steering, updated the stability program, and installed a torque vectoring system. As a result, the new Focus ST’s boasted class-leading handling, impressing even hardened race car drivers with its quick reactions and road-holding ability. And with a price that undercut its rivals in the competitive C segment, the Ford ST is still the talk of performance-car aficionados, even at the tail-end of its model run.
zh:
这款新型高性能紧凑车型充分展示了Ford的跑车技术。

Focus ST作为Focus系列的运动车型，自1998年首次亮相以来一直备受喜爱。ST代表“Sports Technology”。尽管第3代ST的引擎比前代更小，但动力输出反而增加了25 PS，达到250 PS。当市场很多车型开始采用双离合变速器时，这款车型坚持以全六速手动变速箱等特点迎合硬核车迷。

en:
The final-year model of this potent supercar came right after the company's 100th anniversary.

The Ford GT40 became an instant icon in the GT racing world by dominating the famous 24 Hours of Le Mans endurance race, taking the top three spots on the podium in 1966 and winning the next four in a row. In celebration of Ford's 100th anniversary in 2002, the company elected to recreate the legend by producing the spiritual successor to the classic race car of the sixties, the Ford GT.

The concept model was presented at the 2002 North American International Auto Show, followed by the unveiling of the production car at the same show in 2004. Its beautiful styling closely resembled that of the original GT40, but the new machine came armed with the latest technological features. The car measured <457mm> longer and <102mm> taller than the original, but its larger size was effectively veiled by the stunning exterior styling.

Placed amidships, immediately behind the cabin, was a longitudinally-mounted supercharged 5.4-liter DOHC V8 that pumped out <558ps>/<6500rpm> with <69.13kgm> of torque at <3750rpm>. It came with a 6-speed gearbox. The new GT boasted remarkable performance, running from 0 to 60 mph (about 100km/h) in 3.3 seconds, while reaching a top speed of <330km/h>.

A total of 4038 Ford GTs were unleashed onto the streets during its three-year production run, and, by all accounts, this revived version of the GT40 will be just as collectable as the original.
zh:
这款接受了精心调校的百年纪念版车型于该年度停产。

庆祝公司成立100周年的Ford GT的造型和精神汲取自GT40，后者在1966年勒芒24小时耐力赛中包揽前三名，并在此后（直至1969年）连续四年间蝉联冠军，缔造了不朽的传奇。该车能在3.3秒内完成0-60英里/小时的加速，最高时速可达330 公里/小时。在截至2006年的3年间，Ford GT一共生产了4038辆。

en:
The second-generation Ford GT came complete with reengineered aerodynamics."

The original Ford GT, which was produced from 2005 to 2006, brought back the glory of the renowned GT40, whose exploits in the 24 Hours of Le Mans in the 1960s are now legendary. At the 2015 North American International Auto Show, Ford introduced the second-generation GT that boasted even more performance and technical savagery than its predecessor.

While the first Ford GT's styling strongly resembled that of the GT40, the new 2016 car featured a number of aerodynamic improvements that included an active rear spoiler and a large underbody tunnel that directed air from the side through to the rear. Underneath the sheet metal, there were aluminum front and rear subframes that provided a remarkably rigid body structure, while the body panels themselves were composed of lightweight carbon fiber.

Mounted aft of the cockpit was not the V8 of yore, but a twin-turbocharged 3.5-liter V6 that produced a whopping <656ps> and <76kgm>. It came with a 7-speed DCT transmission that sent the power to the rear wheels. This combination enabled the new Ford GT to run from 0 to 60 mph in a scant 3.2 seconds, while reaching a top speed of <348km/h>.
zh:
Ford GT的回归，空气动力学性能经过了大幅改善。

Ford在2005和2006年间复刻了GT40，推出Ford GT，并在2015年宣布推出第2代车型。该第2代车型延续了GT40神韵的同时，在空气动力学设计上做到了极致。碳纤维单体车壳配合铝制副车架减轻车重，让最高时速来到了348 公里/小时。

carNameEn: Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II
sourceName: Ford GT LM Race Car Spec II
en:
Gran Turismo commemorates the return of the legendary Le Mans-winning machine by offering its own interpretation.

As a stunning new take on a legendary racing car, the new Ford GT supercar was launched in the summer of 2004 to commemorate the company's 100th anniversary. As a reinterpretation of the classic 1960s GT40 that won four straight 24 Hours of Le Mans races, this new version featured the latest and greatest automotive technology. With that in mind, Grand Turismo decided to make a good thing even better by creating its own Ford GT to contemporary Le Mans specs, we call it the Ford GT LM Race Car.

The powertrain remains the same as that found in the production Ford GT, a supercharged 5.4-liter DOHC V8 mounted amidships behind the seats. But the <558ps> output from the stock version has been boosted to a whopping <600ps> in this race car model. A 6-speed manual race-spec gearbox has also been added.

The LM Race Car has the identical proportions as that of the stock Ford GT, measuring <4.61m> from bumper to bumper and <1.95m> wide. The chassis is an aluminum space frame design incorporating all of the latest automotive technologies, and the body is composed entirely of carbon-fiber. A large rear wing for increased downforce has also been added. The suspension system consists of a double-wishbone configuration fore and aft. Total curb weight: just <1150kg>.'
zh:
Gran Turismo打造的梦幻车型，代表着勒芒传奇的回归！

这台LM GT赛车是Ford GT按照符合勒芒赛事规格打造的重制版，而Ford GT本身则是运用现代技术对上世纪60年代经典GT40的重新诠释。这台车延续了GT40在勒芒24小时耐力赛的传奇征程，并同样搭载了5.4升机械增压V8双顶置凸轮轴引擎，动力输出达到了600 PS。并且也配备了双叉臂悬挂及赛车规格的6速变速箱。

carNameEn: Ford GT LM Spec II Test Car
sourceName: Ford GT LM Spec II Test Car

Gran Turismo commemorates the return of the legendary Le Mans-winning machine by offering its own interpretation.

As a stunning new take on a legendary racing car, the new Ford GT supercar was launched in the summer of 2004 to commemorate the company's 100th anniversary. As a reinterpretation of the classic 1960s GT40 that won four straight 24 Hours of Le Mans races, this new version featured the latest and greatest automotive technology. With that in mind, we decided to make a good thing even better by creating this Ford GT to contemporary Le Mans specs and calling it the Ford GT LM Race Car.

The powertrain remains the same as that which is found in the production Ford GT, a supercharged 5.4-liter DOHC V8 mounted amidships behind the seats. A large rear wing for increased downforce has also been added. The suspension system consists of a double-wishbone configuration fore and aft. The total curb weight is just 2535 lbs.
zh:
Gran Turismo梦幻车型，代表着勒芒传奇的回归！

这款勒芒比赛规格的赛车以2004年夏季发布的Ford GT为基础，经改装后用于征战勒芒赛事。动力输出从公路版的558 PS提升至600 PS，车身在保持原有尺寸和造型的同时，全部改为碳纤维材料，使得整车重量仅为1,150 公斤。

en:
This race car claimed numerous World Endurance Championship titles.

The second-generation Ford GT, introduced in 2015, came equipped with compact twin-turbo V-6 that allowed the car to spring to 60 mph in about 3.0 seconds and reach a top speed of <348km/h>, making it a legitimate super car and a worthy successor to the classic GT40 of yesteryear.

Like the GT40, the GT shined on the race track. Under the Chip Ganassi Racing and Ford factory team banner, it scored several victories in the World Endurance Championship (WEC) that included the 2016 24 Hours of Le Mans, as well as winning in IMSA, taking three race wins in 2016, two in 2017, five in 2018 and three in 2019. In 2018, after winning the 24 Hours of Daytona, the GT's strong performance that season handed Ford the manufacturers title in the GT-LM class.
zh:
赢得世界耐力锦标赛的Ford车厂车队专属赛车。

2015年发布的第2代Ford GT重制版专注于空气动力学技术与极速表现，搭载紧凑的V6双涡轮引擎，0-100 公里/小时加速时间为3.0秒，最高时速高达348 公里/小时。赛事表现方面，美国车队Chip Ganassi Racing从2016年起开始征战国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛与IMSA赛事。

en:
This historic machine achieved a much-desired Le Mans victory with an incredible 1-2-3 finish.

In 1963, Ford attempted to buy Ferrari in order to improve its brand image through racing. The talks did not go well, to say the least. The deal didn't happen, and Henry Ford II went on a mission to beat Ferrari at its own game, expanding a collaboration with British race car constructor Lola Cars (to whom Ford was already providing engines) to develop a brand-new racing car.

In 1964, based on a race chassis designed by Lola, the Mark I was completed and the Ford GT was born. The commonly known name "GT40" was originally a nickname given by a reporter who was surprised by the low 40-inch height of the car.

A lightweight aerodynamic body of fiberglass was mounted on a steel monocoque chassis, powered by an all-aluminum 4.7-liter OHV V8 mounted amidships. The car made its debut at a 1964 Nürburgring race. Later that year, three Mark I's began the assault on Ferrari. The cars showed incredible speed at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, breaking the lap record and achieving the first run in Le Mans history over <186mph>, but the Fords failed to win due to reliability issues.

From 1965, Ford commissioned race activities to Carroll Shelby, and though the GTs again set new top speed and lap records at Le Mans, all of the cars were again forced to retire from the race. At the 1966 Le Mans race, 8 out of 13 Ford GTs in the race were advanced Mark IIs, with improved chassis and Shelby-made 7-liter OHV V8s. In addition to many other refinements, the power of the engines skyrocketed from <350ps> to <475ps>.

Mr. Ford himself came to the circuit to watch this race, and Ford not only achieved a much-sought victory, they dominated the podium with an incredible 1-2-3 finish. From 1966 through 1969, the Ford GT devastated the competition, winning the 24 Hours of Le Mans four years in a row.
zh:
众望所归地在勒芒大赛中夺得胜利，包揽全部领奖台，为传奇拉开帷幕，极具历史意义。

为了跻身赛车界，Ford与Lola汽车共同开发了Mark I。1964年，这台以Lola设计的“Mk6”为基础的赛车完成了开发，并以Ford GT的名号在大众面前亮相。“GT40”其实是一位记者为它起的昵称，后者对总车身高度仅有40英寸的事实惊讶万分。在1966年的勒芒24小时耐力赛中，改进后的Mark II车型奇迹般地包揽前三名完赛。

en:
This race car represented Ford's last effort to challenge for the 24 Hours of Le Mans title.

The year was 1966, and Ford was on a roll, especially at the world's most famous endurance race, the 24 Hours of Le Mans. The company realized its goal of winning the historic contest on its third try, dominating the competition with the Ford GT Mark II. With their eyes set on winning future Le Mans races, the engineers from Ford began work developing a new race car in 1965, one that would eclipse the prowess of the GT Mark II. The GT Mark IV was built according to changes in Article J of the FIA vehicle regulation.

The new car possessed an aluminum honeycomb chassis, which replaced the previous car's steel monocoque one. The profile of the car was characterized by its long, low body that curved from the center section to the rear end. The side air intakes utilized NACA ducts for less drag. The car was subjected to intense wind tunnel testing, and as a result, the Mark IV was one of the most aerodynamically-proficient vehicles in the world.

Although the Mark IV's engine was carried over from the Mark II, its power was increased to <530ps>. The chassis was also updated. The result was a race car with an improved top speed of <347km/h> and a better overall stability than its predecessor. In 1967, the Mark IV won the 12 Hours of Sebring and claimed the checkered flag at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, beating its rival, Ferrari, by five laps. This victory marked the last time the Ford works team participated at Le Mans. The main reason for its departure was the adoption of a new rule in 1968 that restricted maximum displacement, which seemed directly aimed at the Ford GT because, simply put, the car was too fast for the competition.
zh:
Ford最后一次参加勒芒锦标赛的车型。

在称霸1966年勒芒24小时耐力赛后，为了适应FIA颁布的车辆技术规范的变化，Ford开发了一台新的测试车Mark IV。凭借出色的空气动力学车身，该车兼具了高速稳定性和高达347 公里/小时的极速，帮助其在1967年再度夺冠。它在勒芒24小时耐力赛中以整整5圈的优势击败对手，拿下冠军。

en:
This special high-performance Mustang was produced for only two years.

The Ford Mustang has always included high-performance versions in its lineup with many examples created especially for racing.

One of the first special Mustang versions to be specifically used in motorsports was the GT350, developed by Shelby American for SCCA races. Then, there was the BOSS series, produced in 1969 and 1970, a high-performance Mustang for the street that also possessed a racing heart because it was primarily created for NASCAR homologation purposes. Among these, the BOSS 429 stands out as perhaps the most impressive Mustang ever.

Under its hood was a 7.0-liter V-8, the largest engine to ever grace a Mustang. While officially rated at <375ps>, its true output was said to be closer to <600ps>. And the car's signature hood scoop came only on the Boss 429.
zh:
这是符合NASCAR赛事认证的Mustang，仅仅只生产了两年。

这款高性能车型仅在1969年和1970年款Ford初代Mustang上提供。为满足NASCAR赛事认证要求而生产，搭载Mustang历史上最大排量的7L V8 429引擎。那标志性的大型引擎盖进气口极易辨认，常被誉为史上最强的Mustang。

en:
The 50th Anniversary sixth-generation Ford Mustang GT goes international.

America’s premier pony car celebrated its 50th anniversary in 2014, and Ford celebrated this occasion by introducing the all-new sixth-generation model. Unlike previous versions of the Mustang that were only available in limited markets, Ford decided to share the wealth and marketed the new car to more than 120 countries.

The designers at Dearborn took extreme care in styling the new Mustang, making it appear more aggressive than any model before it, but making sure that it would still be instantly recognizable as a Mustang upon first glance. The engineers took the same tack, giving the car a great balance of efficiency and power. They brought back the inline-4 of Mustangs past, but after bolting on a turbocharger, the base 2.3-liter engine pumped out a hearty <314ps>/<32.6kgm> to the delight of sports car fans worldwide. However, the star of the show was the thundering Mustang GT's 5.0-liter V-8, which people expected from a powerful American muscle car. It didn’t disappoint, delivering a whopping <441ps>/<40.8kgm>, making it among the most powerful Mustangs ever.

The new pony car also featured a fine-tuned fully independent suspension system (previous models came with a rear beam axle). It was clear to see from this rebirth of the modern-day pony car that the Mustang was no longer only an American icon, but an international one.
zh:
在该车型50周年亮相的第6代Mustang，这款备受期待的产品在全球120个国家销售。

在经过漫长而艰巨的开发周期之后，2014年，Ford推出了第六代Ford Mustang。这款经典车型不仅迎来了50周年纪念，在全球市场上的销量也攀至顶峰。这辆车采用了更具侵略性的外观风格，还配备了一套四轮独立悬挂系统。这一代的产品谱系中包含了多个版本，而采用了标志性V8引擎的Mustang GT是最受关注的一款。
