en:
This fully electric sports car combines Jaguar's rich racing tradition with the latest in EV technology.

The Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo has been developed from the ground up as a pure, all-electric race car that celebrates the beautiful designs from Jaguar’s illustrious racing heritage while providing an exciting glimpse into the future of Jaguar design and technology.

The state-of-the-art powertrain features powerful, light, compact electric motors and a lithium-ion battery pack developed from the race-proven technologies used in the Jaguar I-TYPE 4 Formula E car and the world’s first production battery electric vehicle race series – the Jaguar I-PACE eTROPHY championship.

Proportion is fundamental to the design of every Jaguar, and to enable the dramatic form of the Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo, the battery modules are packaged around the cockpit, contributing to the low center of gravity and near-perfect weight distribution.

Inspiration for the cockpit of the Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo, was drawn from the true icons in Jaguar’s rich racing bloodline: cars such as the revered C-, D-, and E-Type. Fused with a contemporary, driver-focused interior philosophy of pure, beautiful and intricate details, creating an ideal balance between analog and digital. Access via a powered roof hatch enriches the driver experience still further.

The car’s architecture is lightweight, simple, and dramatic, and is crafted from advanced and experimental materials and finishes. Sitting down low in the cockpit, the driver will feel enveloped by the car – echoing the feel of the three-time Le Mans-winning D-Type.

The perfectly-weighted controls, essential information displayed precisely in the driver's eye line, and a virtually seamless view of the road combine to deliver a precision racing experience. Features such as hologram technology add a further flourish. Looking out over the gracefully long bonnet of te Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo – a view that is unmistakably Jaguar – te player is fully immersed in the action.

Designed exclusively for Gan Turimo by Jaguar Advanced Design, players ae taken on a journeyinto the future along with the esigners for a purely diital yt visceral exerience that wil truly capture the imagination.
zh:
全电动跑车，结合了Jaguar的赛车理念和最新的技术。

这款Vision Gran Turismo概念车由Jaguar Advanced Design设计部门打造。这款纯电动车型传承了Jaguar经典赛车C-Type、D-Type和E-Type的设计血统，不仅外观优雅，更具备低重心和完美的前后配重。坐进驾驶舱，所有必要的驾驶信息都会无缝投射在前方路面上，通过数字化技术营造出身临其境的赛车体验。

en:
A roadster that's an heir to the legendary D-Type.

The Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo Roadster is an all-electric single-seater which combines a race-proven, state-of-the art powertrain with a taut, sculpted form inspired by the iconic, timeless Jaguar D-type.

Following the success of the original Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo Coupé and Vision Gran Turismo SV endurance racer, the Gran Turismo Roadster is designed to bring gamers the pure, visceral driving experience of an open-cockpit Jaguar sports car powered by three electric motors generating a total power output of more than <1000ps>.

The flowing surfaces, dramatic lines and perfect proportions of the first two Jaguar Gran Turismo Vision cars are instantly recognizable, but in place of a deployable canopy is a swept-back aero screen directly in front of the driver. Behind, a modern interpretation of the fin synonymous with the three-time Le Mans-winning D-type, is aerodynamically optimized using the latest computational fluid dynamics tools to be deployable at speed for enhanced stability with minimal drag.

The fin also features one of the beautiful details found on the Roadster, here in the form of a Union Jack etched into the fin itself, and subtly illuminated by LEDs. The theme continues with the hand-crafted leather straps on the front fenders and iconic roundel lights in the grille.

The Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo Roadster’s dramatic, driver-focused interior combines lightweight, luxurious materials and finishes with stunningly intricate details. Looking out onto the gracefully long hood, gamers will be fully immersed in the action._
zh:
一辆源于传奇D-type的跑车。

Jaguar第三款Vision Gran Turismo概念车的设计灵感源自经典的Jaguar D-Type赛车。这款配备导流风挡的开放式电动单座赛车采用三电机驱动，最大功率超过1,000 PS。座椅后方采用了经典D-Type标志性尾鳍的现代化演绎，简洁专业的座舱控制系统也充分体现了Jaguar的历史底蕴与传统。

en:
This virtual electric race car provides a glimpse into the future of Jaguar.

The Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo SV, an all-electric virtual race car created by Jaguar Special Vehicle Operations, was a radical interpretation of what an electric Jaguar of tomorrow could be.

Developed from the dramatic Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo Coupé of 2019, and fusing the spirit of the iconic C- and D-Type, the Vision Gran Turismo SV artfully blends the new with old. The car's sweeping body and perfectly balanced proportions offer the ultimate in aerodynamics. Highlights include the prominent front splitter, a purposefully-sculpted underbody, rear Venturi and a large rear wing with deployable elements.

The state-of-the-art lithium-ion battery pack, packaged around the cabin to enable ideal front/rear weight distribution, is cooled by a liquid nitrogen system that ensures every cell delivers maximum performance even under the most extreme race conditions.

The engineers successfully integrated elements of Jaguar’s I-TYPE 5 Formula E race car to the Vision Gran Turismo SV. Four powerful, compact electric motors help the car reach a top speed of more than 255 mph (approximately <410km/h>). The car also gives off a mean, distinctive sound to convey its powerful nature, one that reflects its true racing DNA.

Authentically yet futuristically Jaguar, the Vision Gran Turismo SV was designed and engineered to take the performance of the already potent Jaguar Vision Gran Turismo Coupé to the next level.
zh:
这辆虚拟电动赛车是对Jaguar未来的一瞥。

Jaguar第二款Vision Gran Turismo概念车由Jaguar设计，并融合了Jaguar特种车辆部门（SV）的工程技术。在保持优雅车身设计的同时，空气动力学系统经过彻底重新设计，以获得最大下压力。动力系统充分运用了该公司在Formula E赛事中积累的技术经验，采用四电机驱动布局。电池组还配置了最先进的液氮冷却系统。

en:
A dream car that never came to be, this beautiful V12 mid-engine race car disappeared.

When it comes to racing, there may not be any other marquee around with a richer historical heritage than Jaguar. Back in the day, Jaguar won the 24 Hours of Le Mans from 1955 to 1957, with the now legendary D-Type taking the checker three years in a row. The company's activity as a works team ended in 1956, but there were those within the company that still had a passion for racing. These men continued to develop racing cars, and one in particular was intended to succeed the D-Type. This car was dubbed the XJ13 and was completed in 1966. It was Jaguar's first mid-engine race car.

The body was similar to the road-going E-Type, often considered one of the most beautiful road cars in history; however, within the engine compartment sat a 5.0-liter DOHC V12 that pumped out <502ps>. This engine would serve as the basis for the company's 12-cylinder engines for years to come.

The engineers had high hopes for the XJ13 in actual competition, but the management team at Jaguar wasn't keen on seeing it race, and along with the fact that company brass wanted to keep the V12 engine a secret, the XJ13 project was canceled. It's too bad really, because the car was said to be the most beautiful in Jaguar's history. Although it never made it onto any racetrack, one car was actually produced, but it was severely damaged during filming of a promotional clip for the E-Type. Since then, the car has fortunately been restored to its original splendor.
zh:
从未实现的幻想，美丽的V12中置引擎赛车，已经消失在车迷的视野中。

这辆1966年推出的车型是Jaguar的一款中置引擎运动型赛车。其低矮的流线型车身与E-Type非常类似，并安装了一部502 PS动力的5升V12双顶置凸轮轴引擎。虽然这款车理应在赛道上驰骋纵横，但当时的管理层对赛车运动并不感兴趣，于是这个项目最终惨遭下马。它被称为Jaguar最美的赛车，但还没机会参与任何一场比赛便湮没在了历史的滚滚浪潮中。

en:
A road-going Group C car with breath-taking bodywork

In 1988, Jaguar showed a prototype of a super sports machine at the British International Motor Show called the XJ220. In 1991, it unveiled the final production version of the car at the Tokyo Motor Show. The XJ220 received its name from its maximum speed, which was 220 mph, the highest ever at the time for a commercially marketed car.

Jaguar entrusted production of the XJ220 to Jaguar Sports, a joint venture with TWR, which developed the Jaguar Group C car and was in charge of its race team. The prototype engine was a naturally-aspirated V-12, but the XJ220 that was shown in Tokyo came with a twin-turbo 3.5-liter V-6 engine from the XJR11 Group C car. The chassis was crafted from composite aluminum honeycomb and carbon Kevlar, not unlike that of a serious race car. Under the body, a panel that produced serious ground effects was added, again, just like a Group C racer. Setting the car apart from the race machine was a luxurious interior that was finished with the finest materials around, in the same manner as the company's notable luxury cars.

In 1993, Jaguar entered the XJ220 into the GT class of the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Taking the wheel were David Coulthard, David Brabham, and John Nielsen, who teamed up to successfully complete the endurance race and win in its class...or so everyone thought. A month later, the XJ220 was disqualified due to an exhaust violation, and its result was stricken from the books.

Later, the XJ220 was entrusted to the famous Team Chamberlain race team and continued to participate in GT races including the 24 Hours of Le Mans.
zh:
一辆车身设计令人惊艳的C组别公路车。

XJ220因创下当时最快公路车纪录而得名——达到了220英里/小时（354 公里/小时）。其生产由Tom Walkinshaw Racing与Jaguar的合资企业Jaguar Sport负责。它采用来自XJR11 Group C赛车的3.5升V6涡轮增压引擎，搭载于铝制蜂窝板和碳纤维凯夫拉复合材料制成的底盘上。从1993年起，它四处征战包括勒芒24小时耐力赛在内的多项GT赛事。

en:
This iconic race car brought Jaguar many victories, notably against turbocharged competitors.

In the golden era of racing, Jaguar was a force to be reckoned with, especially at the 24 Hours of Le Mans, where the classic marquee won five times from 1951 to 1957. And then, Jaguar took a long break, not returning to the Sarthe Circuit until 1986 when the company re-emerged with the Group C race car, the XJR-6, developed by TWR (Tom Walkinshaw Racing).

Designed by noted Formula 1 designer Tony Southgate, the XJR-6 was a bit different from other Group C cars in that it did not have a turbocharged powerplant. Most teams opted with small displacement turbocharged engines to improve fuel-efficiency, but Jaguar went with pure power, in the form of a naturally-aspirated 6.5-liter V-12, which grew to 7.0 liters in the XJR-9, which produced about <700 ps>.

The XJR-9 competed with perennial powerhouses such as Nissan, Toyota, Mercedes-Benz and Porsche at the 1988 24 Hours of Le Mans. The XJR-9 took the checkered flag, with Jan Lammers, Johnny Dumfries and Andy Wallace sharing the driving duties. It was a historic moment for Jaguar, which returned to glory at the famed French circuit after a long absence.
zh:
Jaguar标志性的勒芒参赛车，打败了涡轮增压赛车。

在1950年代的勒芒取得巨大成功后，Jaguar在1986年带着一款C组别赛车再度杀回这项赛事。这辆XJR-9帮助他们在1988年登上了巅峰。它简单的构造提供了优秀的空气动力学性能和耐用性，帮助这款车在勒芒24小时耐力赛上强势夺魁。凭借一场击败勒芒的常胜冠军Porsche的胜利，它为自己在赛车历史上留下了浓墨重彩的一笔。

en:
The U.S. Army-commissioned vehicle that became the forefather of the modern SUV.+

The SUV genre may well have started with this vehicle, a compact 4-wheel-drive off-roader that was commissioned by the United States Army for use during World War II.

The United States asked Bantam, Ford and Willys to develop and produce prototypes of all-terrain vehicles based on a design by Bantam. Each company built more than 1500 examples that were immediately put to use on the battlefront. Here, the Willys MA shined the brightest, so the U.S. Army placed its order and Willy delivered the MB, of which 360,000 units were eventually manufactured.

When the war ended, Willys registered the Jeep trademark and offered a production-based MB for the general public. Because of its success and exposure during the war, it was an instant hit, thus the SUV was born and the MB's place in the annals of automotive history solidified.
zh:
它诞生于战场上，美国陆军的苛刻要求促成了现代4x4之父的诞生。

SUV车型的起源可追溯到这款1940年应美军要求开发的紧凑型四轮驱动车辆。在Bantam、Ford和Willys生产的测试车型中，Willys MB表现最佳。作为MA的升级版本，最终生产了超过36万辆。其简单坚固的结构（采用边梁式车架和刚性车轴）与四轮驱动形成完美结合，成就了一款真正具有历史意义的汽车，其精神传承至今。

en:
The KTM X-Bow is a unique Audi turbo-powered track car from the Austrian motorcycle manufacturer.

The first sports car developed by Austrian motorcycle manufacturer KTM made its debut at the 2007 Geneva Motor Show. Its name X-BOW was pronounced "Crossbow," inspired by the weapon of the same name. What's more, the car was styled in the image of a crossbow itself. It's a 2-seater, with no doors or windows... in fact, there are no comfort or luxury items to speak of. It certainly is, however, street legal.

The car was styled by Kiska Design, who also designed KTM's 2-wheeled machines, so the chassis features a motorcycle-like design. The X-BOW is a mid-engine vehicle with a carbon monocoque structure, which was co-developed by Dallara, a top race car chassis designer. A pushrod type double wishbone suspension is mounted front and rear, giving it the setup like that of a pure racing car. It possesses a flat bottom and a large diffuser at the rear end that generates <200kg> of downforce at <200km/h>. This helps allow the car to register an insane 1.5g in lateral acceleration.

There is nothing on or in this car other than what is required to go really fast. Inside the simple cockpit, there is a single display that serves as the instrument panel. Mounted behind the seats is Audi's turbocharged direct injected 2.0-liter TSFI engine that produces <240ps>/<31.6kgm> of torque. It propels the <790kg> car from 0-<100km/h> in an amazing 3.9 seconds. Even in standard trim, the X-BOW rivals the performance specs of some respectable supercars. The top-of-the-line "R" model gets the same engine, but power is boosted to <300ps>/<40.8kgm>. And with an upgraded suspension to accompany the extra power, it's as fast as—perhaps faster—than many race cars around a track.
zh:
摩托车制造商KTM的第一款跑车。

X-BOW是奥地利摩托车制造商KTM开发的第一款超级跑车。这个名字的意思是“十字弩”，它的造型设计也采用了同名机械式弓弩武器的概念。这款双门跑车没有车门也没有车窗，还取消了一切不必要的功能。这辆车拥有绝佳的操控性能，在过弯时最大水平重力加速度能够达到1.5G。

en:
A beautiful high performance machine for participation in the Nürburgring 24 hour race.

For Lexus, the 2014 Super GT GT500 class was a historic season in which they fought hard for the class title until the very last race. And in 2015, Lexus added a new page to their ultimate challenge in the top category: They are planning an introduction of a car into the GT3 class, a class that is a gentlemen’s race but at the same time the ultimate international manufacturers’ championship. This comes from the hope of Lexus to fulfill the desires of gentlemen racers; to participate together with them in world class races in the car of their dreams.

With this background of Lexus’ involvement in racing, the LEXUS LF-LC GT “Vision Gran Turismo” was developed in reply to the passions of Gran Turismo fans, to compete in world class races with their dream car. The design and development of the car targets entry in races such as the Super GT and the Nürburgring 24 hour race.

For Lexus, the 2014 Super GT GT500 season was one to remember because it took home the championship in the very last race. In 2015, Lexus entered the GT3 racing class, where it battled in the world's foremost international championships.

The brand's amazing success in motorsports paved the way for the creation of the Lexus LF-LC GT “Vision Gran Turismo.” With this machine, Gran Turismo players were able to compete virtually in various world-class races in what can be called the quintessential gentleman's race car.

The LF-LC GT "Vision Gran Turismo" is based on the LF-LC concept vehicle, which was shown at the 2012 North American International Auto Show and created by Calty Design Research. Thus, the LF-LC GT “Vision Gran Turismo” is a grand tourer that possesses both sculptured beauty and the highest levels of performance, with real world elements provided by Calty blended with the on-road prowess of Lexus Racing

Born from a passion for racing, the Lexus LF-LC GT “Vision Gran Trismo” is a car meant to probe the potentials of the ultimate Lexus rce car.
zh:
优雅的高性能赛车，参赛纽博格林24小时耐力赛。

这辆Lexus LF-LC GT“Vision Gran Turismo”是Lexus设计的梦幻车型，专为参加Super GT和纽博格林24小时耐力赛而打造。这款车基于LF-LC豪华双门概念车打造，其开发创意起源于CALTY DESIGN提出的Lexus设计哲学，并结合了Lexus Racing部门的实用型设计思路。

en:
This futuristic single-seat sports concept possesses the core concepts of Lamborghini's design DNA.

Automobili Lamborghini made a bold entrance into the world of virtual racing with a machine crafted to stir the soul of every Vision Gran Turismo enthusiast. Born from passion and brought to life by the expert hands of the Centro Stile team in Sant’Agata Bolognese, under the guidance of Head of Design Mitja Borkert, the Lampborghini Lambo V12 Vision Gran Turismo is a pure expression of Lamborghini’s design DNA.

What began as a series of sketches evolved into a 1:3 scale digital model, ultimately earning the approval of both Kazunori Yamauchi and Borkert.  The full-scale version was completed between 2018 and 2019 by a team driven by creativity and technical precision.

A single look at the Lamorghini Lambo V12 Vision Gran Turismo reveals its purpose.  Sculpted like a futuristic work of art, it embodies sharp, aerodynamic flair, while remaining rooted in engineering excellence.

From the outset, this was envisioned as a virtual race machine, and that intent shaped everything from its radical single-seat layout to its pilot-focused cabin.  Stripped down and purpose-built, the cabin is designed entirely around the player’s experience. The central driving position, reminiscent of Formula and endurance racers, emphasizes immersion. A digital cockpit, complete with augmented reality and voice control, reinforces the sensation of being in command.

Power comes from the same heart as the Lamborghini Sián FKP 37—a mid-mounted V-12 paired with a supercapacitor hybrid system. Producing more than <830.4ps>, it delivers amazing performance, and a rich sound that elevates the virtual driving experience. The engine is always on display, exposed and ever-inspiring.

The design stays true to Lamborghini’s unmistakable design language, centered around its signature one-line silhouette. Its overall architeture echoes the bold DNA first defined by the iconic Lamborghini Countachin 1971. Influences from Marcello Gandini’s visionary work are eviden througout. Particularly in the side profile, t draws inspiration rom the radical 1970 Bertone Statos Zero concept. From very agle, the car isplays Lamborgini’s hallmark graphical elements: upsilon motifs, hexagonal forms, and “Y”-saped front lights that forehadow the brand’s futue lihting identity."
zh:
这款近未来主义的单座运动概念车的核心设计理念带有深深的Lamborghini 基因。

这款Vision Gran Turismo凝聚了Centro Stile Lamborghini团队的炽热激情与精湛技艺。虽然主要设计语言采用“Y”形和六边形元素，但侧面轮廓却与经典的Stratos Zero有着异曲同工之妙。动力系统采用V12引擎配合超级电容混合动力技术，技术源自Sián FKP 37。最为精妙的设计细节在于，这套系统的运作状态可以从车外清晰看到。

en:
The new flagship of the heralded supercar company was nothing short of awesome.

The Murciélago, which had been a descendant of the Countach, had been the flagship of Lamborghini for nearly 10 years since its debut in 2001, and the time had come for a successor. The company introduced that successor at the 2011 Geneva Motor Show when it unveiled the Aventador.

The newest bull in the stable inherited the scissor doors of its predecessors, as well as a wind-cutting wedge profile that characterized nearly every Lamborghini model ever. While it retained much of the visual cues of the Murciélago, under the sheet metal, things had been completely changed. The steel tube space frame of the Murciélago was replaced with a carbon monocoque and forward/rear aluminum subframes, with nearly every single body part composed of carbon fiber or aluminum. As a result, the new car weighed roughly <100kg> less than the Murciélago, tipping the scales at <1575kg>.

Mounted amidships was a 6.5-liter, DOHC 48 valve V12 that produced <700ps> at <8250rpm> and <70.4kgm> of torque at <5500rpm>. The power was transferred to the ground via an electronically-controlled forward/aft torque-splitting mechanism and a single clutch 7-speed semi-automatic gearbox that shifted 40 percent faster than the e-Gear on the Gallardo.

The pushrod-type double-wishbone suspension system, often used in racing, was the first of its kind in a production car. Thanks to all of its cutting-edge technology, the Aventador reached a top speed of <350km/h>, which was <8km/h> faster than the the Murciélago. It ran the 0-<100km/h> in 2.9 seconds, 0.3 seconds quicker than its predecessor.

In an era where car makers concentrated on efficiency and environmental friendliness, leave it to Lamborghini to throw all that out the window and bring us a car that truly rocked our world.
zh:
Lamborghini全新研发的旗舰车型。

Aventador接棒Murcielago，在2011年日内瓦车展首次亮相。车身几乎完全重新设计，采用碳纤维单体车壳，前后铝材副车架取代了前代车型的钢管空间车架。由于车体主要由碳纤维和铝制成，它相对于同车型来说也非常轻，净重仅为1,575 公斤。

en:
The top-of-the-line version of the Aventador wore the revered SV badge.

The Lamborghini Aventador LP 750-4 Superveloce, introduced in 2015, was the most potent road car from the manufacturer to date (only to be eclipsed by the Aventador S a year later). True to its name of Superveloce, which was first used on the legendary Miura, this car was indeed "super fast."

It came powered by a 6.5-liter naturally-aspirated V-12 that produced <50ps> more power than the standard Aventador with <750ps> on tap, sending the power to all four wheels via a 7-speed semiautomatic transmission. The performance numbers of this mid-engine exotic were staggering, as it recorded a 0-<100km/h> time of 2.8 seconds, reached <200km/h> in just 8.6, and accelerated to <300km/h> in 24.9 seconds. The top speed of the car was estimated at more than <350km/h>. When it was time to slow down, the Aventador's excellent braking system needed only <30m> of tarmac to bring the car to a halt from <100km/h>.

Only 600 coupe models were produced, but a convertible version was introduced later with a limited production run of 500 units.
zh:
Aventador的旗舰车型，装饰有尊贵的SV徽标。

Lamborghini旗舰车型传统上一直搭载的是V12引擎，只有具备最高性能的车型才能冠以“Superveloce” （SV）徽标。这一“超快”之名最早被传奇经典Miura系列所采用。Aventador SV版在2015年推出，最大动力相较基础版提升了50 PS，达到750 PS。

en:
The final model of the Countach, commemorating the 25th anniversary of Lamborghini.

The Lamborghini Countach, with its breathtakingly fresh and futuristic design, was the company’s first supercar and was unleashed onto the world at the 1971 Geneva Motor Show. The original show car, the LP500, remained just that, as the Countach didn’t actually go into production until three years later with the launch of the LP400. This was the closest car to the radical original design concept, and only about 150 of this model were ever made.

Through the years, an LP400 S and LP500 S went into production, and in 1985, a 5000 Quattrovalvole, setting its sights directly onto Ferrari’s refreshingly-styled Testarossa, was released. This Countach featured four valves per cylinder to its boisterous V12 that was increased in displacement to 5.2 liters, its maximum power output now reaching a ceiling of <455 ps>.

But Gran Turismo has opted to include the very last car model in the series, the 25th Anniversary Lamborghini Countach, released in 1988. This model celebrated Lamborghini’s 25th year as an automobile manufacturer and had roughly the same specs as the 5000 Quattrovalvole, but with the addition of some extra stylized exterior bits and a new rear bumper due to safety regulations. This version was also the best-selling Countach over the course of this Italian wild child’s full production run, which ended in 1990 at 657 units.*
zh:
这是Countach的最后绝唱，专为纪念Lamborghini 25周年而制造。

1971年在日内瓦车展上亮相的Lamborghini Countach堪称超级跑车的典范。首个量产型号LP400于1974年推出，限量150台。1985年推出的5000 Quattrovalvole所采用的5,200 立方厘米排量引擎能输出达455 PS的动力。1988年发布的25周年版是Countach的最后一款车型，总计仅生产了657台。

en:
The futuristic styling of this exotic car attracted quite a bit of attention from all around the world.

The Lamborghini Countach, with its breathtakingly fresh and futuristic design, is a historic supercar and was unleashed onto the world at the 1971 Geneva Motor Show. The original show car, the LP500, remained just that, as the Countach didn’t actually go into production until three years later with the launch of the LP400. This was the closest car to the radical original design concept, and only about 150 of this model were ever made.

Through the years, an LP400 S and LP500 S went into production, and in 1985, a 5000 Quattrovalvole, setting its sights directly onto Ferrari’s refreshingly-styled Testarossa, was released. This Countach featured four valves per cylinder to its boisterous V12 that was increased in displacement to 5.2 liters, its maximum power output then reaching a ceiling of <455ps>.
zh:
一辆别具一格的汽车，其未来主义的造型吸引了全世界的目光。

在1971年日内瓦车展首次亮相的Lamborghini Countach是一款真正的史诗级超级跑车，以设计和性能吸引全世界的目光。“Countach”一词源自意大利皮埃蒙特方言，意为“惊喜”，Countach也名副其实，带来了十足的惊喜。马塞罗·甘迪尼那令人惊叹的近未来主义设计对之后多年的超级跑车领域产生了深远影响。

en:
The 80-car limited-edition model that was positioned as "The Ultimate Diablo."8

In 1999, the Lamborghini Diablo was given a minor exterior update that replaced the retractable headlamps with fixed ones. At the Geneva Motor Show of the same year, the ultimate road going limited-edition Diablo GT was unveiled. Based on the Diablo GT2, a racing car developed for the FIA-GT championships, Lamborghini modified this beast for the street.

The 6.0-liter V12, based on the GT2, produces <575ps> and <64.3kgm> of torque. Many body panels were replaced with carbon-fiber ones, resulting in a curb weight of <1490kg>, which is <40kg> lighter than that of the Diablo SV. Therefore, it was super quick and could reach a top speed of <338km/h>.

Keeping engine heat in check was a major issue, so Lamborghini engineers incorporated improved cooling and aerodynamic modifications, such as the special bumper spoiler that contained a larger oil cooler and vents in the hood to better discharge the extra heat. These upgrades and others came from the experience gained in fielding the Diablo GT2 race car; in other words, everything different about the Diablo GT came straight from the racing circuit.

Only 80 cars were produced, and the 80th car is on display at the Lamborghini Museum, at the company's Italian headquarters, in Sant'Agata. It is considered the "Ultimate Diablo," and to some, the ultimate Lamborghini.
zh:
只生产80辆的限量车款，也被称为“终极Diablo”。

Diablo GT的原型为Diablo GT2，后者是专为FIA-GT锦标赛而设计的纯粹赛车。为了适应城市道路驾驶，Diablo GT不得不接受降级调校和改装。其搭载的6升V12引擎可输出575 PS和64.0 公斤力米的扭矩。1,490 公斤的重量比Diablo SV轻40 公斤，让它的最高时速达到了惊人的338 公里/小时。

en:
No longer a "baby Lambo," this car possessed top-tier performance.

The "baby" Lamborghini, officially known as the Gallardo, was introduced in 2003. Since then, the car has evolved over the years, with performance enhancements as well as additional higher-performance models added to the lineup.

The most notable of these appeared at the 2008 Geneva Motor Show as the Gallardo LP 560-4. Upon first glance, the car's aggressive styling seemed to be influenced by the limited-edition (and very expensive) Lamborghini Reventón, making it one of the meanest looking cars to wear the charging bull badge.

As for the car's performance... it was equally mean. The most prominent change under the sheet metal was the engine, a V-10 that grew from <4961cc> to <5204cc>. Breathing improvements were also performed and, when combined with its higher compression ratio, the engine produced a whopping <560ps> and <55.1kgm> of torque, an improvement of <40ps> and <3.1kgm> from the original Gallardo's powerplant. Power was routed to all four wheels (the "560" in the car's name is a reference to engine output, while the "4" stood for 4WD).

A choice of two transmissions came mated to the engine, both inherited from the previous model, a 6-speed manual or the semi-automatic 6-speed gearbox called E-gear, the latter featuring shifts that were 40 percent faster than the human hand when set to "CORSA" mode.

Weight of the LP 560-4 was trimmed by <20kg> from the previous model to <1410kg>, which helped the car reach a top speed of <325km/h> and blast from zero to <100km/h> in 3.7 seconds.-
zh:
不再是Lambo的小号，Gallardo以顶级的性能甩掉了这个绰号。

Lamborghini Gallardo LP 560-4于2007年发布，相比前代车型功率提升了40 PS。虽然延续了四驱动力系统，但换上了6速E-gear变速箱，换挡速度提升了40%。减重同样受到重视，车身重量降至1,410 公斤，使得最高时速提升至325 公里/小时。这款车以流线型设计实现了卓越的性能表现。

en:
Dallara took the best elements of the Huracán and created a radical competition GT3 machine.

The Lamborghini Huracán GT3 is the race version of the Huracán that was released as a successor to the Gallardo in 2014. It was developed according to FIA-GT3 specifications as the name implies, and was revealed for the first time in January 2015.

The development of the Gallardo was handled by Reiter Engineering, but the Huracán GT3 is developed by Squadra Corse, the internal competition department of Lamborghini. Italian race constructor Dallara engineering worked on the materials and aerodynamics of the body.

The hybrid chassis made from aluminum and carbon is the same as in the road car, but the body itself is much wider. Its aerodynamic effects are improved using a low front spoiler and splitter, an adjustable rear wing, and a large rear diffuser. These are in addition to the vents and louvers added on various parts to discharge and improve air flow. These additions have a side effect of giving the car a much more aggressive appearance than the road car.

The engine is also the same 5.2L V10 as in the road car, but the ECU is changed to a Bosch unit to make it more suited for actual operation in competition. The gearbox is changed from a 7 speed DCT to a 6 speed sequential, and to match the regulations, the drive train is modified from an all wheel drive to be a rear wheel drive. There are also 10 level settings for the traction control system and ABS.

The Huracán achieved a debut victory at the opening round of the 2015 Blancpain Endurance Series, but in addition to that win, it also achieved pole position in 3 rounds out of 5, and continued to show stable and fast performance throughout the series.'
zh:
Dallara攫取了Huracán的顶级元素，并提升了这款GT3车型的竞争潜力。

这款Huracán GT3在2015年1月首次公布。顾名思义，它是Huracán的赛车版本，专为FIA GT3规格进行了改装。尽管它的车身与公路车版本一样，采用了铝合金和碳纤维混合材料，但车身得到了进一步加宽。加装的多个部件既能提升空气动力学性能，又让它相较于公路车版本外观更具霸气。

en:
With aesthetics inspired by the Gallardo, this AWD supercar's powerful and lightweight nature makes it ideal for the race track.

Introduced at the 2014 Geneva Motor Show, the Huracán had big shoes to fill as it was labeled the successor to Lamborghini’s most successful model ever, the Gallardo.

Unlike Lamborghini models that came before it, the Gallardo, which enjoyed a successful 10-year run, possessed a compact body that made it more agile than past Lambos. Although slightly larger, the Huracán sported similar proportions, retaining the “agile” spirit that made the Gallardo so popular. That said, its styling theme inside and out was nothing like that of its predecessor. The Huracán’s exterior was simpler and neater, with more curves than the Gallardo, signaling a new design phase for the coach builder from Sant’Agata.

The structure of the car also evolved, from the Gallardo’s aluminum space frame to one composed of aluminum and carbon fiber. This resulted in a 10 percent lighter body with a 50 percent increase in rigidity. The engine, a fire-breathing 5.2-liter V-10 that produced <610ps> and <57.1kgm> of torque, came mounted amidships, and came mated to Lamborghini’s first 7-speed dual clutch gearbox.

Also, a new integrated drive control system called ANIMA was added to instantly switch the engine, transmission, the new Halidex 5 AWD system and handling characteristics from urban driving to hot laps on a race track. When unleashed, the Huracán could run from 0-<100km/h> in 3.2 seconds and hit a top speed of <325km/h>. With performance like that, no one dared to call this compact exotic car a “baby Lambo.”

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
zh:
这辆四驱超级跑车继承了Gallardo的美学设计，并且更加轻巧，马力也更强。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型Huracán将Lamborghini的入门级中置四轮驱动车型升级成了符合Gr.4规格的赛车。其四轮驱动布局能够提供极高的稳定性，而中置引擎布局带来的车身配重比也实现了非常灵敏的过弯能力，最终呈现出一辆平衡性优秀、操控感非凡的赛道机器。

zh:
这辆四驱超级跑车继承了Gallardo的美学设计，并且更加轻巧，马力也更强。

作为Gallardo的后续车型，Huracán在2014年首次公布。其车身材料从铝合金空间车架改为了铝合金与碳纤维混合材料，成功实现了50%的刚性提升和10%的减重。其中置布局引擎采用了一部5.2升V10发动机，能够输出610 PS的动力和57.0 公斤力米的扭矩。这股澎湃动力通过7档双离合变速箱以及Haldex 5全轮驱动系统，高效地施加在路面上。

en:
This car put Lamborghini on the supercar map and defined the genre.

Automobili Lamborghini was founded in 1963. Following the development of the 350 GT and 400 GT, Lamborghini unveiled the TP400 in bare chassis form at the 1965 Turin Motor Show. At the Geneva Motor Show the following year, they revealed the Miura P400, now adorned with a stunning body styled by Marcello Gandini, then Chief Designer at Bertone.

The Miura adopted a mid-engine layout, housing a <3929cc> V-12 behind the rear bulkhead. It was a landmark model for Lamborghini—their first true supercar—delivering <350ps> and <37.5kgm> of torque. With its revolutionary layout and design, it propelled the Lamborghini name into the international spotlight.

The development of the Miura brought together several remarkable individuals. Its chassis was the work of Gian Paolo Dallara, who would go on to found Dallara Automobili, now a powerhouse in the world of racing car design. Paolo Stanzani, the brilliant engineer who would later lead the creation of the Countach, also played a key role in the project.

It is believed that three prototypes of the Miura P400 were built between its Geneva Motor Show debut and the start of full production. The earliest prototype reportedly lacked the distinctive louvre over the rear cowling. These initial cars were later updated to production specifications and sold as standard Miura P400 models.

The Miura line would eventually evolve into the more powerful S and SV versions, with production continuing through to 1973. A handful of rare SVJ models also exist, crafted in homage to the legendary Jota.
zh:
Lamborghini公司的第一款超跑，为公司打响了名声。

作为Lamborghini在1966年推出的首款超级跑车，Miura P400是一个革命性的开发项目，并且帮助Lamborghini在全世界范围内立刻名声大振。为了打造它，许多天才工程师齐聚一堂，包括Bertone的首席设计师马塞罗·甘迪尼，设计底盘的吉安·保罗·达拉拉，以及之后开发出经典车型Countach的保罗·斯坦扎尼。

en:
With <640ps>, the flagship supercar from Lamborghini reached a top speed of <340km/h>.

The Lamborghini Murciélago made its debut at the 2001 Frankfurt Motor Show as the flagship for the renowned Italian maker. It had big shoes to fill for it was succeeding the legendary V12 supercars, the Countach and Diablo as the company's top model. The Murciélago, along with the V10-powered Gallardo introduced at the 2003 Geneva Motor Show, represented a new era for Lamborghini, which blossomed under Audi AG's umbrella.

Five years later, at the 2006 Geneva Motor Show, Audi took the veils off a new, even meaner version of the Murciélago, the LP640. The “LP” in its name stands for Longitudinale Posteriore (longitudinally rear mounted), while the numerical designation refers to its <640ps> (640ps). Actually, the “LP” designation is a traditional one for Lamborghini, dating back to the days of the Countach. As mentioned earlier, the power of the car was <640ps>, up from the stock Murciélago's <580ps>. It came from a 6496 cc DOHC V12 that transferred the power to all four wheels. The car's performance was nothing short of extraordinary, going from zero to <100km/h> in 3.4 seconds and reaching a top speed of <340km/h>.

The styling of the Murciélago and Gallardo were penned by Luc Donckerwolke, and for the LP640, that original design was fine-tuned, resulting in an edgier supercar-like shape. The most notable differences between the stock Murciélago and the LP640 were the front and rear diffusers and the integration of the exhaust tips within the bumper. The scissor-type doors opened upward, providing a family lineage to the Countach and Diablo. The LP640 lineup included an open-air roadster and a lightweight, high-performance limited-edition model called the LP670-4 SuperVeloce.
zh:
旗舰超跑，马力输出达到了640 PS，最高时速高达340 公里/小时。

2006年推出的Lamborghini旗舰车型Murciélago的高性能版本。最初排量为6.2升，后来横置V12引擎扩大至6.5升，输出动力达到640 PS。外观经过全面的空气动力学改进，变速箱和电子系统也进行了相应升级。

en:
Lamborghini's take on a high-performance exotic SUV.

Introduced in 2018 in response to the global SUV boom, the Urus was a “Super SUV” from renowned exotic-car manufacturer Lamborghini.

Styled with sharp lines and an edgy design similar to that of the company's mid-engine models, the Urus' body construction was inherited from other full-size SUVs from the Volkswagen Group.

The Urus' front-mounted powerplant took the form of a twin-turbocharged 4.0-liter V-8, the first ever forced-induction engine ever in a Lamborghini. It produced an impressive <650ps> and <86.68kgm> of torque.

The default setting for the vehicle's AWD system was 40/60 front/rear, but it could be adjusted from 70/30 to 13/87 depending on the road surface.

Other Urus highlights were an adaptive air suspension system, rear-wheel steering, and torque vectoring, all of which combined to deliver the type of handling and cornering performance befitting a Lamborghini. Optional driving modes made the vehicle at home on off-road trails and even through the desert.

But what was most impressive about the Urus was its acceleration. It ran from 0-<100 km/h> in 3.6 seconds, to <200 km/h> in 12.8 and reached a top speed of <305 km/h>, making it truly the world’s fastest SUV upon its debut.
zh:
Lamborghini对全球SUV浪潮的回应。

2018年推出的Urus是Lamborghini的超级SUV。这是Lamborghini历史上首次采用强制进气技术，搭载4升V8双涡轮增压引擎，0-100 公里/小时加速只要3.6秒，最高时速305 公里/小时，在初次亮相时便创下纪录。凭借主动空气悬挂、后轮转向和扭矩矢量系统，该车还具备卓越的操控和过弯性能。

en:
Lamborghini celebrated its 50th anniversary with this extremely limited-production super car.

When Lamborghini introduces a limited-production car to celebrate its 50th anniversary, you know that it’s bound to be special, and very exclusive. Well, the company from Sant’Agata, Italy didn’t disappoint when it unveiled the multi-million-dollar Veneno, a super car whose clientele was restricted to a mere three people.

The Veneno was based on Lamborghini’s flagship, the Aventador, which featured an exterior design that looked like it came from another planet. However, there’s a reason for its bizarre looks, as precision aerodynamics had been implemented into the body to ensure optimal performance. The “V” shaped nose suggested that Formula 1 technology had made its way into the car design. Combined with a high-mounted variable rear-wing, a gigantic rear diffuser, and a shark fin that extended from the roof to the rear, the Veneno possessed gobs of downforce that kept it glued to the pavement through high-speed corners.

Also keeping the Veneno stable was a full-time 4-wheel-drive system and an F1-type pushrod suspension system that made it one of the cars with the best handling of all time. Providing the punch was a 6.5-liter V-12 that came mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. With <750ps> on tap and a lightweight carbon-fiber structure that made it <125kg> lighter than the Aventador at <1450kg>, the Veneno sprinted to <100km/h> in 2.8 seconds and reached a top speed of <355km/h>.
zh:
仅生产了3辆。Lamborghini 50周年纪念款。

Veneno是Lamborghini为了庆祝公司成立50周年而推出的一款特别限量版车型。这款车总共仅售出3辆。它基于Aventador开发，且采用同款底盘和动力系统，而引擎的动力输出被提升到了750 PS，此外还进行了车身减重，如采用碳纤维单体车壳等各种改进。这些改动将Veneno的车重削减到了1,450 公斤，比Aventador轻了125 公斤。

en:
This last and most potent Delta set the WRC record for consecutive wins.

The original Lancia Delta was a family-oriented hatchback designed by Giorgetto Giugiaro. However, when Group B was phased out of the WRC, Lancia selected the Delta as the foundation for its new Group A contender. From that moment, the car’s destiny as a rally legend was sealed.

In 1987, Lancia equipped the Delta a high-performance turbocharged engine and a 4WD system, before setting it loose in the WRC.
From that moment on, Lancia secured an unprecedented six consecutive WRC championships. However, maintaining its edge meant that it had to undergo a series of evolutions. Such is the life of a competition rally car.

By 1991, Lancia faced mounting pressure from its rival, Toyota. In response, it unveiled the ultimate iteration of the Delta at the Frankfurt Motor Show—the HF Integrale Evoluzione.

The Evoluzione sported a larger front grille and expanded hood vents, enhancing enhanced airflow for improved engine cooling and ventilation. This allowed the power of the engine to be increased from <200ps> to <210ps>.

To help the car's stability, the front and rear track were widened by <60mm>.
This necessitated even wider blistered wheel arches, pushing the car’s overall width to <1770mm>.
And, by shifting the 4WD torque distribution toward the rear, Lancia engineered the car to deliver a driving character closer to that of a rear-wheel-drive machine. The car also featured a spoiler mounted to the edge of the roof to further improve downforce.

The Evoluzione made its WRC debut in 1992, playing a crucial role in extending Lancia's streak of dominance. Unfortunately, Lancia's parent company, FIAT, decided to withdraw the car from the WRC, bringing the Evoluzione’s competitive run to an abrupt end that same year.
zh:
以连续胜利创下新WRC纪录的终极Delta。

在1991年Toyota带来激烈的竞争压力之前，Lancia凭借性能出色的Lancia Delta在世界拉力锦标赛斩获连胜。这催生了Delta终极型号——HF Integrale Evoluzione。除了提升引擎的输出外，前后动力分配也得到了全面优化，操控性更是显著提升。Evoluzione在1992年世界拉力锦标赛首次亮相，为Lancia的连胜立下汗马功劳。

carNameEn: Lancia Delta HF Integrale Rally Car '92
sourceName: DELTA HF Integrale WRC Group A (1992)
en:
The Lancia Delta, a six-time consecutive WRC Champion.

Following the end of the Group B era in the WRC, Lancia turned to the Delta as its weapon of choice for Group A competition. Transformed with a turbocharged engine and a newly developed 4-wheel-drive system, the high-performance Delta was rebranded as the HF 4WD and made its debut in the 1987 WRC.

Just a year later, it evolved into the legendary Delta Integrale, equipped with aggressive blistered wheel arches. In 1990, the Integrale received a significant upgrade with the addition of a 16-valve cylinder head, boosting its performance even further. However, it soon faced fierce competition. Despite Lancia’s continued efforts, the Drivers’ Championship slipped from the Delta’s grasp in both 1990 and 1991, claimed by Toyota's Celica. Thus, in 1992, Lancia unveiled what would be considered the final evolution of the Delta.

This new Integrale featured reinforced bodywork for enhanced rigidity and underwent extensive suspension revisions, including a widened track. In line with these upgrades, the blistered wheel arches grew even more pronounced. To enhance aerodynamic performance, a roof-mounted spoiler was added to generate more downforce, while the torque distribution of the 4-wheel-drive system was recalibrated to give the car a more rear-wheel-drive–like character.

Thanks to these comprehensive improvements, the Delta regained its competitive edge. Although Lancia’s factory team ceased official racing activities in 1992 due to a policy shift by parent company FIAT, Lancia partnered with the Jolly Club satellite team, providing full technical support. Juha Kankkunen and Didier Auriol competed in 11 of 14 rounds that season, with Auriol taking six victories, Kankkunen adding one more, and Andrea Aghini yet another. With eight wins total, Lancia clinched the constructors' championship for te sixth consecutive year.
zh:
Lancia Delta的巅峰之作，连续六届WRC冠军得主

Lancia将Delta改为四轮驱动并配备涡轮增压器，打造出HF 4WD高性能车型，征战1987年WRC A组赛事。Delta HF 4WD后来再次进化为Integrale，增加了凸起轮拱罩，引擎动力也更强悍。车身和悬挂系统每年都会进行重大升级。凭借这些努力，这款车在92赛季赢得8场比赛，为品牌夺得连续第6个世界拉力锦标赛冠军。

en:
This mid-engine sports car made quite the impression on the rally world with its sharp wedge-shaped body.

At the 1970 Turin Motor Show, Bertone unveiled a striking concept car called the Stratos Zero. With its radical wedge-shaped profile and a front windshield that doubled as the door, the vehicle was conceived purely as a design study. But even then, Bertone described it as a mid-engine concept. Following the show, development began in collaboration with Lancia, which was in search of a new rally car to succeed the Fulvia.

Marcello Gandini was tasked with refining the concept into a production-ready model. Drawing inspiration from the shape of the Stratos Zero, he created an angular body that echoed its otherworldly name: Stratosphere. Thus, the legendary Lancia Stratos was born.

The Stratos featured a robust welded steel monocoque chassis clad in lightweight fiberglass panels. Mounted behind the seats was the same 2.4-liter DOHC V-6 engine found in the Ferrari Dino 246 GT.

Its performance potential was evident in its dimensions: an exceptionally short wheelbase of just <2180 mm> and a wide rear tread of <1457 mm>. This configuration delivered razor-sharp handling and extremely sensitive response. For those who could master its traits, the Stratos offered extraordinary performance that translated into rally dominance, ushering in a golden era for Lancia on the world stage.
zh:
这辆中置引擎跑车以其轮廓鲜明的楔形车身在拉力赛中崭露锋芒。

Bertone于1970年发布了“Stratos Zero”概念车。这款楔形概念车后来以“Stratos”之名正式量产。车身采用刚性单体框架和玻璃纤维外板，搭载2.4升V6双顶置凸轮轴引擎。凭借短轴距带来的卓越过弯能力，它在拉力赛中表现极为出色。

en:
This stylish sports coupe attracted plenty of attention with its low nose and short overhang design.~

Introduced at the 2016 Geneva Auto Show, the LC500 luxury sports coupe represented the first F-segment model for Lexus.

The styling is nearly unchanged from the LF-FC concept vehicle revealed in 2012, which was penned at Lexus’ design studio in California. Its flowing lines and low hood give the LC500 a wind-cutting shape, and it features short front and rear overhangs that allow the engine to be placed aft of the front wheels, giving it a front mid-engine layout.

The LC500 was built on the newly developed GA-L platform. The body is composed of a combination of materials that include carbon fiber, aluminum and steel, which gives the sports coupe a highly-rigid yet lightweight character.

Under the hood is the same 5.0-liter naturally-aspirated V-8 found in the RC F and GS F that produces <477ps> and <55.1kgm> of torque. The engine comes mated to the first direct-shift 10-speed automatic transmission to be equipped on a passenger car.

The LC500 race car dominated its debut appearance in the GT500 class of the Super GT series in 2017, taking 1st to 6th place.
zh:
这款时尚的双门跑车以其较低的车鼻和紧凑的前后悬间距吸睛无数。

LC500是一款豪华跑车，最初在2016年日内瓦车展上亮相。虽然其前悬和后悬进行了缩短，以实现2+2座位的前中置布局，但其依然保留了流畅的轿跑车身设计。另外，它的车身还运用了多种先进材料，在降低车重的同时还提升了刚性。

en:
This ultra high-tech sports car achieved ultimate performance with mass-production quality.

Twenty years before Japan’s automotive industry was truly recognized by the world, Toyota created a sports car called the 2000GT, which combined the latest technology of the 1960s with a truly revolutionary body design. In the 21st century, Lexus created another cutting-edge sports car that would continue that legacy. It was called the LFA.

Creating such a car was not easy. The goal was to provide stable and consistent quality while incorporating emerging technologies, which included a lightweight carbon-fiber body. For the engineers, it was not enough to simply make another sports car for the masses; they staked the company's reputation to create a car that balanced cutting-edge technology with consistent product quality.

One of the most important factors of a sports car remains the front-to-rear weight distribution ratio; the LFA's was 48 to 52. To achieve this figure, they implemented a transaxle layout and mounted the radiator at the rear. Also, curb weight was kept at <1480kg>. Emphasis was also put on lowering the car's center of gravity, utilizing a dry-sump lubrication system so that the powertrain could be mounted lower.

The LFA's 4.8-liter V-10 had bank angles of 72 degrees with a factory redline of <9500rpm>. Its <560ps> output equated to <117ps> per liter, but what's most impressive was that despite this incredibly high-performance level, the LFA was still relatively environmentally friendly. The transmission came in the form of a 6-speed single-clutch 2-pedal manual that could perform shifts in just 0.2 seconds, a figure on par with the world's top race cars.

Carbon ceramic brake discs were standard fare, with 6-pot calipers in front and 4-pot calipers at rear, all with varying piston sizes.

The LFA ran from zero to <100km/h> in just 3.7 seconds and reached a top speed of <325km/>. But what really sweetened the car's collectivity factor was that it wa produced in a limited run of only 500 cars worldwide.
zh:
一辆以量产品质实现了终极性能的极致高科技水平跑车。

这款顶级跑车承载着传承Toyota 2000GT辉煌成就与卓越性能的使命而诞生。采用自动化工艺制造的碳纤维车身，变速驱动桥和散热器后置布局，实现了48:52的理想前后配重比例。搭载4.8升V10引擎，采用72度气缸夹角设计。引擎优美的轰鸣声经由乐器制造商Yamaha精心调校打造。全球限量生产500台。

en:
Even beginners can experience dynamic driving performance with a range of electronic aids.

While German luxury carmakers have traditionally defined the luxury sports coupe market, Lexus decided to join the fray with a svelte version all its own called the RC F. Introduced at the 2014 North American International Auto Show, the RC F is the sportiest entry of the RC line—the letter “F,” which references Fuji Speedway, is added to all of the brand’s high-performance models.

Under the hood is a 5.0-liter V-8, the same powerplant found in the IS F, with new titanium valves, forged connecting rods, newly designed cylinder heads and custom exhaust system. They combine to help the engine produce <456ps>/<53.0kgm>, which is <33ps> and <1.5kgm> more than the IS F. It comes mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission that performs lightning-quick shifts via paddles near the steering wheel.

The Sports Mode of the VDIM, which centrally controls vehicle dynamics, has been refined for the racetrack, and most of the electronic devices have been updated. The RC F features the first torque-vectoring system in the world to be incorporated into a front-engine/rear-wheel drive car. This system allows drivers of all levels to enjoy the RC F’s excellent handling balance and overall performance.

With the exception of the limited-edition LFA supercar, the RC F is the sportiest model to ever come from Lexus.\
zh:
即便是新手也可以在多种电子辅助设备的帮助下体验到动态的驾驶表现。

RC F是Lexus在2014年底特律车展上公布的一款高性能双门轿跑。其引擎采用了IS F的5升V8的改良版，能够输出456 PS和53.0 公斤力米，比原版引擎高出了33 PS和1.5 公斤力米。这套动力系统还搭配了一部带换挡拨片的8速自动变速箱。除了LFA之外，这辆车是Lexus产品历史中最强调运动性能的车型。

en:
Emil Frey Racing was one of the first teams to compete with a GT3 version of the Lexus RC F.

While Lexus ran an RC F-based race car for the VLN and Super GT Series in 2015, it was allowed to compete with this particular car without

having to adhere to homologation requirements. The RC F GT3 Prototype made its debut in Round 9 of the VLN series and won the SPX class, which allowed specially permitted entries.

This prototype race car was developed with the intent of eventually providing a GT3 machine to race teams around the world. Starting out as an RC F, the entire car was altered dramatically to ensure competitiveness and reliability in GT3 races. Weight was significantly reduced and the body drastically stiffened; the front and rear fenders were swapped to improve aerodynamics; and power from the 5.0-liter V-8 engine was increased to <540ps>. Ultimately, the car was homologated and introduced as the Lexus RC F GT3 in 2017.

The following year, the new race car was delivered to Emil Frey Racing in Switzerland, which took part in the development of the RC F GT3. Participating in the GT Open Championship of Europe, the team won four of 14 races and placed 3rd for the season.
zh:
Emil Frey Racing车队使用的GT3车型。Emil Frey Racing是最早使用Lexus RC F的车队之一。

从2015年起，Lexus开始派出一款基于RC F打造的赛车参加比赛，进行测试。他们利用这些测试中积累来的经验，对这部车进行持续性开发，并最终在2017年首次公布了这辆RC F GT3。作为参与了RC F GT3开发工作的车队，Emil Frey Racing带着这款车参加了国际GT公开赛。他们最终在车队排名上取得了第三的好成绩。

en:
This highly refined Lexus RC F coupe competed in the 2016 VLN as a GT3 race car.+

When Lexus introduced the RC luxury sports coupe in 2014, it also included a high-performance version in the lineup called the RC F, which served as the foundation for the RC F GT3 race car.

Created to compete in GT3 races around the world, the RC F GT3 was developed at the same time as the production RC F. The original V-8 engine was converted to have a dry sump lubrication system, and displacement was increased to 5.4 liters. Mated to a 6-speed sequential gearbox, the race engine produced <500ps>. Although it looks larger than the production car because of its wider fenders, the RC F GT3 tipped the scales at a lean <1300kg>.

Starting in the 2017 season, the RC F GT3 waged battle in the American IMSA series (GTD category), the European International GT Open series, and the Japanese Super GT series (GT300 class), where it performed admirably.

In the International GT race at Silverstone, the RC F GT3 grabbed its first victory. Then in Japan, it won for the first time in the Super GT series, taking the checkered flag in the second-round race at the Fuji Speedway.

The RC F GT3 prototype represented here is a car that was built for performance evaluation before the RC F GT3 acquired homologation. This car won the ninth race of the VLN (Nürburgring Endurance Series) on October 8, 2016, running without a paint job and its carbon-fiber body fully exposed. The car here, though, wears the livery of Emil Frey Racing, a top Swiss team that competes in the International GT Open.
zh:
参与过2016 VLN赛事的Lexus RC F GT3。

RC F GT3是Lexus基于RC F开发的一款GT3规格赛车。这辆车就是在认证版本正式定型之前，为了测试性能而开发的原型车。它在纽博格林耐力赛的第九轮中取得了漂亮的胜利。当时它以无涂装的碳纤维裸色车身参赛，不过我们在这里看到的这个版本采用了Emil Frey Racing车队的涂装。

en:
This Toyota/Lexus race car competed under joint regulations between the Super GT Series and DTM.

Toyota's weapon of choice for the GT500 class of the Super GT Series from 2014 to 2016 was the race version of the Lexus RC F production car, which was released in October 2014.

Because of new regulations from 2014, the car underwent a several changes to conform to the new rules. The weight and rigidity of the monocoque and center of gravity were altered, while new dampers, brakes and a rear wing were added, making it look like a true DTM machine. Powering the car was a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 with direct injection (called the RI4AG), which also saw use in Super Formula cars. Because of of a new regulation that limited fuel flow from <100kg/h> to <95kg/h>, improvements were made elsewhere so the car could produce more power with less fuel.

The 2016 model was the final version of this RC F race car, with the au TOM’S RC F wearing the ace car number 36. It placed 3rd in the third race of the season and 2nd in Round 6, ultimately finishing 5th overall out of 15 cars.
zh:
这款Toyota/Lexus Super GT赛车同样参加了德国房车大师赛。

Lexus RC F参加了2014年至2016年期间的Super GT GT500组别赛事。2014年引入的新规意味着单体车壳和主要部件的重量要与德国房车大师赛车辆等同。而使用的引擎也是Super Formula赛车同款，为2升直列4缸涡轮增压引擎。au TOM'S RC F在2016年整个赛季中有大笔积分入账，包括在第6轮中取得了第2名，赛季总成绩位列第5位。

en:
This version of the highly refined Lexus RC F production coupe was modified for Gr.4.

While German luxury carmakers have traditionally defined the luxury sports coupe market, Lexus decided to join the fray with a svelte version all its own called the RC F. Introduced at the 2014 North American International Auto Show, the RC F is the sportiest entry of the RC line—the letter “F,” which references Fuji Speedway, is added to all of the brand’s high-performance models.

Under the hood is a 5.0-liter V-8, the same powerplant found in the IS F, with new titanium valves, forged connecting rods, newly designed cylinder heads and custom exhaust system. They combine to help the engine produce <456ps>/<53.0kgm>, which is <33ps> and <1.5kgm> more than the IS F. It comes mated to an 8-speed automatic transmission that performs lightning-quick shifts via paddles near the steering wheel.

The Sports Mode of the VDIM, which centrally controls vehicle dynamics, has been refined for the racetrack, and most of the electronic devices have been updated. The RC F features the first torque-vectoring system in the world to be incorporated into a front-engine/rear-wheel drive car. This system allows drivers of all levels to enjoy the RC F’s excellent handling balance and overall performance.

While the RC F’s appearance is similar to that of the base model, Lexus designers incorporated subtle-yet-functional details that help improve performance. These include air outlets on the engine hood and at the rear end of the front fenders. On the trunk is a variable rear spoiler that changes angles automatically according to speed.

With the exception of the limited-edition LFA supercar, the RC F is the sportiest model to ever come from Lexus.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
zh:
一款广受好评的Lexus RC F，专为Gr.4而改装。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是Lexus RC F高性能双门轿跑的Gr.4赛事改装版本。它的大排量V8引擎拥有强大的扭矩，极其擅长进行直线加速。其基础配色是Lexus在他们的特殊车型上常用的同款橙色。

en:
Won the Super GT team title with its stable performance on high-speed circuits.

In 2008, the Nissan GT-R made its heralded return to the Super GT Series in Japan. As the GT-R made the headlines, Lexus was quietly making significant improvements to its entry in Japan's most popular racing series, the SC430.

The SC430 did not fare well in the Super GT series the previous year, as it was aerodynamically inferior to the competition, the result of a compact body with front and rear overhangs that were too short to provide acceptable levels of downforce. However for 2008, Lexus lengthened the overhangs, giving the car much improved aerodynamics than the previous year. The result was a sleek, fast race car that flourished on high-speed race tracks.

Despite winning only one race during the entire season (at the Fuji International Speedway) by the ZENT CERUMO team, the Lexus SC430 GT machine took home the overall championship, thanks to the consistency of the Petronas TOM's team. The combination of a good long-term strategy and a reliable, fast car proved to be the right formula in winning the series title that year.!
zh:
在高速赛道上的稳定发挥帮助车队赢下了Super GT组别的桂冠。

这是一辆曾参加过2008赛季的Super GT赛车。根据前一年度积累的经验，工程师们将它的车头和车尾加长，以有效优化空气动力学性能，而它的紧凑型车身也能在高速赛道上发挥出色。尽管它并没能拿下任何一场比赛的胜利，但确保了整个赛季持续有积分入账，最终赢下了车队冠军头衔。

en:
Mazda's dream rotary race car.

The MAZDA RX-VISION is a concept car introduced at the 2015 Tokyo Motor Show. Based on Mazda’s "KODO - Soul of Motion" design theme, the car represented Mazda's attempt to create the most beautiful FR sports car in the company's history. It came powered by the next-generation rotary engine called "SKYACTIV-R."

Back in 1967, Mazda overcame numerous obstacles to produce the first commercial rotary engine in history. It powered the Cosmo Sport and then was fitted to a number of other Mazda cars, including the RX-7, and even those that raced. In 1991, the four-rotor Mazda 787B became the first Japanese car to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The MAZDA RX-VISION GT3 CONCEPT expresses the design beauty of form following function in a race machine. To meet the performance requirements of the Gr.3 category, the design was inspired by the 787B, specifically the 4-rotor powerplant, now equipped with SKYACTIV technology. This new rotary engine was mounted in a lightweight body to achieve unprecedented performance.
zh:
Mazda的梦幻转子引擎赛车。

MAZDA RX-VISION在2015东京车展上以概念车的身份亮相。原车设计的美感在赛车化改造中得到了更加激进的重新诠释。为满足Gr.3组别的动力需求，轻量化车身搭载了4转子引擎，其设计灵感源自经典787B引擎，采用最新SKYACTIV技术重新打造，带来前所未有的性能表现。

MAZDA RX-VISION在2015东京车展上以概念车的身份亮相。原车设计的美感在赛车化改造中得到了更加激进的重新诠释。为满足Gr.3组别的动力需求，轻量化车身搭载了4转子引擎，其设计灵感源自经典787B引擎，采用最新SKYACTIV技术重新打造，带来前所未有的性能表现。

en:
With only 200 units ever produced, this is the ultimate works-tuned roadster.!

“MAZDA SPIRIT RACING” was an initiative launched by Mazda to cement the company’s place in motorsports and to cultivate new talent through racing. Competing in events such as the Super Endurance Series with a large crew made up of Mazda employees, it grew into a formidable presence in the sport.

From this foundation, the team created a car that embodied the skills and knowledge it had gained through years of competition. That car was unveiled as the “MAZDA SPIRIT RACING ROADSTER 12R” in early 2025 at the Tokyo Auto Salon.

As its name suggested, it was based on the ND Mazda Roadster. But beneath the familiar silhouette, it was packed with works-grade components.

The centerpiece was its engine, built on a 2.0-liter block not normally offered in the domestic soft-top model, enhanced with a specially tuned head, pistons, and exhaust manifold among other components, each unit painstakingly assembled by hand. The power had been pushed close to the very limit of what was achievable in a production car that also demanded durability, ultimately delivering <200ps>.

Its chassis reflected the lessons learned from the Super Endurance Series. Among them was the suspension that used height-adjustable Bilstein dampers, while the brakes were equipped with 4-piston calipers from Brembo. It featured forged Rays wheels, identical to those used on race cars.

Other special parts included Recaro seats and a Fujitsubo exhaust system. With production capped at just 200 units, the ROADSTER 12R stood as perhaps the ultimate works-tuned roadster._
zh:
这是一台经过官方调校的终极敞篷跑车，全球限量仅200台。

这台车由MAZDA SPIRIT RACING打造——该项目于2021年启动，旨在展示Mazda的赛车运动实力。虽然基于ND Roadster打造而成，却搭载了日本软顶车型上不常见的2.0升引擎，配备专门设计的凸轮轴、气缸盖、活塞和排气歧管。最终实现200 PS的惊人动力，这一数据已逼近量产车型工程设计的极限。底盘整体调校充分借鉴了公司在超级耐力锦标赛中的丰富经验。

en:
Exploring the potential of internal combustion, a next-generation bio-diesel-powered race car.

This MAZDA3 Gr. 4, featured here, is a Gran Turismo original model, aesthetically based on the Super Taikyu spec. MAZDA3 Bio concept.

The MAZDA3 Bio concept car is a next-generation, bio-diesel-powered race car, created for real-world testing in the 2023 Super Taikyu endurance race series.

It is the spiritual successor to Mazda’s Bio concept Demio, also known as the MAZDA2 Bio concept, which was created in 2021 with the dual pursuit of achieving carbon neutrality and preserving the joy of driving. Both vehicles participated in the ST-Q class, a category almost exclusively reserved for manufacturer development prototypes.

The car ran on 100-percent next-generation bio-diesel fuel refined from used cooking oil. Under the hood was a 2.2-liter SkyActiv-D diesel engine.

The car itself went through extensive modifications. To reduce weight, components such as the engine hood and roof were crafted from hybrid materials that combine carbon fiber reinforced plastic (CFRP) with natural fibers. Aerodynamic efficiency was enhanced through wider front and rear fenders, while new aero components, including a front spoiler, rear wing, and side skirts, were added to further optimize performance.
zh:
下一代生物燃料赛车，继续发掘内燃机的潜力。

这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型的设计灵感源自曾征战日本超级耐力锦标赛ST-Q组别的“MAZDA3 Bio concept”概念车。该车采用从废弃食用油中提取的新一代100%生物柴油作为燃料。车身同样采用了环保型复合材料。这一雄心勃勃的项目致力于在赛车运动中实现碳中和与顶级竞技性能的完美融合。

en:
An elegant fastback with a revolutionary combustion system.

This MAZDA3 represents the fourth-generation model of Mazda's C-segment passenger car first released in November 2018. Back then, it was called the Axela in Japan, but with this model, it went by the moniker "MAZDA3" all around the world.

Like its predecessor, this MAZDA3 came in both fastback and sedan versions, but thanks to the company's "KODO" design language, the character of the car became more refined. The shape of the fastback was especially impressive, with the delicate form of the body panels beautifully expressing the subtle transition of light.

Powering the car was a new SKYACTIV engine. The base MAZDA3 models came with a 1.5-liter and 2.0-liter direct injection gasoline engines. There was a 1.8-liter turbo diesel powerplant and a 2.0-liter "Mild-Hybrid" (M-Hybrid) version that came a little later. The M-Hybrid was powered by the SKYACTIV-X engine that introduced proprietary spark-controlled compression ignition, a revolutionary technology that suppressed carbon emissions without relying on expensive solutions like the Urea-SCR.

The X Burgundy Selection was a special model with a burgundy interior on the Grade X model. Equipped with wine-colored leather seats and dashboard, this special model exuded a classy, uniquely mature aura.
zh:
采用了革命性的新引擎、外观优雅的斜背车。

第四代MAZDA3于2018年正式发布。随后推出的轻混动力“M Hybrid”车型搭载采用火花控制压燃技术的“SKYACTIV-X”引擎，引起全球瞩目。这款“X Burgundy Selection”限量版基于搭载SKYACTIV-X引擎的X级别车型打造，酒红色内饰营造出成熟典雅的氛围。

en:
A race spec Clubman able to reach 0-<100km/h> in just 3.5 seconds, with a top speed of <290km/h>.

The MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo, created from the inspiration of the MINI's success in motorsports, was designed strictly for the track. It's powered by a <395ps> engine that sends this <1050kg> vehicle from zero to <100km/h> in a mere 3.5 seconds. Top speed is rated at <290km/h>, with the right gear ratios. Power is transferred to all four wheels via a 6-speed sequential race gearbox. The suspension system consists of McPherson struts in the front and HA3 dampers at the rear, all of which are fully adjustable and ensure excellent cornering ability.

The MINI Clubman Vision Gran Turismo sits low to the ground, with the wheels positioned outside the body, resulting in go-kart-like agility. Adjustable carbon diffusers are placed in the front and rear, while large vents behind the wheel arches regulate air flow to cool the engine and brakes. The split rear spoiler and fully enclosed underbody enhance the sophisticated aerodynamics.

The car MINI design has familiar touches, such as the hexagonal front grille, elliptical headlights with implied racing-design stickers, and rally stripes on the hood and roof. Quick release hinges on the hood and tank and the small sliding window on the side reveal that this is not your oridinary performance car.
zh:
竞赛配置的Clubman，从0到100 公里/小时加速仅需3.5秒，最高时速可达290 公里/小时。

这款Vision Gran Turismo车型向我们展示了专为竞速打造的Mini会是什么样的。它拥有1,050 公斤的超轻量车身和395 PS的动力性能，在仅仅3.5秒内完成0-100 公里/小时的加速。其传动系统会向全部四个车轮输出动力。它的车身轮廓极低，几乎像是俯卧在地面上，四个车轮也已经向两侧外扩到了极限，这样的设计让它实现了类似卡丁车的极致操控性能，这也是Mini品牌赖以闻名的特点，更为驾驶者提供了无与伦比的驾驶体验。

en:
This hopped-up MINI Cooper S featured a supercharged engine.

In the latter half of the 1990s, famed sports car manufacturer BMW purchased the branding and manufacturing rights to the MINI brand and resurrected the MINI Cooper in 2001.

This new MINI was a bit larger than the classic model of yesteryear, measuring <3655mm>, <1690mm> and <1455mm>, overall length, width and height, respectively. But BMW kept the car's spirit intact, thanks to quirky styling cues that were reminiscent of the original 1959 model. These included a "cute" face, highlighted by large round headlights and a square front grille and boxy silhouette.

The performance-oriented version in the new MINI lineup was the Cooper S. The power plant in the standard MINI was the "Pentagon," a 1.6-liter SOHC inline-4 developed in cooperation between BMW and Chrysler, while the Cooper S got an intercooled supercharger bolted on to its power plant—the large air intake on the model's hood being a dead giveaway of forced induction.

The supercharger accounted for an additional <54ps> and <7.26kgm> of torque over the stock engine, for a grand total of <170ps> and <22.45kgm>. It came mated to a slick-shifting 6-speed manual gearbox. This made the Cooper S one of the most fun to drive FF (Front drive, Front engine) compact cars in the marketplace.

It was a testament to the German company that effectively instilled the car's British heritage into the new MINI Cooper.
zh:
MINI的热门车型，配备了机械增压引擎。

这款车型是Mini在被BMW收购之后推出的全新高性能掀背车。它的1.6升直列四缸引擎配备了机械增压器，能够输出170 PS/22.0 公斤力米的动力，高于Cooper的54 PS/7.0 公斤力米。另外，它还采用了一套专用6速手动变速箱，将所有的驾驶乐趣都塞进了紧凑的车身之中。

en:
A beautiful streamlined 2-seat sports car that won the Gran Turismo Trophy

Every August in the U.S., the world’s most stunning automobiles from across automotive history gather for the prestigious Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance. In 2014, the Gran Turismo Trophy—just one of the many coveted awards—was claimed by this Maserati A6GCS/53 Spyder, chassis No. 2078.

The A6 nameplate referred to a series of 6-cylinder race cars Maserati developed between 1947 and 1956. The GCS variant was built for sports car championship competition and initially took the form of a two-seat version of the classic cigar-shaped Grand Prix racers. But in 1953, following a shift in regulations, coachbuilders began to craft their own bodies for the car’s tubular frame.

Chassis No. 2078 was one such creation, graced with an elegant Spyder body penned by Carrozzeria Fantuzzi. Its <170ps> engine came from none other than Gioachino Colombo. During the 1954 season, this car competed as part of the Maserati works team, racking up five class wins and three overall victories.
zh:
一辆绝美的流线型双座跑车，曾赢得过Gran Turismo奖杯

这辆Maserati A6GCS/53 Spyder在2014年圆石滩经典车展中荣获Gran Turismo奖杯。优雅的铝制Spyder车身由Carrozzeria Fantuzzi打造，170 PS的引擎则出自乔亚基诺·科伦坡之手。该车代表Maserati厂队参赛，在1954赛季中夺得5次组别冠军和3次总成绩第一。

en:
True to its Italian heritage, this grand tourer was defined by class, performance and elegance.

Maserati's GranTurismo S, not to be confused with this driving simulator of the same name, was unveiled at the 2008 Geneva Motor Show as the high-performance version of Maserati's handsome GranTurismo Coupe.

Although there wasn't much that visually separated the two cars, there were significant differences under the sheet metal; the most noteworthy of which being the drivetrain. For starters, the displacement of the DOHC V8 in the GranTurismo S was increased to <4691cc>, <500cc> more than in the base car. Combined with this revitalized engine was a state-of-the-art semi-automatic gearbox dubbed "MC Shift." MC Shift allowed drivers the choice between a smooth-shifting automatic transmission befitting a pure luxury car and a quick-shifting sequential manual where shifting is performed via paddles on the steering wheel.

And because it was a transaxle (with the gearbox mounted on the rear differential), the front/rear weight distribution was drastically improved, making the GranTurismo S a better handling machine.

Despite the two cars looking virtually identical, the GranTurismo S possessed a more athletic nature than the base car, while still delivering the luxury and elegance that has made the marque famous for nearly 100 years.
zh:
传统杰作，强大的赛车性能隐藏在并不明显的外观之下。

这是2008年日内瓦车展上推出的GranTurismo高性能版本。V8双顶置凸轮轴引擎的排量扩容至4.7升，变速箱和后限滑差速器被整合进一个变速驱动桥单元中。它也是该系列中首款使用双踏板半自动“MC Shift”系统的车型。

en:
A special super car that embodies the tradition and passion of Maserati.

The MC20 is a mid-engine supercar introduced by Maserati in 2020. The Italian company is widely known for its elegant and masterfully constructed high-performance GT cars. The MC20 is the first mid-engine model in the company's road car lineup since the discontinuation of the MC12 in 2005.

With its scissor-type doors, the body is elegant and clean. It's seemingly devoid of aggressive aerodynamic add-ons, such as a large rear wing or a radical front splitter, but that is because this car doesn't need them. Developed by race-car constructor Dallara, this Maserati body underwent rigorous wind-tunnel testing from the beginning, so the use of overt downforce-induing parts was not necessary.

At its foundation is a carbon monocoque that apparently weighs as little as <100kg>. Keeping the car lightweight was a priority for Maserati, and the engineers were able to keep curb weight down to less than <1500kg>.

The newly developed twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 engine features the first F1-style pre-chamber combustion system used in a production car. It produces <630ps> and 730 Nm (<74.5kgm>) torque. Combined with an 8-speed DCT transmission, the MC20 can accelerate from 0 to <100km/h> in under 2.9 seconds and reach a top speed of more than <325km/h>.
zh:
一台承载了Maserati决心与激情的极致超级跑车。

这是Maserati继MC12之后时隔15年推出的首款中置引擎跑车。由Dallara设计的流线型车身无需依赖外置空气动力套件即可产生强劲下压力。碳纤维单体车架自重仅100 公斤，搭载全新开发的3升V6双涡轮引擎，采用F1级别预燃室技术。

en:
This high-output model of the Merak has been tuned for even sharper performance.+

The Maserati Merak, a mid-engine sports car introduced in 1972, was developed as a sister model to the Bora that came out the previous year. Both vehicles shared the same basic exterior styling, penned by renown designer Giugiaro; however, the rear ends were noticeably different, as the Bora was a fastback, while the Merak was a notchback with a fastback-style pillar.

The engines of the two cars were also different. Where the Bora had a rumbling V-8 in its engine bay, the Merak featured a <190ps> 3.0-liter V-6 borrowed from the Citroën SM, thus allowing the Merak to adopt a 2+2 layout and boast more luggage space.

In 1975, a high-performance version of the Merak was offered, called the Merak SS, which came equipped with a <220ps> engine that increased the car's top speed from <225km/h> to <250km/h>.
zh:
Merak的这款高动力车型经过调校后，性能更加犀利。

这款中置引擎跑车于1972年首度登场，与Bora互为姊妹车型。相比搭载V8引擎的Bora，Merak采用了来自Citroën SM的3升V6引擎，尺寸小了一号，并利用节省的空间打造了2+2座椅布局。SS是1975年推出的高性能版本。通过提高压缩比增强引擎输出，最高时速从225 公里/小时提升至250 公里/小时。

en:
The legendary Mazda 787B was the first Japanese-manufactured race car to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

Mazda's rotary-engine race cars were a familiar sight at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in the mid-seventies and throughout the eighties, but it would be 18 years after its first race at the Sarthe Circuit when the car company from Hiroshima would make history.

It all began with the development of the 787, which was powered by the R26B, a 4-rotor Wankel engine that produced <700ps>. To match this power, the car's frame was changed from a conventional aluminum honeycomb composite to a carbon-fiber, which resulted in a light, rigid body structure. The 787 made its debut at the 1990 24 Hours of Le Mans, but mechanical problems forced it to retire from the race early. Mazda came back the following year with an improved version of the race car called the 787B.

The 1991 24 Hours of Le Mans fielded one of the most competitive grids in the history of the event with an all-out effort by Peugeot, as well as strong entries from Mercedes-Benz, Jaguar and Porsche. Two Mazda 787Bs were entered, with the No. 55 car, driven by Bertrand Gachot, Johnny Herbert and Volker Weidler, starting in the 19th position. Once the contest started, the Mazda race car gradually worked its way up the leader board, taking the overall lead just three hours before the end of the race. It managed to hang on to claim the checker, completing 362 laps, which beat the previous year's record. The win marked the first and still the only Japanese race team to win the overall title at Le Mans.
zh:
帮助Mazda成为首家赢得勒芒大赛的日本生产商，成就一代传奇。

1991年，787B成为日本制造商中首台在勒芒24小时耐力赛获得总冠军的赛车，并且全程未出现任何机械故障。Mazda于1974年开始一直使用转子引擎征战勒芒，但由于禁止使用转子引擎的技术规范即将到来，开发787是Mazda在勒芒凭借转子引擎获胜的最后机会。由于787在1990年的比赛中未能实现目标，次年，经过全面改进的787B由此诞生。

en:
The third-generation Mazda6 featured a curvaceous body style and SkyActiv technology.

Called the Atenza in various markets, the Mazda 6 sports sedan offered European-like style and performance in a less expensive package. In 2012, the third-generation model was unveiled, sporting an exterior body that resembled the dashing Takeri concept car shown at the 2011 Tokyo Motor Show. However, the biggest surprise came under the sheet metal as the new Mazda 6 came equipped with an optional diesel engine called the SKYACTIV-D for select markets.

This diesel was in fact an improved version of the turbocharged direct-injection 2.2-liter inline-4 of the CX-5. It produced <175ps> and <42.8kgm> of torque, supplying the driver with gobs of low-end power that enabled the Mazda 6 to jump off the line like a lightweight sports car. Power was transferred via a 6-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual to either the front wheels or all four. In select markets, the “i-stop” idle-stop feature and a capacitor-based regenerative braking system called “i-ELOOP” were incorporated, helping the SKYACTIV-D-equipped Mazda 6s boast a high JC08 mode fuel economy of <22.4km/L>.

The diesel-engine powered cars were labeled “XD,” with Standard, Proactive, and L trim levels. The highest version, the L, came with luxury features including leather seats and accounted for an astounding 76 percent of all Mazda 6 sales in the first month of availability.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.
zh:
这款第3代Atenza赛车因其优美的车身线条和SkyActiv科技脱颖而出。

这是一台Atenza的Gr.3认证车型，基于Mazda全球市场版轿车并按照Gr.3组别规则进行改装。作为赛车车型的原型车，这款轿车经过改装后成为动力输出超过400马力的猛兽。值得注意的是，设计师连车身表面反射效果的流动也考虑到了。

en:
This is an original racing version of the Mazda6 for Gr.3 competition.

In 2012, the third-generation model was unveiled, sporting an exterior body that resembled the dashing Takeri concept car shown at the 2011 Tokyo Motor Show. The diesel-engine powered cars were labeled “XD,” with Standard, Proactive, and L trim levels. The highest version, the L, came with luxury features including leather seats and accounted for an astounding 76 percent of all Mazda 6 sales in the first month of availability.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.
zh:
一款以Mazda的旗舰车型Atenza打造的原创赛车，专为Gr.3竞赛打造。

Mazda Atenza全球版轿车按照Gr.3组别进行改装后，成为这台跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。外观上激进的空气动力学流线遵循Mazda的“魂动”设计理念。驾驶舱后部增添了一块隔板以增加车身刚性，以及一个后视摄像头以扩大视野。

en:
This is an original racing version of the Mazda6 for Gr.4 competition.

Called the Atenza in various markets, the Mazda 6 sports sedan offered European-like style and performance in a less expensive package. In 2012, the third-generation model was unveiled, sporting an exterior body that resembled the dashing Takeri concept car shown at the 2011 Tokyo Motor Show. However, the biggest surprise came under the sheet metal as the new Mazda 6 came equipped with an optional diesel engine called the SKYACTIV-D for select markets.

This diesel was in fact an improved version of the turbocharged direct-injection 2.2-liter inline-4 of the CX-5. It produced <175ps> and <42.8kgm> of torque, supplying the driver with gobs of low-end power that enabled the Mazda 6 to jump off the line like a lightweight sports car. Power was transferred via a 6-speed automatic or a 6-speed manual to either the front wheels or all four. In select markets, the “i-stop” idle-stop feature and a capacitor-based regenerative braking system called “i-ELOOP” were incorporated, helping the SKYACTIV-D-equipped Mazda 6s boast a high JC08 mode fuel economy of <22.4km/L>.

The diesel-engine powered cars were labeled “XD,” with Standard, Proactive, and L trim levels. The highest version, the L, came with luxury features including leather seats and accounted for an astounding 76 percent of all Mazda 6 sales in the first month of availability.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
zh:
一款以Mazda的旗舰车型Atenza打造的原创赛车，专为Gr.4竞赛打造。

Mazda Atenza全球版轿车按照Gr.3组别进行改装后，成为这台跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。搭载四轮驱动系统，这款轿车具有出色的牵引力。新增的Gr.3风格大型前格栅和引擎盖通风口让4缸涡轮增压引擎得以发挥潜力，输出惊人的400 PS动力。

carNameEn: Mazda Atenza Sedan XD L Package '15
