zh:
采用跑车空气动力学技术的下一代GT概念车。

这款Vision Gran Turismo车型不仅为大家描绘了Nissan对于不久之后的未来的畅想，还通过一群由英国设计师和日本工程师组成的年轻团队的精诚合作而化为了现实。它的动力系统结合了一部V6双涡轮增压引擎和3部电机，共同构成了一套高性能混动前置后驱四驱系统。这辆车还采用了主动式悬挂，能够充分利用车身的空气动力学优势，不论在什么场景下都能让驾驶者发挥出它全部的实力。

en:
This front-engine/rear-wheel-drive specialty car was given a different character to its sister car, the Silvia.

The Nissan 180SX — sold as the Nissan 240SX in the U.S. and the 200SX in the EU — was created as the Silvia's sister hatchback model in March 1989. This car, sporting retractable headlights and a glass hatchback, was overshadowed by the coupe at first—despite sharing the same powerplant, a 1.8-liter DOHC inline-4 that came available only with a turbocharger. But as time went on, people recognized the true value of this stylish sports coupe and sales began to climb.

The engine received an upgrade in 1991 to the SR20DET, the same 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 in the normal Silvia with output rated at <205ps> and <28.0kgm>. This prolonged the 180SX's life span because its production run was initially slated to end alongside the S13 Silvia; however, thanks to the popularity of the 2.4-liter 240SX in the U.S. (that possessed the same body shape of 180SX), Nissan elected to keep the compact rear-drive coupe around.

In 1996, the first normally-aspirated 180SX, the Type S, was added to the lineup. Without forced induction, the Type S lacked the acceleration of the hotter version. This made the car a favorite among tuners, who took things into their own hands, giving the car their own dose of power and beefing the chassis up accordingly. This paved the way for a new 180SX, one that featured the Silvia's front end, making the two cars virtual clones of each other; it was dubbed the "Sil-Eighty."
zh:
这款前置后驱特殊车型被赋予了与其姐妹车Silvia完全不同的特征。

1989年3月，180SX作为S13代Silvia的掀背版本推出。按照原计划，它将在Silvia全面改款时与S13一同结束生产。然而，搭载2.4升引擎的美版240SX持续热销，促使Nissan将其从Silvia产品线中独立出来继续生产。改装爱好者尤为喜爱180SX，催生出风格迥异的个性化改装车型。

en:
With its 'G-nose' and fender flares, this car epitomized Japanese sports car cool in the 1970s.

*The Nissan Fairlady Z was sold as the Nissan Z in markets outside of Japan.

Near the end of the 1960s, Japanese cars made a name for themselves on the international stage. One of these examples was the Datsun 240Z that was introduced in 1969. Yutaka Katayama, the president of Nissan North America at the time, convinced the Japanese brass that "now was the time for real sports cars," to challenge those from Europe. Thus, the Z was born.

Among the more notable Zs was the 432. While other Zs were equipped with the Type L engine, the 432 came equipped with the S20, a DOHC inline-6 lifted from the Prince R380. The "4" stood for 4 valves per cylinder, the "3" for 3 twin-choke carburetors, and "2" represented the engine's 2 camshafts. Output of the engine was rated at <160ps> and <18.0kgm> of torque.

This 432 also had a 432R racing spec model that sported a carbon-fiber hood for weight reduction. Only 30 of these cars were made.

A considerable amount of work went into making the 432. The S20 was known to be a delicate powerplant that only the Nissan mechanics at Oppama could get the most out of.

On the other hand, the 2.4-liter Type L engine in the U.S.-spec 240Z was easy to work with, and its ability to provide plenty of torque throughout the rpm spectrum made it popular for racers. The 240Z performed well in safari races and notable off-road events such as the Monte Carlo Rally, as well as those on tarmac racing circuits.

Thanks to its high level of performance, the 240Z made it to Japan in 1971, marketed there as the Fairlady Z. A special version of the car called the 240ZG, referred to as the "G nose," added to the car's popularity, solidifying its place in the history books as one of the most popular and longest-tenured sports cars ever.
zh:
挡泥板外包围和“G字鼻”，70年代最具代表性的日系跑车。

1969年问世的Fairlady Z是首批征战国际舞台的日本车型之一。标志性车型Z 432弃用标准的L型引擎，转而采用源于Prince R380的S20直列6缸双顶置凸轮轴引擎。这台动力输出达160 PS的引擎也被投入到了赛车比赛中。240Z是搭载2.4升引擎的美规车型，这台车在东非拉力赛与蒙特卡洛拉力赛上的成功更是让“Z”成为跑车代名词。

en:
A shortened wheelbase plus larger engine equals driving fun in this sixth-gen Z car.

When the sixth-generation Fairlady Z, the Z34, was introduced in December 2008, most people assumed that the car would be just a mildly updated version of the Z33 that revived the Z car in January 2002. The 370Z, as we knew it, appeared relatively the same; however, upon closer inspection, it became evident that this was an all-new car.

Built atop the E platform that also serves as the foundation of the Infiniti "Skyline" G37, the new Z featured an aluminum hood, door and rear hatch that kept the car's curb weight about the same as the previous vehicle (around <1500kg>). The new Z was nimble, thanks to a wheelbase that was <100mm> shorter and retuned suspension system that consisted of a double-wishbone setup in front and multilink at rear.

Under the hood was a more powerful engine, the VQ37VHR with VVEL. VVEL was a mechanism that varies the operating angle and lift of the valves for improved power and lower emissions. With <200cc> more displacement, the new V6 pumped out <336ps>/<7000rpm> and <37.2kgm> of torque that peaked at <5200rpm>. The engine came mated to either a quick-shifting 6-speed automatic transmission, or a revolutionary 6-speed manual gearbox equipped with the world's first synchro rev control mechanism. This system automatically adjusted engine rpm when downshifting, eliminating the need to heel and toe.

Thus, the Z34 became a true enthusiast sports car that even novices could drive effectively.
zh:
排量提高，缩短轴距，第6代Fairlady z更专注驾驶体验。

2008年推出的第6代Fairlady Z （Z34）虽与前代Z33在外观上神似，实则为全面改款。这台车与V36型Skyline的双门轿跑共享研发平台，但车身更轻、性能更强。VQ37VHR引擎动力输出达336 PS。这款性能车型还对悬挂与刹车进行了优化。

en:
With its tidy exterior design, this 4th-gen Z car was a handsome sports car for the global market.(

*The Nissan Fairlady Z was sold as the Nissan 300ZX outside Japan.

The Z32, appearing in 1989, was the first complete transformation for the Fairlady Z. It came in a wide, flat body, turning 180 degrees from the narrow, long body designs that lasted 3 generations. It was sized as a global sports car, not restricted by the size classes of the Japanese market.

Its steering characteristics were changed drastically. As soon as the steering wheel is turned, the nose slices into the corner, and the wide tread gave it a high level of potential. This Z opened new doors as a cornering machine, while maintaining its performance as a GT. Again, the Z dropped European thoroughbreds into a hole of despair.

At the heart of this car was a compact V6 with a low center of gravity. Even though it is an FR, it was given a front midship layout with the engine located as far back as possible, to make the front/rear weight distribution close to 50:50. Aiming for the global market, the engine size was fixed at 3 liters, and producing <230ps> in the NA, and <280ps> in the twin turbo, its performance decorated the end of the 20th century. Its suspension used advanced designs as well, and even features like an ABS that does not transfer shock to the brake pedal, were things that went beyond the usual standards of the time.

In 1992, a convertible model was added to the lineup, and was greatly welcomed in its main market of California.
zh:
改用宽体车身之后，第四代Z成为了面向全球市场的跑车。

第四代Fairlady Z是专门针对全球市场所设计，基本上没有考虑日本国内的尺寸限制。其较宽的车身让增加轮距成为可能，也让它的过弯性能更上层楼。动力方面，它采用了一部3升V6前中置引擎，其自然进气版本可以输出230 PS，而双涡轮增压版本则可以输出280 PS。

en:
This special Datsun Z was equipped with the same engine as the Skyline GT-R.

In 1969, Nissan completely transformed the Fairlady brand from that of a classic open-top roadster into a classy fixed-roof sports car that went by the name 240Z in many parts of the world. A performance-oriented version of this car was created, called the Z 432.

The car's name referred to its engine, namely its 4 valves, 3 carburettors and 2 camshafts. While the base car came with the L20, a SOHC inline-6, the Z 432 was powered by the L20, which was in fact a detuned version of the <220ps> GR8 engine used in the R380 prototype race car. In the Z 432, it produced <160ps>, which was the same as the previously released Skyline GT-R version.

This made the special Z car quick — a 0-<400m> time of 15.8s and top speed of <210km/h> — making for an ideal race car, but only a limited number of a pure race versions of the car, called the Z 432R, were made. It featured fibrerlass and acrylic components that decreased its weight by <100kg>. Today, the car is a prized collector's item with an example rumored to have fetched $800,000 at auction. .
zh:
这辆Fairlady Z配备了与Skyline GT-R相同的S20引擎，只为比赛而生。

Z 432在1969年作为Fairlady Z的顶配版推出，搭载直列6缸双顶置凸轮轴“S20”引擎（160 PS）。该引擎源自Nissan R380赛车，0-400 米加速时间为15.8秒，最高时速达210 公里/小时。这台引擎也被投入到了赛车比赛中。此外，还有一款采用玻璃纤维与亚克力材料进行部件减重的Z 432 R车型，但销量寥寥。

en:
This refined Z33 model came powered by the next-generation VQ35HR engine.

Nissan's legendary sports car, the "Fairlady Z," disappeared from the catalog lineup in the summer of 2000, but Nissan President Carlos Ghosn knew full well the importance of this car and had secretly given the go-ahead for the new generation model. In July of 2002, the new Z33 Z-car made its debut.

It shared its base frame and the V6 3.5-liter VQ35DE engine with the V35 Skyline, but it produced <280ps> and <37.0kgm> of torque. It also came with a 6-speed manual gearbox.

The new Z continued to evolve in the following years. One major advancement was made in January 2007, when the engine was changed to the new generation VQ35HR, improving power output to <313ps>. The intake manifold was completely redesigned, and the friction within the engine was reduced. By further improving the crankshaft section, the engine revved more freely. Also, the exhaust note was tuned to give off a deep and low sound, reminiscent of a V-8 engine. The designers added a power bulge to the car's hood to show the Z's extra power.

The engineers heavily modified the car's suspension, improving absorption of the road surface and delivering a flatter cornering character. These changes translated to better overall handling feel and enhanced race-track performance.
zh:
经过调校的Z33配备了新一代的VQ35HR引擎。

这台车是2007年发布的Z33 Fairlady Z的改进版。全新的VQ35HR引擎将动力输出提升至313 PS，进气歧管的改进和摩擦的降低改善了引擎高转速时的体验。悬挂设定改进后让车身姿态更加平稳、灵活。

en:
This very fast GT-R scored wins at Suzuki, Okayama, and Autopolis in the 2008 Super GT.

When the all-new R35 GT-R made its debut in the Fall of 2007, it was obvious that Nissan intended its supercar to go racing. The company didn't waste much time making its official announcement. Only a month after the GT-R went on sale, Nissan told the Japanese press that the new GT-R would compete in the Super GT Series, the most popular race series in Japan, perhaps all of Asia.

Specifically developed with 2009 vehicle regulations in mind, this race-ready Nissan GT-R featured an innovative construction design that centered on the cabin. While its overall appearance was similar to that of the production GT-R, the race car was a completely different animal.

The engine was a 4.5-liter V8 based on the VK45DE, the power plant in the Fairlady Z GT race car from the previous year. It was reported to produce more than <500ps>.

In competition, the number 23 Xanavi Nismo GT-R piloted by Satoshi Motoyama and Benoît Tréluyer, showed incredible performance from the opening round of the car's maiden season, winning the first two races. In the end it won a total of three races, good enough to bring the team the drivers' title in 2008.

In all, five GT-Rs competed in the Super GT series that year. The GT-R finished 1-2 in the opening round at Suzuka, and won a total of seven out of that year's nine races, meeting, and perhaps exceeding, the expectations of Nissan and GT-R fans all over Asia.@
zh:
第一款符合新规则的GT-R，以压倒性的速度回应了车迷的期待。

在完成令人惊喜的回归后，Nissan GT-R开始参加2008赛季Super GT锦标赛。为了针对下一年的规则改动提前做好准备，这款车采用了管式框架车身，并安装了一台沿用自Z车型的4.5升V8引擎。从第一轮起，Xanavi Nismo便展现出了不可思议的实力，并一路势如破竹般拿下了车手冠军。

en:
This JGTC machine gained its edge by lowering the center of gravity and shortening the wheelbase.

Nissan originally conceived the Skyline GT-R R32 as a Group A race car, but when Group A racing went defunct, Nissan found a new series for its prized car, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC). The GT-R later underwent a full redesign as the R33, and performance of this new car on the track was impressive to say the least. However, as Nissan's main rival, Toyota, started contesting with a faster version of the Supra, and Honda added more heat when it joined the series in 1997, the GT-R was losing its grasp on JGTC dominance.

Although Nissan took both the Drivers' and Constructors' championship titles in 1998, the company switched to the new R34 in 1999 as the foundation for its race car. The new GT-R rode on a <55mm> shorter wheelbase than the R33, making it more agile than its predecessor. Also a shallower oil pan and the fuel tank relocated inside the cabin accounted for better weight distribution.

The new revived GT-R found itself in far fiercer competition than anticipated, and didn't score its first win until the fourth race of the season.

The GT-R was unable to log a second win that year, but collected enough points on the strength of its reliability to give Érik Comas, driving the Pennzoil NISMO GT-R, the Drivers' championship title for the second year in a row before the final race was even run.
zh:
通过降低重心和缩短轴距来提高速度的JGTC赛车。

这款R34型GT-R参加了1999年全日本GT锦标赛。相比前代R33车型，轴距缩短了55毫米，因为采用浅油底壳调整了引擎位置，显著提升了整体性能。在第4轮Mine Circuit赛道上，埃里克·科马斯和本山哲驾驶Pennzoil NISMO GT-R夺得胜利，科马斯还因此蝉联了车手冠军。

en:
Despite a touch of maturity, the new GT-R still possessed the heart of a monster.

This new Nissan GT-R was announced at the New York International Auto Show in April 2016, amid a fury of anticipation and hype. As the most significantly changed model since its introduction in 2007, the new R35 GT-R didn’t disappoint.

Changes to the car’s design was not only intended to make the car look better, but also designed to enhance its aerodynamic performance. The new, larger Vmotion grille highlighted the new freshened face, while a new lower, rigid hood resisted deformation at high speeds. The fenders and front bumpers were reshaped to provide more downforce.

The GT-R remained a monster when it came to performance. The engine, which was still built by hand by master craftsmen, had more power than before, with <573ps> at <6800rpm> and a maximum torque of <64.6kgm> on tap. Combined with an improved 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, the new GT-R was quicker and more responsive than the previous model in the mid-rpm ranges.

With pavement-sticking all-wheel-drive handling, the new GT-R now wreaked havoc in a custom-tailored suit.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
zh:
2017年的车型做出了更深入的改进。

这是Nissan的“全能超级跑车”R35 GT-R的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，专门针对Gr.4组别进行了改装。四轮驱动系统带来稳定的操控，而雾灯等各种耐力赛部件让这台车成为长距离比赛的完美车款。

en:
This Gr.B design reimagines the Nissan GT-R as a dedicated off-road race machine.

This new Nissan GT-R was announced at the New York International Auto Show in April 2016, amid a fury of anticipation and hype. As the most significantly changed model since its introduction in 2007, the new R35 GT-R didn’t disappoint.

Changes to the car’s design was not only intended to make the car look better, but also designed to enhance its aerodynamic performance. The new, larger Vmotion grille highlighted the new freshened face, while a new lower, rigid hood resisted deformation at high speeds. The fenders and front bumpers were reshaped to provide more downforce.

The fenders and front bumpers were reshaped to provide more downforce. The engine, which was still built by hand by master craftsmen, had more power than before, with <573ps> at <6800rpm> and a maximum torque of <64.6kgm> on tap. Combined with an improved 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, the new GT-R was quicker and more responsive than the previous model in the mid-rpm ranges.

Combined with an improved 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, the new GT-R was quicker and more responsive than the previous model in the mid-rpm ranges.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
zh:
以Gr.B规格设计的这款车型将Nissan GT-R重新塑造成了一辆火力全开的越野赛车。

这是Nissan的“全能超级跑车”R35 GT-R的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型，专门针对Gr.B组别进行了改装。外观上最显著的改变就是为了在夜间赛场上照亮赛道，在引擎盖上加装了四盏雾灯，以及在保险杠两侧分别加装了一盏大号雾灯。GT-R的四轮驱动系统原本已经非常优越，让它在拉力赛场上也独具优势。

en:
A front-wheel-drive prototype hybrid racer designed by Ben Bowlby.

In the spring of 2014, Nissan Motor Company announced that it would enter the LPM1 hybrid class of the 24 Hours of Le Mans the following year with a race car wearing a GT-R badge. It would mark the return of "the Nissan prototype race car" after a 16-year hiatus—since the R391 in 1999. As if that wasn't newsworthy enough, Nissan revealed at the car's introduction in February 2015 that its new race machine, called the GT-R LM NISMO, possessed a front-engine/front-wheel-drive layout, a concept previously unheard of in prototype race cars.

The mastermind behind the GT-R LM NISMO is none other than Ben Bowlby, the man who created the DeltaWing and ZEOD RC race cars. By mounting the engine in the front, Bowlby claims that it opened up new design possibilities to maximize aerodynamics, thus making the car more efficient at higher speeds.

The body consists of a monocoque chassis and outer panels made of carbon fiber, allowing the car to tip the scales at a light <880kg>. Under the long front nose is a twin-turbocharged 3.0-liter direct injection V-6 mated to an energy-recovery system.

The drivers of the car include homegrown talents, Michael Krumm and Tsugio Matsuda; GT Academy graduates Lucas Ordóñez and Jann Mardenborough; former F1 drivers Marc Gené and Max Chilton; and sports car drivers Alex Buncombe, Harry Tincknell and Olivier Pla.

Nissan will run two cars starting from the first round of the FIA World Endurance Championships, and enter three cars in the 24 Hours of Le Mans, with the sole purpose of grabbing the overall title._
zh:
前轮驱动混动车原型，由本·鲍尔比设计。

2014年春季，Nissan宣布将派遣GT-R赛车征战勒芒24小时耐力赛。这辆GT-R LM Nismo采用了颠覆性的前置引擎前轮驱动架构。碳纤维车身由DeltaWing和ZEOD RC的设计师本·鲍尔比操刀设计，搭载3升V6双涡轮增压引擎和能量回收系统。车重达到最低限重880 公斤，此车参加了争夺总冠军的角逐。

en:
The 2017 GT-R was a smoother, more refined version of the previous model.

The GT-R NISMO was introduced in 2014 as the high-performance version of the R35 GT-R. It delighted Japanese sports-car enthusiasts as soon as it appeared and remained unchanged until the summer of 2016 when an updated model finally arrived.

The 2017 GT-R NISMO featured structural adhesives that improved body rigidity. Under the hood, new GT3 turbines were added and the engine was slightly tuned, but output was kept at <600ps>/<66.5kgm>. While still a menacing handling machine, the new GT-R felt more civil on public roads, thanks to the Damp Tronic ECU incorporated into the car's suspension.

At first glance, the new GT-R looked similar to the outgoing model, but in fact, major improvements were made to the car's aerodynamics. The addition of rear spoiler and a front under spoiler and bumper with canard shaped fins on both sides resulted in <100kg> more downforce than the standard GT-R at <300km/h>.
zh:
这款2017年的车型将GT-R的性能提升到了新的高度。

2017款GT-R Nismo对全车上下进行了改良。在保留其粘合车身结构和引擎规格的同时，前车窗框架的刚性得到了强化，城市和赛道的驾驶舒适性也获得改善。得益于工程师对外观进行全方位的重新设计，空气动力学效应也优化了不少，让车身在高速时也能产生更多下压力。

en:
A homologation model with 500 cars produced for Group A racing

Nissan's BNR32 Skyline GT-R was created to win touring car races. Armed with the RB26DETT engine with displacement meeting Group A specifications, this all-wheel-drive grand tourer had all the ingredients that went into a high-performance sports machine, including a 4-wheel steering system.

As was expected, a GT-R NISMO version appeared in its second year of production in the form of a Group A homologation model with a limited production of 500 cars.

Compared to the standard GT-R, the GT-R NISMO was equipped with fins above the front grille that increased airflow into the engine room for cooling, as well as air inlet openings in the front bumper. To improve aerodynamic characteristics, the rear end of the side sills had protectors that directed airflow around the rear tires. A small rear spoiler was also added to improve downforce, while the turbos were changed from ceramic to metal. The exhaust manifold was specially redesigned for this car, and to reduce weight the A/C, audio system, and rear wipers were deleted, making the car <30kg> lighter than the base model.

The GT-R NISMO won the top touring car class in Japan, as well as many other famous endurance races throughout Asia, Europe and in Australia. Its mere presence was enough to cause havoc at Group A races all over the world.
zh:
仅量产500辆的A组别赛事认证车型。

这款R32 Skyline GT-R的赛事认证版本限量生产500台。为在A组赛事中夺冠，全面升级了散热系统，涡轮增压器叶轮改用金属材质，车身也经过空气动力学优化并实现轻量化。性能提升十分显著，这款车不仅在日本本土，更在欧洲和澳大利亚的房车赛事中屡获佳绩。

en:
Kazunori Yamauchi and this GT-R NISMO GT3 fought hard in the Nürburgring race in 2013. n

In 2012, Nissan introduced the GT-R NISMO GT3 into GT3 racing, a category that has now become the mainstay of GT races. Schulze Motorsport is a private team that fielded this car in the German ADAC GT Masters series.

In 2013, Gran Turismo game producer Kazunori Yamauchi collaborated with Schulze Motorsport for a fourth attempt at the 24 Hours of Nürburgring. The GT-R NISMO GT3 was updated to 2013 specs, and Polyphony Digital set up the car specifically for the Nürburgring using the simulation technology of Gran Turismo. In addition to Yamauchi, drivers taking the wheel included the two Schulze brothers, Tobias and Michael, as well as professional racer Michael Krumm.

Appearing like the production GT-R at first glance, the race car was converted from AWD to rear drive to meet FIA GT3 regulations. Fenders were widened to fit larger tires, and weight was reduced to <1300kg>. Engine output, brake performance, and aerodynamics were also upgraded. In qualifying for the 2013 race, car number 123 recorded the top time, a first for a Japanese car at the Nürburgring, but on race day, the team was plagued by a combination of red flags and mechanical problems. In the end, the 123 GT-R did not have a chance to show its full potential. There was a silver lining; however, the driving data gained from this racing effort significantly advanced the simulation engine of Gran Turismo.
zh:
在2013年里与山内一典共同征战纽博格林赛道的GT3。

2013年，《跑车浪漫旅》系列制作人山内一典与Schulze Motorsport携手开始合作。依托于Polyphony Digital的技术实力支持，打造出了专门用于参加纽博格林24小时耐力赛的GT-R GT3。从这辆车收集的数据将被用于改进《跑车浪漫旅》的模拟引擎。

en:
This racing spec version of the GT-R was created for GT3 category competition.

The Nissan GT-R GT3, based on the road-going R35 GT-R, was a familiar presence in the FIA's GT3 class. When the race car was introduced in 2012, it came powered by the same twin-turbo 3.8-liter V-6 as in the production model, with the output of the engine rated well above <500ps>.

A new version of the race car appeared in 2015 with a stiffer body structure and going by a new name: the Nismo GT3. In 2018, a dry sump oil system was incorporated to allow the powerplant to sit lower in the engine bay by <150mm>, giving the car a better overall center of gravity. It was also moved aft by <150mm> to optimize front and rear weight distribution.

The radiators and intercoolers were repositioned to provide enhanced airflow and better engine cooling. By redirecting how the air flowed over the body, the Nismo GT3 possessed improved body stability, while a stiffer front body rigidity and retuned suspension system improved handling.
zh:
这是GT-R的赛车规格版本，用于参加GT3组别的比赛。

Nissan GT-R NISMO GT3是基于R35 GT-R开发的FIA GT3规格量产赛车。后期又将基础车型更换为GT-R NISMO，后者采用了干式油底壳系统以降低重心并优化配重。强化的前部刚性和全新设计的悬挂系统提升了操控响应度。引擎舱布局的调整提升了散热效率，同时有助于高速行驶下的稳定性。

en:
This 2016 Super GT race car was driven by the team of Tsugio Matsuda and Ronnie Quintarelli.

Since 2008, Nissan's entry in the GT500 class of the Super GT Series was the R35 GT-R. The car initially came with a 4.5-liter V-8 (VK45DE), then switched to a 3.4-liter V-8 (VRH34A/VRH34B) in 2010. In 2014, it sported yet another new powerplant: a turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4 with direct injection (NR20A), independently developed in the same manner as Toyota and Honda.

Because of new regulations in the Super GT Series for the 2014 season, where the weight and center of gravity of the monocoque had to mimic those of DTM machines, the GT500 GT-R underwent major changes under its skin. These changes continued all the way to the 2016 season.

In 2014, four teams competed with the new GT-R, and the Motul Autech team of Tsugio Matsuda and Ronnie Quintarelli brought home the series championship that year. The following year saw them repeat the feat bringing home the Driver Championship and the Constructor Championship to Nissan for the second straight year. The streak came to an end in 2016 when, despite winning the first two races of the season, they ended up in 3rd place in both the Driver and Constructor championships.
zh:
在2016年Super GT赛事中由松田次生和罗尼·昆塔雷利驾驶。

2014年实施的全新规则意味着这辆车也会采用与DTM版本相同的单体车壳车重和其他主要部件。这辆GT500规格GT-R加入了多项重大调整。直至2016年，车型经历了不少后续优化。在2014和2015赛季，这辆MOTUL AUTECH GT-R连续两年蝉联系列赛冠军。2016年，车队志在夺取三连冠，但最后仅以第三名的总成绩遗憾完赛。

en:
Despite a touch of maturity, the new GT-R still possessed the heart of a monster.

This new Nissan GT-R was announced at the New York International Auto Show in April 2016, amid a fury of anticipation and hype. As the most significantly changed model since its introduction in 2007, the new R35 GT-R didn’t disappoint.

Changes to the car’s design was not only intended to make the car look better, but also designed to enhance its aerodynamic performance. The new, larger Vmotion grille highlighted the new freshened face, while a new lower, rigid hood resisted deformation at high speeds. The fenders and front bumpers were reshaped to provide more downforce.

The GT-R remained a monster when it came to performance. The engine, which was still built by hand by master craftsmen, had more power than before, with 565 HP at <6800rpm> and a maximum torque of 467 ft-lb on tap. Combined with an improved 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, the new GT-R was quicker and more responsive than the previous model in the mid-rpm ranges. Of course, to be considered the world’s best handling car, the cornering performance has also been improved.

With pavement-sticking all-wheel-drive handling, the new GT-R now wreaked havoc in a custom-tailored suit.
zh:
2017年的车型做出了更深入的改进。

2016年，Nissan GT-R迎来了自2007年问世以来最大幅度的改款升级。外观设计在空气阻力、下压力和散热性能之间达到完美平衡。同时，输出573 PS的3.8升V6双涡轮增压引擎配合改进的6速双离合变速箱，带来更顺畅的加速和更优异的过弯表现。这些深层次的进化完美体现了日本跑车的独有特质。

en:
News of the Nissan GT-R R35's demise was evidently greatly exaggerated.

Rumors had circulated that production of the GT-R would conclude with the 2022 model, but in reality, Nissan was still diligently working on further developments. This became evident with the unveiling of the 2024 model at the 2023 Tokyo Auto Salon.

Two significant changes distinguished the 2024 model from its 2022 predecessor. The first was the development of a new muffler system designed to meet the stricter noise regulations that had fueled speculation about the GT-R's discontinuation. This new system successfully reduced unwanted noise and vibrations without compromising engine performance.

The second update was a comprehensive exterior redesign, the first since the 2017 overhaul. The front end now features a horizontal line across the bumper, reminiscent of the iconic R34 GT-R. At the rear, a redesigned bumper and the first modification to the rear wing geometry since the R35's debut subtly push the attachment points further back. These enhancements increased downforce without adding drag.

Beneath the surface, several improvements were also made. For instance, the accelerometers in the electronically controlled suspension was upgraded to more sensitive units, resulting in better traction control and a noticeably smoother ride compared to previous models.
zh:
R35 GT-R系列的巅峰之作粉碎了停产的传言。

2024款GT-R的推出使得该车系在2022款后停产的传言不攻自破。全新的排气消音系统让该车在满足噪音法规的同时保持卓越性能。外观设计同样得到改善，下压力进一步增强。此外，电子控制悬挂系统引入的高灵敏度加速度传感器，不仅提升了抓地性能，同时也改善了乘坐舒适性。

en:
This Nissan GT-R, converted into a safety car, was made to patrol the race track.

This new Nissan GT-R was announced at the New York International Auto Show in April 2016, amid a fury of anticipation and hype. As the most significantly changed model since its introduction in 2007, the new R35 GT-R didn’t disappoint.

Changes to the car’s design were not only intended to make the car look better, but also designed to enhance its aerodynamic performance. The new, larger Vmotion grille highlighted the new freshened face, while a new lower, rigid hood resisted deformation at high speeds. The fenders and front bumpers were reshaped to provide more downforce.

The GT-R remained a monster when it came to performance. The engine, which was still built by hand by master craftsmen, had more power than before, with 565 HP at <6800rpm> and a maximum torque of 467 ft-lb on tap. Combined with an improved 6-speed dual-clutch transmission, the new GT-R was quicker and more responsive than the previous model in the mid-rpm ranges.

With pavement-sticking all-wheel-drive handling, the new GT-R now wreaked havoc in a custom-tailored suit.
zh:
Nissan GT-R的安全车版本，专为赛道设计。

这个跑车浪漫旅的原创车型是以Nissan R35 GT-R超级跑车为基础进行开发的一款安全车。车顶安装的LED巡逻灯和前后保险杠上的灯组极大增强了其醒目程度。中控台还设有该车型独有的额外按钮。

en:
Nissan's compact SUV is even better with e-Power.

The Qashqai is Nissan’s C-segment compact SUV, positioned as a cornerstone of the brand’s global lineup. It was launched in 2006 and followed by a second-generation model in 2013. The version featured here represents the third-generation Qashqai, which made its debut in 2021.

With this latest incarnation, the Qashqai continued to evolve. It arrived with a striking redesign, complementing its larger body with a bold, angular aesthetic. Sharp character lines converged toward Nissan’s signature Vmotion grille, giving the front end a confident and modern presence. Underpinning the vehicle is the advanced CMF-C/D3 platform, which enhances both ride comfort and handling.

When it comes to the powertrain, the Qashqai offers more than just conventional gasoline options—it also features Nissan’s innovative "e-Power" series-hybrid system. This setup uses a gasoline engine solely to generate electricity, which then powers an electric motor that drives the wheels. What’s more, the engine at the heart of Nissan’s e-Power system is the world’s first mass-producible variable compression ratio engine. It delivers significantly improved thermal efficiency, resulting in reduced CO₂ emissions.

Tekna denotes one of the higher model grades in the lineup. This trim comes generously equipped, with larger alloy wheels, ambient lighting, and a head-up display—all included as standard.
zh:
Nissan紧凑型SUV搭载e-Power后更加出色

2006年首次亮相的Qashqai是Nissan产品线中占据C级车细分市场的一款紧凑型SUV。第三代车型拥有更大的车身和全新的外观设计。这台车可选装Nissan专有的“e-Power”串联混合动力系统，该系统利用传统引擎带动发电机发电，驱动电机从而让汽车前进。“Tekna”规格车型提供丰富的配置，标配更大的轮毂、氛围灯和抬头显示器。

en:
Appearing towards the end of Group C's turbo era, this car won every round of the final All-Japan Sports Prototype Championship.

In the 1980s, Group C represented the most competitive arena for GT racing, prompting Nissan engineers to develop a strong engine for this class: a twin-turbocharged 3.5-liter V-8. This powerplant found a home inside the engine bay of a new, sleek race car called the R89C, which

was co-developed with the British company, Lola.

The R89C waged war in the European World Championships, the American IMSA and the All-Japan GT Championships, as well as the 24 Hours of Le Mans. As Nissan began development on its own chassis to house the powerful engine, those plans were scrapped when the FIA revised the regulations for the Group C class, prohibiting turbocharged engines. So while Nissan began development of a new Group C car for race series abroad, it refined its racer for Japan, where the regulations remained unchanged. The R89C eventually made way for the R92CP. With <900ps> on tap, the car's revised VRH35 engine allowed it to reach <400km/h> on the front straight at Fuji Speedway, generating 3.5 tons of downforce. An even more powerful version was tuned for Le Mans, which pumped out <1200ps>.

The new race car was most successful in Japan, winning all six All-Japan Championship races it entered.
zh:
这款优秀的汽车一直坚持到了C组别涡轮引擎时代的终结，曾在全日本跑车原型锦标赛总决赛中赢下了每一轮的冠军。

在全日本锦标赛决定将旧有的涡轮增压器规定沿用到1992年之后，Nissan也继续开发他们的赛车，直到最后推出了这款R92CP。R92CP在富士高速赛道的直道上跑出了超过400 公里/小时的创纪录极速，同时产生了最高达3.5吨的下压力。它势不可挡地赢下了当个赛季的每一场比赛，为涡轮增压器时代画上了圆满的句号。

en:
This Nissan blended the 180SX with the appealing front end of the Silvia.

The Nissan 180SX — sold as the Nissan 240SX in the U.S. and the 200SX in the EU — was created as the Silvia's sister hatchback model in March 1989. This car, sporting retractable headlights and a glass hatchback, was overshadowed by the coupe at first—despite sharing the same powerplant, a 1.8-liter DOHC inline-4 that came available only with a turbocharger. But as time went on, people recognized the true value of the stylish fastback and sales began to climb.

The engine received an upgrade in 1991 to the SR20DET, the same 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 in the normal Silvia with output rated at <205ps> and <28.0kgm>. This prolonged the 180SX's life span because its production run was initially slated to end alongside the S13 Silvia; however, thanks to the popularity of the 2.4-liter 240SX in the U.S. (that possessed the same body shape of 180SX), Nissan elected to keep the compact rear-drive coupe around.

In 1996, the first normally-aspirated 180SX, the Type S, was added to the lineup. Without forced induction, the Type S lacked the acceleration of the hotter version. This made the car a favorite among tuners, who took things into their own hands, giving the car their own dose of power and beefing the chassis up accordingly. This paved the way for a new 180SX, one that featured the Silvia's front end, making the two cars virtual clones of each other; it was dubbed the "Sil-Eighty."
zh:
将180SX和Silvia糅合在一起，车迷的狂热喜爱让它得以诞生。

180SX是作为S13代Silvia的掀背版本推出的。它比Silvia更重，后部刚性也有所不足，性能上存在差距。但很快就推出了众多改装部件，以便车迷打造属于自己的个性化设定。最著名的改装之一是为180SX换装S13的前脸造型，创造出了被称为“Sileighty”的经典车型。

en:
The top grade of the S14 adds a rear spoiler and leather wrapped steering wheel.+

The S14 Silvia made its debut in October 1993 as the successor to the hugely successful S13 model. Armed with a new larger body Nissan hoped to continue on its previous successes.

The S14 is <1730mm> wide compared to the S13's <1690> ,and track width was increased. The new model is also <30mm> longer at <4500mm> and <5mm> taller at <1295mm> for an overall larger body. The softer lines of the body design make the wider stance stand out the most. The K's grade model also featured 16-inch wheels as standard.

The engine is a retuned version of the S13's SR20 series. The highest grade K's model features an intercooled turbocharger and produces <15ps> more than the previous generation at <220ps>/<28.0kgm> with the naturally aspirated Q's and J's models producing <160ps>/<19.2kgm>. The basic suspension structure was carried over from the S13, utilizing front struts and a multilink setup at the rear. The car was also available with the Super HICAS electronic rear-wheel steering system.

In 1996, Nissan released a facelift model with an extensive redesign. The exterior's soft image was tightened up with scowling headlights and a large real spoiler was added for a more sharp and striking appearance.

The "Aero" model featured here was added to the Q's and K's lineup in the spring of 1995 as the top-of-the-line model. The exterior features unique bumpers along with front and rear spoilers. The interior received a leather wrapped steering wheel, a new shift knob and white gauge faces. These changes proved to be popular with drivers, and the grade was continued on the facelift model.

As the number of affordable rear-wheel-drive coupes dwindled through the 1990s, the S14 Silvia can be considered a very important car for carrying that design DNA into the next generation. It was also popular overseas where it wa sold in North America as the 240SX and in Europe as the 200SX.
zh:
装有后扰流板和皮革包裹方向盘的最顶级S14。

S14款Silvia的车身尺寸比S13更大。1996年，S14进行了大幅改款，增加了凶狠的前大灯和大型尾翼。“Aero”是K's和Q's均可选配的高级版本，标配特殊保险杠、前后扰流板、真皮包裹方向盘和换挡手柄球，以及全白仪表盘。

en:
This special S13 had many previously optional items now included as standard equipment.

The Nissan Silvia, called the 240SX in the States, had a loyal following since it was first introduced in 1988 because of its extremely sporty nature and head-turning good looks.

The most popular version was the 5th-generation model, which many felt was the best looking in the car's lineage. Produced from 1988 through 1993 and dubbed the S13, the stylish coupe was also heralded by the media, garnering Japan Car of the Year honors for 1988. It would eventually go on to become the best-selling Silvia ever. The top-of-the-line version was the K model, powered by Nissan's CA18DET, a turbocharged DOHC inline-4 that produced <175ps>/<6400rpm> and <23.0kgm> of torque at <4000rpm>.

From the driver's seat, the engine felt much more powerful, thanks mainly to the car's lean curb weight of <1140kg>. Its straight-line prowess and finely-tuned suspension that included a compliant multilink setup at the rear made the FR (Front drive/Rear engine) sports coupe a true driver's car that was capable on both winding roads and the open highway.

In February 1990, a Diamond Select Edition was added to the lineup. This special model offered an array of optional features that included automatic climate control, aluminum wheels and a rear spoiler, allowing prospective owners to tailor their car toward either a grand tourer or pure sports car.*
zh:
采用特殊规格的S13 Silvia，加入了众多倍受欢迎的选配配置。

1988年至1993年生产的S13 Silvia凭借紧凑型后驱布局提供的出色操控性能赢得了无数车迷的喜爱。在Silvia的众多车型中，搭载涡轮增压直列4缸双顶置凸轮轴“CA18ET”引擎的高性能K's版本因其在各种场合下的巨大潜力而备受推崇。后来还推出了“Dia Selection”作为低成本车型。

en:
The sixth-generation Silvia emphasized heightened luxury in a wide body format.

The S14 Silvia made its debut in October 1993 as the successor to the hugely successful S13 model, and with a new larger body, Nissan hoped to continue on the car's previous success.

The S14 sat <1730mm> wide compared to the S13's <1690> and the track was also enlarged. The new car stretched <30mm> longer at <4500mm> and <5mm> taller at <1295mm> than the outgoing model. The softer lines of the body really enhanced the wider nature of the car's body. The K trim level came with 16-inch wheels as standard, further adding to it visual flair.

Under the hood was a retuned version of the S13's SR20 engine. The K model came with an intercooled turbocharger that helped pump out <15ps> more than the previous generation at <220ps>/<28.0kgm>. The naturally-aspirated Q and J trim levels produced <160ps>/<19.2kgm>. The basic suspension geometry was carried over from the S13, featuring front struts and a multilink system at rear. The car was also available with Super HICAS electronic rear wheel steering.

The S14 placed an extra focus on luxury to increase its appeal as an FR coupe, but when Japan's financial bubble burst in 1991, the coupe market shrank, and the car lost its appeal. To revitalize the model, Nissan released a facelift model in 1996 with an extensive redesign. The exterior's soft image was tightened up with scowling headlights and a large real spoiler for a sharper and more striking appearance.

The S14 Silvia was sold in North America as the 240SX and in Europe as the 200SX.
zh:
第六代Silvia采用宽体车身设计，呈现出更强的奢华感。

S14型Silvia更宽的车身带来了更胜一筹的豪华感。S13的SR20引擎得到沿用，在顶配K's车型上则进一步配备了中冷涡轮增压器。基本悬挂设置同样沿用了S13的设计，前部采用支柱系统，后部采用多连杆系统。还提供配备电动Super HICAS系统的车型选项。

en:
A low price, excellent handling and naturally aspirated engine made this S13 quite attractive.

In May 1988, the fifth-generation S13 Silvia stole market share away from the Honda Prelude and gained immediate popularity. This is because of its front-engine/rear-drive layout and fun-to-drive nature, but the main reason was the car's elegant styling.

Under the hood was the CA18, a 1.8-liter inline-4, but it was later replaced by the SR20, a 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4. The premium K's model came turbocharged, producing <205ps> and <28.0kgm> of torque, while the Q's and J's remained naturally aspirated, rated at <140ps> and <18.2kgm>. The front suspension consisted of MacPherson struts up front and a multi-link setup at rear. Nissan's 4-wheel steering system, Super HICAS, was available as an option.

Thanks in part to the car's light weight — it tipped the scales at a lean <1170kg> — the turbocharged K's was quick off the line and made for an ideal drift machine. It was also a huge favorite among tuners, especially because the CA18DET could easily deliver <300ps> after a few tweaks. In fact, the S15 proved more popular to drifters and tuners than Nissan's signature FR sports car, the Z.
zh:
S13由自然进气引擎提供动力，平易近人的价格和优越的操作性是其备受欢迎的原因之一。

1988年至1993年生产的S13 Silvia凭借紧凑型后驱布局提供的出色操控性能赢得了无数车迷的喜爱。顶配K's车型搭载涡轮增压引擎，而Q's车型则搭载动力为140 PS的自然进气引擎。悬挂系统前部采用支柱系统，后部采用多连杆系统，还可选装“Super HICAS”四轮转向系统。

en:
This popular S15 model included side skirts and a rear spoiler.

Tapped as the savior of the brand, the seventh-generation Silvia made its debut in January 1999 amid the S14's struggle in the marketplace. Returning to basics, the S15 came with a more compact body, one more like the popular S13. This was Nissan's way of saying that the new Silvia wasn't intended to be luxurious, but very sports minded.

Under the hood was the same SR20 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4 that powered both the S13 and S14, only it was more refined than ever. The naturally aspirated variants produced <165ps> and <19.6kgm> of torque, while the turbocharged version pumped out <250ps> and <28.0kgm> of torque. The S15 was offered in two main trim levels: the naturally aspirated Spec S and the turbocharged Spec R that boasted a weight-to-power ratio of <4.96kg/ps>.

Retaining key components of the S13 and S14 chassis, Nissan drastically increased body rigidity, which improved handling. The S15s also received a helical LSD.

To broaden the car's appeal even more, a convertible version of the Spec S, called the Varietta, was introduced in 2000. However this year also marked the beginning of the end for the Silvia because it wasn't able to meet Japan's exhaust emission standards for 2000. Production of the S15 stopped in August 2002, marking the end of the 38-year Silvia dynasty that started in 1965.
zh:
S15最受欢迎的车型，侧面和尾部扰流板成为标配。

第七代S15 Silvia回归到类似S13的紧凑型设计，成为了一款价格亲民的后驱跑车。延续了前代车型的SR20引擎，但传动系统和悬挂经过了全面升级。车身刚性增强，制动系统升级，悬挂更具运动性，还配备了螺旋式限滑差速器，性能水平较前代车型大幅提升。

carNameEn: Nissan Silvia spec-R Aero (S15) Touring Car
en:
This popular S15 model included side skirts and a rear spoiler.

Alongside the Z and the GT-R, the Silvia (240SX) represented one of Nissan's most prominent sports cars. The seventh-generation Silvia (S15) was introduced in January 1999 with a smaller body than its predecessor and a focused sport-car-minded disposition.

Under the S15's hood was the SR20 engine, which also powered the S13 and S14, but tuned for enhanced performance. The naturally aspirated version produced <165ps> and <19.6kgm> of torque, while the turbocharged inline-4 pumped out <250ps> and <28.0kgm>. The S15 came in two trim levels: the Spec S and the Spec R, which also came with a manual 6-speed gearbox.

While sharing the same basic chassis of the S13 and S14, the new Silvia boasted a stiffer body structure, better braking performance and upgraded suspension system. It also featured a helical LSD that made it a much better handler then the S14.

The Spec R was the choice for enthusiasts, thanks partly to a weight-to-power ratio of <4.96kg/ps>. In 2000, a convertible model, the Varietta, was introduced with a naturally aspirated engine, but the entire line was discontinued just two years later, marking the end to this legendary model after 38 years.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
zh:
S15最受欢迎的车型，侧面和尾部的扰流板成为标配。

第七代S15 Silvia回归到类似S13的紧凑型设计，成为了一款价格亲民的后驱跑车。延续了前代车型的SR20引擎，但传动系统和悬挂经过了全面升级。车身刚性增强、制动系统升级、悬挂更具运动性，配备螺旋式限滑差速器，性能水平较前代车型大幅提升。

en:
Only 197 examples of this GT-R were made before it was discontinued because of stricter emissions standards.

The C10 Skyline, more commonly known as the Hakosuka, was succeeded by an all-new model in September 1972. The new car, designated C110 , came to be known as "Kenmeri" because its commercials featured a couple of models named Ken and Mary. The car was an instant hit, thanks to its attractive styling and excellent performance. The Kenmeri also included the four round headlights that defined previous Skylines.

The top-of-the-line GT-R was added to the Kenmeri lineup in January 1973. This car was designated inhouse as KPGC110, and it came equipped with the same legendary engine as its predecessor, the S20 inline-6. Output remained at <160ps> and <18.0kgm> of torque, as did the front strut and rear semi-trailing arm suspension, but the new 4-wheel disc brakes were an improvement over the previous model.

The car's dimensions were <4460mm> in overall length, with a width of <1695mm> and height of <1380mm>, not much different than the Hakosuka.

The Kenmeri GT-R should have won many races, but it wasn't able to compete because of stringent emissions regulations. You see, the S20 inline-6 was virtually a pure race engine, which meant it could not adhere to the new emissions laws. So, Nissan made the difficult decision of shelving the Kenmeri after only three months and 197 units produced, without it ever having raced. The GT-R name would lay dormant for another 16 years, until it returned in the form of the R32.
zh:
这款GT-R只生产了197辆，就因更严格的排放标准而不得不停产。

这是第四代“C110”Skyline的高性能车型。相比前代车型体型更大，搭载与“Hakosuka”GT-R相同的S20直列六缸引擎，并首次配备四轮碟式刹车系统。这款车旨在延续GT-R的辉煌传统，但新的排放法规导致其未能参加任何一场比赛就不得不结束赛车生涯。该车总共仅生产了197台。

en:
This top-of-the-line GT-R R33 included the ATTESA ET-S Pro high-performance all-wheel drive system.

When the new ninth-generation SKYLINE sedan, the R33, was introduced in August 1993, one model was conspicuously missing from the lineup: the GT-R. The R32 GT-R was still being sold at dealerships (all the way through November 1994), and Nissan engineers were working overtime to create a car that surpassed the R32. The car was finally unveiled at the 1993 Tokyo Motor Show, but fans still had to wait until January 1995 for it to hit dealerships.

Many had their doubts whether the R33 could surpass the awesome performance standards set by the R32, but it not only met everyone’s expectations, it surpassed them, proving this in a television commercial called “Minus 21-second Dream.” It showed the R33 running the famed Nürburgring race course 21 seconds faster than the R32.

Under the R33’s hood, which was now made of aluminum along with the front fenders, sat the RB26DETT, but this one was more refined. It pumped out a whopping <280 ps> at <6800 rpm> and <38.2 kgm> of torque at <4400 rpm>. Gear selection was performed through a 5-speed manual gearbox that sent power to all four wheels via Nissan’s ATTESA E-TS all-wheel-drive system. Also included in the handling mix was an active LSD, strut-tower bar and powerful ABS-equipped Brembo brakes.

To commemorate its entrance in the famed 24 Hours of Le Mans race, the LM Limited was introduced in 1996./
zh:
R33 GT-R的顶级车型，搭载ATTESA E-TS Pro系统。

R33 GT-R于1995年1月推出。在面对种种质疑时，如与前代车型相比获得了哪些提升，有哪些特点能让它成为历史上最伟大车型之一，Nissan为这款新车设计了“减掉21秒的梦”的广告词，着重宣传它在纽博格林赛道上的单圈成绩比R32缩短了整整21秒。新车型沿用了前代的RB26DETT引擎，但优化了引擎响应和扭矩。这款V-Spec型号同样也标配了Attesa E-TS Pro四轮驱动系统，能够实现主动限滑差速器（LSD）和防抱死刹车系统（ABS）的联动控制。

en:
This unique R32 GT-R came fitted with 17-inch BBS wheels, Brembo brakes and 45-series tires.

On August 21, 1989, after a 16-year hiatus following the legendary "Kenmeri" GT-R, the iconic GT-R badge made its triumphant return as part of the eighth-generation Skyline series.

Powering the car was the freshly developed RB26DETT, a twin-turbocharged 2.6-liter DOHC inline-6. Equipped with ceramic turbochargers, the engine delivered <280ps> and <36.0kgm> of torque, while being packed with motorsports-bred technology, including six individual throttle bodies, sodium-filled exhaust valves, and a reinforced cylinder block. The drivetrain featured the groundbreaking ATTESA E-TS system—an electronically controlled, torque-split 4WD system engineered with a clear focus on one goal: enhancing cornering performance.

The suspension employed Nissan’s unique multilink setup at both the front and rear, working in harmony with the brand’s Super HICAS 4-wheel steering system. Aluminum calipers were introduced to the braking system, with 4-pot opposing pistons in front and 2-pot opposing pistons at the rear.

Nissan resurrected the GT-R name with one clear mission: to dominate Group A racing. After pouring its cutting-edge technology into this machine, it became an unstoppable force on the circuit, going on to win race after race.

The company introduced several special variants that pushed the GT-R’s performance even further. This included the limited-edition Nismo model, followed later by the V·Spec and V·Spec II.
zh:
配备了Brembo刹车和45小尺寸轮胎的特殊R32 GT-R。

自从“Kenmeri”停产之后，R32 Skyline GT-R将成为16年来首次再度冠以GT-R之名的车型。全新开发的RB26DETT引擎配备有陶瓷双涡轮增压器，能够输出280 PS/36.0 公斤力米的动力。其传动系统采用了革命性的Attesa E-TS四轮驱动系统，着重满足“让车辆实现轻松转向”的需求。V-Spec II是1994年推出的高性能车型，采用了更宽大的245/45R17轮胎。

carNameEn: Nissan Skyline GT-R V･spec II Nür (R34) '02
en:
A limited-edition model signifying the end of production, the "Nür" stands for Nürburgring, where the car was developed.

The much anticipated R34 was unveiled in January 1999, armed with a total new approach to styling and technology. The new GT-R was a bit smaller than its predecessor, with a slightly shortened overall length and wheelbase. The new chassis, whose structural rigidity was increased dramatically, made for a car more adept through tight corners. The R34’s exterior styling was based on form over function with all the elements designed to help the car’s aerodynamics, including providing massive amounts of downforce at high speed.

For the engine, the RB26DETT saw significant improvements, including the refinement of the ceramic turbocharger that generated less friction. The 2.6-liter inline-6 was more efficient than before and produced more torque, rated at <40.0 kgm>. Horsepower remained level at <280 ps>, the maximum allowed for JDM cars at the time. The ATTESA-E-TS all-wheel-drive system efficiently managed torque between the four wheels. The R34’s steering system was also tweaked to exhibit more sharpness.

The high-performance V-spec model featured an active LSD (Limited-Slip Differential). The V-spec II, introduced in October 2002, got a carbon-fiber hood with NACA ducts. A better riding version of the GT-R arrived in May 2001 in the form of the M-spec.

As a final hurrah for the R34, in January 2002, Nissan unveiled the most potent GT-R ever, the Nür, whose name was derived from the famous Nürburgring race course in Germany.
zh:
以研发地为名；限量版V Spec II，为纪念停产推出。

R34 GT-R于1999年1月亮相。与尺寸更大的R33相比，这款新车采用了紧凑有力的车身设计，长度缩短了75毫米，轴距也缩短了55毫米。而日臻成熟的RB26DETT引擎也得到了进一步提升，扭矩提升到了40.0 公斤力米，再加上底盘优化，让这辆车的稳定性更上一层楼，操控性也更易预测。而“Nur”也是Nissan推出的最后一款搭载N1 spec RB26DETT引擎的限量车型。

en:
An unlikely monster machine born from the elegant lines of the seventh-generation Skyline.

Despite retaining the sporty appeal of the previous generation R30, the seventh-generation R31, when it was released in August 1985, marked a change of direction for the Skyline brand line. The Japanese car scene at the time saw a growing trend in luxurious "high-society cars." In response to this cultural boom, Nissan repositioned the Skyline as a luxury sedan.

When the car was introduced, the only variants available were a sedan and an estate. Not until May 1986 was the coupe model offered.

But the real star of the seventh-generation Skyline arrived in August 1987, when Nissan unveiled the GTS-R. Only 800 cars were made available, and the car's true raison d'etre was to reclaim the Group A racing title for Nissan.

The powerplant was based on the turbocharged RB20DET DOHC inline-6 featured in the GTS, which generated <180ps> and <23.0kgm> of torque. The GTS-R version added a stainless-steel exhaust manifold and a T04E turbocharger, resulting in <210ps> and <25.0kgm> of torque. This was a very special engine, earning itself the designation RB20DET-R.

The suspension and exterior of the car were also modified. While the normal GTS-X possessed an automatic front spoiler that deployed according to vehicle speed, the GTS-R instead had a fixed spoiler, with the rear spoiler also being upgraded to a larger version. And the car was offered in an exclusive Blue Black exterior.

Group A machines based on this GTS-R shined on the race track. The Reebok Skyline won three races in the Japan Touring Car Championship in 1989, taking home the series title. However, the GTS-R name sparked a fervent debate among fans, who wondered why it was not called a GT-R. The answer would be revealed in the form of the R32 Skyline GT-R, which was introduced two years after the release of the GTS-R.
zh:
这辆不可思议的怪物赛车脱胎于拥有优雅外形的第7代Skyline。

这款第7代Skyline高性能车型专为征战A组赛事而生。RB20DET引擎经过深度改装，配备不锈钢排气歧管和T04E涡轮增压器，悬挂系统和外观设计也进行了相应调整。它夺得了1989年全日本房车锦标赛赛季冠军，但同时也给车迷们留下了一个谜题——为何不以GT-R命名？

en:
This car, dubbed the "Hako-Suka," became a legend after winning 50 races in a row.

This GT-R, added to the Skyline (C10) line on February 1969, kick-started the glorious history of the brand, a few years after Nissan had taken over Prince Motors.

The car has since become a classic, going by the nickname "Hako-suka," which in Japanese means "box" and a shortened form of Skyline (suka-i-ra-in)," an obvious reference to its boxy overall body style.

Equipped with the S20 engine, a twin-cam inline-6 that was lifted from the famed R380 race car, the sporty GT-R model was made primarily for competition.

In fact, it was said that only the most skilled technician could perfectly adjust the high-tech valves and three carburetors to maximize the engine's potential. When it was tuned just right, the S20 had few equals, allowing the C10 Skyline GT-R to leave most of its rivals in the dust. The car also possessed excellent handling, thanks to its stable suspension system, with struts up front and a semi-trailing arm setup at rear.

The race version of the car was as dominant as there ever was. With famous drivers such as Moto Kitano and Kunimitsu Takahashi behind the wheel, the competition GT-R racked up 50 consecutive wins, making it one of the most successful race cars in history.
zh:
Skyline传奇的开启者。连续赢得50场比赛的传奇Hakosuka（方盒Skyline）。

这是C10 Skyline的高性能版本，昵称“Hakosuka”，于1969年2月正式发布。配备螺栓式宽体轮拱和源自R380赛车的S20双顶置凸轮轴引擎。此车创造了史无前例的赛车战绩，在其车厂车队停止参赛前共夺得52场胜利，其中包括49场连胜。Skyline的传奇历史正是由它开启的。

en:
An extraordinary Skyline that stood out in races of the 1980s)

The Hakosuka GT-R, which gets its nickname from "Hako" (square) and "Suka" (Skyline), took Japanese motorsports by storm and ended its illustrious career in 1972. But the legend of the Skyline refused to die, and fans continued to hope for its return many years after.

Their hopes became reality in 1982 when Nissan created a Silhouette Formula car based on the sixth-generation Skyline 2000RS, powered by a 4-valve DOHC engine that had not been in the lineup since the "Kenmeri" GT-R. (Ken Meri was a nickname that came from the car's commercials.) This was the Skyline Super Silhouette.

The Super Silhouette racecars were pure race cars that maintained the silhouette of production models. These cars were active in the Fuji Super Silhouette Series, which began as the supporting race for the Fuji Grand Champion Races in 1979, but the Silhouette Series soon became more popular than the main Grand Champion event.

The Skyline Super Silhouette is one of the most iconic cars from this series, with a look that is far from ordinary, to say the least. Sporting a chin spoiler that extends far forward of the car that nearly scrapes the tarmac, it also had fenders expanded to extreme levels at both the front and rear and a large rear wing. It came powered by a turbocharged 2.1-liter 4-cylinder race engine called the LZ20B. It often spit flames out of its exhaust, which was located just below the left door, making it an awesome presence on the track, completely mesmerizing car enthusiasts and race fans.

In the hands of legendary driver Masahiro Hasemi, it competed in the 1982 to 1984 seasons with eight wins to its credit. Because of regulation changes, it was active for three seasons, accounting for 19 races. People still refer to this car as the "extraordinary" Skyline, and it is still fondly remembered to this day.
zh:
一辆超凡卓绝的Skyline，在1980年代的赛事中脱颖而出

Skyline Super Silhouette是基于第6代Skyline打造的剪影方程式赛车（指一种仅保留量产车型基本轮廓的赛车）。配备了宽大的前后轮拱和大型后翼，车身内搭载着2.1升4缸涡轮增压“LZ20B”赛车引擎。这款车在1982年至1984年间斩获了8场胜利。

en:
The seventh-generation Z is a 21st century reinterpretation of the classic S30.

In September 2020, Nissan unveiled a new prototype Z car. Its design was reminiscent of the original 240Z (S30) that appeared in 1969. A few months later, Nissan announced that it would be building a production model scheduled to hit the market in North America in 2022. While the new Z would utilize the same platform of the previous model, sharing much of the same basic construction, everything else would be completely new.

The new Z features a complex mix of tradition and cutting-edge technology. The exterior follows on from the S30's iconic long nose, while dynamic touches like its undulating character lines and LED headlights make it look fresh. It also utilizes the latest developments in cooling and aerodynamic performance.

The previous generation's naturally aspirated engine was replaced by the powerful VR30DDTT, a twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 found in the Skyline 400R that produced <405ps>/<6500rpm> and 475 Nm (<48.4kgm>)/<1600rpm>-<5600rpm> of torque.

This powerplant was mated to a 9-speed automatic with manual mode or a traditional 6-speed manual. To keep the car's curb weight in check for the automatic-gearbox model, the engineers opted to use a magnesium alloy transmission case. Also, the front and rear dampers featured monotube construction that improved response and an advanced launch control system that ensured the car left the line with aplomb. This is the first time Nissan offered such a system on its rear-wheel-drive models.

Can this classic sports car survive in an industry increasingly moving towards automated driving and electrification? Time will tell, but we think it will not only survive but flourish._
zh:
第七代Z系列跑车是经典S30在21世纪的最新演绎。

第7代Fairlady Z的量产车型最初于2020年以原型车形式亮相。Nissan选择不采用电动传动系统，而是继续利用VR30DDTT 3升V6双涡轮增压引擎，匹配6速手动变速箱或带手动换挡模式的9速自动变速箱。虽然整个汽车行业都在关注自动驾驶和电动化革命，但这款车追求的却是前置引擎、后轮驱动跑车的浪漫主义。

carNameEn: Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo
sourceName: Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo
en:
This Vision Gran Turismo embodies the electric spirit of Opel’s GSE sports car brand.

The Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo stands as the 2025 highlight in Opel’s long tradition of concept cars. The brand with the Blitz logo was the first European manufacturer to unveil a concept car in 1965—the Experimental GT. Now, 60 years later, Opel once again broke new ground with a “phygital” concept—a physical show car that could also be driven in Gran Turismo 7.

The Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo draws upon Opel’s deep motorsports and performance heritage, blending it with the iconic Corsa nameplate while offering a glimpse of future generations of sporty GSE models bearing the Blitz insignia. In short, it embodies the essence of Opel’s GSE sub-brand, wrapped in a compact, all-electric high-performance machine.

To captivate the gaming community, the Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo combines outstanding efficiency with pulse-quickening driving dynamics. It's powered by two 350 kW (<476ps>) electric motors, one on each axle, for a combined output of 588 kW (<800ps>) and 800 Nm (<81.6kgm>) of torque. Also, its permanent all-wheel drive sharpens grip, refines handling, and elevates overall stability. With a single-speed transmission, it accelerates from zero to <100km/h> in just two seconds and reaches a top speed of <320km/h>.

Its stunning performance is mirrored by a bold, muscular presence. The car's muscular exterior is defined by sharp lines and intricate mechanical details. Overall, the Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo offers a sharper expression of Opel’s bold and pure design philosophy, highlighted by the sleek evolution of the next-generation Opel Vizor. 这款Vision Gran Turismo承载了Opel GSE运动品牌的电动精神，电力十足。

Opel Corsa GSE Vision Gran Turismo是一款全电动高性能概念车，将Opel对传统的敬意与对未来科技的激情完美融合。前后轴双电机总输出功率高达588千瓦（800 PS）。让车辆仅需2秒即可完成0-100 公里/小时加速，最高速度能达到320 公里/小时。它还拥有出色的空气动力学性能，配备主动式空气扩散器和后扰流板，确保高速行驶时的稳定性。

en:
Experience pure steering response in a car that generates powerful downforces directly from its body panels.

When PEUGEOT designers and PEUGEOT SPORT engineers teamed up to create an exceptional super car the result was PEUGEOT Vision Gran Turismo.

This racing car, specifically designed for the Anniversary Edition of Gran Turismo 6, brings together the major elements of a hyper-efficient endurance car. Boasting a radical style, the PEUGEOT Vision Gran Turismo stands out with its almost absent aerodynamic elements and its air-rending monolithic figure. Its design allows an aerodynamic support directly generated by the car bodywork, which reaches a mere 1.04 m (<1.04m>).

The PEUGEOT Vision Gran Turismo focuses on the driver. Behind them, in a rear central position, the 3.2L V6 turbo engine delivers its 875 ch (<887ps>) to the four permanent driving wheels, sized 22-inch at the front and 23-inch at the rear, via a mechanical 6-speed transmission.

Combined with the car's lightness of <875kg>, and its ideal mass distribution (48% at the front and 52% at the rear), the ultra-direct steering makes it the perfect ride to face up to the challenges of Gran Turismo. Its acceleration is exceptional thanks to its 1 kg/ch (1 kg/HP) weight/power ratio and its deceleration is just as formidable thanks to its 4 ventilated carbon discs with a diameter of 380 mm (15-inch) on the front, and 337 mm (13-inch) on the rear.

Are you ready to add your name to PEUGEOT SPORT’s great list of victories on every track of the world?

在直接通过车身板件产生下压力的跑车中体验纯粹的转向反应。

Peugeot设计团队和Peugeot Sport工程师们为PEUGEOT Vision Gran Turismo的诞生贡献了卓越的头脑。它的车身仅高1 米，仿佛紧紧趴在地面上一般，再加上它的3.2升V6涡轮增压引擎能够输出高达875的动力（887 PS），很明显这辆车唯一的开发焦点就是驾驶性能。
