en:
A car with bold styling, a lavish interior and a 6.0-liter twin-turbo Mercedes-AMG V12.

Argentine businessman Horacio Pagani's background as a designer worked in his favor when he established Pagani Automobili in Modena, Italy, and then, in 1999, announced the company's first supercar. After all, this is a man who worked on the Lamborghini Countach 25th Anniversary.

His first model, the Zonda, was developed with another famous Argentine, legendary race car driver Juan Manuel Fangio, who served as an adviser. The car focused purely on driving performance. It was an extremely expensive and limited-production model, but it certainly proved its mettle on the track, even recording the fastest lap time at the world-famous Nürburgring in Germany up to that point. Highly regarded by many, it sold out immediately.

The Zonda's successor, the Huayra, made its debut in 2011. It was produced with a newly developed monocoque frame, combining carbon and titanium, and incorporated the gullwing doors that were carried over from the Zonda. However, in contrast to the sharp, edgy styling of the Zonda, the Huayra instead adopted beautiful, flowing lines. It was a vehicle that married high quality craftsmanship with top tier supercar performance; the mostly carbon-fiber body encased a luxurious interior, which combined leather, aluminum and carbon. In terms of aerodynamics, the four variable flaps in the front and rear of the car automatically adjusted downforce, while also serving as air brakes.

Under its hood was the same 6.0-liter, hand-built AMG V12 of the Zonda, but twin-turbochargers were added for more power. The Huayra produced <700ps> and <102kgm> torque, and was combined with a 7-speed sequential transmission. With a 0 to <100km/h> acceleration of 3.2 seconds and a top speed of <378km/h>, it was one of the fastest cars ever built.
zh:
奢华的内饰，杰出的性能。这款高档超级跑车是高品质杰作的代表。

Pagani于2011年推出Huayra车型，用以接替Zonda。车身采用碳纤维与钛合金混合打造的单体车壳结构，配备鸥翼式车门，完美融合了精致设计与卓越性能。搭载AMG 6L V12双涡轮增压引擎，匹配7速序列式变速箱，0-100 公里/小时加速时间仅需3.2秒，最高时速可达378 公里/小时。

en:
The Zonda R featured an adjustable rear wing and a sequential-shift 6-speed transmission.\

Italian car manufacturer Pagani Automobili came to fame in 1999 when it introduced the Zonda, a very limited-edition super car for the extremely wealthy, at the Geneva Motor Show that year.

The company founder and president, Horacio Pagani, who once worked for Lamborghini and assisted in the design of the Countach anniversary model, set out to create a hand-made machine that would surpass all others in performance and styling. Many would agree that he did just that with the Zonda.

Looking like a Group C race car for the road, the Zonda C12's body was completely made of carbon fiber, helping the car to weigh in at an incredibly lean <1250kg>. Providing the power was a mid-mounted AMG V-12 engine that produced <394ps>.

There were a few variations of the Zonda after its initial release. This car, the Zonda R, was one meant strictly for the racetrack, like the Ferrari FXX. In this version, the AMG V12 was tuned to produce <750ps> and <72.4kgm> of torque, all managed by a 6-speed sequential gearbox. In order to raise stability on the racetrack, the car's wheelbase was lengthened and its tread width was extended. Also, a large front spoiler and a rear variable wing were added to improve downforce. According to Pagani, the Zonda R could accelerate from 0-<100km/h> in just 2.7 seconds and reach a top speed of <350km/h>.
zh:
赛道专用Zonda，搭载序列室变速箱和可变尾翼。

这是1999年推出的Zonda的纯赛车版本。其中置布局的AMG V12引擎能够输出750 PS/72.0 公斤力米。此外为了提升稳定性，这款车的轴距和轮距均有扩大。该车的0-100 公里/小时成绩为2.7秒，最高速度达到350 公里/小时。

en:
A masterpiece hot hatch from France that became a rally legend.

In 1983, after more than 15 years of production, the Peugeot 104 passed the torch as the brand's compact hatchback to the all-new 205.

Designed by Peugeot's in-house team, the 205 featured a transverse engine layout and quickly became a bestseller, thanks to its modern styling and comfortable interior.

But the story of the 205 doesn’t end there. Alongside its debut, Peugeot unveiled the 205 Turbo 16, a high-performance model developed specifically for competition in the World Rally Championship’s Group B category. Peugeot recognized the need for a road-going sports model that captured the spirit and capability of the 205 Turbo 16. This resulted in the creation of the iconic hot hatch, the 205 GTI.

Its greatest appeal lay in its high-performance engine. Although it only measured a mere <3.7m> long and weighed <900kg>, this compact car came powered by a high-revving 1.6-liter SOHC engine mated to a 5-speed manual gearbox.

In 1986, engine displacement was increased from 1.6 liters to 1.9, which resulted in a output of <130ps>. The car also featured an excellent suspension setup with struts on the front wheels and trailing arms at the rear. Through turns, the 205 GTI showcased exceptional performance, rivaling the reigning "king" of hot hatches at the time, the Golf GTI.

In Europe alone, sales of the Peugeot 205 GTI surpassed 300,000 units. This masterpiece of French engineering is one of the most important cars of 1980s-1990s automotive history.
zh:
一款来自法国的高性能掀背车杰作，也是拉力赛领域的传奇。

205 GTI是Peugeot以参加过世界拉力锦标赛的“205 Turbo 16”为蓝本打造的运动版车型。轻量紧凑的车身搭载强劲的1.6升顶置单凸轮轴引擎，成就了性能上的全面飞跃。这件法国汽车工程杰作仅在欧洲单地便售出超30万辆，是上世纪80至90年代汽车史不可或缺的篇章。

en:
This 4-wheel-drive pocket rocket took the Group B racing world by storm.

The 205 Turbo 16, a Group B car developed by Peugeot for the World Rally Championship, was similar to the production 205 in both looks and name, but it was an entirely different animal on the inside.

Built on a pipe frame chassis, the 205 Turbo was a converted mid-engine car, with its turbocharged 1.8-liter inline-4 that produced more than <350ps> placed where the rear seats once were. The engine sent power to all four wheels, while its double wishbone suspensions system at all four corners provided incredibly agile handling. To better access to the engine and rear suspension for maintenance, the rear half of the body shell from the B-pillar back was a single fiberglass piece that could be lifted out of the way.

The car made its racing debut at the 1984 Tour de Corse. That year it won three races and followed it up in 1985 with three more. But because Peugeot wasn't satisfied with those results, it manufactured an extra limited run of 20 specially modified cars. Called the 205 Turbo Evolution 2, they possessed a lighter frame, an improved engine, and a large rear-wing and became known as one of the monsters of Group B.

The 205 Turbo Evolution won seven out of the 12 Group B races in 1985 and six out of 13 in 1986, taking home both the manufacturers' and drivers' championship titles both years. However, its amazing run lasted until the end of 1986 when the FIA decided to discontinue the Group B category. Still, the car had made its mark and definitely carved out a place in the annals of automotive history.
zh:
这辆四驱中置引擎怪兽横扫了B组别的各项赛事。

205 Turbo 16是Peugeot为世界拉力锦标赛打造的一款B组别赛车。该车在1984首秀年便赢得3场赛事，并在接下来的1985年再夺3冠。Peugeot通过对重量、动力与空气动力学效应的优化进一步开发出Evolution 2车型。新车型在1985年12场赛事中7次折桂，并在1986年的13场比赛中再夺6冠，蝉联车手和车厂双料冠军。

en:
An exciting hot hatch with a distinctive French character.

The 208 GTi is the high-performance variant of the 208, Peugeot’s mainstream compact car. It made its official debut at the Paris Motor Show in the fall of 2012, following the launch of the new 208 series earlier that spring.

A key development goal for the 208 series was to redefine Peugeot’s B-segment offering, addressing the issue of the 207 becoming too large and heavy. While the 208 retained the 207’s platform, its overall length was reduced to less than <4m> by trimming the front and rear overhangs. Also, the use of lighter materials resulted in a <100kg> weight reduction compared to its predecessor.

This weight-saving effort particularly benefited the GTi model. It allowed Peugeot to rekindle the spirit of the legendary 205 GTI—a globally acclaimed sports model known for its compact size, agility, and thrilling performance.

Visually, the 208 GTi featured subtle yet distinctive enhancements, including a large roof spoiler, 18-inch wheels, and unique trim elements. Beneath the surface, however, significant engineering refinements were made. The front and rear track widths were widened by <10mm> and <20mm>, respectively, while the suspension, subframe, and control arms were specifically tuned for this model.

Power came from a turbocharged 1.6-liter inline-4 direct-injection engine, producing <200ps>/<28.0kgm>, paired with a 6-speed manual gearbox.

With a top speed of <230km/h> and a 0-<100 km/h> acceleration time of 6.8 seconds, it was among the hottest hatches in its class.-
zh:
轻盈、小巧、有趣、快速。时髦而现实的紧凑型跑车。

208 GTi是Peugeot的主打紧凑车型208的运动款。它的车身比前代207更小，全车构造和材料上的全面革新使得整车重量减轻超过100 公斤。230 公里/小时的最高时速和6.8秒的0-100 公里/小时加速时间让这台车跻身性能掀背车的前列。

en:
This Peugeot LMP took the top four spots in qualifying for the 2010 24 Hours of Le Mans, but not one finished the race.

The diesel-powered 908 HDi FAP is a car that Peugeot developed for many years, aimed to dominate the world of prototype racing. In 2007 and 2008, the company continued to perfect the machine using LMS races as a test bed, and finally in 2009, the car attained supremacy when it defeated its main rival, the Audi R10, also diesel-powered, at the 24 Hours of Le Mans with a 1-2 finish.

Peugeot went for two in a row at Le Mans the following year, with a new version of the car with reduced weight, revised aerodynamics and a completely reinforced drive system. Four cars were entered, three from Peugeot Sport and one from Team Oreca.

The driving teams assigned to these cars were first rate, with Anthony Davidson, Marc Gené, and Alexander Wurz piloting the No. 1 car; Nicolas Minassian, Frank Montagny, and Stéphane Sarrazin in the No. 2 car, and Pedro Lamy, Sébastien Bourdais, and Simon Pegenaud driving the No. 3 car.

The drivers were set on making their mark in qualifying as all three cars raced to the front of the grid, led by the amazing lap time set by Bourdais in the No. 3 car of 3 minutes 19.711 seconds.

But the fruits of victory don't always go to the quickest in racing, especially in a race that lasts 24 hours. All four Peugeot cars experienced mechanical trouble, and all four retired from the race. There was no doubt in anyone's mind that the Peugeots were the fastest cars on the track, so not finishing one car was especially disappointing for the company. You could hear the resolve of the team in a company spokesperson's statement after the race: “We'll learn from our defeat today to return stronger.”'
zh:
在2010年勒芒24小时耐力赛资格赛中包揽前几名的Peugeot LMP赛车。

Peugeot开发908 HDi FAP，旨在攀上原型车赛车领域的巅峰。2007至2008年，这台车征战LMS等赛事来进一步推动研发工作。2009年，它在勒芒24小时耐力赛中取得了辉煌的战果，击败了宿敌——Audi的柴油车R10，实现一二带回。2010年虽未能蝉联冠军，表现依然可圈可点。

en:
An electric hypercar that represents the racing spirit of Peugeot.

The Peugeot 9X8 was a Le Mans Hypercar (LMH) developed by Peugeot Sport with the goal of returning the French manufacturer to Le Mans glory. After stepping away from top-class endurance competition in 2011, Peugeot returned in 2022 under LMH regulations with the arrival of the 9X8. The "9" referenced its lineage to prototypes such as the 905 and 908. The "X" denoted its status as an all-wheel-drive hybrid built for the electrified era. Finally, the "8" reflected its connection to Peugeot’s modern production car lineup.

Upon its debut, the 9X8 attracted widespread attention for its radical aerodynamic concept, which initially eliminated the need for a rear wing. Its bodywork was shaped through extensive calculations balancing downforce and drag, challenging conventional ideas surrounding prototype race car design.

However, regulation revisions introduced during the 2022 season required adjustments to aerodynamic freedom and tire dimensions. To comply with the updated rules, the 2024 version adopted staggered tire sizes along with major revisions to weight distribution and aerodynamic balance. This dramatic evolution resulted in a redesign of roughly 90 percent of the bodywork, including the addition of a large rear wing.

The 2025 specification further refined these developments, creating the most complete version of the 9X8. Built around a hybrid powertrain combining a twin-turbocharged 2.6-liter V-6 engine with a front-mounted MGU, the car was engineered for reliability and consistent performance. It demonstrated its potential during the fiercely contested 2025 FIA World Endurance Championship season, where Peugeot secured a podium finish with 2nd place at Fuji. Developed through relentless innovation and refinement, the 9X8 became a striking expression of Peugeot’s engineering ambition and racin identity.
zh:
淋漓尽致诠释Peugeot赛车精神的电动终极跑车。

Peugeot在2022年依据勒芒终极跑车（LMH）规则重返耐力赛事的巅峰组别，这是自品牌2011年退出后，时隔11年的回归。该品牌为这次回归打造了全轮驱动混合动力车型9X8。最初的空气动力学设计成功省去了尾翼，但在2024年加装了这一部件。2025款车型在这些改进基础上进一步优化，最终呈现出现在的最终形态。在2025年国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛富士站中，它以第二名的成绩完赛，证明了自己的竞速潜力。

carNameEn: Peugeot L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo, 2017
sourceName: Peugeot L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo, 2017
en:
This Vision Gran Turismo pays homage to the legendary L45 race machine.

On May 30, 1916, Peugeot won the legendary “Indianapolis 500 Mile Race” with its L45 race car. One hundred years later, we pay homage to that achievement by bringing you the Peugeot L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo.

Filled with the latest technology, the L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo features sharp styling cues and an incredibly low profile. With even the bulge that covers the cockpit kept to a minimum, the car stands a mere <1m> tall. The tail section was inspired by the old L45 race car, ending in a streamlined shape with three distinctive rear lamp claws similar to that of the 3008, which is a Peugeot design cue today.

The cockpit utilizes a near-future user interface, with two holograms displaying a variety of information to the driver. Unlike the L45, the L500R is a single seater—the navigator has been replaced with a virtual navigator in this concept.

The L500R is powered by a 1.6-liter 4-cylinder turbocharged engine and two electric motors. Total output is <500ps> and maximum torque is <74.43kgm>. Utilizing the latest lightweight materials, the car weighs only <1000kg>. All this allows the Peugeot race car to run from 0-<100km/h> in 2.5 seconds and to the <1000m>-mark in just 19 seconds.

Peugeot has participated in many forms of motorsports all over the world, including the 24 Hours of Le Mans, WRC and Rally Raids. This innovative machine represents the company’s spirit and passion for competition.
zh:
专为致敬传奇的L45赛车而打造的Vision Gran Turismo。

这款Vision Gran Turismo车型的诞生是为了纪念Peugeot在1916年印地500英里比赛上取得的胜利。它采用了令人难以置信的低悬架设计，车身高度仅有1 米，而它那逐渐收窄的车尾设计则直接沿用自在印地赛上夺冠的L45赛车。其动力系统采用混动架构，搭载了一部1.6升4缸涡轮增压引擎和两部电机，总计能够输出500匹马力/730牛米（500 PS/74.0 公斤力米）。

carNameEn: Peugeot L750R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo, 2017
sourceName: Peugeot L750R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo, 2017
en:
This Vision Gran Turismo pays homage to the legendary L45 race machine.

On May 30, 1916, Peugeot won the legendary “Indianapolis 500 Mile Race” with its L45 race car. One hundred years later, we pay homage to that achievement by bringing you the Peugeot L500R HYbrid Vision Gran Turismo. To celebrate the release of Gran Turismo Sport, Peugeot decided to develop the L500R even more, creating the L750R HYbrid, a competition model with even more performance.

What mainly separates the L750R from the L500R is its power unit. By raising the rev limit of the turbocharged 1.6-liter inline-4 to <10000rpm>, output has been increased to 580 brake horsepower. And when you combine that with the 170 brake horsepower coming from the electric motors, you get a total output of 750 brake horsepower.

The L750R basically wears the same body as the L500R, but with improved aerodynamics. A large splitter has been added to the front, and the airflow of the underfloor has been further optimized. A rear wing has also been added to increase downforce. The L750R weighs <175kg> less than its stablemate, tipping the scales at <825kg>. This has improved the car’s 0-<100km/h> acceleration by 0.1 second, to 2.4 seconds.

Peugeot took the incredible L500R race car and refined it even further to create a truly remarkable machine that conveys the company’s passion and spirit for competition.
zh:
专为致敬传奇的L45赛车而打造的Vision Gran Turismo。

这是L500R Hybrid Vision Gran Turismo的赛事车型。原版L500R的1.6升4缸引擎的转速限制器被拉高到每分钟10000转，从而将最大动力输出推高到了580马力。再加上几部电机提供的170马力，其总动力输出达到了750马力。在外观方面，它在车头下加装了一部大尺寸前扰流板，外加一部大尺寸尾翼，有效地提升了下压力。

en:
A unique car with a double-bubble rear roof.[

At the Peugeot booth of the 2007 Frankfurt Motor Show, there was a concept car displayed with flowing lines: the “308 RCZ”. This sports car was notable for its wide and low silhouette, with a cabin offset forward due to its midship layout. From the center of the roof to the rear glass, a double-bubble design was utilized, giving it a unique style.

This was a design study based on the 308, but it gathered a lot of attention, with many fans wanting to see the car actually produced. To answer their call, the car was finally released in 2010 with a style that was virtually unchanged from the prototype. It was named with no 308 designation but simply as the “RCZ”.

The engine is a 1.6-liter inline 4-cylinder turbo, with two models producing <156ps> and <200ps> respectively. The <200ps> version is given an engine that becomes more lively as the engine RPM becomes higher, and a suspension system carried over from the original 308 series is made stiffer for sports driving. The combination gave the car a level of performance that provided a fulfilling sports driving experience.

Then in 2012, the RCZ underwent a minor change. This was mostly a stylistic change with the opening of the grille made smaller, the addition of a black light unit and LED position lights, and the overall facelift of the front end, giving it a chic style and appearance.

The GT Line is a grade model added from 2015, with a special front grille, double exhaust pipes, 19-inch wheels, and red stitched black leather interior for a sportier look.
zh:
具有双气泡后车顶的独特车型。

The combination gave the car a level of performance that provided a fulfilling sports driving experience.

Then in 2012, the RCZ underwent a minor change. This was mostly a stylistic change with the opening of the grille made smaller, the addition of a black light unit and LED position lights, and the overall facelift of the front end, giving it a chic style and appearance.

The GT Line is a grade model added from 2015, with a special front grille, double exhaust pipes, 19-inch wheels, and red stitched black leather interior for a sportier look.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.

Peugeot RCZ紧凑型双门轿车的Gr.3公路车版。

RCZ是Peugeot的特色车型，拥有优雅流畅的外观，而这辆车则是专为Gr.3规则改装的跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。为了优化配重比和整体性能，这辆车的传动系统从前置前驱改为了中置后驱布局。RCZ那2,612毫米的长轴距也让它成为了赛车改装的完美候选者。

en:
This is a Gr.4 race car version of the stylish Peugeot RCZ compact coupe.

At the Peugeot booth of the 2007 Frankfurt Motor Show, there was a concept car displayed with flowing lines: the “308 RCZ”. This sports car was notable for its wide and low silhouette, with a cabin offset forward due to its midship layout. From the center of the roof to the rear glass, a double-bubble design was utilized, giving it a unique style.

This was a design study based on the 308, but it gathered a lot of attention, with many fans wanting to see the car actually produced. To answer their call, the car was finally released in 2010 with a style that was virtually unchanged from the prototype. It was named with no 308 designation but simply as the “RCZ”.

The engine is a 1.6-liter inline 4-cylinder turbo, with two models producing <156ps> and <200ps> respectively. The <200ps> version is given an engine that becomes more lively as the engine RPM becomes higher, and a suspension system carried over from the original 308 series is made stiffer for sports driving. The combination gave the car a level of performance that provided a fulfilling sports driving experience.

Then in 2012, the RCZ underwent a minor change. This was mostly a stylistic change with the opening of the grille made smaller, the addition of a black light unit and LED position lights, and the overall facelift of the front end, giving it a chic style and appearance.

一款专为Gr.B拉力赛调校的Peugeot RCZ紧凑型双门轿车。

en:
This compact SUV showcases Peugeot design cues throughout.

Peugeot has long been known for crafting spirited compact cars. This legacy continues to shine in today’s SUV-dominated market. The brand found success in 2013 with the debut of the original 2008 compact SUV, and in 2019, Peugeot elevated the concept further with the launch of the next-generation 2008.

Peugeot’s traditional naming convention—three digits with a zero in the center—evolved with the rise of SUVs, expanding to four digits. The 2008 follows this format, sharing the same CMP platform as its hatchback sibling, the 208.

Measuring just <4.3m> in length, the 2008 may be compact in size, but it projects all the presence and stature expected of a true SUV. Its sharp, angular motifs evoke the image of a lion’s claws and fangs, a design language that has become a hallmark of Peugeot’s identity.

Step inside, and you’re greeted by Peugeot’s distinctive 3D i-Cockpit, a driver-focused layout that sets the cabin apart. At its heart is a compact, flat-topped and -bottomed steering wheel. Just above it sits a head-up digital instrument cluster, cleverly elevated to fall within the driver’s natural line of sight.
zh:
这款紧凑型SUV处处展现Peugeot的设计风格

Peugeot 2008于2013年推出。展示的这台2008 SUV为该系列的第二代车型。它采用与Peugeot“208”掀背车相同的开发平台。灯具设计融入了狮子爪牙的元素。这款紧凑型SUV的另一个显著特点是“3D i-Cockpit”，由上下扁平的小直径方向盘和位于其上方中央的抬头数字仪表盘组成。

en:
This stock car for the street had a wedge-shaped front end and one of the tallest rear wings ever to grace a production car.

From the middle of the 1969 season, the Charger 500 Daytona made its appearance in stock car racing. It took full advantage of its aerodynamics, and was performing very well. This in turn raised demand from teams racing Plymouth race cars which are in the same Chrysler group, for a model that has the same aerodynamics as the Daytona.

The answer to those demands was the Superbird.

Because Plymouth did not produce a vehicle that could be considered the sibling of the Charger, the Road Runner — with the same intermediate-class chassis — was selected to be its base.

Because of the familiar extended nose and rear wing, it looks very similar to the Daytona, but there are slight differences to details such as the shape of the roof.

Because the number of cars required for homologation was doubled in 1970 from 500 cars to 1000, and with the Daytona’s performing so well on the circuit, many Superbirds made it to the streets, not just the circuit.

The base engine for the Superbird was the <375ps> 440 Super Commando, with a 426 Hemi producing over <425ps>, and a <390ps> 440 six barrel as options. This was more in line with the GTX, which was ranked above the Road Runner.

The Superbird was produced, like the Daytona, during the homologation certification period of only one year.
zh:
这是一辆拥有令人难以置信的巨大尾翼和延展车头的原厂赛车。

这是Plymouth在Chrysler集团旗下推出的赛事认证车型，专为征战原厂量产车赛事而生。基础版Road Runner配备了加长车头和巨型尾翼，营造出独特的视觉效果。标配375 PS的440 Super Commando引擎，另可选装输出超过425 PS的426 Hemi引擎或输出390 PS的六腔化油器版本引擎。它只在为期一年的赛事认证期间内生产。

en:
The Gran Turismo Trophy winner, with unique asymmetric styling.

The car that won the Gran Turismo Trophy at the 61st Pebble Beach Concours d’Elegance in 2011 was this 1960 Plymouth XNR Ghia Roadster.

The designer was Virgil Exner, the legend who led the golden years of Chrysler in the 1950s and 1960s. The XNR Ghia Roadster, which inherited his name in abbreviated form, was actually built by Carrozzeria Ghia, a company that Exner had close ties with.

Plymouth represented the entry-level brand for Chrysler, but that didn't stop Exner from incorporating technology into his creation that had trickled down from Chrysler's involvement in NASCAR. This concept car was made as the future of sports cars that would rival cars like the Chevrolet Corvette and Ford Thunderbird.

By far, the most striking feature was its asymmetric styling. From the air intake in the car's nose to the flow from the headrest to the rear, it's Exner's interpretation of aerodynamic styling that characterized 1950s racing. The cockpit's right side is covered with a tonneau cover which makes the car appear to be a single-seater at first glance, but there actually is a seat hiding under the cover, making it a fully-fledged 2-seat sports car.

The prominent fins on the sides of the body were actually a shared design feature from the Valiant, the car on which the concept car was based. Although its overly avant-garde styling ultimately proved too much for the market, thus prohibiting the car from making it to mass production, the XNR did manage to make major shockwaves in the car design realm at the time and gave a glimpse into the depth of American Automotive History.
zh:
Gran Turismo奖杯获得者，独树一帜的不对称设计风格让人眼前一亮。

由汽车设计大师维吉尔·埃克斯纳在1960年献上的一款敞篷跑车杰作。它采用非对称风格、引擎盖鼓起式进气口和气动翼面设计，成为了埃克斯纳对1950年代赛车精彩的全新演绎。这款车在2011年赢得了“Gran Turismo奖杯”。

en:
Polestar's flagship model combines sustainability with high-performance.

The Polestar 5 is the flagship model of the Scandinavian high-performance electric brand, Polestar. It represents the realization of ideas introduced by the Precept concept car in 2020, embodying pure Scandinavian design, advanced technology, and sustainability.

Its stretched form, measuring <5m> in length, draws inspiration from aircraft, while the panel structure and expansive glass roof, extending toward the rear, contribute to its aerodynamic efficiency. With a drag coefficient of just 0.24, the bonded aluminum body delivers a lightweight yet rigid structure, offering greater torsional rigidity than many sports cars.

The powertrain employs a dual-motor system built around an in-house developed electric rear motor. The Performance Edition is capable of a total system output of 650 kW (<884ps>) and runs from zero to <100km/h> in just 3.2 seconds. Its 800 V electric architecture enables 350 kW fast charging, replenishing the battery from 10 percent to 80 in only 22 minutes. Maximum range under WLTP testing reached <670km> for the Dual Motor edition.

The suspension consists of a specially designed double-wishbone layout. The Performance Edition features magnetorheological dampers that read the road surface up to 1,000 times per second, balancing agility with comfort. Driver assistance systems extend further, with automatic lane and speed control operating up to <150km/h>.

With futuristic design, remarkable electric performance, and a deep commitment to sustainability, the Polestar 5 stands as the ultimate grand tourer package.
zh:
将可持续性理念与高性能完美融合的Polestar旗舰车型。

由北欧电动汽车品牌Polestar打造的Polestar 5是一款全轮驱动电动轿车，其特点是拥有修长的5 米流线型车身以及一直延伸至车尾的玻璃车顶。它采用双电机布局，前后轴各配备一台电机。性能版车型可输出650千瓦功率和1015牛米扭矩。800伏电气架构支持350千瓦快速充电，仅需22分钟即可将电池电量从10%提升至80%。在WLTP测试下，最大续航里程为670 公里（双电机版）。

en:
Made famous by Burt Reynolds in "Smokey and the Bandit," this was one of the leading '70s muscle cars.

Pontiac was the sporty upscale brand of General Motors, and the model which helped define the division in its heyday was an American muscle car called the Firebird. It was created to take on Ford's ultra-popular pony car, the Mustang.

Many variations of the Firebird were produced in order to compete against its famous rival, with Pontiac making the cars faster and more luxurious. The top model "Trans Am" was a car enthusiast's dream: the name of this top-of-the-line model, which ended up becoming more famous than the original "Firebird" name, was taken from the popular sports car racing series. The Pontiac Trans Am, with its giant Firebird sticker garnishing the hood, became a revered muscle car, and a classic American automotive symbol of the 1970s.

The final 1978 model of the second-generation series was available with both a 400 or 403 cubic inch V8. The big, high-compression 6.6-liter mill was an engine exclusive to Pontiac, and was not available in its pony car brother, the Chevrolet Camaro. The brass at Pontiac figured that instead of aligning the Trans Am with the Camaro, they were better off developing a special engine unique to the Firebird. Also, the car possessed a four-headlamp design, instead of the customary two, which differentiated it from the Camaro and other GM products.

The car was a great hit, and the Firebird Trans Am lives on in infinite lore as the car driven by Burt Reynolds in the movie "Smokey and the Bandit."
zh:
来自1970年的头号肌肉车，核心是一颗自行研发的特殊引擎。

这是一台20世纪70年代极具代表性的肌肉车。引擎盖上的大型火鸟贴花在当时深受年轻车迷喜爱。它是Chevrolet Camaro的兄弟车型，但这台顶配Trans Am版本搭载了Camaro上不可选的特殊6.6升引擎，代表了Pontiac的骄傲。

en:
The ultimate sports spec car that appeared towards the end of the GTO era, when muscle cars flourished.

The first-generation Pontiac GTO, which was introduced in 1964, was a big hit and is credited for the boom in street-legal muscle cars. The second-generation model followed in 1968 with a more stylish fastback style and decent performance. It wasn't enough to prevent the GTO from losing its king-of-the-hill status to its increasingly impressive rivals, however.

Keen to rectify this situation, in 1969, General Motors released a new GTO known as "The Judge." The standard sports package wore an exclusive logo and stripe decals, and powered by a 6.6-liter V-8 "Ram Air 3" engine that was said to be capable of more than the advertised <366ps>. It was mated to a Hurst shifter. The car had a heavy-duty suspension system, wide tires, and a rear spoiler. Despite all this, it only cost $332 more than the standard GTO. In terms of both performance and sheer presence, it outdid its rivals and attracted plenty of attention.

Muscle cars such as the GTO started to disappear when strict emissions regulations were introduced a couple of years later.
zh:
在肌肉车首次领跑的GTO时代末期出现的终极运动规格车辆。

1968年推出的第二代Pontiac GTO被誉为肌肉车的鼻祖之一，但面临着众多强劲对手的竞争。“The Judge”运动套件的推出正是为了终结这场争论。这个套件包含6.6升V8“Ram Air III”引擎、Hurst换挡器、重型悬挂系统、宽胎和后扰流翼，让GTO重新夺回了王者地位。

en:
A semi-race equipped model of the 356A, one of the cars that contributed to the Porsche mystique.

The 356, Porsche's first mass-produced car, made its debut in 1949 and immediately revolutionized the compact sports-car genre. An updated version of the original model called the 356A appeared in 1955 and again in 1959.

The 356A featured a rounded windshield, soft padding above the interior panels, and a horn at the center of the steering wheel. Performance of the car increased every year, ultimately leading to the 1500 GS Carrera and the 1500 GS GT Carrera, which were limited-production models billed as the GT3 of their day.

Powering the 356A was a slightly detuned version of the 4-cam engine found in the 550 Spyder race car. The road-going 1500 GS Carrera produced <100ps>, while the track-ready 1500 GS GT Carrera pumped out <110ps>. Both cars were offered as a coupe, cabriolet, and speedster.

Of particular note is that the 1500 GS Carrera was the first to go by the "Carrera" name, which has now become synonymous with Porsche.
zh:
356A的半赛事车型，该车使Porsche闻名于世。

1949年推出的356 A是Porsche首款量产车型356的改进版。356A有两个版本，所搭载的引擎均来自550 Spyder，但性能经过下调。公路车1500 GS Carrera能输出100 PS，半赛车1500 GS GT则能输出110 PS。这款车更是首次启用了Porsche如今标志性的“Carrera”子车型命名。

carNameEn: Porsche 356 A/1500 GS GT Carrera Speedster '56
en:
With the introduction of this model, Porsche became known as a maker of the world's finest sports cars.

The Porsche 356, the German sports car maker's first mass-production model, made its debut in 1949. It went through major updates in 1955 and 1959. During these two updates, the car was referred to as the 356A.

The 356A was simply a modernized version of the original, with a rounded windshield, soft padding above the interior panels, and a horn at the center of the steering wheel. The performance of the 356A improved every year, which ultimately led to the creation of the 1500 GS Carrera and the 1500 GS GT Carrera, a pair of limited-production models that were in essence the GT3s of their day.

Power came from a slightly detuned version of the 4-cam engine found in the 550 Spyder race car. The 1500 GS Carrera, offered as the road-going model, produced <100ps>, while the track-ready 1500 GS GT Carrera pumped out <110ps>. The two cars came in the forms of a coupe, cabriolet, and speedster.

Of particular note is that these cars were the very first to carry the "Carrera" moniker, a name that has now become synonymous with Porsche. !
zh:
让保时捷成为知名跑车制造商的历史车型。

Porsche的首款量产跑车，首次亮相于1949年。于1955年至1959年间发布的车型被统称为356 A，采用的引擎基于550 Spyder。定位为半赛车的1500 GS GT Carrera版本可输出110 PS的动力，是首款冠以“Carrera”之名的车。

en:
A first in Porsche 911 history, the elusive Rennsport.

Introduced in 1973, the 911 Carrera RS 2.7 was the first model in the long history of the Porsche 911 to feature the RS badge. The "RS" stands for "Rennsport," which is translated as "racing sport" in English. As its name suggests, this sports car was developed as a homologation model for the FIA's Group 4 category.

Mounted at the rear is a 2.4-liter engine from the base model 1973 911 S, but displacement was increased to 2.7 liters, which in turn upped power to <210ps>. The front end was modified to house an air dam that fed into an oil cooler. The tail section of the car featured the iconic duck-tail spoiler as standard fare, and the fenders were stretched to make room for wider rear tires.

The Carrera RS 2.7 came in three grades: Touring, Sport and Racing. Of note, even the luxury-oriented Touring model weighed less than <1100kg>.

The car was originally produced in a limited homologation run of 500 units; however, because it sold out almost immediately, Porsche increased production to 1,580 units.
zh:
Porsche 911历史上首款冠以稀有的Rennsport之名的型号。

Porsche 911史上首款冠以“RS”徽标的车型是1973年发布的911 Carrera RS 2.7。RS代表“Rennsport”，也就是“比赛运动型”的意思。这款车是专为满足国际汽联Group 4组别赛事认证而开发的。上市后反响极为热烈，原计划生产的500台瞬间售罄。Porsche随后增产并总计生产了1580台。

en:
This Porsche was a lighter version of the third-generation 911 Carrera 2 and came with a 3.6-liter flat-6.

In 1989, Porsche introduced the Type 964, the third-generation version of the popular 911. While the car featured approximately 80 percent new parts, it nevertheless stayed true to the elements that defined all 911s before it. What was different about this one was that the first model offered, the Carrera 4, came equipped with a new 4WD system originally developed for the vaunted 959. The lighter 2WD version of the 964, called the Carrera 2, came a year later in 1990.

All Type 964 911s came powered by an air-cooled flat-6, mounted aft of the rear wheels, with 3.6 liters of displacement. The Type 964 produced <250ps>/<31.6kgm>.

The Carrera RS was a performance model based on the Carrera 2, with a more rigid body structure and less weight (lighter by <120kg>). Power was upped to <260ps>, making this model a monster on the race track. A turbocharged 911 would appear later, with the top-of-the-line Turbo S delivering a whopping <381ps>.
zh:
引擎排气量增加到3.6L。这款跑车车型是第三代911 Carrera 2的轻量化版本。

1989年，Porsche推出第3代911，这便是Type 964。造型上虽然与前代911颇为相近，实则约80%的零部件都是全新设计。四驱款Carrera 4率先发布，后驱款Carrera 2于1990年问世。Carrera RS是在Carrera 2基础上衍生的性能车型。

en:
The most powerful version of the 993, the last air-cooled Porsche, came with a 3.8-liter flat-6 producing <300ps>.(

The Porsche 911 entered its fourth generation in 1993 with the introduction of the Type 993.

The most noticeable change was a significantly lower nose that flattened the peaks of the front fenders and swept the headlights rearward. The rear fenders were widened, among other revisions, giving the car an entirely new look. The rear suspension was also redesigned with a multilink setup to improve handling.

The base engine was a 3.6-liter flat-6 carried over from the previous Type 964 and tuned to <272ps>. With the succeeding 911 (996) moving to water cooling, the 993 became the last air-cooled flat-6 911.

The most powerful version of the Type 993 was the Carrera RS, released in 1995. Its engine was enlarged to a <300ps> 3.8-liter unit, body rigidity was increased, and weight was reduced by removing the rear seats.

The lineup also included the Carrera RS Clubsport, which featured track-oriented modifications such as a large front spoiler, a rear wing and a welded roll cage.
zh:
搭载一台3.8L水平对置6缸引擎，可产生300 PS动力。作为993最强大的车型，这是最后一款采用风冷的Porsche。

Porsche 911于1993年推出了代号为993的第四代车型。在造型设计更新的同时，悬挂系统也得到了改良，进一步提升了操控性能。最高性能版本是1995年推出的Carrera RS，采用了更加坚固，同时也更轻量化的车身结构。该车还搭载了993系列最后一款风冷引擎——一款3.8升水平对置6缸引擎，最大动力300 PS。同时还提供了专为赛道设计的Carrera RS Clubsport版本。

en:
This version of the Type 993, the final air-cooled Porsche 911, was designed specifically for the race track.

The Porsche 911 entered its fourth generation in 1993 with the introduction of the Type 993.

The most noticeable change was a significantly lower nose that flattened the peaks of the front fenders and swept the headlights rearward. The rear fenders were widened, among other revisions, giving the car an entirely new look. The rear suspension was also redesigned with a multi-link setup to improve handling.

The base engine was a 3.6-liter flat-6 carried over from the previous Type 964 and tuned to <272ps>. With the succeeding 911 (996) moving to water cooling, the 993 became the last air-cooled flat-6 911.

The most powerful version of the Type 993 was the Carrera RS, released in 1995. Its engine was enlarged to a <300ps> 3.8-liter unit, body rigidity was increased, and weight was reduced by removing the rear seats.

The lineup also included the Carrera RS Clubsport, which featured track-oriented modifications such as a large front spoiler, a rear wing and a welded roll cage.
zh:
专为赛道打造的Type 993，最后一款911风冷车型。

第四代Porsche 911（代号993）于1993年进行了全面改款换代。1995年推出的Carrera RS采用了更加坚固和轻量的车身，搭载300 PS的3.8升水平对置6缸引擎。车系中还包括了Carrera RS Clubsport版本。后者专为赛道使用而调校，配备了大型前扰流板、尾翼以及焊接式防滚架。

en:
A road-going version of the 911 GT1 was developed by Porsche to compete in GT racing.

As its name implies, the 911 GT1 Strassenversion was the "street version" of the 911 GT1, a race car developed to compete in grand touring races between 1996 to 1998. Because the FIA required that every GT1 race car needed to be based on a production car with at least 25 units produced, Porsche homologized the 911 GT1 into the vehicle you see here.

Introduced in 1996, the 911 GT1 race car used the Type 993 chassis converted into a mid-engine layout. Power came from a twin-turbocharged 3.2-liter flat-6 that produced <640ps>. A year later, the production version of the GT1 was released wearing the front fascia of the Type 996, but possessing the same basic architecture of the race car.

The engine was relatively unchanged, but power was decreased to <544ps> to meet European emissions standards. Still, the race car-converted-into-street car was remarkably quick, thanks to its lean curb weight of <1100kg>, which allowed the 911 GT1 Strassenversion to run from zero to <100km/h> in a scant 3.7 seconds and reach a top speed of <308km/h>.!
zh:
911 GT1的公路版，此车是Porsche为GT赛事而专门开发的。

Porsche在1996至1998年间为GT赛事开发了911 GT1赛车，911 GT1 Strassenversion是该车的道路合法版本。车灯改为与type 996相同的配置，但车辆的基础结构与赛车版本几乎别无二致。为符合排放法规，引擎动力下调至544 PS，但该车依然能够实现3.7秒的0-100 公里/小时加速时间，最高时速达308 公里/小时。

en:
The 911's first GT3 spec model was introduced for the Type 996. It proved to be very popular, selling 1889 units.

It can arguably be said that the Porsche 911 is the quintessential sports car, with many race versions found in all kinds of series all over the world, as well as various trim levels to satisfy the most demanding enthusiast. Nowadays, the GT3 model is the closest thing you can get to a race-ready car, and this super-focused model first appeared in the 911 lineup in 1999.

In the midst of the Type 996 production run (1997 to 2002), the GT3 was introduced using the Carrera 4 chassis, which possessed a stiffer body and was slightly wider than the C2's. In addition to suspension upgrades, the 911 GT3 utilized the brake system (calipers and discs) of the 911 Turbo for better stopping power from higher speeds.

The engine featured what is called a GT1 crank case, a high-strength unit used for race cars to withstand heavy loads at high rpm. The cylinder head came equipped with Variocam Plus, a two-stage variable-valve lift mechanism. The 3.6-liter naturally-aspirated engine produced <360ps>, which was <60ps> more than the standard 3.4-liter flat-6.

Initially, the 911 GT3 was planned for a limited production run of 1400 cars, but a total of 1889 cars were built to satisfy high demand.
zh:
Type 993引入了911系列中的首款GT3规格车型。这款车深受消费者的喜爱，现已售出1,889辆。

最初于1997年推出的996款911是首款GT3车型。以高刚性的Carrera 4车身为基础，悬挂和刹车均升级为赛车级部件，而引擎则用适合更高转速的GT1曲轴箱来搭配。此车总共生产了1889台。

en:
Featuring adjustable dampers as standard equipment, this GT3 version of the Type 997 made its debut in 2006.

The GT3 model joined the Porsche 911 lineup in 2001, during the Type 996 production run (1997 to 2002). The 911 GT3 proved to be as fast as it was popular, prompting Porsche to offer it for its Type 997 911. The new 997 911 GT3 was introduced in 2006, and like its predecessor, it was a race car in road-car clothing, still built on the Carrera 4 chassis with various reinforcements and brake upgrades.

While the 3.6-liter flat-6 was basically the same as the one found in the 996 GT3, it did get a power increase of <34ps>, raising the final number to <415ps>. And for handling improvements, the new GT3 (as well as the RS) came equipped with PASM variable damping shocks.

In 2008, the 911 GT3 received a performance upgrade, with engine displacement increased from 3.6 to 3.8 liters. Thanks also to slight tuning of the exhaust system, the car was rated at an incredible <435ps>. The suspension system was also stiffened and a new PSM system was added to control the car's stability and traction.
zh:
这款GT3版本的Type 997于2006年发布，标配可调式避震。

2006年为997款911推出的GT3规格车型。以Carrera 4车型为基础，底盘和刹车得到了和前代996车型一样的升级。最初的3.6升引擎排量在2008年扩容至3.8升，动力输出达435 PS。此外，还标配了电控PASM可变式减震器。

en:
This is a pure racing machine from the 8th generation 911 catalogue.

Since the introduction of the original Porsche 911 more than half a century ago in 1963, the 911 had long been regarded as the epitome of the sports car on both public roads and race circuits around the world. With its unique rear-mounted flat-6 engine and highly tuned performance, the 911 series had claimed victory in countless races, cementing its position in automotive history.

This bloodline was continued by the eighth-generation "992" model 911, released in 2018. With features such as stretched rear fenders on all models, 4-point LED headlights, and intricate rear combination lamps, this car became the true embodiment of modern Porsche design philosophy. Built around a turbocharged 3.0-liter flat-6, technological upgrades like improved cooling and the 8-speed PDK transmission allowed for peak performance from everyday driving to spirited sports use.

The 992 model was also developed into a pure racing machine as the 911 GT3 R.

Introduced in 2022, this car housed a 4.2-liter flat-6 engine producing up to <565ps>. It featured carbon-fiber and aramid-woven components, along with the double-wishbone and multilink suspension from the 911 RSR.

The brakes featured AP Racing discs, while the driver controls were updated with new steering components and a 10.3-inch user display. The 911 GT3 R represented the culmination of all Porsche’s racing knowledge and technology—a single purpose-built car designed to dominate the circuit.
zh:
脱胎于第八代911车系的纯粹竞速机器。

911 GT3 R是一款纯粹为赛道而生的跑车，基于Porsche面向日常使用的911跑车的第八代车型992来研发。这款于2022年发布的赛车装备了一台自然进气的4.2升水平对置六缸引擎，可产生高达565 PS的动力。其车身还采用了轻量化的碳纤维车身板件和芳纶纤维部件，以及沿袭自911 RSR的双摇臂/多连杆悬挂配置。

en:
The ultimate 991, rebuilt from the ground up.

Since the Type 996, the name "GT3" had been given to Porsche 911 roadcars with a strong emphasis on motorsports, developed with FIA GT3 race regulations in mind. And for the 996 and the later 997, there exists a "GT3 RS," which further refines the GT3 and improves its performance. At the 2015 Geneva Motor Show, the successor to these, the Type 991 GT3 RS was announced.

The model is said to be based on the Type 991 GT3, but on the inside it is something that looks like it has been developed from scratch using all the knowhow they have gathered over the years.

The body takes the widest 911 Turbo model, with track widths in the front and rear widened even further. The roof is made of magnesium, the front fenders and hood are carbon fiber. The rear and rear side windows are acrylic, giving a total weight reduction of <10kg>.

Aerodynamic parts have also been updated. The front spoiler is even lower and wider, and the rear wing stands much higher and is larger. Behind the front fenders are air outlets for drawing air out from under the car. As a result, the downforce is more than double that of a standard 911.

The engine takes the 3.8-liter engine of the GT3 and extends its stroke, making it 4.0 liters in displacement. The tuned engine now produces <25ps>/<2.0kgm> more, at <500ps>/<46.9kgm>. And the dampers, springs and stabilizers for both the front and rear have been newly developed for this car.

As a result the car lapped the Nürburgring at 7 minutes 20 seconds, a full 5 seconds faster than the base 911 GT3.
zh:
从零开始全新打造的终极版911。

这款高性能车型是991系列中的Porsche 911 GT3的改进版。基于911 Turbo的宽体车身，前后轮距加宽，同时进行了大幅减重和空气动力学方面的改进。如今引擎排量扩容至4升，动力输出达500 PS，得以在纽博格林北侧赛道创下7分20秒的圈速。

en:
A hyper-performance road car packed with race car features.

Introduced in the summer of 2022, the Porsche 911 GT3 RS (992) was a high-performance road car that brought the aerodynamics of the 911 GT3 R race car to the 992 model.

Visually, the car shared more in common with race cars than even its predecessor, the 991.2 model GT3 RS. Its most prominent feature was the swan-neck-mounted rear wing, the largest ever fitted to a production Porsche. It incorporated a Formula 1-style drag reduction system (DRS), which, under certain conditions, allowed the wing to flatten at the push of a button to reduce drag and increase top speed. Under heavy braking, the system also functioned as an air brake, increasing aerodynamic drag to enhance stopping performance.

Beyond these features, further aerodynamic refinements included front aero bars and air outlets integrated into both the front and rear fenders. These innovations collectively resulted in more than double the downforce produced by the 991.2 GT3 RS. Additional race-derived features, inspired by the 911 GT3 R and RSR, included the front compartment—traditionally used for luggage—which was replaced by a front-mounted radiator. This was one of the key features of the 992 model GT3 RS.

Mounted at the rear was a naturally-aspirated 4.0-liter flat-6 engine, mated to a 7-speed PDK transmission. Official figures indicated a modest power increase of <5ps> over its predecessor, bringing the output to <525ps>, while peak torque was reduced by <0.51kgm> to <47.42kgm>. The GT3 RS sprinted from 0 to <100 km/h> in just 3.2 seconds and reached a top speed of <296km/h>.
zh:
一辆配备各种赛车特性的终极性能公路车。

Porsche 911 GT3 RS（992）是一款高性能公路跑车，采用了源自911 GT3 R赛车的空气动力学套件。该车配备了多种先进的空气动力学系统，包括搭载DRS（可变尾翼减阻系统）的大型天鹅颈式尾翼，以及在急刹车时可起到气动减速作用的可调主动式扩散器。

en:
This 911, the first in history to feature a mid-engine layout, is a full competition spec machine.(

Starting with the Carrera RSR that was born in 1973 to compete in Group 4 racing, the RSR series has left an impressive mark in the world of motorsports over the years. The latest version of the series based on the 7th generation model of the 911 (Type 991) is the 911 RSR that debuted at the 2016 Los Angeles Auto Show.

This RSR is a pure competition machine born and bred to race in the LM-GTE class of the WEC (World Endurance Championships), and the American IMSA. Even though it’s obvious just by looking at the completely different exterior, including the aerodynamics, body structure, engine, and transmission, the car was truly developed in an entirely different process from the road car.

The showcase of difference is in the engine. In the history of the 911 series the engine was always mounted behind the rear axle, but this is the first car where the engine is mounted mid-ship, in front of the axle. What resides in that space is a 4-liter, horizontally opposed 6-cylinder naturally aspirated engine with direct fuel injection, producing <510ps>. The change in the engine mounting location had an immense impact on drivability, and furthermore allowed the addition of a large diffuser in its original space, giving it a distinct advantage in terms of aerodynamics. The large swan neck rear spoiler that was carried over from the 919 Hybrid LMP machine also gives the RSR’s rear end a distinct look.

At the Le Mans 24 hour race held in June 2017, the 911 RSR led the pack for much of the race, proving its impressive performance to sports car fans. Although it did not make it on top of the podium due to an unfortunate tire issue near the end, its driving performance was top notch throughout the race and worthy of the RSR lineage.
zh:
911史上第一款中置引擎车型。和最终的量产车型不同，这是一款高规格赛车。

这台赛车继承了RSR的精神。其开发过程完全不同于911公路车。这款4升自然进气引擎是911历史上首款中置引擎，输出马力为510 PS。在2017年纽博格林24小时耐力赛中，它拿出强劲表现，大部分时间都占据杆位。

en:
This top-of-the-line version of the vaunted 911 possessed a more muscular look and a turbocharged engine.

The first time that the word "Turbo" appeared on a Porsche product was 1975, with the birth of the 911 Turbo. This car became the company's halo model, as it possessed much of the technology gained from its participation in motorsports.

The car's bulging front and rear fenders were indeed reminiscent of a race machine, as was its large rear wing. Sitting right under that wing was Porsche's tried and tested 3.0-liter air-cooled flat-6 equipped with a KKK Turbocharger. This engine produced <260ps>, which allowed the lightweight 911 to reach a top speed of <250km/h>, an incredible feat for a production car of its day.

From 1977, the engine's displacement was increased to 3.3 liters, while an air-cooled intercooler was added to raise power to <300ps>. This version of the Porsche 911 Turbo was produced up to 1989, and is often referred to as the "930 Turbo." The name came from the internal code name of the car, 930, and also because the folks at Porsche themselves referred to it as the 930 Turbo at the Paris Motor Show where the car was displayed a year before going on sale.
zh:
911系列当中的旗舰款，拥有强大的车身设计和同等强劲的涡轮增压引擎。

1975年推出的这款911 Turbo是Porsche量产车历史上首款使用“Turbo”标识的车型。正如其标识所示，3升风冷水平对置6缸引擎搭载了KKK涡轮增压器，最大动力达260 PS。这些配置还能让该车达到250 公里/小时的巡航速度，在当时堪称惊人的成就。从1977年起，引擎排量提升至3.3升并增配了空对空式中间冷却器，进一步提升了动力输出。

en:
The top performance version of the eighth-generation 911.

For more than 60 years, the Porsche 911 has reigned as the crown jewel of the historic sports-car company, and in 2018, it entered its eighth generation, codenames "992."

Visually, the 992 refined the design language introduced by its predecessor, the 991. While the body grew slightly larger, Porsche made significant strides in weight management by incorporating more aluminum into the construction. One notable departure from tradition was the elimination of the "narrow body" base model, a hallmark of previous generations.

A key innovation in the 992's design was the new "MMB" modular development platform. This flexible architecture included a front axle, floor, and rear axle, designed to accommodate both rear-engine and mid-engine configurations by simply adjusting the rear axle position.

The powertrain reflected a move toward downsizing, with the base model powered by a turbocharged 3.0-liter flat-6. Power output varies by model, with the Carrera generating <385ps> and the Carrera S delivering <450ps>. The standard gearbox was an 8-speed PDK, while a 7-speed manual was available for the Carrera 4 and Carrera 4S.

In April 2020, the range-topping Turbo S model joined the 992 lineup. Featuring a slightly shorter stroke than its predecessors, the twin-turbocharged 3.7-liter flat-6 produced an impressive <650ps> and <800Nm> of torque (<81.6kgm>), sending power to all four wheels.

These figures translated into phenomenal performance: the Turbo S accelerated from 0 to <100km/h> in just 2.7 seconds, and a top speed of <330 km/h>. As the automotive world edges toward electrification, the 992 Turbo S may well represent the pinnacle of the internal combustion era for the iconic 911.
zh:
第八代911的高性能车型。

自1960年代起便成为Porsche品牌象征的911，于2018年推出了代号992的第八代车型。2020年4月，Turbo S作为顶级性能版本加入了992车系。双涡轮增压3,745 立方厘米水平对置6缸引擎输出650 PS最大动力和81.6 公斤力米峰值扭矩，通过四轮驱动系统传递澎湃动力，0-100 公里/小时加速仅需2.7秒，最高时速达330 公里/小时。

en:
The third-generation 911 Turbo was virtually all new with 80 percent new parts. +

One of the most storied sports cars in history is the Porsche 911, and among the most popular versions of this classic German sports car is the Type 964, the third-generation model introduced in 1989. While its exterior appeared nearly identical to its predecessor, the 930, the 964 featured approximately 80 percent of new parts, all but making it an all-new model.

The 964 was offered in three different trim levels: the rear-drive Carrera 2 base car, the all-wheel-drive Carrera 4 and the high-performance 911 Turbo. When the 911 Turbo made its debut, it came with the same turbocharged 3.3-liter flat-6 in the Type 930 911 Turbo, producing <320ps>, but in 1993, Porsche upgraded the powerplant to a turbocharged 3.6-liter, increasing power to <360ps>. The new 911 Turbo 3.6 looked meaner too, with a body lowered by <20mm>, the addition of Speedline 18-inch wheels and a special RS bumper.

The Type 964 remains one of the most popular 911 models ever, and the 964 911 Turbo has become a highly sought-after car for classic Porsche collectors everywhere.
zh:
第三代911，首次采用全轮驱动，超过80%的零部件经过重新设计。

在911系列中，964是继Type 901和930之后的第三代车型。在这一代的车系阵容中，主打的“Turbo”车型用于满足用户对强劲动力的需求，同时也推出了特别版的911 Turbo S Leichtbau，用于纪念Porsche在1993年IMSA系列赛中夺冠。这款Turbo S被赋予“Leichtbau”（轻量化）之名，搭载了高升程凸轮与一台可提供额外增压的特制涡轮引擎，能够爆发出381 PS动力和50.0 公斤力米扭矩。与标准的Turbo车型相比，其重量也得到了显著减轻。

en:
The 911 Turbo S reimagined as a safety car.}

This 992-generation 911 Turbo S was a virtual model created by Gran Turismo, reimagined as a safety car leading the pack in the event of an incident.

The original 992-generation 911 Turbo S was the top-performance model of the eighth-generation Porsche 911. Built on Porsche’s latest 911 architecture, the wide body used a high percentage of aluminum parts, blending tradition and innovation. The rear-mounted twin-turbo <3745cc> flat-6 engine produced <650ps> and 800 Nm (<81.6kgm>) of torque, sending power through an 8-speed PDK transmission and sophisticated four-wheel-drive system before reaching the track surface. It was able to accelerate from 0-<100km/h> in just 2.7 seconds and reach a top speed of <330km/h>, but that served as only a glimpse of its true potential.

Qualities such as excellent traction and stability made the 911 Turbo S ideal for leading the field as a safety car. Meanwhile, its ability to keep a pack of race cars in line without faltering came from its outstanding performance and high-level chassis control.
zh:
重新设计为安全车的911 Turbo S。

这款992车型911 Turbo S是《跑车浪漫旅》创作的一款虚拟车型，在原车型基础上重新设计为安全车。基于全新开发的MMB平台，其宽体车身设计采用了更高比例的铝制部件。出色的牵引力与稳定性，让911 Turbo S担任安全车、引领车阵的不二之选。

en:
This extreme hyper car is an updated version of the legendary 917, one of the most celebrated race cars in Porsche history."

The Porsche 917 Living Legend is a hyper car inspired by the legendary Porsche 917 racer, which brought the manufacturer the first overall victory in the 24 Hours of Le Mans back in 1970.

Developed in 2013 by a small team of engineers and designers in Weissach, the 917 Living Legend was simultaneously a tribute and spiritual successor to the legendary Porsche racer. Inspired by the signature proportions of the original, the 917 Living Legend was all about celebrating the car that brought the Le Mans title to Stuttgart.

Under the sheet metal, the 917 Living Legend featured the latest technology of its day, including lightweight materials such as carbon fiber, which was used for the chassis. Powering the car was a turbocharged 8-cylinder engine that pumped out about <1014ps>, while the suspension system, based on the 918 Spyder, provided remarkable handling at all speeds.

With updated aerodynamics, the car could reach <300km/h> on long straights, making the 917 Living Legend a true reincarnation of the legendary Porsche race car.
zh:
这款极限超跑是对经典917的现代重塑，后者是Porsche历史上最辉煌的机器之一。

917为Porsche创造了诸多辉煌战绩，包括在1970年世界跑车锦标赛中10场比赛斩获7场胜利。Porsche 917 LIVING LEGEND是一款以经典917为灵感打造的终极跑车。经典的外观设计下蕴藏着前沿的技术内核。极速与下压力的完美结合，即使在超过300 公里/小时的速度下也能保持如磐石般的稳定性。

en:
This prototype race car that gave Porsche its first victory at the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The Porsche 917K, a prototype race car developed by Porsche to compete in Group 4 sports-car racing, was essentially the 917 with a shortened body. After the debut of the 917 in 1969, Porsche introduced the shorter model, calling it the 917K (the "K" stood for "Kurz," which means "short" in German). The standard, longer car was then called the 917LH.

The car's space-frame chassis was composed of aluminum alloy pipes that weighed just under <50kg>. A carbon-fiber body covered a mid-mounted <4494cc> flat-12 engine that produced <600ps>. And with a curb weight of about <800kg> and enhanced aerodynamics — downforce was increased by sloping up the rear edge of the short tail body, while the front tip was squared off — the 917K was a monster on the straights.

In 1970, it dominated the international manufacturer’s championship winning 7 of 10 races, and also brought Porsche its first victory in the Le Mans 24 Hour race.
zh:
这款原型赛车帮助Porsche在勒芒24小时耐力赛中首次获胜。

917K是Porsche为跑车赛事专门设计的原型赛车。车重仅800 公斤，1970款917的引擎在最强配置下可输出高达600 PS的动力。1970年是其参赛的第二年，几乎鲜有对手可以匹敌。在国际车厂锦标赛10轮比赛中豪取7场胜利，并为Porsche赢得了期盼已久的勒芒24小时耐力赛首冠。

en:
This super sports car represents the first plug-in hybrid flagship from the famed German car maker. ~

Introduced by Porsche in 2011, the 918 Spyder succeeded the Carrera GT as the company's flagship model and was its first road-going supercar to feature a hybrid powerplant.

Based on the powertrain of the RS Spyder prototype race car, the 918 Spyder's drive system takes a <608ps> 4.6-liter V-8, mounted amidships, and mates it with a single electric motor at the rear. The combined output totals a whopping <886p>, enabling the 918 to reach <100km/h> in just 2.6 seconds, <200km/h> in 7.2 and <300km/h> in just 19.9, when equipped with the Weissach Package that reduces the car’s curb weight from <1674kg> to <1634kg>.

The 918 Spyder, of which only 918 examples were made, claimed a top speed of <345km/h> and lapped the famed Nürburgring Nordschleife in 6 minutes and 57 seconds.
zh:
这款超级跑车以插电式混合动力的形式重新诠释了光彩夺目的Carrera GT。

Porsche 918 Spyder是Porsche于2011年推出的超级跑车。作为Carrera GT的继任者，正如其名称所示，限量生产918台。其最值得一提的特点是采用了插电式混合动力系统。中置的608 PS 4.6升V8引擎配合前轴双电机和后轴单电机，总输出动力可达886 PS。

en:
The consecutive Le Mans champion & hybrid prototype sports car.

The 919 Hybrid is a prototype sports car developed by Porsche for the World Endurance Championships and the Le Mans 24 hour race. This is a hybrid prototype machine developed for the new regulations of the LMP1-H that had been planned for introduction in 2014, and was revealed at the Geneva Motor Show of the same year.

Its base configuration is a carbon composite monocoque with a turbocharged 2-liter V4 engine mounted mid-ship. It is an all-wheel drive, equipped with an ERS (an advanced version of KERS) for the front axles, with lithium ion batteries.

The total system power of <900ps> consists of <500ps> delivered from the engine to the rear axle, with <400ps> delivered to the front axles through the hybrid system. This propels the <875kg> car from a standstill to <100km/h> in 2.2 seconds, reaching <200km/h> in 4.8 seconds.

For visibility and operability, the seat position is slightly high. Driver safety is also maximized by providing ample interior space and reinforcing the side panels with materials used for bulletproof vests.

The competition debut of the car was in 2014 as planned, but it ended with only 1 victory in the final round of the World Endurance Championships. However, for the 2015 season, alterations were made to the chassis design to optimize weight distribution while still keeping the concept of the car intact, and they went on to dominate the WEC series by winning 6 out of 8 races, including Porsche’s 17th overall victory in the 24 Hours of Le Mans. In 2016, the car was further refined, and not only did it win the 24 Hours of Le Mans, but by the 6th race they had already scored 5 wins and 1 race in 2nd place.
zh:
连续夺得勒芒冠军和混动原型车比赛的跑车。

这是一款为参加世界耐力锦标赛和勒芒赛事而开发的原型跑车。2升V4涡轮增压引擎是混合动力系统中的一部分，配备有能量回收系统，总马力为900 PS。它称霸了2015年到2017年间的世界耐力锦标赛，每年均夺得车厂和车手双料冠军。

en:
A four-wheel-drive road car that shines bright in automotive history.

At the 1983 Frankfurt Auto Show, Porsche introduced the "Gruppe B" concept model. This was a design study of an all-wheel-drive race car that was being developed for competition in the top "Group B" category of the WRC that started in 1982.

Two years later, in 1985, the road going version of this model was unveiled. Called the Porsche 959, it adopted the basic structure of the Porsche 911 and was packed with revolutionary technology. The engine was a <2850cc> twin-turbocharged horizontally-opposed 6 cylinder, with a maximum output of 450 horsepower. It came mated to a 6-speed manual transmission.

The most noteworthy feature of this car was its electronically controlled all-wheel-drive system that actively managed the drive ratio between the front and rear wheels according to the conditions of the road surface. Also, it was possible to select a drive mode that matched the current driving condition. The 959's all-wheel-drive system was truly revolutionary in that it provided not only excellent stability at high speeds, but also convenience for the user.

Only 292 examples of the Porsche 959 were produced for Group B homologation, but because of the termination of the Group B category, the race version never made it to the WRC. But it did go on to set great records in competition, even winning the overall title at the Paris-Dakar Rally, which is considered one of the most grueling races in the world.

Many of the technical innovations of the 959, including the all-wheel-drive system, saw their way into the company's other production cars, such as the 911. The Porsche 959 still enjoys a high level of respect and popularity today and remains a very important part of automotive history.
zh:
一辆在汽车历史上熠熠生辉的四轮驱动公路车。

Porsche 959是基于“Gruppe B”原型车打造的量产版本，该原型车是Porsche为参加当时世界拉力锦标赛最高级别的B组别赛事而开发的。该车配备了先进的电子控制四轮驱动系统，驾驶者可根据路况选择不同的驱动模式，既保证了出色的稳定性，又兼顾了舒适性。由于B组别赛事的取消，该车最终未能在世界拉力锦标赛中参赛，但在其他赛车领域取得了令人瞩目的成绩。

en:
These Group C cars scored numerous endurance racing championships for Porsche.

Porsche built the 962 C in 1985 as a prototype race car to compete in the WEC (World Endurance Championships). The car was in fact based on the 956, which in 1982, waged battle in the WEC in the FIA Group C category.

The 956 was a spectacular success right from the start, winning races in the WEC as well as dominating the 24 Hours of Le Mans. Thereafter, the 956 was improved for the IMSA-GTP of North America which had similar regulations as the WEC, and it made its debut in 1984 as the 962. The following year, when Group C safety regulations were changed to be in line with those of IMSA-GTP, Porsche modified the 962 and thus was born the 962 C.

The car, powered by the twin-turbo flat-6, scored many championship titles, winning seven out of its first 10 races. In 1986, the Porsche 962 C won four out of nine races in the WSPC (World Sports Prototype Championship), which took the place of the WEC. In 1987, it dominated Le Mans, and took 2nd the following year.
zh:
在无数场耐力赛中为保时捷带来胜利的C组别赛车。

Porsche 962 C是于1985年在世界耐力锦标赛（WEC）中首次登场的原型赛车。在整个参赛生涯中，其为Porsche夺得了众多分站胜利和锦标赛冠军。此车在其WEC首秀之年便赢得了10场比赛中的7场胜利，1986年在WEC更名后的世界运动原型车锦标赛（WSPC）中又夺得9轮比赛中的4场胜利。1987年WSPC赛季，它在勒芒收获冠军，次年又获得亚军。

en:
A new category LMDh hypercar created by Porsche, the masters of endurance.

The 963 is Porsche’s latest-generation LMDh prototype, carrying on the concepts embodied by the legendary 962 and 919 Hybrid. Its Multimatic carbon-fiber monocoque is equipped with a twin-turbo 4.6-liter V-8 rooted in the RS Spyder and 918 Spyder, combined with a standardized hybrid system. It was a package that combined the efficiency, reliability and overwhelming performance demanded in top-level endurance racing.

The 963 made its race debut at the 2023 24 Hours of Daytona and went on to compete in both the World Endurance Championship and the IMSA Championship. Together with the esteemed Team Penske, it challenged for the very pinnacle of endurance racing.

The 963 truly came into its own in 2024. It won the IMSA season opener at Daytona, then followed with victories at Laguna Seca, Watkins Glen and Road America, results that helped it secure both the drivers’ and manufacturers’ championships.

Its WEC results also were highly impressive. The 963 showed consistent pace throughout the season, winning in Qatar, at Spa-Francorchamps and at Fuji, while Porsche Penske Motorsport clinched the 2024 drivers’ title.

Porsche withdrew the 963 from the WEC’s Hypercar class at the end of 2025, but the car continued to compete in the 2026 IMSA Championship. The 963 is something of a masterpiece, further burnishing Porsche’s reputation as the king of endurance racing.
zh:
由耐力赛大师Porsche打造的全新LMDh终极跑车。

Porsche的勒芒-戴通纳混合动力（LMDh）终极跑车，延续了传奇车型962和919 Hybrid的辉煌血脉。自2023年戴通纳24小时耐力赛首秀后，该车便迅速在WEC和IMSA两项赛事中斩获无数冠军并多次登上领奖台，最终在2024年IMSA赛季中包揽了车手和车厂双料冠军。2025年，该车迎来了进一步升级，通过对悬挂系统和后部空气动力学套件的更新，确保在任何赛道上都能保持平衡与稳定。

en:
Only 1270 examples of this mid-engine supercar were produced from 2003 to 2006.

When the Carrera GT was introduced in 2003, it became an instant collector's car, not only because it was one of the most exotic cars Porsche had ever produced, but only a total of 1270 units were manufactured.

Unlike the 911, Porsche's signature model, the Carrera GT had a mid-engine layout. Tucked behind the cabin was a 5.7-liter V-10 that was originally designed for LMP endurance racing. The naturally aspirated engine produced <612ps> and <60.2kgm> of torque that came mated to a 6-speed manual transmission. With a curb weight of only <1380kg> — carbon fiber was not used sparingly in the Carrera GT — the car was a virtual road rocket, going from zero to <100km/h> in a scant 3.9 seconds and reaching a top speed of more than <330km/h>.

In 2006, the Carrera GT was discontinued, but it remains one of the most alluring Porsches of not only its generation, but of all time.
zh:
从2003年到2006年，这款中置超级跑车只生产了1270辆。

Porsche Carrera GT是2003至2006年间生产的中置布局超级跑车，总共仅生产了1270台。其底盘以轻质高刚性碳纤维单体车壳为核心，搭配碳纤维副车架用于安装引擎与后悬挂。引擎为基于赛车引擎开发的5.7升自然进气V10，输出高达612 PS。搭配6速手动变速箱。

en:
A masterpiece that brought great success to Porsche's GT race efforts in the 1960sf

Shortly after its establishment in the 1950s, Porsche quickly rose to prominence in global motorsports with the 356 and its purpose-built mid-engine derivatives like the 550 Spyder.

One of the key milestones that carried this legacy forward was the 1963 Porsche Carrera GTS. Also known by its development code, the 904 GTS, it was developed in response to the evolving World Sportscar Championship regulations.

In the 1950s, the championship featured low-volume, pure racing machines. However, the regulation changes of 1961 shifted the focus to mass-produced sports cars. To compete in the GT Class, manufacturers had to meet a homologation requirement of producing at least 100 units.

Porsche responded with the Carrera GTS, engineered around a ladder-frame chassis better suited for small-series production. It was then wrapped in a lightweight fiberglass-reinforced plastic (FRP) body. This combination was a first for the company. Styling was led by Ferdinand Alexander Porsche, grandson of company founder Dr. Ferdinand Porsche. His design gave the car its low, clean lines that remain iconic to this day. Mounted in a mid-engine layout was an air-cooled flat-4 engine, though the chassis was versatile enough to accept 6- and even 8-cylinder units for competition use.

From its debut, the Carrera GTS proved its capability with victories in storied events like the Targa Florio, as well as class wins at endurance races including the Nürburgring and Le Mans. In 1964, it went on to dominate the GT Class Championship.
zh:
Porsche在1960年代赖以统治GT赛事的杰作。

1963年，Porsche为迎合当时世界跑车锦标赛的规则开发了Porsche Carrera GTS。为了满足100台量产车的赛事认证条件，该车采用了梯形框架底盘与轻量化玻璃纤维车身。这款车型性能卓越，从塔格·佛罗热大奖赛开始便在众多顶级赛事中夺冠，成为1960年代Porsche GT车队的中流砥柱。

en:
A Cayman designed for motorsports and possessing all the competitive flair of the 911.

Porsche has competed in many sports-car races with the 911, which was one of the most popular models in its production-car lineup. The company eyed going racing with another of its production cars in 2015, when it introduced the Cayman GT4. The Cayman was a mid-engine model that possessed performance levels comparable to the 911, and the GT4 was created specifically for motorsports.

The Cayman GT4 had the same combination of 3.8-liter flat-6 and 6-speed manual gearbox used in the 911 Carrera S. In fact, it actually outdoes the 911 with <385ps> of power.

Some parts from the 991 GT3 were used for the brakes and suspension of the Cayman GT4, thus reducing ride height by <30mm>. The 2-seater also came with a distinctive lip spoiler and a fixed rear wing.

The choice of optional extras included a roll cage, fire extinguisher, and a 6-point seatbelt, making it clear from the start that this was a car designed for the track.
zh:
为赛车运动而生的Cayman，包含了911所有的领先技术。

Cayman GT4赛车版本于2015年加入Porsche Cayman系列产品线。这台车采用了源自911 Carrera S的3.8升水平对置6缸引擎，配备6速手动变速箱。385 PS的输出远超基础车型911 Carrera，刹车和悬挂也采用了911车型911 GT3的一些部件。追加了防滚架与六点式安全带作为选装项。

en:
The highest performance model of the Cayman series in its naturally aspirated flat 6 generation.

Throughout the modern racing era, Porsche has traditionally used the 911 to participate in major sports-car races, but in 2015, they surprised many by turning to the Cayman as its entry in GT4 races

The Cayman GT4 was the fastest Cayman ever, with many components carried over from the 911. It came with a 3.8-liter flat-6 from the 911 Carrera S that produced more power than the 911 Carrera at <385ps>. The front suspension and brakes were lifted from the 911 GT3, which meant it handled amazingly well and had plenty of stopping power.

The following year, the GT4 was even further refined, creating the Cayman GT4 Clubsport. This special Cayman was a pure race version designed exclusively for the race track. Any and all creature comforts on the road-going model were deleted to make it as lightweight as possible.

A roll cage protected the driver, and the seats were replaced with full bucket types. It also came with a DCT gearbox and the suspension and brakes used components equal to that of the 911 GT3 Cup car. While the engine was left as is, the mid-engine GT4 Clubsport was the ultimate Cayman and is sure to go down in the annals of Porsche history.
zh:
Cayman系列中性能最高的车型，采用自然进气水平对置6缸引擎。

专为GT4级别Cayman赛车推出的纯赛车版本。它使用与GT4型号相同的385 PS输出3.8升水平对置6缸引擎，除此之外，还经过了完美的赛车调校，移除了所有与舒适度有关的部件的同时，采用了911 GT3 Cup上的部件。

en:
A hypercar concept to celebrate the 75th anniversary of Porsche.

On June 8, 1948, the first car to bear the Porsche name, the 356 "No. 1" Roadster was approved, setting in motion the rise of one of the greatest sports car brands in history.

Seventy-five years later, on the same date in 2023, the company unveiled a new concept car, a vision of the future of sports car technology inspired by classic Porsche legends. It was called the Mission X.

The conceptual 2-seat fully electric hypercar was relatively compact, measuring <4500mm> in length and <2000mm> in width. Standing just under <1200mm> tall, the low-slung design featured an almost sculptural form with bold lines, which proved that a hypercar did not necessarily need to look hyper aggressive.

Historic Porsche motifs were placed throughout the car’s exterior. The headlights served as a reinterpretation of the quad lights of historic cars like the 906 and 908, while the doors adopted the same upward opening motion as the legendary 917 endurance car. An illuminated "PORSCHE" logo adorned the center of the taillights, which extended out from the side of the body. The Porsche emblems on the hood and steering wheel were also updated to a more modern interpretation of the classic logo.

The interior expressed a strong affinity with motorsports. The steering wheel featured an open yoke style design, fitted with paddle shifters and several mode switches. The passenger had access to a stopwatch module, created by Porsche Design, which had both analogue and digital timers. Also, the driver could press the record button on the multi-purpose controller at any time to begin recording video footage from the numerous cameras installed around the car.

The Mission X aimed to be the fastest road-legal car on the Nürburgring Nordschleife, and shows off its prowess in Gran Turismo 7. With a power-to-weight ratio of over 1PS per kilogram, it generated more downforce than even the current 911 G3 RS. The concept car also had radical charging capabilities. With its 00V sysem architecture, charging speeds were geatly improved, alloing it to hypothetically chargearound twice as fast as orsche's current ppular EV, the Tycan Turbo S.

Following in the tradition of the 917 LIVING LEGEND, the Porsche ision Gran Turismo, and thePorsche Vision Gran Turimo Syder—all featured  Gran Turism ‒the Mitsion X is ye anothes remarkable uomobile that pushes the boundaris of what is possible in thfuture.
zh:
这是为庆祝Porsche成立75周年推出的概念超跑。

这款全电动终极跑车于2023年6月8日正式发布，恰逢Porsche首款汽车356“No.1”Roadster获得批准的75周年纪念日。外观设计融入了该公司悠久赛车历史的经典元素，配备了专为运动驾驶打造的高性能座舱。这款车型的马力重量比达到了每1 公斤  1 PS，下压力比992款911 GT3 RS显著提升。

en:
This French blue Porsche wears the original livery from the 1956 24 Hours of Le Mans race.

The 550/1500RS was a purpose-built racing sports car that Porsche introduced in late 1954.

Its name, “550,” reflected its impressively light dry weight of just <550kg>. Built on a steel tube frame clad in an aluminum body, the car was powered by a 4-cam flat-four engine that produced <135ps>.

The 550/1500RS quickly proved itself on the racing circuit, capturing its class win at the 1954 24 Hours of Le Mans. The following year, it finished 4th overall, repeating its class victory.

One notable example was chassis number 550-0067, finished in French Blue. Delivered originally to a French dealership, this car also made an appearance at the Paris Motor Show.

This extremely historic race car still wears its original livery from its participation in the 1956 24 Hours of Le Mans race and is said to have been owned by famed French race driver Jean Marie Behra.
zh:
一辆参加过1956年Le Mans赛事的法国蓝Porsche竞技型跑车。

自1954年开始销售的550/1500RS是一款竞速跑车，采用钢管框架结构搭配铝制车身，搭载4凸轮轴水平对置4缸引擎，输出功率为135 PS。它在赛道上取得了卓越战绩，在1954年和1955年的勒芒24小时耐力赛中均获得了组别冠军。这台1500RS是一台特别珍贵的收藏，仍保留着它参加1956年勒芒24小时耐力赛时的原始涂装。

en:
With a total system voltage of 800V, this fully electric sedan boasts both comfort and remarkable performance.

The Taycan is Porsche’s answer to the question of sustainable mobility, their first fully-electric vehicle.

A sports sedan that combines sports performance with everyday usability, its electric all-wheel-drive system uses 2 electric motors mounted on the front and rear axles, with the rear-motor encompassing a revolutionary 2-speed transmission allowing unparalleled acceleration and efficiency at high speeds.

Both the Turbo and the Turbo S models normally output 460 kW (<625ps>), but with the overboost feature engaged the output of the Turbo model is boosted to 500 kW (<680ps>), and the Turbo S cranks out a staggering 560 kW (<761ps>). This incredible power output is enabled by the first 800-volt power unit to be seen in a production car, which successfully achieves greater efficiency while drastically reducing charging time.

And of course no effort has been spared in producing dynamic handling. It features Porsche’s superior active suspension management and torque vectoring technology, controlling these systems in sync to provide the best possible driving experience under all driving conditions. Taycan’s technical advances also extend to its user interface, enabling media and air-conditioning to be operated directly through its intuitive voice control system.

The Taycan carries forward Porsche’s historical lineage while signaling a new era of automobiles. Truly a model in which heritage meets the future.
zh:
这辆全电动轿车搭载800伏超级快速充电系统，不仅乘坐舒适，更拥有难以置信的性能。

Taycan是Porsche首款纯电动运动轿车。四驱系统在前后轴分别配备电机，搭配2速变速箱，实现了惊人的加速性能和极速表现。配备超级增压功能的Turbo S版本可输出560千瓦（761 PS）。它采用量产车中首创的800V电气系统，在动力单元效率和充电时间方面均具优势。

en:
Porsche's modern-yet-daring statement on the future of the sports car.

Starting in 1948, Porsche built its reputation as one of the world’s premier automotive manufacturers by creating elegant, well-engineered lightweight sports cars. These cars were not defined by extreme horsepower, but instead were characterized by a highly efficient power-to-weight ratio combined with timeless, functional design.

The Porsche Vision Gran Turismo follows in this tradition while expressing the company's take on the future of the sports car. It merges elements of the iconic design of historic Porsche sports cars with the company's storied race machines. The car also possesses hints of the record-breaking 919 Hybrid, as well as Porsche's first electric sports car, the Taycan.

Exterior and interior design flow seamlessly together, providing drivers with the feeling of being one with the car when inside the cockpit of the state-of-the-art carbon monocoque chassis. The glass dome places them into the surrounding natural environment.

The Porsche Vision Gran Turismo’s dual electric engine layout delivers 820 kW (<1114ps>) of power and a maximum torque of 1,090 Nm (<111kgm>). An innovative active aerodynamic system dynamically reacts to all driving situations to enhance the car’s performance, thus making the car perfectly suited for the demanding corners and high-speed segments found on tracks like the Nürburgring Nordschleife or on alpine roads.
zh:
Porsche将其对未来跑车的预测以非常现代化且大胆的方式呈现。

这是2021年亮相的Porsche Vision Gran Turismo的Spyder版本。外观与内饰设计无缝融合，打造最具沉浸感的驾驶体验。动力系统采用双电机配置，创新的主动空气动力学系统可根据实际情况提供最佳的空气动力学效果。

en:
Porsche's modern yet daring statement on the future of the sports car remains true to its racing roots.

Since it was founded in 1948, Porsche has continually represented the highest level of automotive performance in both motorsports and on the public road. The Porsche Vision Gran Turismo honors the virtues of the German manufacturer with a future version of a sports car designed without restrictions.

Merging elements many historic Porsches from the past with those of today, including the 919 Hybrid super car and the company's first EV, the Taycan, the Porsche Vision Gran Turismo may well be the closes thing to the perfect sports car.

Virtually built around a state-of-the-art carbon monocoque chassis, the cabin is enclosed by a glass dome. Powering the car are dual electric motors that combine to produce 820 kW (<1114ps>) and 1090 Nm (<111kgm>) of torque. An innovative active aerodynamic system dynamically reacts to all driving situations to enhance the car’s performance.

The car's styling was inspired by past Porsche race cars such as the 908 and the legendary 917, and while the Porsche Vision Gran Turismo looks like it belongs exclusively on a track, it was created to also shred winding roads as a true GT car.
zh:
Porsche对未来跑车的现代化且激进的展现。
