The new Supra will also star in the virtual world as Gran Turismo Sport has been charting the development progress of this car from day one, offering gamers a true representation of how this exciting sports car drives. The further refined 2020 model will come in highly anticipated new body colors./
zh:
这辆2020款Supra的3升涡轮引擎经过了大幅的动力提升。

Toyota Supra在2002年停产后，于2019年重新回归。新一代Supra延续了前代的直列六缸引擎和后轮驱动布局，追求纯粹跑车的理想境界。它拥有理想的车身平衡，前后50:50的重量分布和低重心设计。双涡流涡轮增压器带来出色加速性能，宽体车身和短轴距成就敏捷操控，组合之后极具吸引力。

en:
The Supra returned after a 17-year hiatus, with this racing version competing at the Nürburgring in 2019.

After 17 long years, the beloved Supra made its return, first as the race-ready GR Supra. Toyota's flagship sports car was co-developed with BMW, borrowing among other things the BMW Z4's superb inline-6 engine.

The 2-seat sports car made its first appearance at the 2018 Nürburgring 24 hour race a year before its release along with the slogan: To make even better cars. It entered the SP8T class in 2019 after its release.

With Masahiro Sasaki, Uwe Kleen, Herwig Daenens, and Morizo at the wheel, the GR Supra started the final race at the Ring from 99th place, but steadily made its way up the field as the drivers avoided a number of accidents at the beginning of the race. Eight hours into the contest, the car was involved in a slight crash, but fortunately for Toyota, damage was minimal and the car went on to finish in a respectable 41st place overall, and 3rd in its class.

Its outing proved that the GR Supra was a true sports car with a genuine race car heart.
zh:
Supra暌违17年后再次归。这款跑车曾参与过2019年的纽博格林赛事。

消失17年的Toyota旗舰跑车重获新生，GR Supra延续了经典的后驱布局和直列六缸引擎，以全新双座设计、先进车身和双涡管涡轮增压技术回归。该车于2018年首次征战纽博格林24小时耐力赛，2019年参加SP8T组别竞技，获得组别第三名、总成绩第41名的佳绩。这确立了GR Supra作为纯粹战斗跑车的形象。

en:
First seen at the 2018 Geneva Motor Show, this race Supra represented a preview of the production model.

The GR Supra Racing Concept, unveiled at the 2018 Geneva Motor Show, was a bold reimagining of Toyota’s legendary Supra—a sports car that had been out of production since 2002. With this concept, the nameplate returned for the first time in 16 years, reborn as a pure race car.

The car was developed by TOYOTA GAZOO Racing, the division responsible for the company’s motorsports activities and the GR sports-car series.

Its design followed the classic long-nose, short-deck form, with a front-engine/rear-wheel-drive, two-door coupe layout. The compact body was constructed from lightweight, high-strength carbon composite materials, the kind used in frontline racing. Large blister fenders, a rear wing, and a pronounced diffuser were added to deliver superior aerodynamics and high-speed stability.

The suspension, wheels, tires, and brakes were all racing-spec. The stripped-down interior included a dashboard with a rear-view monitor, competition seats, a race steering wheel with paddle shifters, and a full roll cage—all purpose-built for the track.

For a quarter of a century, the Supra had been beloved worldwide as “The Sports of Toyota,” leaving a powerful mark on motorsports history.
zh:
这辆Supra跑车首次亮相于2018年的日内瓦车展，是量产车型的前瞻。

自2002年停产16年后，GR Supra Racing Concept概念车将Toyota Supra以赛车身份复活，帮助其再度回归。这款双门轿跑的紧凑车身沿用传统的长鼻加短尾跑车比例，采用的尖端材料和工程技术创造了卓越的空气动力学和操控性。

carNameEn: Toyota GR Yaris 1st Edition RZ "High performance" '20
en:
This new WRC race car was created to carry the torch for Toyota's strong rallying tradition.

Toyota has long been a dominant presence in the World Rally Championships, consistently fighting for the series championship year after year. After building a number of classic rally race cars, the company will be introducing its newest off-road competition machine in 2021: the GR Yaris.

At first, it may not look that different from the production hatchback, aside from the super wide rear fenders, but under the skin beats the heart of a serious racer. Built on a combination of the TNGA GA-B and GA-C platforms, the extremely lightweight body possesses increased rigidity. Its flowing profile, characterized by the low carbon-fiber roof, optimizes airflow.

Under the hood of the RZ model is the G16E-GTS, a turbocharged 1.6-liter inline-3. Boasting the smallest size and lightest weight in its class, this unit produces 200 kW (<272ps>)/370 Nm (<37.7kgm>) and comes mated to a 6-speed manual transmission that sends power to all four wheels via a newly developed electronically controlled coupling type center differential. The RZ High Performance model is equipped with Torsen LSDs for both the front and rear differentials, for maximum traction.

This "First Edition" model, introduced alongside the GR Yaris in January 2020, was offered to those who pre-ordered the car. Among other things, it featured special forged aluminum wheels and was autographed by Toyota "master driver" Morizo, who is in fact Toyota CEO Akio Toyoda.
zh:
这款全新的WRC赛车将延续Toyota一贯强大的拉力赛夺冠传统。

Toyota为征战WRC而开发的GR Yaris，表面上是一款朴素的紧凑型车，实际上却是一台强悍的赛道机器。车身刚性得到强化，重量实现轻量化，重心尽可能降低。四驱版RZ车型搭载1.6升三缸涡轮增压引擎，匹配6速手动变速箱。RZ High performance版本进一步配备限滑差速器，提供稳如磐石的抓地性能。2020年1月，厂家推出了“1st Edition”特别版车型。

en:
This version of Japan's signature lightweight sports car boasts a bigger engine, but it remains true to its heritage.

Since its introduction in 2012, more than 200,000 units of the Toyota 86 were sold around the world, solidifying its place in the history books as one of the most popular front-engine/rear-wheel-drive compact sports cars of all time.

Nine years after the 86's debut, Toyota introduced the GR86, a high-performance version of the car that wore the Gazoo Racing badge (GR). While maintaining the virtues of the original car, namely a lightweight body and superb handling, Toyota engineers equipped the GR86 with a larger engine. Under the bonnet was a 2.4-litre flat-4 that replaced the 2.0-litre variant. Power came in at an impressive <235ps>/<7000rpm> with maximum torque peaking at <25.5kgm>/<3700rpm>. This translated to a 0-<100km/h> acceleration time of 6.3 seconds, which was a stark improvement over the 7.4 seconds of the first-generation model.

To enhance the 86's handling, the company's chassis engineers stiffened the body and adopted aluminium in the roof panel to lower the center of gravity, as well as reduce overall weight. With the GR86, Toyota offered sports-car enthusiasts exactly what they were hoping for with the 86: a meaner, faster version of the car that was designed for the race track.
zh:
排量与动力更大的引擎，不变的理念。日本最具代表性的轻量级前置后驱跑车。

Toyota轻量化前置后驱跑车“86”于2012年发布，全球销量突破20万辆。发布9年后，该车以“GR86”的身份重生，搭载2.4升自然进气四缸双顶置凸轮轴水平对置引擎，输出235 PS的动力和25.5 公斤力米的最大扭矩。通过强化车身刚性、削减车身重量，以及采用汲取自赛车运动的全新空气动力学设计，这款车带来了前所未有的驾驶乐趣。

en:
Toyota's endurance race machine that achieved a class win at Le Mans in 1999.!

In the early 1990s, Toyota set out to win the 24 Hours of Le Mans with its Group C TS010 race car. A number of unsuccessful years followed, but the company would return for the 1998 season with the Toyota GT-One (TS020). During its Group C racing days, Toyota developed its race cars almost exclusively within Japan. However, it revamped its plans and entrusted this project to the group in charge of their World Rally Championship activities, German-based TTE (Toyota Team Europe), in an attempt to once again claim overall victory in the 24 Hours of Le Mans.

The new Le Mans car, the GT-One, was designed by André De Cortanze, a race-car design genius with a brilliant track record in top motorsports genres, including Formula 1, Le Mans and the WRC. De Cortanze designed the Peugeot 905B, the first Group C Peugeot car to claim victory at Le Mans in 1992 and 1993.

For the GT-One, Cortanze incorporated the latest in F1 technology into its design. Its carbon-composite monocoque body was developed for aerodynamic performance. Providing the power was the same twin-turbocharged 3.6-liter V-8 developed during the Toyota's Group C days. The suspension had very long arms in both the front and rear, allowing for ideal suspension geometry.

In its first time out at Le Mans in 1998, Toyota entered three GT-Ones in the LM GT1 class in a serious attempt for overall victory. While one of its cars led the race, a combination of mechanical trouble and bad luck kept it from taking the checkered flag.

The following year, a change in the race's technical regulations saw the GT-One entered in the LM GTP prototype class. Three GT-Ones were entered in the race, but two of them, including the favorite and its supporting car, were forced to withdraw due to a host of problems.

However, the third car, driven by Ukyo Katayama Toshio Suzuki and Keiichi Tsuchiya managed to stay in the race and claim2nd place overall. This was the highest ever finish for a Japanese car riven b an all-Japanese team.
zh:
Toyota耐力赛赛车于1999年在勒芒赢得组别冠军

1998年，Toyota开发了GT-One（TS020），目标是征服勒芒24小时耐力赛。GT-One由安德烈·德·科尔但泽设计，采用了源自F1的空气动力学和悬挂技术。1998年的技术故障让车队铩羽而归，但在1999年GT-One进化为LM GTP规格赛车。片山右京领衔的车队获得总成绩亚军，创造了日本车手在勒芒历史上的最佳战绩。

en:
The cab-over commercial van was equally capable of moving people and cargo."

Since its introduction in 1967, Toyota's Hiace cab-over commercial van has enjoyed international acclaim for its utility and reliability. The fifth-generation H200 model was introduced in 2004 and, thanks to regular updates, remains in production to this day.

The H200 Hiace lineup featured a number of different configurations and trim levels to meet various uses and specifications, but these can largely be categorized by the body's overall length, width and height. The H200 was equipped with a choice of engines: a 2.0-liter or 2.7-liter gasoline inline-4, or a 2.8-liter diesel inline-4.

This Van DX was the base model that measured <4695mm> long, <1695mm> wide and <1980mm> high. It was powered by the 2.0-liter gasoline engine, mated to a 6-speed automatic transmission that sent power to the two rear wheels. This 4-door configuration did not include a right-hand sliding door, and accommodated nine people. When needing to haul large cargo, the second- and third-row seats folded down to provide <2435mm> of storage.
zh:
这款前置驾驶室的商用厢型车在载人和载货方面同样出色。

Hiace是Toyota商用车的代表车型，在全球范围内都有大量拥趸。第五代H200车型于2004年推出并持续更新，已成为创纪录的长青畅销车型。H200根据车身尺寸提供多档选择，可选2升或2.7升汽油引擎，或2.8升柴油引擎。Van DX是标准车顶高度的后轮2轮驱动车型。最多可容纳9人乘坐，座椅也可折叠收起，形成宽敞的载货空间。

en:
A best-selling Land Cruiser with a 24-year production run.

The Toyota Land Cruiser was first conceived as a vehicle for Japan’s National Police Reserve, but it evolved into a world-class off-roader renowned for its all-terrain ability and legendary reliability. More than 70 years later, the model that continued to hold a special place in the hearts of enthusiasts was the third-generation “40,” introduced in 1960.

Exports had begun earlier with the “20” series in 1955, establishing the Land Cruiser as a serious contender on the world stage. The “40” was designed to better meet the expectations of international customers. Beyond its refreshed exterior, it elevated the model’s already renowned off-road prowess with greater comfort on the highway, broadening its appeal.

The 40 series was available in short, medium, and long-wheelbase versions, each tailored to different needs. The 2-door hardtop variant, seen here, found extensive use in mountainous regions, where its short <2285mm> wheelbase proved invaluable.

Compact in size, it measured <3870mm> in length, <1690mm> in width, and <1930mm> in height. Originally equipped with a 3.9-liter “F” gasoline engine, the lineup gained even more popularity in 1974 with the addition of the 3.0-liter “B” diesel engine. Its part-time 4-wheel-drive system with a 2-speed transfer case only reinforced its reputation for toughness. This was the model that embodied the Land Cruiser philosophy of “go anywhere and come back alive.”

Alongside the 2-door hardtop, the 40 series as a whole became one of the Land Cruiser’s greatest successes, remaining in production for 24 years, until 1984. Its enduring popularity inspired the launch of the FJ Cruiser in 2006, a modern homage that revived many of the classic 40’s design cues.

And in 2021, Toyota announced the reproduction of 40-series parts throuh Gazoo Racing, proving that this iconic Land Cruiser was, and always wil be, worth keeping alive on the road.
zh:
这款经典畅销的Land Cruiser生产周期长达24年。

凭借卓越的全地形性能与可靠性，Land Cruiser已成为全球最受喜爱的越野车型。1960年问世的第三代“40”车型还同时兼顾了舒适的公路驾驶体验。这台双门硬顶车型搭载3.9升F型汽油引擎和分时四驱传动系统。但1974年推出3升B型柴油引擎让这台车的人气进一步提升。该系列热销不衰，持续生产至1984年。

en:
The turbocharged model of Toyota's mid-engine sports car featured a rigid chassis that matched its extra power.

The second-generation MR2, which arrived in 1989, represented the all-new version of the AW11, Japan's first mass produced mid-engine sports car. Toyota wanted to broaden the appeal of its two-seater to the general public, so it made the car larger. To compensate for the added mass, Toyota increased power. The 4A-G, a 1.6-liter inline-4, was swapped in favor of the 3S-G, a 2.0-liter DOHC inline-4, which produced <165 ps> in naturally-aspirated form and <225 ps> when turbocharged. Unfortunately, with the new engines, the handling characteristics of the AW11 worsened, as the car exhibited a tendency to oversteer. As a result, in December 1991, the chassis was completely revised in the updated SW20 II model.

Things dramatically improved, even more so in 1994 with version III that featured more power via a stronger turbocharger; <245 ps> and <31.0 kgm> of torque. The naturally-aspirated model also saw an increase in performance going to <180 ps> and <19.5 kgm> of torque. In June 1996, the IV added a helical LSD, as well as standard fare ABS. In December 1997, the V introduced the VVT-i (Variable Valve Timing-intelligent) to the naturally-aspirated engine that was now pumping out <200 ps> and <21.0 kgm> of torque. With all these improvements, the SW20 became one of the most popular sports cars of its day, outshining the AW11, the model that started it all.
zh:
最终的涡轮增压机车型，具有可以承受引擎动力的底盘稳定性。

第二代MR2发布于1989年，也被称为SW20，是日本第一部中置布局量产车AW11的继任者。SW20的车身延长后达到日本5级汽车尺寸的上限，平滑圆润的造型也与第一代MR2截然不同，但仍然采用了中置式布局。发布初期，这辆车因其糟糕的操控而饱受批评，后续的更新升级却将其打造成了一款平衡性极佳的中置引擎跑车。

en:
This sports sedan's refined looks hide sharp teeth.

Originally released in 1968, the Toyota Mark II was Japan’s answer to the midsize sedan. The Tourer V was a performance trim grade that became available from the seventh-generation Mark II onward. The version shown here was the Tourer V from the eighth-generation Mark II, also known as the X100 series. The clean-cut, long-nose sedan body and wild driving character resulted in a very attractive car.

Its most notable feature was the power unit. The 2.5-liter inline-6 1JZ-GTE engine was a further-evolved, second-generation model with variable valve timing and a single turbocharger, producing <280ps>/<38.5kgm>. Also available with a 5-speed manual transmission, a push of the throttle pedal delivered a surge of boost and the sensuous growl of the inline-6.

While it boasted excellent performance, the interior focused instead on luxury and comfort, gently enveloping the driver and passengers.

This dichotomy was what made the Tourer V so attractive. It hid its teeth, presenting the image of a refined gentleman. Its discerning drivability sent many car enthusiasts wild.
zh:
这款运动轿车精致的外表下暗藏锋芒。

Tourer V是第8代Mark II系列车款中新增的一款运动版车型。其最大卖点是动力单元：一台涡轮增压2.5升直列六缸引擎，可输出280 PS动力和38.5 公斤力米扭矩。该车还提供了5速手动变速箱。当你将油门踏板踩到底时，六缸引擎的轰鸣声，伴随着强大的增压推背感，向你瞬间袭来。有如此澎湃动力，Tourer V的内饰依然堪称奢华舒适，将两种看似矛盾的特质集于一身。

en:
This Prius variant focused on both increased performance and delivering better overall driving pleasure.

The third-generation Prius, introduced at the 2009 North American International Auto Show, did not simply improve the environmental characteristics of its predecessor, it significantly raised the bar in terms of sportiness and the all-important fun-to-drive factor.

While the overall body style of the new Prius was defined by sharp lines and angles, making the vehicle more aerodynamic and better looking than the outgoing model, it also had a vastly improved drive system. A larger 1.8-liter engine was installed and more than 90 percent of the hybrid system was redesigned. And yes, it was more fun to drive than any Prius before it.

With an increase in the popularity of "green" vehicles in the global marketplace, the new Prius shattered its sales target goal of 10,000 units per month by selling 18,000 soon after its release. It continued to top the new-car sales chart for the next six months, all the way up to November 2009. Naturally, it was awarded Japan's Car of the Year for 2009.

The new Prius came in three trim levels of L, S, and G, with the G being the most luxurious, fitted with leather-wrapped steering and smart entry system.
zh:
这台Prius的目标不仅仅是性能提升，还有驾驶乐趣。

第三代Prius车型，混合动力汽车的代名词。这款车型不仅致力于提升环保性能，更注重驾驶乐趣的提升。全新车身采用利落的空气动力学造型，散发出强烈的速度感。引擎不仅扩大至1.8升，混合动力系统更是有超过90%的部件采用了全新开发的技术。在燃油经济性方面，这款车达到了惊人的2.7 升/百公里，为驾驶世界带来了全新品质——节油的乐趣。

en:
An adventurous SUV for active lifestyles.

When it was introduced in 1994, the Toyota RAV4 pioneered an entirely new market segment, called the “crossover SUV.” Combining smooth off-road handling with a compact body, the first-generation model was widely praised for its ability to transcend the boundaries of on-road and off-road vehicles, and it continued to evolve with each successive generation. In 2018, the fifth-generation RAV4 was introduced on an all-new platform. Built on Toyota’s New Global Architecture (TNGA), it set new benchmarks for driving dynamics, safety, and comfort.

The Adventure grade, in particular, embodied the core spirit of an SUV. With its distinctive front grille, skid-plate bumper, and 19-inch tires, it projected rugged styling and a readiness to embrace the great outdoors. Its powertrain paired a 2.0-liter 4-cylinder Dynamic Force Engine with a Direct Shift-CVT, delivering smooth acceleration and impressive fuel efficiency.

Of special note was the newly developed Dynamic Torque Vectoring AWD system, which precisely controlled torque distribution between the left and right rear wheels, enhancing both traction and stability. A disconnect mechanism allowed the driver to disengage the rear-drive system entirely, improving fuel economy during everyday use.

On the safety front, Toyota Safety Sense came standard across the lineup, offering advanced features such as a pre-collision safety system, Lane Tracing Assist, and adaptive Radar Cruise Control. Additional amenities included a modern multimedia system with smartphone integration and a Panoramic View Monitor that provided a bird’s-eye view around the vehicle.

An ideal expression of the modern SUV, it excelled on city streets and natural terrain, infusing a sense of adventure into daily driving.
zh:
专为挑战与活力打造的SUV。

1994年问世的Toyota RAV4开创了“跨界SUV”这一全新的细分市场。这款车型以紧凑的车身和高离地间隙赢得全球拥趸，并在2018年迎来第五代。Adventure版本拥有硬朗的越野造型，配备专属前格栅、防护板式保险杠及19英寸轮毂。2升直列四缸涡轮增压动态出力引擎与直驱式无级变速器，可同时实现平顺加速与出色的油耗。

en:
With its wide tread and low center of gravity, the "Yota-Hachi" was a capable sports car.\

With its compact and lightweight body, the Toyota Sports 800 was one of the most admired sports cars of its day. It made its debut in 1965, and represented Toyota's first production sports car. Known in Japan as the "Yota-Hachi" a vernacular phrase for "Toyota Eight," it also was the first Japanese car to feature a targa top and removable roof panel.

As a sports car, it was cleverly designed. It aimed for simplicity rather than complicated mechanics, so many parts came from its popular boxy passenger-car, the Publica. The Yota-Hachi was smaller than the Publica, with an overall length of <3580mm>.

The engine was a <790cc> flat-2 with two carburetors helping it to produce <45ps>. Although it wasn't as powerful as other sports cars, its lean <580kg> curb weight allowed it to behave like a true performance machine on the road. The FR (Front engine, Rear drive) exhibited adequate punch off the line and was able to reach <155km/h>, performance comparable to cars with <1500cc> engines.

Thanks in part to the Publica's wide tread and low center of gravity, the Sports 800 demonstrated exceptional agility on the twisty stuff, with sharp turn-in response and near neutral handling balance. Its main rival was the Honda S800, and oftentimes, the Sports 800 battled the little Honda on both road and track.
zh:
被车迷爱称为“Toyota 8”的车型。宽胎搭配上较低的重心，在过弯时优势明显。

被昵称为“Yota-Hachi”的Toyota Sports 800是一款小型跑车，采用固定B柱式可拆卸车顶设计（即Targa顶）。车身大量采用铝合金和丙烯酸材质部件，将整车重量降至仅580 公斤。750 立方厘米引擎虽然仅有45 PS的功率输出，但凭借轻量化的车身，最高速度可达到155 公里/小时，这已经与当时许多1,500 立方厘米级别车型的速度相当了。

en:
The tossable nature of this original hatchback 86 more than compensated for its lack of structural rigidity.

Already considered a classic among enthusiasts today, this compact car has become a favorite for drifters and has been featured in movies and comic books. The car has its roots from the Corolla/Sprinter, but when this model changed its layout to FF (front engine/front drive), the sporty version in the lineup, the AE86 or Corolla Levin/Sprinter Trueno, remained as a rear-wheel driver.

The "86" (or Hachi-Roku, as it was called in Japan) developed an immediate following because of its rear-drive layout, lightweight, excellent handling and affordable price tag. It came in two shapes: a 3-door hatchback and a 2-door notchback. The main difference between the Corolla Levin and Sprinter Trueno was the front end, where the former featured a horizontal grille and fixed headlights and the latter no grille and retractable headlights.

Providing power was the newly developed 4A-GEU, a 1.6-liter DOHC inline-4. This engine featured some of the day's most advanced technology, including EFI-D (Electronic Fuel Injection-Druck), which calculated fuel amount through a pressure sensor, and the T-VIS (Toyota Variable Injection System). This helped the 4-cylinder to produce <130ps> and <15.2kgm> of torque.

It revved freely and quick, and demonstrated excellent throttle response, making the car wonderfully controllable through tricky corners. The suspension, body and engine worked harmoniously together to provide real sports car attributes. It was this performance and personality that made the "86" loved by so many.
zh:
原版86掀背车，车身刚性欠缺的问题在怀旧面前就不再是问题了。

Corolla/Sprinter在1983年大部分改为前轮驱动布局，唯一例外是后轮驱动的AE86型Corolla Levin/Sprinter Trueno，也就是俗称的“Hachi-Roku”（86）。车身提供3门掀背和2门三厢斜背车两种版本。引擎为新开发的1.6升4A-GEU直列四缸双顶置凸轮轴型。虽然竞争对手也推出了相似规格的车型，但86至今仍因其趣味十足的操控体验而深受汽车爱好者喜爱。

en:
This variant of the Supra was a homologation model with special equipment for Group A racing.

Using the popular Celica XX, which made its debut in 1981, as the foundation, Toyota decided to embark on making a true sports car that would challenge the best examples from Europe. And after much research and development work, the company introduced the Supra in 1986.

Intended mainly for the North American market, the Supra featured a double-wishbone suspension at all four corners, a first for the company since the 2000GT. The rear differential utilized a subframe to deliver sporty handling and a comfortable ride.

The new Toyota sports car was large for a coupe, measuring <4620mm> long, <1690mm> wide and <1310mm> high. It initially came powered by the 7M engine, a 3.0-liter turbocharged unit that produced <230ps>, with a twin-turbocharged <185ps> 2.0-liter inline-4 and normally-aspirated versions added later (<105ps> and <140ps>). But the most noteworthy Supra was the 3.0 GT Turbo A, which appeared in 1988. This model became the foundation for a race car that competed in the Japan National Touring Car Series. It used a 3.0-liter turbo engine that produced <270ps>., and it wore the same <1745mm>-wide body as the North American-spec model, with low-profile tires and improved suspension.

In 1990, this power plant was replaced by the 1JZ-GTE in the 2.5GT Twin Turbo R. The new engine cranked out <280ps>, which was the maximum allowed for JDM cars at that time.
zh:
获得认证的车型，具备A组别标准的特殊设备。

XX起初只是Celica的一个改款，后来在1986年2月独立成一个车型，并获得了Supra的名号。在所有不同档次型号之中，人气最高的就是高性能的3.0GT Turbo A。这个型号是专为参加锦标赛而生产的认证车型，采用了一台270 PS的7M-GTEU 3升涡轮增压引擎。此外，它还采用了与北美规格车型相同的1,745毫米宽车身，外加一套加强型悬挂。

en:
This car brought an end to the GT-R's domination by taking the title in 1997.!

As the most popular form of motorsports in Japan, the All Japan Grand Touring Championship (JGTC) featured the country's top car makers doing battle on the country's most famous racetracks. The series was renamed the Super GT Series in 2005, with races held in Malaysia and China, expanding its appeal throughout Asia. So it was understandable that Japanese automobile manufacturers poured plenty of energy and resources into producing results in this racing series.

Toyota was among the early pioneers, whose Supra, running in the GT500 class, was the main challenger to the Nissan GT-R that had dominated the series for three straight years beginning with the first year of the championship in 1993. In 1997, the Supra finally dethroned the GT-R and became series champion with the number 36 Castrol Tom's Supra.

The winning car was piloted by Michael Krumm and Pedro de la Rosa, who began racing the Tom's Supra starting with the second round of that year. In their next five races, they won two races and placed 2nd and 3rd in two others to secure the championship. This was accomplished despite the fact that the car had not changed greatly from the previous year; the only differences were a switch from an "H"-pattern gearbox to a Hewland 6-speed sequential transmission, and lowering engine displacement to 2.0 liters to decrease weight. Still, the 3S-GT engine produced nearly <500ps>.

When all this was combined with better structural rigidity, an improved suspension system and better aerodynamics, the GT500 race Supra had no equals.
zh:
这台机器正是终结GT-R王朝的勇士。

全日本GT锦标赛（JGTC）一直举办到2004年，随后演变为现在的Super GT系列赛。Toyota Supra于1994年开始参加JGTC赛事。当时赛事由Nissan Skyline GT-R统治，但1997年Supra终于从GT-R手中夺回了当季的冠军。这辆具有历史意义的赛车正是36号Castrol TOM'S Supra。

en:
This Supra was all business, equipped with a 6-speed gearbox and Bilstein suspension.

Toyota took its flagship sports car, the Supra, in an entirely new direction when it introduced the second-generation variant in May 1993. This was evident from the car's unique exterior styling that featured a long nose, large fixed rectangular headlights and slim taillights on a round rear. It looked nothing at all like the previous model, or anything else on the road for that matter. It sat <120mm> wider and <100mm> shorter. Inside the cockpit was a snug 2+2 layout with the dashboard wrapping around the front-seat occupants.

There were two engines offered, a naturally aspirated and turbocharged version of the 2JZ. The base 3.0-liter DOHC inline-6 produced <225ps> while the turbocharged one cranked out <280ps>. A race version of this engine is said to produce <400ps> to <500ps>, so it was far from reaching its potential in the Supra, though many aftermarket tuners managed to reach that figure and beyond. The engines came mated to a 5-speed manual, 4-speed automatic or a new Getrag 6-speed manual gearbox.

The Supra's suspension consisted of double wishbones at all four corners, tuned to provide maximum cornering prowess. Thus, ride quality was on the stiff side, but this FR (Front engine, Rear drive) car possessed the best handling in its class.
zh:
6速变速箱和Blistein悬挂，让Supra更上层楼。

1993年5月，Toyota Supra重获新生，摒弃了传统的长车鼻设计，换上了更具魅力的肌肉形态。这个车型采用了著名的2JZ 3升双顶置凸轮轴双涡轮增压引擎，能够输出280 PS的动力。而最高档车型还搭载了一套六速手动变速箱和Bilstein悬挂。此外它还获得了结构强化，并对避震器和衬套进行了调校，让这只桀骜的野兽更易驯服。

en:
The revolutionary hybrid-powered racing prototype that waged war at Le Mans and the WEC.

The TS030 hybrid prototype race car waged battle in the 2012 24 Hours of Le Mans and the WEC (World Endurance Championships) as one of the first hybrid-powered machines to step onto the international motorsports stage.

As its name suggests, the TS030 succeeds the TS010 and TS020, Toyota's awesome race cars that competed at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in the 1990s. What sets the TS030 apart from its predecessors is its hybrid powertrain.

The THS-R system (Toyota Hybrid System-Racing) was developed by Toyota's production hybrid development team and the East Fuji Research Lab's motorsports department. The car utilizes a newly designed naturally-aspirated 3.4-liter V8 and a Denso motor unit built into the rear gearbox. Power is stored in an electric double-layer capacitor.

The drivers of the TS030 were Alexander Wurz, Nicolas Lapierre and Kazuki Nakajima. For the 24-hour race, a second car, driven by the formidable lineup of Anthony Davidson, Stéphane Sarrazin and Sébastien Buemi, was added.

At its first Le Mans race, the TS030 ran at the top of its class, but was forced to retire due to accidents and problems. However, the car made up for its shortcomings in the WEC. Of the six races the TS030 ran, it won three times, took three pole positions, and set four fastest laps. And although the car didn't partake in every race of the series, it still managed to take 2nd overall at the end of the WEC season.
zh:
参加勒芒24小时耐力赛和WEC的原型赛车，采用混动系统。

这辆TS030 Hybrid是专为参加2012世界耐力锦标赛所开发。它的“THS-R”动力系统由Toyota的量产混动开发团队与东富士技术中心的赛车运动部门合作打造，采用了一部全新设计的V8引擎。在参加勒芒24小时耐力赛的首秀中，这辆车不幸被迫退赛。但在接下来的整个赛季里，它夺得了3场胜利，并最终在排行榜上位列第二。

en:
Toyota's hybrid LMP1 car was developed to dominate the World Endurance Championship.

The TS050 Hybrid was Toyota’s prototype race car, developed in 2016 to compete in the LMP1 class of the FIA World Endurance Championship, which included the legendary 24 Hours of Le Mans. Two years earlier, in 2014, Toyota had claimed the series championship with the TS040 Hybrid. By 2015, however, the team finished the season in 3rd place, prompting Toyota to design the TS050 from scratch to reclaim the top.

Like its predecessor, the TS050 was an all-wheel-drive hybrid, employing MGUs at both the front and rear wheels. But the powertrain switched from the naturally-aspirated 3.7-liter V-8 to a twin-turbocharged, direct-injection 2.4-liter V-6. Its supercapacitor system was replaced with a high-power lithium-ion battery, specially developed for racing and capable of rapid energy storage and deployment. The total system output stood at <1000ps>, equal to the TS040’s, but torque was significantly boosted thanks to turbocharging.

Further refinements included a more compact front MGU, which enabled aerodynamic redesigns to channel airflow more efficiently under the car, further sharpening its performance.

Toyota Gazoo Racing fielded two TS050 Hybrids in the World Endurance Championships. One car was piloted by Kazuki Nakajima, Sébastien Buemi, and Anthony Davidson, while the other was shared by Kamui Kobayashi, Stéphane Sarrazin, and Mike Conway. In 2016, the Kobayashi entry demonstrated blistering pace and remained in contention for the Drivers’ Championship, but in the end, the team concluded the season ranked 3rd in the Manufacturers’ standings.
zh:
Toyota的混合动力LMP1车型，专为在世界耐力锦标赛中夺冠而设计。

这辆TS050 - Hybrid 是专为参加2016世界耐力锦标赛所开发。这辆车安装有一部V6直喷双涡轮增压引擎，前后轴上还安装了电机发电机单元。引擎和电机的总动力输出达到了1,000 PS。这辆车来势汹汹，似乎对车手冠军头衔志在必得，但最终只在排行榜上屈居第三。而在车厂排行上，这款车也以第三名的成绩收官。

carNameEn: Toyota Trueno 3door 1600GT APEX (AE86 Shuichi Shigeno Version)
sourceName: Sprinter Trueno 3door 1600GT APEX (AE86 Shuichi Shigeno Version) '00
en:
This modified 86 was built to order for the author of the "Initial D" comic books.

Known in Japan as the "Hachi-Roku" (Eight-Six), the popularity of the AE86 Levin/Trueno platform has not diminished in the more than 25 years since it first appeared. The Trueno here is of special interest—it is owned by Shuichi Shigeno, the author of "Initial D," a very popular comic book series in Japan in which the AE86 plays a pivotal role.

While chassis rigidity was improved by beefing up some body panels in key areas, the car's overall stock curb weight was reduced by about 100 kg, thanks to installing a carbon composite hood in place of the much heavier stock unit.

The AE86 enjoyed a long and varied tuning history, from carburetor conversions to superchargers to turbo kits. The method chosen for our car is perhaps the most common of AE86 upgrades: conversion to a 4-barrel throttle body. Further upgrades like high-compression pistons and a high-lift camshaft helped bring out the famous engine's character even more, imparting it with an exciting power curve where engine response felt sharp and the torque delivered generously with increasing revs.

A powerful MoTeC engine control unit was utilized for superior control, enabling the engine to attain a <210ps> maximum output, which is very close to the physical limits under normally aspirated tune. The exhaust system made use of an HKS manifold and Trust muffler to extract the most performance from the engine... plus it sounded really nice.
zh:
调校版86，专为《头文字D》作者量身定制。

这台车是人气漫画《头文字D》作者重野秀一所拥有的Trueno，该漫画对“Hachi-Roku”，即AE86型Levin/Trueno有很多描绘。该车加装了HKS排气歧管和Trust消音器，使引擎输出动力提升至210 PS。此外还配备了TRD悬挂套件，实现了敏捷的车身动态和高速过弯能力。

en:
Toyota's large pickup was equipped with a unique suspension system to maximize its sporting performance.

Toyota decided to go after Ford and Chevy in the heartland of America by offering a large pickup truck called the Tundra to the North American market.

The Tundra struggled at first, as it was smaller than its competition, and unable to sway die-hard Ford and Chevy fans from ditching their F-150s and Silverados. So for the second-generation model which was introduced in 2007, Toyota made its truck even bigger and dropped a larger engine into it. While it wasn't enough to dethrone the American brands, it was a great success in the marketplace.

In 2014, the bodywork was made more aggressive, and in 2015 the “TRD Pro” version was introduced. Tuned by TRD, Toyota’s motorsport arm, the new truck performed significantly better on rough roads, thanks to TRD coils and Bilstein dampers that improved the stroke characteristics of the suspension.

The TRD Pro disappeared from the Tundra lineup afterward, but returned again in 2019. Based on the Crewmax 4x4 with a 5.7-liter V8, the suspension was further tuned with Fox dampers, and its sporting character was enhanced with equipment such as a new hood scoop and BBS wheels.
zh:
Toyota的全尺寸皮卡使用了独特的悬挂系统和配件，可最大程度发挥运动性能。

Tundra是Toyota专为北美市场开发的全尺寸皮卡。2015年推出的TRD Pro是由Toyota赛车运动部门TRD调校的5.7升V8四驱版本。悬挂系统经过调校并配备Fox减震器，新设计的引擎盖进气口和BBS轮毂打造出更加运动化的外观。

en:
Its cute silhouette and rear-engine layout made this car an icon in automobiledom.

The Volkswagen Type 1, better known as "The Beetle" and "The Bug," can arguably be called the most universally loved automobile in history. "The People's Car," as it was known in Germany when it was introduced in the late 1930s, was designed by none other than Dr. Ferdinand Porsche.

The Type 1's most distinctive design features were its cute-looking round silhouette and air-cooled 4-cylinder rear-mounted engine (rear engine/rear-wheel drive layout). This engine would be the predecessor found in a long line of Porsche cars, featuring a flat or Boxer layout. Perhaps most remarkable of all was its production volume and longevity: 21 million cars were produced from 1938 all the way up to 2003.

The Volkswagen 1200 was the official name of the model manufactured in the mid-1950s to the late 1960s powered by a 1.2-liter 4-cylinder engine. Of these, the 1966 model is of particular interest to many VW fans and car collectors. This was the last Beetle to use a 6-volt battery to power its electrical system and was nicknamed the "6-Volt" in some countries.

From 1967 on, the electrical system was updated to a 12-volt system, and the car featured upright headlights, making it look more modern. The <1192cc> engine mounted in the 1200 first appeared in 1954. A <1285cc> version appeared in 1965 and a <1493cc> was offered in 1966. The engine did get a few improvements over the years, as horsepower was increased from the initial <34ps> to <40ps> in its late years.
zh:
外形可爱的后驱车，也是商用车历史上的一个里程碑。

以“甲壳虫”为世人所熟知的Volkswagen Type I是一款后轮驱动车型，它的气冷式4缸引擎也安装在车身后部。这款车的生产周期从1938年一直持续到2003年，总共生产了超过2100万辆。从二十世纪50年代中期到60年代末期生产的型号安装了一台1.2升引擎，而它的正式名称就是Volkswagen 1200。

en:
This Gr.3 race version of the Volkswagen Beetle is on an entirely different level to the road-going model.

The Beetle is an important part of Volkswagen’s history and heritage. But beneath its charming exterior lies a rich motorsport pedigree. It enjoyed its moment in the racing spotlight as far back as the 1950s. Early in its storied history, the Beetle won the East African Safari Rally three times and held its own in the Acropolis Rally in Greece. The reborn Beetle, which debuted in 1998, even inspired its own one-make racing series. In more recent years, it achieved notable success in the Global Rallycross in the U.S.

This Beetle Gr.3 is a model that traces this racing legacy of the Beetle. Its extensively reworked exterior and internals embody the spirit of racing success that Volkswagen has achieved over decades of competition.

The body has been widened to accommodate larger-diameter wheels, while the roofline has been lowered to reduce frontal area, resulting in a silhouette reminiscent of a classic chop-top Beetle. The aggressive front spoiler, functional air outlets channeling flow from the front tires to the door panels, and the towering rear wing all speak volumes about this car’s performance pedigree.

At its heart lies a DOHC 2.0-liter inline-4 paired with a high-pressure turbocharger, mated to VW's proven 7-speed DSG transmission. While output is adjusted according to Balance of Performance (BoP) regulations for each race, rest assured, it packs more than enough punch to compete fiercely in the Gr.3 category.

This racing Beetle exists in an entirely different realm from the charming, street-going Beetles you might be familiar with.
zh:
这辆Gr.3竞赛级别Beetle与可爱的公路版本Beetle完全是两个层次。

Beetle Gr.3是Volkswagen标志性紧凑型车Beetle的赛车版，经改装后符合Gr.3组别规则。通过将动力传动系统从前驱改为后驱，降低车顶减小正面横截面等大量改装，这台小巧的基础车型摇身一变，成为顶级赛车。

carNameEn: Volkswagen GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo
en:
This supercar with the GTI's DNA possesses race car-like acceleration.

The alluring "GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo," created by Volkswagen Design, embraces the successful history of the GTI in its flowing lines. The style-defining design elements from various GTI generations illustrate the rich history of the model, and you can tell by just looking at it, notably the low-cut windshield, that this roadster promises great fun and excitement behind the wheel.

Powered by a 3.0 twin-turbo VR6 TSI engine, the GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo delivers 503 HP with a hearty helping of 665 Nm (<67.8kgm>) of torque. The 7-speed dual-clutch transmission with sports programming ensures phenomenal acceleration and fast gearshifts on the racetrack.

An aerodynamically optimized front and rear spoiler, together with an integrated diffuser element at the rear, combine to generate gobs of downforce. Fitted with 20-inch wheels that are shod with 235/35 front and 275/30 rear tires, the all-wheel-drive sports car stays glued to the driving surface in all types of conditions. Stopping power is provided by ventilated ceramic brakes, <380 mm> in diameter at the front and <356 mm> at the rear.

The "GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo" is presented in a bright, intense Gran Turismo Red, a modern interpretation of the classic GTI red.

The result is a fascinating and exceptionally dynamic extreme sports car with a sophisticated design for the racetrack that appropriately conveys what it's like to drive in the GTI world.
zh:
体验极限加速性能。具有“GTI”血统的超跑。

“GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo”是一款继承了Volkswagen“GTI”经验和基因的超级跑车。它的心脏是一部3升双涡轮增压VR6 TSI引擎，能够输出510 PS/67.0 公斤力米。这股动力通过一套7档双离合传动系统输送到前后车轮，实现了无与伦比的牵引力和加速性能。

carNameEn: Volkswagen GTI Supersport Vision Gran Turismo
en:
The ultimate GTI; there's a reason this car's name includes "Supersport."

Volkswagen developed a new sports car for the digital world when it unveiled the 2-seat “GTI Supersport Vision Gran Turismo." The designers and engineers injected the DNA from the legendary GTI into this car, before further refining the car's design and performance. The car came equipped a 503-hp VR6 TSI engine that was mated to a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox. Power was transferred to all four wheels via VW's 4MOTION four-wheel-drive system. Thanks to a whopping 665 Nm (<67.8kgm>) of torque, this car provides amazing acceleration, while its handling was tuned specifically for the “Gran Turismo” race tracks.

The body of the “Supersport” was aerodynamically optimized through numerous features. The front-end, for instance, was fine-tuned, with the designers placing the vertical light modules further outboard. They are now connected by a spoiler element to underscore the width of the GTI and enhance its visual presence. The air flow through the body was enhanced with a large air inlet that boosts aerodynamic performance at the front. The airstream flows past the front wheels and is practically sucked out of the wheel arches in order to cool down the brake discs. The hallmark GTI honeycomb structure adorns all the air inlet and outlet openings.

Aerodynamics and cooling are just as important in the strengthened rear section: downstream of the roof spoiler, a rear wing creates the necessary downforce to keep the rear end stable. An aerodynamic feature on the roof ensures that the airflow to the rear wing is ideal. Furthermore, air flows through the rear wheel arches in order to optimally dissipate the thermal energy produced during braking. The flat rear lights have been visually adapted to the extraordinary flat and dynamic proportions of the rear end.

Like the “Roadster,” the “Supersport”was also fitted with 20-inch GTI alloy wheels. The multipiece GTI wheels ere refined further to a five-spokes design finished in ultralight carbn fiber Between the wheels, the two classic GT stripes can be foun above the side sill, an homageto the Golf GTI I. The sme appies to the halmark black fil around the edges of the rear window, which is finished in a carbon-fiber look. A hlmet compartment and a racig tank have also been bult ito the car. The “G Supersport iioh Gran Surismo” coes in io four colors eflex Silver, Gran Turismo Red, apiz Blue and Oryx White.
On digital acetracks around the world, the unmistakably charismatic looks o the new eTI Superport ision Gran Turismo” is sure to catch more than a few tares ab make the competitioh nevu.
zh:
超跑的性能和外形。拓展了GTI的可能。

这款“GTI Supersport Vision Gran Turismo”的基因继承自Volkswagen GTI发展史上的诸多传奇车型，铸就了一辆从技术上到外观上都精益求精的超级跑车。它的车身给人以经典车型Golf的熟悉感，车身内安装了一部510 PS排量的VR6 TSI引擎。轻量化部件和低重心姿态的设计提供了非常优秀的操控体验。

en:
This supercar with the GTI's DNA possesses race car-like acceleration.

Based on successful GTI DNA, Volkswagen Design has developed a highly distinctive supercar: the “GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo”.

The design owes much to the successful history of the GTI: style-defining design elements from the various GTI generations illustrate the extraordinary evolution of this vehicle. Boasting a visionary design, the Roadster promises an immediate driving experience – the extreme acceleration can be experienced directly through the low-cut windscreen.

Powered by a 3.0 twin-turbo VR6 TSI engine, the "GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo" delivers <510ps> with an enormous torque of 665 Nm (<67.8kgm>). The 7-speed dual-clutch transmission with sports programming ensures phenomenal acceleration and fast gear-shifts on the racetrack.

An aerodynamically optimized front and rear spoiler, together with an integrated diffuser element at the rear, achieve the required downforce for excellent road-holding. Fitted with 20-inch wheels in size 235/35 (front) and 275/30 (rear), the massive torque can be transferred reliably to the track via 4 driven wheels. The supercar features ventilated ceramic brakes, <380mm> in diameter at the front and <356mm> at the rear.

The "GTI Roadster Vision Gran Turismo" is presented in a bright, intense Gran Turismo Red, a modern interpretation of the classic GTI red.

The result is a fascinating and exceptionally dynamic extreme sports car with a sophisticated design for the racetrack in which players can gain a unique impression of what it’s like to drive in the GTI world.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.3 regulations by Gran Turismo.
zh:
体验极限加速性能。具有“GTI”血统的超跑。

GTI Vision Gran Turismo是Volkswagen和《跑车浪漫旅》联合开发的车型，而这辆跑车浪漫旅的原创车型则是它的Gr.3规则改装版本。设计师为它加装了大尺寸前定风翼和扩宽的尾翼，进而使下压力得到了大幅度提升。

en:
This grandfather of hot hatches balanced everyday usability with a fun-to-drive nature.

When the time came for Volkswagen to create a successor to the legendary people's car, the Beetle, it came in the form of the Golf in 1974. Unlike the Beetle, however, the Golf had its engine up front powering the front wheels (FF), and this format would define the company's compact cars to this day.

The revolutionary packaging was a hit with the public, spurring VW to produce a number of variations on the Golf theme. Included among them was the GTI, which made its debut at the 1975 Frankfurt Motor Show.

Based on the 2-door Golf LSI, the GTI came powered by a 1.6-liter SOHC inline-4 whose compression ratio was boosted to 9.5:1 and featured Bosch fuel-injection. The end result was an engine that produced <110 ps> at <6100 rpm> and <14.0 kgm> of torque at <5000 rpm>. The car's handling saw dramatic improvements as well. The suspension was strengthened and counterbalanced, with custom shocks and springs that stiffened ride quality but improved the car's cornering nature. Also assisting in this department were 175/70R13 tires.

The Golf GTI enjoyed great popularity, and improved gradually over the years. In 1979, it received a 5-speed manual transmission, then in 1981 a 4-door model was added, and at the end of 1982, a 1.8-liter inline-4 was introduced. The Golf GTI set the standard for VW's compact cars to this day.
zh:
小钢炮车型的鼻祖，在日常用途的同时提供更多驾驶乐趣。

Volkswagen Golf于1974年推出，作为紧凑型车型的开拓者获得了巨大成功。运动版“GTI”搭载1.6升直列四缸顶置单凸轮轴引擎，配备Bosch燃油喷射系统，输出功率可达110 PS。GTI完美融合了高性能与实用性，开创了运动驾驶的全新标准。

en:
The GTI version of the 7th-generation Golf ups its handling performance.

When the 7th-generation Golf made its debut in 2012, the car seemed more or less a carryover from the previous model; however, once Volkswagen revealed the changes made under the sheet metal, it was clear that the new Golf was a different breed altogether from its predecessor.

The platform was thoroughly refreshed, highlighted by a newly developed modular MQB system that significantly heightened driving performance, improved ride quality and increased safety. The Golf has long been considered the benchmark of the C-segment class, but the new version raised the bar even higher, leaving engineers from America, Japan and Korea scratching their collective heads.

In fact, the bar was raised so high that the sport-tuned Golf models were making sports car makers nervous. Both 3-door and 5-door GTIs possessed a high level of performance that could satisfy the most critical enthusiast. Under the hood was an intercooled-turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-4, with the output improved from <210ps> of the previous GTI to <220ps>. This improved the 0-<100km/h> acceleration time of the car from 6.9 seconds to 6.5, and increased its top speed to <246km/h> from <240km/h>.

The new GTI shined in the handling department as well. Advancements in the “XDS” electronic control differential lock, which acts as a limited-slip differential, was improved to give the GTI super crisp turn-in response. The adaptive chassis control called “DCC,” along with the utilization of progressive steering, improved the Golf’s overall stability and cornering speed.

Also of note, the new GTI featured BlueMotion technology, a first for this model. Adding a brake energy recovery system and a start-and-stop mechanism, the new car was greener than before. Safety was also enhanced, thanks to a pre-crash brake system and lane assist.

The Glf GTI has always been known as a giant killer, and the new 7th-gen iteraion embraced that role as never before.`
zh:
7代高尔夫的GTI版本，操作性能达到巅峰。

2012年首次亮相的第7代Volkswagen Golf基于新平台打造，从而将各种改进化为现实。最值得一提的是，该车的操控性在“XDS”（一种工作原理与限滑差速器类似的电子差速器锁定系统）、“DCC”适应性底盘控制和渐进式转向的加持下得到了改善。这些改进提升了车辆的稳定性和高速过弯性能。

en:
The prototype EV that rewrote speed records around the world.)

As the threat of global climate change looms ever closer, automotive manufacturers are pushing forward with electrification to reduce carbon dioxide emissions. Volkswagen was one of the first companies to take up the challenge. The company introduced its ID brand in 2020, which included a radical performance machine that showed the awesome performance potential of electric vehicles. This car was the ID.R prototype race car.

The ID.R's body was constructed of carbon-fiber, with oversized wings placed on the front and rear to produce maximum downforce. At <5.2m> long, the car was relatively large, but weighed less than <1100kg>. The dual-motor 4WD system produced 500 kW (<680ps>) / 650 Nm (<66.3kgm>), allowing for a 0-<100km>/h acceleration time of just 2.25s. These performance statistics rivaled those of race cars with internal combustion engines.

In the real world, the ID.R competed in numerous motorsports events around the world and produced amazing results. At the 2018 Pikes Peak Hill Climb, driver Romain Dumas set a record of 7 minutes 57 seconds, the first ever run to break the 8-minute barrier. At the Nürburgring Nordschliefe, the ID.R set the record for fastest lap by an EV at 6 minutes 5 seconds. At the Goodwood Festival of Speed, the car became the first to ever finish the legendary hill in less than 40 seconds with a record of 39.9s.

Since the birth of the automobile, people have been enamored with the pursuit of speed. The ID.R is proof that even in the age of electrification, this fascination lives on.
zh:
这款原型电动车在世界各地“刷圈速”。

Volkswagen的原型赛车堪称碳减排的典范。碳纤维车身前后配备大型扰流翼，采用双电机布局分别驱动前后车轴。此车同时拥有惊人的性能表现，在派克峰爬坡赛、纽博格林北侧赛道以及古德伍德速度节等赛事中创下了令人瞩目的圈速记录。

en:
The 'hot' version of the 5th generation Polo uses an advanced engine setup."

The Polo, one of the core models in Volkswagen's lineup, has been considered a benchmark for B-segment cars around the world, and the fifth-generation model, introduced at the 2009 Geneva Motor Show was no exception.

The new Polo featured bold styling cues that differentiated it from other B-segment entries. It was also greener than its predecessor, thanks to a smaller engine and a super efficient 7-speed DSG transmission. The sporty GTI model made its debut in 2010, equipped with a new 1.4-liter direct injection inline-4 that came with both a turbo and supercharger. It produced <179ps>/<25.5kgm> that allowed the GTI to run from zero to <100km/h> in 6.9 seconds and reach a top speed of <225km/h>. What's more, fuel economy was rated at <16.6 km/L>, the best ever for a Polo.

With ground holding improvements including sports suspension and electronic devices that perform the same function as a limited-slip differential, the Polo GTI was one of the best handling machines in its segment, with some even claiming that it was right up there with its bigger brother, the vaunted Golf GTI.

In 2014, the GTI model received a facelift. One of the most notable changes is the new engine. Now featuring a <400cc> larger 1.8L inline-4 turbo engine, the maximum power output had increased to <192ps>. Extra power isn't the only difference, as the fuel efficiency had also been greatly improved, consuming much less fuel than the 1.4L GTI.
zh:
第五代Polo的“高性能”版本使用了先进的引擎配置。

Volkswagen经典紧凑型车第5代Polo的高性能版本。最初搭载1.4升双增压引擎，2014年款改为1.8升涡轮增压引擎，在实现192 PS高功率输出的同时提升了燃油经济性。凭借配得上GTI徽章的出色性能，这款车型是B级高性能掀背车的杰出代表。

en:
With maximum interior space in a small body, this cute bus was highly efficient.+

The Volkswagen created by Dr. Ferdinand Porsche had a plethora of ideas packed in the small bodies, as well as infinite possibilities. The cars were developed into a variety of variants, from off-road cars for battlefields, to sports cars like the Porsche 911.

This Sambabus is an example of its transformation into a van with a large luggage space. Because the engine is mounted in the rear in the same manner as the old Volkswagen Beetle, the nose is extremely short. And because of the flat horizontally opposed engine, the floor of the luggage room is not very high. This is an example of the Volkswagen mechanism proving its superiority, in attaining the maximum space in a minimum body size.

The actual height of the car is relatively low at less than <1600mm>, and it is said this is because they did not want to raise the air resistance with a high height. Still, because the floor of the car was very low to the ground, it had more space than its rivals, and it was also very high in cost performance. Its small turning radius thanks to its short wheelbase, and the versatility of its compact size also gave it a lot of advantages as a commercial van.

The round headlights and the rounded front end design was practical but humorous, and is often used as a motif of other custom cars. Volkswagen is well aware of the important image of the Sambabus, and has already introduced this in taller wagon concept cars.
zh:
具有露营车风格，以最小的体量实现了最大的内部空间。

由费迪南德·保时捷博士设计的Volkswagen车型推出过多种不同版本。其中一款改成了厢式货车，提供更大的行李空间，那就是Sambabus。通过将水平对置引擎安装在车尾，设计师成功地在保持紧凑车身尺寸的同时，腾出了宽敞且极低的地板空间。这一高实用性的特点给了这个车型诸多优点，使其成为了一款非常成功的商用车辆。

en:
This attractive coupe possessed the sharp cornering ability of a full-fledged sports car.\

Thanks to its sporty and stylish nature, the Volkswagen Scirocco became a popular 3-door model in the 1970s and 80s; however, it ultimately faded into automotive oblivion by the early 1990s. Just when we thought we heard the last of the Scirocco, it made a triumphant return in 2008 as a hot new hatchback based on the popular VW Golf platform.

The new Scirocco continues where the last one left off, offering plenty of sport for the economy-minded enthusiast. Its turbo-/supercharged 1.4-liter TSI engine gained high praise for its performance when it debuted in 2008, but the following year, an even better powerplant was introduced under the hood of the hot Scirocco R. This car was so impressive that it won its class in the Nürburgring 24-hour race two years in a row.

The Scirocco R's lowered ride height and wide body hinted at its high-performance nature: it wore special side skirts and a roof spoiler reminiscent of the successful Nürburgring race car. Its suspension and brakes were greatly improved, and the 2.0-liter TSI direct-injection turbocharged engine produced an impressive <256ps> at <6000rpm>—the same as the Golf R. But while the Golf R utilized 4-Motion all-wheel drive, the Scirocco remained front-wheel drive to keep its weight low. As a result, it is <120kg> lighter than the Golf R at <1410kg>.

With its dynamic engine sound, sharp cornering capability and convenient utility, the Volkswagen Scirocco is the rare car that fulfills every boy racer's heart for spirited driving while also serving the role as everyday commuter.

*This model was specially tuned to meet Gr.4 regulations by Gran Turismo.
zh:
堪称完成体的运动双门跑车，过弯干净利落。

对Volkswagen那独具风格的Scirocco跑车进行Gr.4规格改装，便得到了这款跑车浪漫旅的原创车型。在空气动力学方面，它采用了相对低调保守的设计，只安装了小尺寸的前定风翼和尾翼。但这辆车的开发重心是发挥基础车型的高性能，并实现了远超大部分前驱车的过弯性能。

en:

zh:
堪称完成体的运动双门跑车，过弯干净利落。

Scirocco R是一款基于Golf基础组件开发的高性能运动轿跑车。车身采用低离地间隙和宽轮距设计，配备了专用保险杠、侧边包围和车顶扰流板。悬挂系统和制动系统也得到了重大升级。这款车相比同期推出的Golf R更加轻盈，被精心打造成一台“身手矫健”的高规格运动车型。

en:
A historic model that epitomized the station wagon.

Back in the day, when someone uttered the name Volvo, many people tended to envision a station wagon. Until SUVs became popular in the late 1980s, station wagons were considered the ultimate family utility vehicle, and the one model that epitomized this genre was the Volvo 240 Estate.

When the 240 was introduced in 1974, it featured a number of different body styles, including the "244" sedan, the "242" coupe and the "245" 5-door wagon. The last digit in these numerical designations denoted the number of doors of the model.

It wasn't until 1983 that these variants were consolidated into a single 240 model. The model was introduced with round headlights, but were replaced with the company's iconic square lamps in 1979. The exterior appearance of the 240 was timeless, remaining largely unchanged until production of the vehicle ended in 1993. But in terms of safety, it was always on the cutting-edge, with airbags and ABS offered as standard equipment. The Estate was extremely popular, making up one-third of the 240 sales mix in an era when sedans were the "in" thing.

One of the most notable features of the 240 Estate was its styling. Its boxy exterior became its most distinguishable feature. It emphasized "safety" with its long overhangs, front and rear that incorporated ample crumble zones. This resulted in the car's characteristically long thin silhouette.

Like the exterior, the car's cabin was characterized by a simple yet functional design that defined cars made in Scandinavia at the time.

Although not particularly powerful, the engine was robust and capable. Ride quality was excellent, thanks to a well-tuned suspension system. Everything about the 240 Estate made drivers want to pack their bags and head out on an extended road trip to enjoy the countryside.

It took quite some time unti the 240 was recognized for its historical significance. It's rare for a ar to retain such a following well after its production run had ended.
zh:
这款拥有特殊历史意义的车型让全世界对旅行车爱不释手。

240 Estate这台车是奠定了Volvo旅行车制造商形象的经典之作。其最大魅力在于棱角分明的方正造型与修长的车身比例。其余亮点包括简约独特的北欧风格内饰及柔软如沙发的座椅。尽管已停产多年，这台车仍被许多人珍视为日常座驾，这在经典车型中实属罕见。

en:
The globally successful Volvo that served as a sedan, estate and coupe.

The V40 was revealed at the 2012 Geneva Motor Show as a C-segment 5-door hatchback. Although positioned as Volvo’s entry-level model, it played a significant role in the lineup, effectively replacing three models: the S40 sedan, V50 wagon and C30 three-door hatchback.

Developed from the ground up, the car was designed to combine the comfort of a sedan, the practicality of a wagon and the sporty appeal of a coupe.

While the underlying structure shared elements with a Ford-derived platform, the styling marked a clear departure from Volvo’s traditionally conservative image. Drawing inspiration from the classic P1800 of the 1960s and the later 1800ES, it featured flowing lines and a distinctive silhouette that blended coupe and estate influences. The model was well received at launch, earning attention for both its design and versatility, with seating for four adults and usable cargo space.

The T5 R-Design stood as the sportiest variant in the range. Its <213ps> turbocharged 2.0-liter inline-5 delivered strong acceleration, while a sport-tuned suspension and 18-inch wheels provided a balance of handling and ride comfort. Unique exterior elements, including a revised front bumper and rear diffuser, enhanced both aerodynamics and visual presence.
zh:
身兼轿车、旅行车和双门轿车三种身份，在全球范围内取得巨大成功的Volvo车型。

V40是瞄准C级车定位的5门掀背车型。汲取Volvo 1960年代经典车型如P1800和1800ES的设计灵感，流畅的车身轮廓既可诠释为双门轿车，也可视为旅行车。T5 R-Design是该系列中最具运动性的车型。2L直列五缸涡轮增压引擎输出213 PS，运动悬挂和18英寸轮毂带来敏锐而平顺的操控体验。

en:
More than 10,000 labor hours went into this 2016 Gran Turismo Award winner."

In 2016, the 1951 Ford Custom Club Coupe drove away with the coveted Gran Turismo Award, a prize presented every year at the SEMA show in Las Vegas to the best customized car at the convention.

This particular example was built by a team of specialists working for former racing driver Bruce Leven, who incorporated Leven's vision of a classic racing Ford with elements of European style; thus, the Custom Club Coupe features major bodywork that includes a slimmer waistline and lower roof.

Under the hood of this mean machine is a 1956 Lincoln 368 cu.-in. V-8 tuned to produce <380ps>. Chassis enhancements included the front and rear suspension constructed to provide competition spec handling. Nearly every piece of this car was customized, with the team saying it took an estimated 10,000 hours of work to complete the entire vehicle.
zh:
这辆2016年Gran Turismo奖得主车款总共耗费了10000小时的设计与制造工时。

“Gran Turismo Award”大奖授予美国汽车用品改装协会大展上的最佳改装车。2016年第14届奖项颁发给了这辆由定制专家团队为前赛车手布鲁斯·莱文以1951 Ford Custom Club Coupé为基础打造的汽车。改装工程耗时约1万个小时。

en:
It's the smartphone giant’s expression of automotive innovation.

Xiaomi has achieved global success in the world of smart devices. Utilizing the same technologies and innovative spirit, Xiaomi has turned its attention to the electric mobility market. Its debut model, the SU7 sports sedan, quickly found success, but development of the car did not end there. It was followed by a monster variant designed to challenge the preconceptions of BEVs. That car was the SU7 Ultra.

The SU7 Ultra used a three-motor all-wheel-drive system, placing one motor on the front axle and two on the rear. This configuration delivered a total system output of up to <1548ps>, with the “V-8-type” electric motors capable of spinning up to <27200rpm>—an unprecedented feat for a production model. This translated into extraordinary performance, with a
0-<100km/h> acceleration time of just 1.98 seconds and a top speed of <350km/h>.

Xiaomi has also left no stone unturned when it came to body innovation. High rigidity and low weight were realized through extensive use of carbon-fiber body panels and cell-to-body construction, seamlessly integrating the battery and chassis. This introduced an entirely new era of passenger-car construction.

The exterior was engineered for maximum aerodynamic efficiency, with the carbon-fiber body kit generating up to <285kg> of downforce. Special attention has also been given to braking performance—its brakes enable the car to decelerate from <100km/h> to a complete stop in just <30.8m>.

With its luxurious interior, electronically controlled active suspension, and the latest in ADAS technology, the SU7 also delivered outstanding cost performance. This ultimate mobility solution marked a turning point in the history of BEVs.
zh:
智能手机巨头推出的极致出行解决方案。

智能设备厂商小米进军汽车市场后推出的首款车型是小米SU7运动型轿车，小米SU7 Ultra是它的极致性能版本。该车的全轮驱动系统在前后轴布置了共三台电机，系统综合输出功率高达1,548 PS。其中布置于后轴的“V8”电机，功率输出超过所有当前量产车型，最高转速可达27,200 转每分。此外，深度的空气动力学研发使得该车能够产生285 公斤的下压力。

en:
This rare electric super car broke world speed records.

One electric motor on each of the four wheels. The Yangwang U9 is a revolutionary model that challenged conventional ideas of the electric supercar.

Released by Yangwang, BYD’s luxury brand, it used the proprietary e⁴ platform, featuring four electric motors and delivering a total system output of 960 kW, or roughly <1305ps>. It accelerated from 0-<100km/h> in 2.36 seconds. It boasted a level of performance that could easily mask its status as a heavyweight EV.

But the U9’s appeal extended beyond raw power. The “DiSus-X” suspension system integrated hydraulic and pneumatic controls to manage body balance, at times lifting the tires off the ground and, at others, enabling dynamic movement. This system was not merely theatrical—it formed the technical core of the U9, with four-wheel independent control delivering exceptional stability and precision.

Designed by Wolfgang Egger, the scissor-door coupe presented a futuristic form while retaining the presence expected of a supercar.

In 2025, the high-performance U9 Xtreme variant attempted a world speed record, reaching <496.22km/h>. The Yangwang U9 stands as a clear expression of power and technology and a defining symbol of speed in the electrified era.
zh:
这款稀有的电动超级跑车刷新了世界速度纪录。

作为比亚迪旗下豪华品牌仰望发布的车型，U9致力于在电动车时代定义性能、技术与速度的终极标杆。此车基于品牌专属的e⁴平台打造，采用四电机布局，系统综合动力输出高达960kW，即1,305 PS。全力加速下，此车仅用2.36秒即可完成0-100 公里/小时加速。2025年，U9的高性能版本U9 Xtreme对世界纪录发起挑战，并跑出了惊人的496.2 公里/小时。

A single-seat all-wheel-drive EV from the distinguished Czech manufacturer."

Leveraging the illustrious legacy of Škoda Motorsport, the Škoda Design Team crafted a visionary rendition of a single-seat, all-electric conceptual race car. Dubbed the Škoda Vision Gran Turismo, this creation was created exclusively for the Gran Turismo gaming series, marking the company's debut in this realm. Drawing inspiration from the iconic Škoda 1100 OHC Spyder race car of 1957, originally conceived for the esteemed 24 Hours of Le Mans, the Vision Gran Turismo paid homage to this legendary vehicle in a contemporary guise. It pledged an immersive and dynamic driving encounter, echoing the spirit of its revered predecessor.

The Škoda Vision Gran Turismo project began in 2019 when the design team revisited the iconic Škoda 1100 OHC. Initially, the team was debating whether to restore the 1100 OHC or create a futuristic iteration for the digital age. After consulting with Chief Designer Oliver Stefani, the Škoda Design team opted for a fresh innovative approach, creating a fusion of past and future.

This race concept pays homage to its legendary predecessor as well as incorporating the defining features of Škoda’s Modern Solid design language, as seen in its T-shaped headlights. What’s more, the Vision Gran Turismo showcased two distinct liveries: one reflecting the heritage of the famous Škoda 130 RS race car from the 1970s, and the other inspired by the Vision 7S concept car, which embodies Škoda´s Modern Solid Design philosophy.

The Škoda Vision Gran Turismo boasts a sleek exterior with crisp, clear lines and pronounced edges, mirroring the aesthetics of current Formula E racers. Its design is optimized for superior handling through active aerodynamics. Features like the aerodynamically sculpted body, and the striking, adaptive two-piece rear wing, all work together to dynamicaly adjust to driving conditions and boost performance.
